jobs.title: Barnevernskonsulenter
jobs.description:
Om oss

Barnevernstjenesten ligger organisert under seksjon Livsmestring i kommunalområdet Oppvekst og har ca. 80 årsverk. Vi er organisert etter en aldersinndelt spesialistmodell. Avdelingene er mottak-akutt og kontorfag, tre avdelinger for undersøkelse og tiltak (sped- og småbarn, barn og ungdom/ettervern), to avdelinger for omsorg (barn og ungdom/ettervern) og avdeling oppfølging. I tillegg har vi en rådgiver med ansvar for fag og kvalitet i tjenesten.

Avdeling omsorg ung har som hovedoppgave å sikre at ungdom som er plassert i fosterhjem eller institusjon får forsvarlig omsorg, og at
oppfølgingen er helhetlig og tilpasset den enkeltes behov. De er opptatt av å sikre god oppfølging, og har et stort fokus på tett samarbeid med fosterhjem, institusjon og øvrig samarbeidspartnere. De etterstreber å få til et godt samarbeid med biologisk familie. Avdelingen har også ansvar for ettervern. Avdelingen er en av to omsorgsavdelinger i tjenesten som jobber tett sammen. 

Avdeling undersøkelse og tiltak sped- og småbarn har som hovedoppgave å undersøke omsorgssituasjonen til de yngste barna og sikre at barn og familier som har behov for hjelp, får riktig hjelp til rett tid. Avdelingen arbeider med undersøkelser og oppfølging av hjelpetiltak, med særlig vekt på å ivareta de yngste barnas behov for trygghet, omsorg og god utvikling. De er opptatt av å ha et stort fokus på tidlig innsats, godt samarbeid med foreldre og tett samhandling med øvrige tjenester rundt barnet og familien. Avdelingen er en av tre undersøkelses- og tiltaksavdelinger i tjenesten som jobber tett sammen.

Les mer om Indre Østfold kommune som arbeidsplass og gode grunner til å jobbe hos oss på våre nettsider. 


Er du vår nye kollega? 

Vi har ledig tre 100 % faste stillinger som barnevernskonsulent med mulighet for rask tiltredelse. Stillingene er for tiden på avdeling omsorg ung (15-25 år) og undersøkelse- og tiltak sped- og småbarn (-1-6 år). Avdelingene har 8-9 faste stillinger samt fagleder og avdelingsleder. 

Vi søker etter deg som har et stort engasjement knyttet til at barn og unge skal ha gode oppvekstsvilkår og få utviklet sitt potensiale. Du må ha et godt menneskesyn, ha tro på at det bor gode ressurser i alle, og se barn og foreldre som dine viktigste samarbeidspartnere. Du må trives med omstilling og utvikling, samt se verdien av at vi er bedre sammen enn hver for oss.

Arbeidstiden er i hovedsak dagtid, men det må påregnes noe ettermiddags- og kveldsarbeid.


Hva gjør vi hos oss?

Som barnevernskonsulent hos oss vil du blant annet ha ansvaret for å

  • saksbehandle etter Lov om barnevern
  • utarbeide planer, evaluere tiltak og ha oppfølging
  • samarbeide på tvers av avdelinger i tjenesten og med andre hjelpetjenester i kommunen
  • samarbeide med kommuneadvokatene og forberede saker som skal behandles i nemnda/rettsapparatet
  • representere kommunen i rettsbehandlinger (barnevernsnemnd, tingrett, mm.)
  • aktivt bidra inn i arbeidet i avdelingen og i beslutningsprosesser

For stilling i avdeling undersøkelse og tiltak vil du også gjennomføre undersøkelser, fatte vedtak om hjelpetiltak og utarbeide planer.
For stilling i avdeling omsorg vil du i tillegg følge opp av barn under omsorg eller i ettervern i fosterhjem og på institusjon.

Andre oppgaver kan tillegges stillingen ved behov.

Hos oss får du muligheten til å utvikle deg faglig, være en del av et inkluderende arbeidsfellesskap og gjøre en forskjell - hver eneste dag.


Bli en del av vårt team!

Barnevernstjenesten er opptatt av å holde høy faglig kvalitet og sikre at arbeidet bygger på oppdatert kunnskap og forskning. Vi legger stor vekt på struktur, systematisk arbeid og god internkontroll. Sammen med kontinuerlig faglig utvikling mener vi dette er viktige forutsetninger for å kunne tilby forsvarlige tjenester av høy kvalitet. Tett oppfølging og veiledning av ansatte står sentralt i vårt arbeid og skal bidra til faglig trygghet, refleksjon og utvikling. 

Vi mener at et godt menneskesyn, solid barnefaglig kompetanse, sterke relasjonelle ferdigheter og god samarbeidskompetanse er avgjørende for å forstå barn og familiers behov, bygge tillit og bidra til positiv endring. Gjennom en kombinasjon av faglig kompetanse, gode relasjoner og systematisk arbeid ønsker vi å sikre at barn og familier får riktig hjelp til rett tid.


Kompetanse og erfaring

Du må ha

  • 3-årig bachelorgrad i barnevern eller sosialt arbeid, annen relevant utdanning på bachelornivå kan vurderes
  • gode norskkunnskaper, både skriftlig og muntlig
  • evne til å beherske digitale verktøy og data godt
  • førerkort klasse B

Det er ønskelig at du har

  • master i barnevern, sosialfag med fordypning i barnevern eller annen relevant master rettet mot målgruppen
  • relevant videreutdanning, kartleggingskompetanse m.m., særlig rettet mot målgruppen
  • erfaring med saksbehandling fra førstelinje barnevern
  • erfaring fra arbeid med barn og familier, særlig rettet mot målgruppen
  • erfaring fra bruk av familieråd/nettverksarbeid
  • kjennskap til barneverntjenestens kjerneoppgaver og har forståelse for hva arbeidet innebærer

Er du den vi ser etter?

Vi ønsker at du

  • er engasjert, positiv og ansvarsbevisst
  • er strukturert og har en systematisk arbeidsform
  • har gode samarbeids- og kommunikasjonsevner
  • er god til å reflektere i arbeidet og rundt din egen arbeidsutøvelse
  • kommer med nye ideer og er utviklingsorientert
  • er relasjonelt modig, trygg i deg selv og evner å jobbe selvstendig
  • trives med høyt arbeidstempo, varierende oppgaver og arbeidsmengde
  • er fleksibel, omstillingsdyktig og har god arbeidskapasitet

Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt.


Hos oss får du 
  • inkluderende læringsmiljø med erfarne kollegaer
  • utfordrende og spennende arbeidsoppgaver
  • ukentlig veiledning for nyansatte med fokus på faglig og personlig utvikling
  • gode parkeringsmuligheter utenfor arbeidsstedet med mulighet for lading av el-bil
  • tjenestebiler til disposisjon
  • mulighet til å ta relevant videreutdanning
  • inntil tolv lønnede dager velferdspermisjon i året per kalenderår, for eksempel inntil tre dager for tilvenning i barnehage
  • en av Norges beste pensjonsordninger som varer livet ut, inkludert både uførepensjon og etterlattepensjon
  • gode forsikringer og gunstige lånevilkår gjennom medlemskap i offentlig pensjonskasse
  • lønn i henhold til gjeldende tariffavtale, samt øvrige ordninger for lønnstillegg som kan gjøre seg gjeldende

Til deg som søker

Vedlegg til søknaden

For å kunne behandle søknaden din på best mulig måte, ber vi deg fylle ut fullstendig CV, samt laste opp attester og vitnemål når du søker. Dokumentasjonen på tidligere praksis og erfaring, er viktig for beregning av din ansiennitet og lønnsplassering ved en eventuell ansettelse.

Det stilles krav til at nødvendig dokumentasjon er levert før innplassering og beregning av lønn kan gjennomføres. 

Krav om politiattest

Før du tiltrer i stillingen må du fremvise godkjent politiattest som ikke er eldre enn tre måneder. 

Indre Østfold kommune mener det er viktig med mangfold og vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifiserte til å søke hos oss. 

Offentlig søkerliste

Vær klar over at navnet på søkere kan bli offentliggjort, selv om du som søker har bedt om å være unntatt søkerlisten. Du vil i så fall bli varslet om dette og får anledning til å trekke søknaden din hvis du ønsker det. 
Dersom du har ytret ønske om unntak fra søkerliste, ber vi deg følge med i din innboks for tilbakemelding fra oss. 

Søknad

Det er kun søknader som er sendt inn via denne utlysningen som vil bli vurdert. Søknaden sendes elektronisk via lenken «Søk stillingen» på denne siden.

Har du spørsmål om utfylling av elektronisk søknad, kan du kontakte Jobbnorge på telefon 75 54 22 20.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Indre Østfold kommune er Norges største jordbrukskommune med 47 900 innbyggere. Våre 3750 dyktige medarbeidere gjør hver dag en stor innsats for å styrke og utvikle tjenestetilbudet for innbyggerne.  

Kommunen består av to byer og flere tettsteder som alle har kort avstand til Oslo, Akershus og resten av Østfold. Vi har et blomstrende idretts- og kulturliv, et næringsliv i utvikling og et sterkt fellesskap med god tradisjon for frivillig innsats.

Vi er en ambisiøs kommune i vekst, med stort behov for flere ressurspersoner med den rette kompetansen og erfaringen. 
 
Bli med på å bygge kommunen vår videre! 
 
Les mer om oss på www.io.kommune.no

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in epigenetics at the K.G Jebsen Centre of Obesity Research (CORA)
jobs.description:
About the position 

Applications are invited for a 3-year position as postdoctoral researcher in epigenetics and obesity research at the newly established K.G Jebsen Centre of Obesity ReseArch (CORA). The position will be affiliated to Yvonne Böttcher’s research group at the Department of Clinical Molecular Biology (EpiGen) at Institute of Clinical Medicine, UiO, physically located at Campus Ahus (Akershus University Hospital).  

The project aims at investigating molecular mechanisms underlying weight regain and long-term weight loss maintenance using advanced molecular biology techniques. In particular, the project will investigate amongst other the concept of epigenetic memory of obesity in humans and closely collaborate with clinical environments involved in treatment of obesity  

The applicant will be involved in tasks related to epigenetic and epitranscriptomic mechanisms potentially being implicated in the regulation of human body weight and adipose tissue biology in general. We are looking for a candidate with extensive hands-on training on a broad spectrum of multiomics analyses in adipose tissue. The applicant will join a team with long-standing experience in translational obesity research whilst other groups in the department Is generally working on translational biomedical research focusing on Alzheimer´s, and cancer research in a precision medicine perspective. 


Project description

Obesity is a growing health problem worldwide. Metabolic surgery or use of GLP-1R analoga are efficient methods to induce significant weight loss in individuals with obesity. However, many individuals struggle to maintain a healthier body weight and often suffer from regain weight after treatment. The newly established K.G. Jebsen Center for obesity research (CORA), lead by Prof. Yvonne Böttcher, aims to understand the biological mechanisms underlying weight regain and obesity relapse, identify individuals at risk, and develop strategies for sustained weight loss and long-term weight maintenance.  

Yvonne Böttcher’ research group (https://functionalgeneticsofobesity.wordpress.com/) is investigating the role of epigenetic mechanisms in obesity, the molecular mechanisms imposed by DNA, RNA and histone modifications and their potential interplay with genetic risk variants. In CORA, the group will specifically focus on the role of epigenetic memory in adipose tissue after weight loss.  

The project aims at investigating mechanisms involved in metabolic memory in human adipose tissue and weight re-gain after weight loss in humans. The candidate will be closely involved in collaborations with excellent clinical environments in Norway and abroad. 

The successful applicant will will work on amongst others on human biomaterial and cell culture models to better understand the potential epigenetic mechanisms responsible for weight regain. The work will include advanced molecular biology techniques such as next generation sequencing and multi-omics technologies as well as potentially single-cell technologies. 

The position will require collaboration both within Norway, and internationally, with clinicians, molecular biologists and bioinformaticians/statisticians in other areas of the centre. The successful candidate is expected to become a driver of the project in close


Your areas of responsibility will be
  • Carry out high-quality scientific research
  • Publish results in high-impact, peer-reviewed scientific journals
  • Apply for research funding 
  • Disseminate research at national and international meetings and conferences 
  • Co-Mentoring of PhD and mentoring of master students 

Qualifications and competence

Qualification requirements:

  • A degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in molecular biology, biomedicine, genetics, or a closely related area. If the degree is not yet formally received, the doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the application date. Only applicants with an approved doctoral thesis and public defense are eligible for employment
  • Experience in epigenetics and/or obesity research 
  • Extensive experience in molecular biology laboratory work
  • Hands-on experience in one or more of the following:
    • Single cell sequencing techniques 
    • Omics techniques such as ChIP-seq, CUT & Run; CUT & Tag, ATAC-seq, Whole genome bisulphite sequencing, RNAseq, Nanopore sequencing, ribosome profiling
    • Work with human adipose tissue or primary adipocytes and relevant cell culture models such as 3T3L-1 adipocytes or SGBS cells 
    • Next generation sequencing data analysis 
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English
  • Published first author papers in well recognized journals

It is an advantage if you have:

  • Experience working with sensitive data in TSD  
  • Methodologal knowledge in cell sorting 
  • Basic programming skills (R/Python/Unix) 
  • Competence in statistics (R/SPSS/Stata) 

Personal characteristics
  • Team player
  • Self-driven/ independent  
  • Structured and well organized 
  • Good communication and collaboration skills 
  • Positive and enthusiastic 
     

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We can offer you
  • A stimulating environment at a high scientific level at CORA, with possibilities for extensive cross-diciplinary collaborations
  • Excellent laboratory facilities at EpiGen 
  • Career development programs through the Postdoctoral programme (The Medical Faculty, UiO), and through the K.G. Jebsen academy for young scientists 
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Salary in position as Postdoctoral Fellow, position code 1352 in salary range NOK from 595 00 to 679 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal


Application

Your application should include:

  • Application letter
  • CV
  • A complete list of publications separating original publications from review articles
  • Transcripts and certificates
  • Contact information for 2-3 references

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews. 

No one can be appointed for more than one Postdoctoral Research Fellowship at the University of Oslo. 

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian) and Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO. 

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Institute of Clinical Medicine (Klinmed) is one of three institutes under the Faculty. Klinmed is responsible for the Faculty's educational and research activities at Oslo University Hospital and Akershus University Hospital. With about 900 employees spread over approximately 425 man-labour years, Klinmed is the university's largest institute. Our activities follow the clinical activity at the hospitals and are spread across a number of geographical areas.

jobs.title: Granlund: Senior Full Stack Developer (C#, React)
jobs.description:
**Type**: Full-time, permanent

**Location**: Malminkaari 21, 00700 Helsinki

**Application deadline**: 26.10.2026

Experienced with C#/.NET and React? Join Granlund to take ownership of a growing software platform and shape its future development!

**What will you be doing?**

Granlund is looking for a **Senior Full Stack Developer** to further develop its Design Data Management (DDM) platform. DDM transforms building information models into structured, usable data for cost, lifecycle, and 4D calculations. The platform is already in production, with new features and use cases actively being explored. Your work will help turn these opportunities into practical solutions for the construction and real estate industry.

In this role, you will develop the DDM platform, focusing mainly on C#/.NET backend development and SQL Server, while also working with React and TypeScript on the frontend. You will develop new features end-to-end, improve existing functionality, and propose practical technical and architectural solutions. Your responsibilities will also include maintaining code quality through automated testing and controlled releases.

You will collaborate with colleagues across different business areas to develop solutions that address real business needs. Beyond implementing new features, you will evaluate technical feasibility and help prioritize development efforts. Initially, your focus will include turning existing proofs of concept into usable features.

**What makes you a great fit?**

We are looking for an experienced developer who has a strong background in software development and actively uses AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor. You understand software architecture, can critically evaluate AI-generated code, and enjoy building software.

You take ownership of your work and approach development with a practical, business-oriented mindset. You can assess business needs, identify what is worth developing, and suggest technical solutions that make sense. You also know when something is not worth implementing and can explain why.

You are comfortable working independently in a small team and collaborating with others to make technical decisions. You don't need previous experience in construction or real estate; we welcome applications from developers across all industries.

**We hope you have:**

- Several years of backend development experience, ideally with C#/.NET, and strong SQL skills

- Experience with React and TypeScript, and the ability to develop frontend features independently

- A good understanding of software architecture, clean code, and automated testing

- Hands-on experience building software with AI coding agents, and the judgement to review their output

- Good communication skills in English or Finnish


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience with Python and data processing tools, such as FastAPI, pandas, pyarrow, or IfcOpenShell

- Experience working with large language models or developing AI-powered features

- Familiarity with Azure services and CI/CD pipelines

- Experience combining data from different sources into structured, usable information

- Experience in product development, startups, or other environments requiring broad technical ownership.


**What does Granlund offer you?**

- An opportunity to take ownership of a growing software platform and directly influence its technical development.

- Meaningful work turning complex building data into solutions that support smarter and more sustainable construction.

- The freedom to shape technical solutions and see your ideas progress from early concepts into working features.

- A small, collaborative team within an established company, with potential to grow into product or team leadership.

- Flexible remote and hybrid working arrangements that allow you to combine independent development with in-person collaboration.

- Comprehensive employee benefits, including occupational healthcare, sports and cultural benefits, and professional development opportunities.


**Practicalities**

This is a permanent, full-time position, and you will be employed directly by Granlund. The role offers flexible remote and hybrid working arrangements. Still, we hope you are based in the Helsinki metropolitan area or nearby to make it easier to meet in person for collaboration and workshops at Granlund's office in Malmi when needed. We hope you can start as soon as possible, but the exact start date is negotiable.

Salary in this position is approximately 6000-8000 €/month. The final salary will be determined based on your experience and expertise. Granlund also offers a company-wide performance bonus scheme.

**Recruitment process**

- Remote interviews with aTalent

- Two rounds of interviews with Granlund, conducted remotely and/or in person


**Interested? We'd love to hear from you!**

Submit your application and CV in PDF-format latest by the 26th of October via our application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/390936/create/.

We review applications throughout the application period in the order they are received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we only accept applications through our recruitment system, not by email.

We welcome applicants from different backgrounds and are committed to an inclusive recruitment process. We will accommodate individual accessibility needs whenever possible. You can learn more about Granlund at www.granlund.fi. For more information about the recruitment process contact aTalents Managing Recruitment Consultant Sofia Latva-Koivisto (+358 50 321 4473, sofia.latva-koivisto(at)atalent.fi). If Sofia is unable to answer your call, please leave a text message and she will get back to you.

jobs.title: Total Rewards Analyst
jobs.description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $100M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

    We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
    

    We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
    We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The role

As Total Rewards Analyst, you'll be the analytical backbone of Legora's reward function — turning data into insight across compensation, equity, benefits, and mobility. You'll work directly within the Total Rewards team, reporting to the VP of Total Rewards, and collaborate closely with the Total Rewards Manager.

This is a role for someone who is energised by making sense of complex data, building robust processes, and making sure every part of our reward engine runs smoothly and accurately.

What you will do

    Build and maintain reward reporting and dashboards covering compensation, equity, benefits, and mobility — enabling the team and leadership to make data-informed decisions.
    

    Support compensation benchmarking cycles: gather and clean market data, model scenarios, and present findings clearly.
    Analyse equity data to track grant activity, vesting milestones, and programme performance across regions.
    Build and improve People operations processes across the reward function — creating workflows and documentation that reduce manual effort and increase accuracy.
    Support the administration of benefits programmes across markets, coordinating with external vendors and ensuring data accuracy.
    Support the mobility programme operationally — coordinating documentation, timelines, and third-party providers.
    Help prepare materials for employee and manager communications on compensation, benefits, and equity topics, and contribute to reward-related compliance activities as needed.

Who you are

You love digging into data to find patterns and build clarity out of complexity. You're a natural problem-solver with a keen eye for process, accuracy, and making things run better.

We think you'll thrive here if you have:

    3+ years of experience in a People, Reward, Finance, or Operations analyst role — ideally in a high-growth or international environment.
    

    Strong analytical skills with experience handling complex datasets; proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets is essential, and experience with HRIS or reward tools is a plus.
    Familiarity with compensation frameworks, equity programmes, or benefits administration — even if not a specialist in all areas.
    High attention to detail and comfort working with sensitive, confidential data.
    A process-builder mindset: you don't just do the work, you look for ways to make the work better.
    Clear and confident communicator, able to present data and findings simply to a range of stakeholders.

Why Legora

This is an exceptional opportunity to grow within a reward function that's building from the ground up. You'll gain broad exposure across every dimension of total rewards — compensation, equity, benefits, and mobility — while working alongside experienced people leaders in a company with real momentum.

We value clarity, humility, and impact. Your work will directly support the team that shapes how every Legora employee is rewarded. We're just getting started.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description:
Job ID: 6455

Core Technology Change & Delivery is seeking an experienced Lead Project Leader to drive the delivery of critical technology capabilities enabling safe, scalable and compliant AI adoption across Nordea.

In this role, you will lead a portfolio of interdependent initiatives spanning AI governance, Identity & Access Management, network connectivity and security. You will translate strategic AI ambitions into executable delivery plans, establish effective governance and coordinate dependencies across architecture, infrastructure, security, risk and business teams.

You will play a key role in ensuring that foundational capabilities - including identity and privileged access, secure connectivity, network segmentation, platform controls and enterprise guardrails - are delivered in a coordinated, transparent and predictable manner.

About our team

Core Technology Change & Delivery team is responsible for the Project & Programme management, the delivery & execution and governance of our Change Initiatives  to ensure we meet our commitments in adherence to our Core Tech Operating Model and according to Nordea Delivery Guide.

Main responsibilities in this role:

    Lead end-to-end delivery of AI governance and technology-enabler initiatives across IAM, network and security domains.
    Establish and maintain integrated delivery plans covering scope, milestones, dependencies, resources, financials, risks and expected outcomes.
    Coordinate delivery across architecture, AI platform, IAM, network, security, cloud, risk, compliance and business teams.
    Translate AI platform and governance roadmaps into executable programmes and clearly sequenced delivery plans.
    Drive the implementation of foundational capabilities required for secure AI adoption, including identity federation, privileged access, connectivity, segmentation, platform security and enterprise guardrails.
    Establish governance frameworks, decision-making forums, controls and operating models supporting the adoption of emerging AI technologies.
    Facilitate governance and approval processes in line with internal policies, regulatory requirements and Nordea’s delivery framework.
    Proactively manage cross-domain dependencies, risks, issues and delivery constraints, escalating where required to maintain momentum and predictable execution.
    Drive alignment between enterprise architecture, security requirements, regulatory obligations and technology delivery roadmaps.
    Ensure operational readiness, including service ownership, support models, resilience, security controls and transition to operations.
    Provide senior stakeholders with concise, decision-oriented reporting on delivery status, financials, risks, dependencies and required actions.
    Promote a strong delivery culture based on ownership, transparency, collaboration and continuous improvement.

Who you are

This is the right role for you if: you are a collaborative, pragmatic and solution-oriented leader who can bring diverse stakeholders together, challenge constructively and create clarity in a complex delivery environment. You combine strong programme leadership with enough understanding of AI governance, identity, network and security principles to ask the right questions, manage dependencies and drive informed decisions.  

Your background and skills include:

    Proven track record in leading complex cross-functional technology programmes.
    Strong experience coordinating initiatives spanning Identity & Access Management, Network, Security or enterprise governance functions.
    Experience establishing governance frameworks, controls and operating models supporting adoption of emerging technologies.
    Ability to manage complex dependency landscapes across infrastructure, security, architecture, risk and business stakeholders.
    Experience driving delivery of foundational technology capabilities required by strategic programmes and platforms.
    Strong understanding of security, regulatory and compliance considerations related to cloud and AI technologies.
    Experience facilitating governance forums and steering committees involving senior business and technology leaders.
    Ability to drive alignment between enterprise architecture, security requirements and technology delivery roadmaps.
    Strong understanding of identity, privileged access, connectivity, segmentation, platform security and risk management principles.
    Experience managing large-scale stakeholder ecosystems and influencing decisions across organisational boundaries.
    Very good financial and resource management skills.
    Very good analytical skills and attention to detail.
    Advanced presentation skills, especially PowerPoint and Excel.
    Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
    Excellent English skills, both spoken and written.
    Can-do attitude.

It would be ideal if you also:

    Have an interest in AI governance, AI platforms and emerging technology trends.
    Have experience working in highly regulated environments.
    Understand cloud platform operating models and enterprise security controls.
    Can translate strategic objectives into executable delivery plans and measurable outcomes.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

The recruitment process consists of the following steps:

    Preliminary CV selection
    Online interview with the hiring leader
    Background check

For union information, please contact Finansförbundet at finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACO at SacoNordea@nordea.com.

jobs.title: Senior Engagement Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

About the Role


The way legal work gets done is changing, and Engagement is at the centre of that transformation. We're looking for an experienced Engagement Manager to own Legora's global relationship with one of the Big 4, one of our most significant partnerships, and to fundamentally change the way that firm works with Legora.

This is a role for someone who has led change inside large, complex organisations and knows that real transformation is designed and managed. You will own the adoption and long-term success of this client globally: building the relationships, defining the outcomes and serving as the trusted adviser and orchestrator who turns Legora into an embedded part of how their teams operate.

Global means global. You will set the strategy for how the firm adopts Legora worldwide, and Engagement Managers in other regions will run their local programmes against the direction and decisions you set. Day to day, you will be the point of contact for the firm's UK and Ireland practice from our London office, and you will travel regularly to other
member firms in the network to build those relationships and land the programme on the ground. Expect to be travelling around 25% of the time.

At the heart of the role is designing the client's adoption playbook and delivering a multi-year change-management programme that transforms how they work. You will build the roadmap, sequence initiatives from initial rollout through firm-wide scaled adoption, define measurable outcomes and ROI and evolve the programme as new AI capabilities and use cases emerge.

You will be critical as we continue to build a best-in-class adoption programme at Legora, helping the client realise measurable ROI, expand successful use cases and transform the way their teams work.

What You'll Do


You'll own the global relationship end to end, leading the post-sale experience across every member firm we work with. Specifically, you will:


● Set the global adoption strategy for the account and lead its execution across regions. Engagement Managers in other markets will deliver their local programmes against the strategy and decisions you set, and you will be accountable for coherence and outcomes globally.
● Act as the primary point of contact for the firm's UK and Ireland practice, while travelling frequently to other member firms to build senior relationships and support local delivery in person.
● Design the client's adoption playbook: the tailored change-management approach, stakeholder map and target outcomes for how the firm adopts Legora and transforms the way it works.
● Execute against that playbook, sequencing initiatives from initial rollout to enterprise-wide scaled adoption and adapting as the client's needs and Legora's capabilities evolve.
● Act as a strategic adviser who deeply understands the client's goals and legal and professional services workflows, surfaces high-impact opportunities and guides teams towards maximum value from Legora.
● Drive sustained value through a structured operating cadence: success plans, enablement, stakeholder check-ins, training and value reviews.
● Orchestrate engagement from cross-functional teams to accelerate client success (GTM, Product, Legal Engineering, Engineering, Marketing, Support), maintaining end-to-end account context and coordination globally.
● Partner with GTM on key commercial moments to ensure seamless transitions, continuity and exceptional customer experience, and to identify and realise expansion opportunities across the account.
● Translate customer feedback into action by collaborating closely with Product, Engineering and Marketing to inform roadmap, positioning and enablement.


What You Bring


You care deeply about customer outcomes and you know that transformation has to be designed and led. You're proactive, strategic and comfortable steering demanding, senior stakeholders through significant change. You take pride in being the reason customers adopt, grow and succeed.

We're looking for:


● 5+ years experience in management consulting, legal, LegalTech or customer success in an AI-native B2B vertical.
● Extensive experience working with or inside a Big 4 firm is highly desirable, we want someone who already understands how these firms are structured, how decisions get made and how change actually lands across member firms.
● A consulting or transformation background, with a demonstrated track record of designing and delivering change-management programmes inside large, complex organisations.
● Experience building tailored transformation roadmaps and adoption plans and steering them to measurable outcomes.
● A track record of driving adoption, retention and satisfaction with enterprise clients and senior stakeholders.
● Experience leading through influence rather than direct authority. You will set the direction that colleagues in other regions deliver against, so you need to be able to bring people with you.
● Experience working with legal, compliance or other regulated and complex industries or the ability to learn a complex domain exceptionally fast.
● Strong programme and project management skills; you keep multi-workstream initiatives moving and your clients confident.
● Excellent communication skills — written, verbal and interpersonal. You can lead boardroom conversations with legal and professional services leaders and roll up your sleeves with hands-on teams.
● High EQ: you know when to listen, when to advise and when to act.
● A love of fast-paced, early-stage environments where you help build the playbook, not just follow it.
● Fluency with metrics and driven by data, customer health and outcomes over process.
● Willingness to travel internationally around 25% of the time.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Programme Manager (Trade)
jobs.description:
Powering Great Work

We started as the place to find a trusted trade. Now, as we shape the future of home improvement, we're building the tech to transform that landscape for everyone - better products, smarter data, AI where it actually helps - so trades can spend less time on admin and consumers can find someone they trust, first time. That's Powering Great Work, and it's why every team here exists:

🔧 Trades spend less time on admin and more on winning work and growing their business

🏠 Homeowners get a trusted trade, first time, every time

🚀 We get to build products that change homes and lives across the country

As Programme Manager (Trade) in Retention, you'll turn strategy into delivery that actually sticks. You won't manage the teams, but you'll shape how they work, what they work on, and whether the initiatives our Head of Operations is driving make it into everyday practice. You'll sit across the whole of Trade Lifecycle, working with Finance, Product, Engineering, Sales and CRM so the right things get built, rolled out and embedded, not just kicked off.

The job, unfiltered:

  • Own the delivery of Trade Lifecycle's most critical initiatives end to end, from scoping and planning through to execution and review.

  • Lead tooling and systems changes across Retention, Credit Control and Trade Support: define requirements, manage timelines and make sure the teams can use the new systems well.

  • Spot where processes are inconsistent, undocumented or breaking under scale, and fix them.

  • Run the change management side: stakeholder communication, rollout sequencing, training and adoption tracking, so new ideas don't fade after launch.

  • Be the senior point of coordination between Trade Lifecycle and Finance, Product, Engineering, Sales and CRM.

  • Build and maintain the reporting that shows whether strategic initiatives are working, and own the KPI framework for transformation delivery.

The fit:

  • Depth of experience in a programme, operations or strategy delivery role, ideally in a high-growth tech or marketplace business.

  • A track record of delivering complex, cross-functional initiatives from design to measurable outcome. Not just managing the plan, but owning the result.

  • Strong project management instincts: you hold several workstreams at once, spot dependencies before they become blockers and keep senior stakeholders informed without overwhelming them.

  • Experience leading tooling or systems rollouts in an operational environment, and you understand the change management challenge as well as the technical one.

  • Confidence with project management tools (Jira, Asana, Monday or similar) and reporting tools (Tableau, Looker, or advanced Sheets/Excel).

(Don't self-select out because you don't tick every box. We'd rather meet you.)

What you get

💰 Competitive salary, annual bonus & equity scheme

🩺 Health, wellbeing and learning support

🚲 Gym membership, Smart Tech Scheme, Cycle Scheme

🎂 Birthday/special day leave, buy & sell holiday scheme

❤️ 1 week's paid charity leave, and more

How this goes

  • Screening call with one of our Talent Acquisition Partners

  • First stage: interview with Head of Operations

  • Second stage interview with our Operations Manager

  • Final stage: panel interview including case study

Not this one? Stay close anyway. Join the Talent Community and we'll ping you the second something better fits.

 

About us

We’re Checkatrade – the UK’s leading platform for finding a tradesperson. With more than 50,000 trades listed and over 6 million reviews, we help homeowners get jobs done right and help tradespeople grow their business.

We’re growing fast, with big plans to become the go-to brand for home improvements. If you care about great work, take pride in the details, and want to make an impact, you’ll fit right in.

jobs.title: Head of Enablement
jobs.description:
Head of Enablement

Do you love building something from scratch, and turning busy professionals into confident users of cutting-edge technology?

We’re looking for a Head of Enablement to build and lead the function that educates thousands of users on Aveni Assist and Aveni Detect. Our clients buy Aveni for their advice and compliance teams and your job is to win them over with programmes that are engaging, scalable, and genuinely useful.

About Aveni

Aveni is an award-winning technology company. We use advanced AI to enable scalable efficiency for financial services companies, combining world-leading Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Large Language Model (LLM) expertise with deep financial services domain experience to drive enterprise-wide productivity. We’re using the latest in AI to automate and innovate, empowering businesses to achieve exceptional productivity and compliance outcomes.

About the Role

This is a build role. Our user base has grown to thousands of users on Assist alone, and a single client can have 2,500 users to train. You’ll design how enablement works at Aveni - the processes, standards, tooling, and team structure - and maybe even launch an Aveni Certification across different user types.

Core Focus Allocation

  • 60% Framework & Process: Process design, programme architecture, and training automation.

  • 20% Team Leadership: Hiring, coaching, and scaling your enablement team.

  • 20% Hands-On Delivery: High-impact in-person and online training execution if we hit capacity

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Enablement Strategy: Own enablement for Assist and Detect, defining what great looks like for each user type and customer segment.

  • Aveni Certification: Design and launch programmes featuring LMS courses, quizzes, and digital badges aligned to our delivery model.

  • Scalable Programmes: Build onboarding, new-joiner, refresher, and feature-launch training that reaches thousands of users with minimal manual effort.

  • Blended Delivery: Run in-person and online training, delivering critical sessions yourself where it matters most or where we have hit capacity.

  • Operating Model: Set the operational processes, scheduling rhythm, and quality expectations for the team.

  • Measurement & Analytics: Track engagement, completion, adoption, and competency, using data to continuously improve outcomes.

  • Team Leadership: Hire, coach, and grow a high-performing team

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with Customer Success, Implementation, Product, and Sales.

What We’re Looking For

  • Function Builder: Proven experience building an enablement, training, or customer education function and establishing its operational model.

  • Training Manager Background: Strong hands-on experience delivering training both in person and online.

  • Enterprise Certification Design: Experience designing programmes or certifications in an LMS for thousands of end users.

  • B2B2C / Large-Scale Adoption: Experience enabling the end users of enterprise client organisations at scale.

  • Customer Adoption Journeys: Proven track record running customer-facing onboarding and adoption journeys.

  • Key Attributes: Quick-thinking, emotionally intelligent, customer-obsessed, and process-driven.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with both high-touch and self-serve enablement models.

  • Financial services, wealth management, or regulated industry experience.

  • Background in automating customer training journeys.

  • Scale-up or start-up experience.

Benefits

  • Environment & Culture: Collaborative, innovative work environment with substantial career growth opportunities.

  • Time Off: 34 days holiday plus your birthday off (inclusive of bank holidays).

  • Equity: Share options—we believe in shared success.

  • Professional Growth: Skills development and continuous learning support.

  • Work Flexibility: Fully remote and flexible working options (remote, co-working spaces, or hybrid).

  • Health & Protection: Life insurance, income protection, and private healthcare.

  • Wellbeing: 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) for emotional wellbeing.

  • Perks & Savings: Cycle to Work scheme, pension match up to 5%, and exclusive retailer discounts.

Join Us in Making a Difference

At Aveni, we believe that diversity drives innovation. We’re committed to building a team that reflects the diverse communities we serve and creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best work. We know that some people only apply when they meet 100% of the requirements, but we’d like to hear from you anyway.

Apply now to join us on our mission to transform the financial services industry through AI.

jobs.title: Post-doctorant.e en conception de catalyseurs bimétalliques et multifonctionnels pour la conversion directe du CO2 en carburants liquides (H/F) – CDD 11 mois
jobs.description:
ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE :

École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation.

Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être.

IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient.

Les activités du centre RAPSODEE sont structurées en deux groupes de recherche dans les domaines de l’énergie, de l’environnement et du génie particulaire avec un accent particulier sur des procédés durables : plus intenses, plus économes en énergie, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus sûrs.

Le poste est ouvert dans le fond propre d’IMT Mines Albi. Une collaboration avec le laboratoire de chimie de coordination (LCC) à Toulouse est prévue.

 

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE :

A ce jour, les carburants fossiles sont encore largement utilisés dans les différents secteurs industriels et notamment pour le secteur de transport, qui sont une source importante d’émission de gaz à effet de serre. Pour réduire l’impact environnemental du secteur de transport, les carburants de synthèse jouent un rôle important, en particulier pour le transport aérien de demain. Parmi les voies de R&D étudiées à ce jour pour la production de ces carburants de synthèse, le captage du CO2 et l’hydrogénation directe de ce CO2 par de l’hydrogène obtenu par l’électrolyse de l’eau avec de l’électricité renouvelable est une voie stratégique. L'un de leurs atouts majeurs réside dans l’optimisation de la production pour minimiser le coût du produit final, et la compatibilité des carburants de synthèse avec les infrastructures et les flottes existantes.

Ce projet, qui réunit deux laboratoires (RAPSODEE à Albi, et LCC à Toulouse), vise à produire des carburants alternatifs par hydrogénation directe du CO2 via une synthèse de Fischer-Tropsch à partir de CO2 (CO2-FTS). Ce processus se décompose en deux étapes successives : (i) l'hydrogénation du CO2 en CO (réaction inverse du gaz à l'eau, ou RWGS), suivie (ii) de l'hydrogénation du CO en hydrocarbures (synthèse de Fischer-Tropsch, ou FTS). Ce projet continue la recherche récente entre les deux laboratoires sur le même sujet, en développant des systèmes catalytiques multifonctionnels assurant la conversion, en une seule étape, dans un seul réacteur et à une seule condition de température et de pression, du CO2 et H2 en carburants liquides. Une attention particulière sera accordée à l’ingénierie de la composition, de la structure et de l’environnement des sites actifs, afin d’établir des relations structure-activité et de comprendre le rôle de chaque composant métallique dans les différentes étapes réactionnelles. Cette stratégie vise à dépasser les limitations des catalyseurs conventionnels en améliorant leur activité, sélectivité, stabilité et résistance à la désactivation. Le projet contribuera ainsi au développement d’une nouvelle génération de catalyseurs multifonctionnels pour la valorisation directe et durable du CO2 en carburants et produits chimiques à valeur ajoutée.

Les missions sont les suivantes :

  •        Etat de l’art : Une étude bibliographique est prévue sur les derniers travaux publiés sur ce sujet, pour compléter le travail réalisé en début de 2026.

  •        Synthèse et caractérisation des catalyseurs multifonctionnels : des catalyseurs bimétalliques et multifonctionnels à base de fer et/ou de cobalt pour la conversion directe du CO2 en hydrocarbures par voie Fischer-Tropsch seront développés. L’objectif sera d’obtenir des matériaux présentant une synergie contrôlée entre différentes fonctions catalytiques, permettant de favoriser simultanément l’activation/hydrogénation du CO2, la formation des intermédiaires carbonés et leur transformation sélective en chaînes hydrocarbonées. Les paramètres à étudier sont : la modification des supports catalytiques par des promoteurs efficaces ; le contrôle de la taille, la forme et la composition de la phase active, le contrôle de l’équilibre entre les fonctions pour l’activation du CO2 et de l’hydrogène. Ces matériaux seront caractérisés par différentes méthodes de caractérisation conventionnelles ou avancées.

  •        Evaluation des systèmes catalytiques en CO2-FTS : Les catalyseurs synthétisés seront évalués à l’échelle laboratoire. La performance des meilleurs catalyseurs pourra être évaluée à l’échelle pilote.

  •        Valorisation des résultats : Les résultats obtenus feront l’objet de la valorisation sous forme de brevet et ensuite communiqués dans les congrès et les journaux scientifiques.

 

CAPACITE ET ATTITUDES :

Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables :

Des compétences solides en catalyse hétérogène, en particulier pour la conversion du CO2 sont recherchées.

Capacités et aptitudes :

Des qualités de synthèse, d’organisation et de communication sont également nécessaires pour mener à bien les missions de ce poste.

PROFIL RECHERCHE :

Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat obtenu il y a moins de 3 ans.

AU-DELÀ DE L’ENVIRONNEMENT PROFESSIONNEL, POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ? :

  • 49 jours de congés par an

  • restauration administrative sur place

  • aide à la mobilité durable pour le transport domicile-travail

  • action sociale (protection sociale complémentaire et aide aux familles)

 

INFORMATIONS COMPLÉMENTAIRES :

Des déplacements entre les deux laboratoires sont prévus. Un permis de conduire B est un plus.

jobs.title: IT Service Specialist  Server & Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Boliden is a high-tech metals company with its own mines and smelters that works long-term to guarantee society's access to base and precious metals. For a century, our work has been part of the value chains that have shaped modern society. At Boliden, we know that the metals we mine and make available will continue to play a crucial role in the future – what matters is how we produce them. Become a part of us and drive change for generations to come.  

Your opportunity

Do you want to take ownership of business-critical server infrastructure in a high-tech industrial environment? As our IT Service Specialist in Aitik, you will help ensure stable, secure and efficient IT services while contributing to future-ready infrastructure solutions. This is a varied specialist role with significant responsibility, technical breadth and the opportunity to make a visible impact on daily operations.

Who you will work with

You will be part of Aitik's local IT organisation, a group of approximately ten colleagues. Collaboration extends across local IT disciplines, central specialist teams, other Boliden sites and external suppliers. The team shares knowledge and works across boundaries.

What you will do

You will be responsible for the operation and lifecycle of the Aitik server environment. Your work will include:

    Operating, administering, maintaining, installing, and upgrading server environments, Windows/Linux.

    Working with Active Directory, Group Policy, virtualisation, storage, backup and physical server hardware.

    Supporting secure infrastructure design, system segmentation, and implementation of new systems.

    Handling incidents, troubleshooting technical issues, and contributing to root cause analysis.

    Planning capacity, monitoring performance and improving availability, resilience, and recovery capability.

    Driving continuous improvement through automation, standardisation and clear technical documentation.

    Working with suppliers and internal stakeholders to turn different requirements into secure, practical, and maintainable solutions.



What you bring

You have several years of hands-on experience in server operations and infrastructure and can quickly understand an existing environment, set priorities and work independently. You are comfortable taking responsibility for delivery, while knowing when to involve colleagues or central specialists. You combine analytical problem solving with a structured and security-conscious approach. Collaboration comes naturally to you, and you communicate clearly with technical specialists, suppliers, and other stakeholders. You are curious, proactive and motivated by continuous improvement.

    Completed upper-secondary education. Relevant post-secondary IT education is an advantage.
    Several years of experience in server operation and infrastructure.

    Strong knowledge of Windows Server and Active Directory, including Group Policy.

    Experience of virtualisation platforms such as VMware and/or Hyper-V, as well as storage and backup solutions.

    Experience in IT security, infrastructure architecture, and secure implementation of systems.

    Professional proficiency in spoken and written English.

    A valid category B driving license for manual transmission.

Experience from agile ways of working, automation, PowerShell, Azure or hybrid environments is considered an advantage. Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes, is considered an advantage. Cisco or other relevant vendor certifications are also an advantage. Swedish language skills are beneficial but not required.

Why work with us

At Boliden, we believe in promoting a workplace where care, courage, and responsibility are central to everything we do. We offer a workplace where we believe in collaboration and where what you contribute will have a direct impact on future generations. We are a company made up of responsible and creative people all working towards the same vision; to become the most sustainable and respected metal supplier in the world.

Apply today to be part of something truly meaningful!

At Boliden, diversity and inclusion are drivers of innovation. We know that different perspectives and experiences strengthen us and help us stay at the forefront of an important and exciting industry. Therefore, we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and viewpoints. Together, we build a workplace where everyone can feel safe and inspired to reach their full potential.

jobs.title: Senior Data Center Operations Engineer H/F
jobs.description:
📍 Paris / Île-de-France | Environnement Data Center | CDI | Périmètre multisite

Rejoignez mon client au cœur des infrastructures critiques.

Dans un contexte de forte croissance et de développement de ses infrastructures, mon client renforce son organisation Operations en France et crée un poste de Chief Engineer.

Au sein d'un nouvel pôle d'expertise technique transverse, vous devenez le référent technique des opérations sur plusieurs sites stratégiques en France, avec un périmètre prioritaire couvrant notamment deux sites.

Votre mission : apporter votre expertise, sécuriser les opérations et contribuer à faire progresser l'ensemble de l'organisation vers davantage de standardisation, de rigueur opérationnelle et d'excellence technique.

Ce poste s'adresse à un profil expérimenté qui souhaite aller au-delà de l'expertise technique pure et jouer un rôle central dans la structuration des opérations d'un acteur Data Center en pleine croissance.

Vos missions

Votre rôle

Le Chief Engineer intervient comme référent technique et opérationnel multisite.

Vous êtes à la fois :

  • un expert technique capable de challenger les équipes et les prestataires ;

  • un référent opérationnel garant de la sécurisation des opérations ;

  • un acteur transverse capable de fédérer des équipes aux profils et niveaux d'expérience différents.

Vous disposez d'une véritable autorité technique : lorsque les conditions de sécurité ou de maîtrise des risques ne sont pas réunies, vous êtes capable de challenger une opération et, si nécessaire, de prononcer un NO GO sur un mode opératoire ou une intervention.

Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les responsables de site, qui conservent la responsabilité opérationnelle de leur périmètre.

Vos principales missions

1 - Être le référent technique des infrastructures critiques

Vous apportez votre expertise sur l'ensemble des infrastructures techniques du Data Center et êtes capable d'en comprendre les interactions et les impacts opérationnels.

Votre périmètre couvre notamment :

  • les infrastructures électriques HT/BT ;

  • les systèmes de secours électrique ;

  • les UPS / onduleurs ;

  • les groupes électrogènes ;

  • les infrastructures CVC / HVAC ;

  • les systèmes de refroidissement ;

  • la protection et la sécurité incendie ;

  • les systèmes de contrôle-commande et infrastructures associées.

Vous intervenez comme référent technique auprès des responsables de site et des équipes Operations, et êtes capable de challenger les différents interlocuteurs internes ou externes sur leurs choix et leurs pratiques.

2 - Sécuriser les opérations

L'une de vos responsabilités majeures sera de garantir que les opérations réalisées sur les infrastructures critiques sont préparées et exécutées dans les meilleures conditions de sécurité et de maîtrise des risques.

À ce titre, vous :

  • challengez les modes opératoires (MOP) ;

  • vérifiez la cohérence et l'exhaustivité des procédures ;

  • identifiez les risques et leurs impacts potentiels ;

  • sécurisez les opérations avant leur réalisation ;

  • challengez les premières analyses et propositions d'intervention ;

  • pouvez émettre un NO GO lorsqu'une opération ne présente pas les garanties nécessaires ;

  • accompagnez les responsables de site dans la prise de décision technique ;

  • contribuez à la mise en place de mécanismes de double vérification.

Vous êtes en quelque sorte le garde-fou technique de l'organisation, avec pour objectif de sécuriser les opérations sans perdre de vue les impératifs de continuité de service.

3- Structurer et harmoniser les pratiques

L'un des enjeux majeurs du poste est de contribuer à l'harmonisation des pratiques entre les différents sites.

Aujourd'hui, les niveaux de maturité et les pratiques peuvent varier d'un site à l'autre. Votre rôle sera de contribuer à construire un socle commun de méthodes et de standards opérationnels.

Vous serez notamment amené(e) à :

  • structurer les processus d'exploitation ;

  • définir et harmoniser les standards techniques ;

  • rédiger et améliorer les procédures et modes opératoires ;

  • mettre en place des workflows opérationnels ;

  • contrôler leur bonne application ;

  • identifier les écarts entre les sites ;

  • proposer et suivre les plans d'amélioration ;

  • partager les bonnes pratiques ;

  • réaliser des REX multisites ;

  • accompagner les équipes dans l'adoption des nouveaux standards.

La capacité à construire et faire vivre des process sera donc aussi importante que votre expertise technique.

4- Apporter votre expertise lors des incidents critiques

En cas d'incident technique complexe, vous intervenez comme référent technique auprès des équipes Facility et Operations.

Vous êtes notamment amené(e) à :

  • analyser techniquement l'incident ;

  • identifier les causes et les impacts potentiels ;

  • apporter votre expertise aux responsables de site ;

  • challenger les analyses proposées ;

  • accompagner les équipes internes et les prestataires ;

  • contribuer à la définition des actions correctives ;

  • participer à la résolution de l'incident ;

  • organiser et partager les retours d'expérience à l'échelle des différents sites.

Votre capacité à prendre du recul, analyser rapidement une situation complexe et apporter une réponse techniquement robuste sera essentielle.

5 - Développer une culture d'excellence opérationnelle

Vous ne vous contentez pas de définir les standards : vous accompagnez les équipes dans leur appropriation.

Vous serez ainsi amené(e) à :

  • former et accompagner les équipes ;

  • expliquer les exigences techniques et opérationnelles ;

  • faire progresser les pratiques ;

  • fédérer autour d'objectifs communs ;

  • accompagner la conduite du changement ;

  • favoriser le partage de connaissances entre les sites.

Vous disposez d'une forte capacité d'influence et savez faire avancer les sujets sans nécessairement disposer d'un lien hiérarchique direct.

6 - Être l'interlocuteur technique des clients majeurs

Vous serez capable de :

  • représenter la société sur les sujets techniques ;

  • expliquer une situation ou un incident complexe ;

  • présenter les actions mises en œuvre ;

  • répondre aux interrogations techniques des clients ;

  • apporter un discours structuré et crédible sur les enjeux d'exploitation et de sécurité des infrastructures.

Une organisation en construction

Vous rejoindrez un pôle d'expertise technique transverse nouvellement structuré, regroupant différentes compétences destinées à accompagner les opérations et les projets.

L'objectif est de créer une véritable communauté d'experts capable d'apporter son expertise à l'ensemble des sites et de faire progresser collectivement les standards d'exploitation.

Vous travaillerez au quotidien avec :

  • les responsables de site ;

  • les équipes Facility et Operations ;

  • les équipes projets ;

  • les experts techniques ;

  • les prestataires et partenaires externes ;

  • les fonctions transverses ;

  • les clients majeurs.

Le poste est donc particulièrement transverse et nécessite une forte capacité à créer du lien entre les différentes parties prenantes.

Vos compétences

Votre profil

Vous disposez d'une expérience significative dans un environnement Data Center ou infrastructure critique fortement structurée.

Vous avez idéalement évolué dans un environnement où les exigences en matière de procédures, de sécurité opérationnelle, de maintenance et de continuité de service sont particulièrement élevées.

Une expérience dans un environnement critique comparable serait particulièrement appréciée.

Votre expertise technique

Vous disposez d'une excellente connaissance des infrastructures critiques et notamment :

  • électricité HT/BT ;

  • systèmes de secours électrique ;

  • UPS / groupes électrogènes ;

  • CVC / HVAC ;

jobs.title: Head of Customer Success
jobs.description:
At evenito, we build enterprise event management software centered on human connection. By combining cutting-edge technology with personal support, we empower event teams to automate routine logistics and free up time for what truly matters: crafting memorable, sustainable event experiences.

As our Head of Customer Success (CS) you will have a front row seat. Together with your team you will be responsible for evenito’s customer excellence. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will not only ensure that our customers receive professional support, but also be the strategic business owner of our post-sale organization and act as a key customer voice within the company. You will develop and execute a scalable CS operating model and play a pivotal role in shaping our product and the future of evenito.

Are you ready to make an impact?

Your Mission:

Drive customer success, develop a high-performing team and turn everyday user insights into strategic product growth.

  • Lead by Example: You set the tone through your actions. From onboarding our largest enterprise clients (ICPs) to handling support tickets alongside your team, you showcase what great customer service looks like while equipping your team with the tools and support they need to succeed.

  • Team Development & Coaching: You will lead and coach a team of five. Through regular 1-on-1s, clear goals and constructive feedback, you will foster a positive, supportive work environment focused on steady growth and a resilient team setup.

  • Escalations & Problem Solving: You view complex situations as opportunities to build trust with our clients. When high-stakes issues arise, you partner directly with Product and Management to find clear solutions, using customer data to guide thoughtful decisions.

  • Cross-Functional Advocacy: You serve as a key connector between our clients and internal teams. By sharing real customer insights with Product, Sales and Marketing, you help shape and prioritize our product roadmap while keeping team priorities aligned with company strategy.

  • Process & Project Innovation: You stay current on Customer Success best practices and enjoy improving how things work. You will have the freedom to introduce new CS workflows that streamline daily operations and support our current growth stage.

  • Commercial Impact & Growth: You ensure Customer Success is a growth engine by delivering clear, measurable value. You will drive product adoption and offer high-impact paid services, positioning expansions as a natural result of client success. This, while tracking performance with clear, business-focused metrics.

  • Knowledge Base Development: You will own and champion our self-service tools (Knowledge Base, Video Academy, Automation). By making resources clear and accessible, you help our customers find quick answers independently and keep support queues manageable.

Your Story

You have a solid B2B SaaS experience, a practical doer mindset and a genuine drive to grow people and businesses - all fueled by a real enthusiasm for the magic of event tech.

  • SaaS Experience: You bring 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Implementation or Account Management in the B2B SaaS environment.

  • Hands-on Doer Mindset: You keep your cool and stay positive when things go sideways. You are pragmatic, humble and jump into daily support queues without hesitation.

  • Effective Communicator: You are a skilled communicator and workshop facilitator who connects effortlessly with enterprise executives, end-users and internal teams alike.

  • Tech Savvy and Agile: You are at home analyzing usage data, mapping workflows and collaborating with Product on technical escalations. You adapt quickly to new software, shifting priorities and changing processes.

  • Leadership Drive: You genuinely care about people. Ideally, you have led a small team before and take true fulfillment in coaching others, building confidence and helping your team grow.

  • Passion for Events and Tech: Events are all about emotion and experience. We are looking for someone who brings that exact enthusiasm for events, event tech and / or digital products.

  • Languages: Fluent in English and German, with the ability to comfortably follow Swiss-German in client meetings.

What We Offer

Unlock your full potential in an inspiring and fast-paced environment. We provide the stage; you take the reins.

  • Impact: Take ownership of a role where your work directly shapes evenito's growth and sets new standards for the industry. You will work closely with management, an amazing team, passionate clients and drive projects that make a difference.

  • Flexibility: As one of our core values, we strongly believe in hybrid remote work options and flexible schedules that allow you to align your professional commitments with your personal life.

  • Time to Recharge: Enjoy 30 days of paid vacation, plus an additional day off for every year of service, giving you plenty of time to rest and recharge.

  • Modern Zurich HQ: Located just a five-minute walk from Zurich HB, our centrally located office offers an inspiring work environment with local coffee, a variety of snacks and access to many lunch spots.

  • Unique Events: Events are our DNA. Beyond building great software, we truly enjoy spending time with each other - whether through spontaneous summer swims in the Limmat-river, Friday Beer um Vier drinks, our annual Global Team Event or legendary Christmas parties.

  • Mobility Support: We contribute toward your public transport pass (öV-Abo) to support convenient and sustainable commuting.

  • Growth Potential: Thrive in a workplace with flat hierarchies, fast decision-making and an open feedback culture designed to help you continuously develop.

Are you ready to shape the future of events with us?

Discover more about life at evenito on our career page, send us your CV and tell us what excites you most about joining our team. We are building something special at evenito - and we can’t wait to meet the person behind the application.
