jobs.title: PhD in In-Operando Diagnostics of Li-ion and Post-Li-ion Batteries Using Acoustic Technology
jobs.description:
At AAU Energy, a PhD stipend position is available within the general study program. The stipend is open for appointment from 15 November 2026 or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years.

Your work tasks
Battery performance assessment and diagnostics rely today on standardised electrical measurements complemented by post-mortem analysis. None of these methods is suited for in-operando diagnostics, as they are either destructive or require the battery to be taken out of its daily operation. Acoustic techniques, based either on passive listening to acoustic emissions or on active ultrasound signal injection, have recently been proposed as an alternative; however, further research is needed to establish the relationship between materials degradation and the sensed acoustic signals. The aim of this PhD project is to establish a mechanistic understanding of the coupling between battery ageing mechanisms and measured acoustic signals, and to translate this understanding into a diagnostic method applicable to both Li-ion and post-Li-ion chemistries.

You will start by reviewing the state of the art in acoustic-based battery diagnostics, and you will then design and build a set-up for sensing acoustic emissions in coin cells. Using this set-up, you will carry out degradation tests over a wide range of operating conditions with simultaneous acoustic and electrical measurements, and you will analyse how the acoustic signatures relate to the electrical ones and to the underlying degradation mechanisms. On this basis, you will develop an acoustic-based, physics-validated model for battery diagnostics; the resulting algorithm is targeted to be at least 25% more accurate than conventional impedance-based estimation and at least 50% less energy demanding than traditional diagnostic approaches. While most of the experimental work will be carried out at coin-cell level, a proof of concept at single-layer pouch-cell level is expected, which will facilitate further demonstration towards innovation.

The work will be supported by critical analysis of the results, benchmarking against the state of the art, and high-quality publications and conference presentations. In addition to the research activities, you will contribute to teaching and to the supervision of student projects, as well as to broader dissemination activities within the department.

The position is offered in relation to the research group Batteries, and the PhD Student will be positioned to the section for Power Electronics Systems Integration and Materials.

Your competencies 
We are looking for a motivated PhD candidate who is eager to work at the intersection of battery testing, sensing instrumentation and signal processing, and who enjoys combining fundamental understanding with hands-on experimental work. The ideal candidate is curious and persistent in the laboratory, excels at troubleshooting, can plan and execute experiments independently, and motivated to collaborate closely with colleagues in an international and interdisciplinary environment.

Applicants must hold an M.Sc. degree in electrical engineering, energy engineering or mechatronics. Experience with one or more of the following will be considered an advantage: electrical characterisation of batteries, acoustic or ultrasonic sensing and laboratory instrumentation, and signal processing and data-driven modelling (e.g., in MATLAB or Python). Experience with Problem Based Learning (PBL) is required, as the PhD student will be involved in the supervision of BSc and MSc student projects. Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken, are required, as the project will be carried out in an international research environment. Danish language skills are highly desirable and will support co-supervision of BSc student projects; however, they are not a formal requirement.

Qualification requirements
PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1124 of September 19, 2025 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are    
AAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners, utilities and other academic environments to address real world energy challenges.

Aalborg University has been ranked as the best university in Europe within energy research and is among the very best universities worldwide in this field. At AAU Energy you will be part of a top international environment where research, innovation and collaboration are used to develop solutions to global challenges such as the green transition and future energy systems.

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and with diverse national and disciplinary backgrounds, which creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as working language in both research and teaching, which supports the integration of international colleagues.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday work.

New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. Aalborg University offers general onboarding support to all new employees, as well as dedicated support for international staff through its International Staff Unit (ISU). You can read more about relocation support and services here: https://www.en.hr.aau.dk/relocation-support

Aalborg University also offers Danish language courses to support international employees in settling into both the workplace and Danish society. International employees typically can attend Danish language courses during their first years in Denmark (depending on individual eligibility and national schemes).

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk.

How to apply
Your application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Do you have any questions?     
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  
Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.
Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employment
The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement). 

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

jobs.title: PhD in Quantum Computing for Power Systems
jobs.description:
At AAU Energy, a position as PhD stipend is available within the general study program. The stipend is open for appointment from December 1, 2026, or as soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years.

Your work tasks
This PhD position focuses on the application of quantum computing to computational challenges in power systems with high shares of renewable energy. You will investigate quantum and hybrid quantum–classical methods for power system analysis and optimization, with emphasis on their practical performance and suitability for real-time applications.

Your work will include formulating representative power system analysis and optimization problems, developing and implementing quantum and hybrid quantum–classical solution methods, and comparing their performance with relevant classical approaches. You will also evaluate the developed methods through numerical studies and real-time power system simulation. The research will involve scientific programming, analysis and documentation of results, and dissemination through peer-reviewed publications and international conferences.

The position is offered within the Center for Research on Microgrids, and the PhD student will be affiliated with the Electric Power Systems and Microgrids section at AAU Energy.

Your competencies 
The applicant must have a relevant educational background in electrical engineering, energy engineering, computer science, or a closely related field. You should have a solid foundation in mathematical modelling and numerical methods, together with experience in scientific programming, preferably in Python. Knowledge of power system analysis and optimization (e.g., power flow and optimal power flow), as well as experience with quantum computing methods and algorithms (e.g., HHL or variational quantum linear solvers for linear system problems, and QAOA or quantum annealing for optimization problems), is expected.

Experience with real-time power system simulation using platforms such as RTDS or OPAL-RT would be an advantage. Previous peer-reviewed journal publications at the intersection of quantum computing and power and energy systems would also be considered an advantage. You should be motivated to further develop your expertise across both power systems and quantum computing.

You should be able to organize and conduct research independently, document and communicate your methods and results clearly, and discuss technical challenges constructively with colleagues. The position requires both independent research and collaboration with researchers from different disciplinary backgrounds, as well as good written and spoken English.

jobs.title: Tapahtumapäällikkö Helsingin sydämeen – Kellotorni etsii tekijää!
jobs.description:
Etsimme tapahtumapäällikköä vastaamaan upeiden ja uniikkien tilojemme tilaisuuksista Helsingin päärautatieasemalla. Kellotornissa järjestämme monipuolisia B2B- ja B2C-tapahtumia aina 10 hengen intiimeistä kokouksista 160 hengen istuviin illallisiin ja jopa 300 hengen suuriin cocktail-tilaisuuksiin.

Tässä roolissa pääset loistamaan projektinhallinnan ammattilaisena ja varmistamaan, että jokainen tilaisuus on asiakkaallemme ikimuistoinen elämys.

**Tehtäväsi ja vastuualueesi**

Tapahtumapäällikkönä kannat kokonaisvastuun asiakkaasta ja tilaisuuden onnistuneesta vedosta. Meillä myyntitiimi hoitaa tapahtuman alkumyynnin ja sopii alustavan kulun, minkä jälkeen sinun vastuusi alkaa:

· **Asiakkuuden haltuunotto:** Astut kuvaan noin 1–2 viikkoa ennen tapahtumaa. Otat yhteyden asiakkaaseen, käyt läpi kaikki yksityiskohdat huolellisesti ja vahvistat lopulliset järjestelyt.

· **Tiimin johtaminen:** Toimit esihenkilönä vuoropäälliköille ja johdat operatiivisia tiimejä (0–12 henkilöä) tapahtuman koosta riippuen.

· **Monipuoliset konseptit:** Luotsaat onnistuneesti niin kokouspalvelut, yritystapahtumat, yksityisjuhlat (kuten syntymäpäivät ja privaatit illalliset) kuin Kellotornin omat lennokkaat B2C-tapahtumat (esim. Halloween-bileet).

· **Perehdytyksen jälkeen:** haluat myös itse päästä jakamaan Kellotornin ainutlaatuista tarinaa ja elämyksiä asiakkaillemme! Esittelet historiallisia tilojamme ja menukokonaisuuksiamme sekä tarvittaessa johdatat pienryhmiä tornin huipulle ihailemaan Helsingin upeita maisemia ja kuulemaan kiehtovia tarinoita Kellotornin historiasta. Sinulle elämyksellisyys ei ole vain sana, vaan tapa kohdata asiakkaat ja tehdä jokaisesta vierailusta ikimuistoinen.

**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

· **Vankkaa tapahtuma- ja ravintola-alan osaamista:** Sinulla on jo vahva kokemus molemmilta aloilta sekä sujuva projektinhallintakyky. Langat pysyvät käsissäsi kiireessäkin.

· **Ruoan ja juoman tuntemusta:** Ymmärrät laadukkaan tarjoilun merkityksen osana onnistunutta tapahtumaa ja osaat sparrata asiakasta menuvalinnoissa.

jobs.title: Aana Palvelut Oy, Henkilökohtainen avustaja Poriin
jobs.description:
Etsitkö ihmisläheistä työtä, jossa saat samalla vaikuttaa omiin työaikoihisi?
Haluatko työn, joka mukautuu elämäntilanteeseesi eikä vaadi aiempaa koulutusta tai pitkää työkokemusta?
Olemme käynnistämässä henkilökohtaisen avun palvelutoimintaa, jossa työ rakentuu sinun ja asiakkaan arjen ympärille.

Aana Palvelut työnantajana

Aana Palvelut on uusi henkilökohtaiseen apuun keskittyvä yritys.
Rakennamme toimintaamme yhdessä avustajien ja asiakkaiden kanssa – avoimesti, inhimillisesti ja luottamukseen perustuen.
Emme etsi työntekijöitä järjestelmään, vaan ihmisiä ihmisille. Sinusta tulee tärkeä osa jonkun arkea.

Mitä henkilökohtainen avustaminen on?

Henkilökohtaisena avustajana autat asiakasta elämään omannäköistään elämää sairauden tai vamman tuomista rajoitteista huolimatta. Työsi on käytännönläheistä, vaihtelevaa ja merkityksellistä.
Avustaminen voi sisältää esimerkiksi:
- kodin arjen askareissa avustamista,
- asiointia ja liikkumista kodin ulkopuolella,
- harrastuksiin ja vapaa-ajan toimintoihin osallistumista.

Kenelle työ sopii?

Etsimme ihmisiä, joilla on aito halu auttaa ja kohdata toinen ihminen arvostavasti ja luontevasti. Et tarvitse aiempaa koulutusta tai kokemusta.
Arvostamme luotettavuutta, avoimuutta ja halua oppia. Perehdytämme sinut työhön ja olemme tukenasi myös arjessa. Meille on tärkeää, että voit olla oma itsesi.

Joustavat työajat

Keskustelemme kanssasi siitä, millainen työmäärä ja aikataulu sopivat elämäntilanteeseesi. Työ voi olla kokoaikaista, osa-aikaista tai keikkaluonteista. Noudatamme palvelualan työehtosopimusta.

Henkilökohtaiseksi avustajaksi otettavan henkilön on esitettävä alle 6 kuukautta vanha rikosrekisteriote työnantajalle ennen työn aloittamista. Rikosrekisteriote haetaan sähköisesti Oikeusrekisterikeskuksesta työnhakijan toimesta.

Så hører vi meget gerne fra dig!

jobs.title: Personal Trainers Wanted Across Norway
jobs.description:
We’re Hiring Personal Trainers at Multiple SATS Clubs Across Norway!

SATS is taking the personal training profession to the next level! We are proud to offer newly hired Personal Trainers greater security and closer support than ever before. We are now looking for passionate individuals who are driven to improve the health and well-being of people across Norway, backed by the best support system in the industry.

SATS operates fitness clubs in several of Norway’s largest cities, and we are currently recruiting Personal Trainers for multiple locations in Greater Oslo, Bærum, Bergen, Fredrikstad, Kristiansand, Drammen, Porsgrunn, Sarpsborg, Skien, Stavanger, and Tromsø.

Please indicate in your application which location or region you would prefer to work in.

Are you passionate about inspiring others to live healthier lives and helping members achieve their goals? Would you like to work in a professional, energetic environment alongside knowledgeable and inspiring colleagues, while developing both personally and professionally? Then we would love to hear from you!

💙 How You Can Make a Difference

As a Personal Trainer at SATS, you will play an important role in the lives of our members. For many, working with a Personal Trainer is the key to achieving lasting results, whether that means improving their lifestyle, reaching specific fitness goals, or building sustainable training habits.

You will work closely with members from the very first meeting, conducting thorough needs assessments and using your expertise to create realistic, motivating, and individualized training and nutrition plans that help them achieve their goals.

You are a positive motivator, a proactive team player, and someone who contributes beyond your own responsibilities. Together with your colleagues, you help ensure that the club delivers an exceptional experience in every area while continuously developing and improving.

🤩 Does This Sound Like You?

  • You have at least one year of Personal Trainer education (equivalent to 60 ECTS credits or similar). PT certifications that do not award academic credits but are equivalent in scope to a one-year program are also accepted. (Please upload documentation of completed and/or ongoing studies as part of your application.)

  • Alternatively, you have other education relevant to the PT profession, such as a bachelor’s degree in sports science, physiotherapy, psychology, coaching, or a related field. (All candidates, regardless of educational background, must complete a thorough interview process, including a practical audition.)

  • You have strong work capacity and see yourself delivering approximately 80 to 100 hours per month as an established Personal Trainer.

  • You are passionate about creating unique training experiences based on concrete and individual goals.

  • You enjoy sales and take responsibility for developing and growing your own client portfolio.

  • You are confident and skilled at building and maintaining strong relationships.

  • You are positive, inclusive, and approachable.

  • You work independently and take initiative.

  • You are committed to following procedures and respecting rules and guidelines.

🤝 Why Join the SATS Team?

  • SATS offers an introductory salary during your start-up period.

  • Close mentoring and support from experienced leaders and PT Managers.

  • You will become part of a competent and professional team that supports and motivates one another to succeed.

  • Access to a large membership base, providing unique opportunities to build your client portfolio.

  • The chance to work with an exciting and continuously evolving product.

  • Excellent development opportunities through our internal education platform, SATS Academy.

  • Guaranteed minimum income protection following maternity/paternity leave and/or periods of illness.

  • Free training at all SATS clubs across the Nordic region.

  • Employee benefits and discounts through our partner network.

  • As a new PT at SATS, you will participate in our introductory program, PT Trial Session. Personal Trainers help members get started with exercise and establish healthy training habits. Working with PT Trial Sessions is the perfect gateway to becoming a full-time PT. It allows you to gain valuable experience in PT sales, build relationships with potential clients, and develop your business while receiving an introductory salary.

As a Personal Trainer at SATS, you will contribute to work that truly matters. You help people improve their quality of life, achieve important goals, and sometimes even realize long-held dreams. That is why we believe a career at SATS offers a more meaningful and rewarding workday than many others.

#SATSNorge
#LI-AB1

Om arbeidsgiveren:

SATS Group, through our brands and concepts SATS, ELIXIA and Fresh Fitness, is the leading provider of fitness and training services in the Nordics with over 275 clubs, some 10 000 employees and around 700,000 members. At SATS, everyone is welcome and our members have full flexibility to tailor packages for their individual needs. We offer cutting-edge studio facilities for individual training, the broadest offering of group training programs, and highly qualified personal trainers for specialized training and individual coaching. We also focus strongly on supporting our members with online training and digital tools when they are unable to visit our club facilities. We are constantly working with trend research and innovation to be the industry’s best and most forward-looking fitness chain.

jobs.title: Senior Logistics Engineer
jobs.employer: ODA NORWAY AS AVD OSLO DISTRIBUSJON
jobs.description:
At Oda, we develop affordable grocery services to make the logistics of living surprisingly easy. First we built Norway’s leading online grocery store and now, partnered with Mathem in Sweden, we’re on our way to becoming the world’s most effective grocery system, delivering to thousands of Scandinavian doorsteps every week.

As part of our team, you’ll work with smart, passionate colleagues who bring their whole selves to work every day. It’s a fast-moving, collaborative environment where everyone is welcome and everyone’s opinion matters. Whether you're shaping the future of online retail, tackling complex logistical problems, or making everyday life better for our customers, your work will have a real impact. Read on to find out what part you could play in our story.

Our world-class logistics and tech solutions allow us to reduce food waste, save time and money, and ease the mental and physical load for people who want more space for life.

Lastly we are entering the space of becoming a logistics systems provider to serve other online grocery players meaning we are commercializing our hardware blueprint, our proprietary smart software and our ways of working into Oda systems - our new brand and business area!

We’re looking for a Senior Logistics Engineer to join Oda!

As our new Senior Logistics Engineer, you will take ownership of core physical process flows, optimize layout solutions, and lead physical installation projects from concept to commissioning. You will play a vital role in ensuring that our technical and physical solutions optimize unit economics, maximize throughput, and eliminate waste across our operations.


What you’ll be doing

  • Process Ownership & Optimization: Design, implement, and continuously improve physical process flows, layout solutions, process dependencies, and supporting systems to maximize throughput and operational efficiency.

  • Lead Installation Projects: Drive and manage physical installation projects for equipment, hardware, and infrastructure from initial concept through to commissioning.

  • Cost Control & Insights: Analyze cost drivers within the process flow and ensure all technical and physical solutions directly optimize unit economics and bottom-line results.

  • Lean Application: Apply Lean manufacturing principles to eliminate waste, enhance safety, and foster a continuous improvement culture.

  • Operational Collaboration: Work closely with on-site operational teams to ensure drawings and technical designs function seamlessly in daily operations and execute smooth handovers.

  • Flexibility: Step up and contribute to responsibilities beyond the core job description when the team or business needs it.


To thrive in this role,

You are analytical and strategic with a sharp eye for cost drivers and unit economics. You excel at switching abstraction levels effortlessly, combining a precise attention to detail with the strategic bird’s-eye view. As a highly structured project manager, you have the drive to push process improvements and complex physical implementations forward.

You are communicative and highly collaborative, capable of building strong bridges between on-site operations, software developers, designers, data analysts, and product managers. Above all, you are self-driven, confident in taking full ownership of entire processes, and act in alignment with our shared behaviors and values.


What you’ll need to succeed

Education: Master of Science (M.Sc.) in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Process Engineering, or an equivalent relevant field.

Operational Experience: 5–10 years of hands-on experience within Lean manufacturing, industrial production, or logistics environments.

Project Management: Proven track record of successfully leading complex, physical installation projects from concept to completion (delivered on time and within budget).

Technical Competence: A solid understanding of modern software development methodologies.

Business Acumen: Strong financial and operational understanding of cost drivers and how process design impacts the bottom line.

Language: Fluent in spoken and written English.


What would be nice to have

  • Experience scaling logistics or fulfillment center infrastructure in rapid-growth environments.

  • You value innovation and enjoy working in an AI-integrated environment where we constantly iterate on what’s possible.


What we offer

  • A chance to make a real impact in a fast-moving company with a product people love-while shaking up the grocery industry.

  • Teammates who aim high and have each other’s backs. We care about people, and that means supporting each other every step of the way.

  • A flat structure where we team up across disciplines to solve exciting challenges. Big ideas come from everywhere!

  • A transparent way of working. We use Slack to stay in the loop-less email, fewer meetings, more getting things done.

  • A buzzing office at Tøyen, with lunch made by amazing chefs. 🧑‍🍳

  • A collaborative approach-we tackle exciting tech and product challenges together, across different fields.

  • A chance to shape the future of grocery shopping while building a company that’s here to stay.


Practical Information

  • Application deadline: 08.11.26

  • Percentage: 100%

  • Location: Tøyen, Oslo OR Larsboda, Sverige

  • Background check: required prior to hire


We can’t wait to hear from you! 🧡

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Oda is the leading online grocery retailer in Norway, but as a company, we’re first and foremost an ambitious tech and logistics company - not a classic retailer. We’re one of the fastest-growing startups in the Nordics, working with huge, complex challenges to make the lives of our customers simpler and easier. Want to join us? Our goal is to create the world's most efficient retail system. Through smart work, passionate customer focus and our own technology we make a difference in the lives of thousands of customers and change society for the better through a completely re-imagined value chain for grocery shopping. Our customers save more than 60 hours a year, time we believe can be better spent than going to the store. Our effective value chain and logistics save society tonnes of food waste each year and our distribution network replace almost 13,000 individual trips by car to the grocery store each year.

As a fully owned subsidiary of Safran Electronics & Defense, Safran Electronics & Defense Australasia Pty Ltd (SEDA) delivers and supports various products including high-performance optronics and inertial navigation equipment.



Headquartered in Sydney, SEDA brings local expertise in the integration of optronics and navigation systems for the air, land, and naval platforms of the Australian and New Zealand Defence Forces.



In this role, you will be responsible for the design, integration, and verification of resilient PNT solutions for complex systems operating in challenging environments. You will work across system architecture, GNSS and timing engineering, sensor fusion, and assured PNT technologies, collaborating closely with software, hardware, and systems engineering teams.



This role is suited to an engineer with strong systems thinking, hands-on technical depth, and experience delivering high-reliability navigation and timing solutions.

In this role, you will be responsible for:



Systems Engineering & Architecture

o Gather, analyse and formalise internal and external stakeholders' needs relating to resilient PNT systems.

o Define end-to-end PNT system architectures integrating GNSS, INS, IMUs, aiding sensors (odometers, altimeters, computer vision), atomic clocks, time servers and Navwar software.

o Develop and maintain PNT architecture, design, and interface documentation, including SAD, SSDD, and interface control documentation.

o Develop simulation environments to characterize PNT solution performance and robustness.



PNT Engineering

o Knowledge on Safran's Inertial Navigation product lines (INS, IMU, gyroscope and accelerometer sensors), address questions and provide training to customers and industry partners.

o Knowledge on Safran's Timing product lines (clocks, time servers), address questions and provide training to customers and industry partners.

o Design, integrate and support PNT solutions for trials, demonstrations and trade shows, including inertial navigation, PPS generation, UTC traceability, clock disciplining, and holdover strategies.

o Support alternative and complementary PNT techniques, including inertial-only navigation, terrain aiding, celestial navigation, and signals of opportunity.

o Contribute to assured PNT strategies for operation in GNSS degraded or contested environments.

Job Description:

French Below

Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for a Avionics Retrofit Systems Manager (f/m) to join our Airbus Services team  based in Toulouse, France.

As a "Retrofit Systems Manager", you will be responsible for a given set of avionics products of Upgrades Retrofit Projects to drive the technical definition and execution of the engineering retrofit solution (Service Bulletin).

Your role and responsibilities:  

- Manage a Retrofit project (on-time, cost and quality) end to end from Technical 0ffer or Service Bulletin (SB) launching decision coming from Service Bulletin control Board (SBCB) to SB technical approval and dispatch to the customers, ensuring technical support when required.

- For optional upgrade subjects, perform Technical Offers and contribute to ROM at pre-sales phase, in coordination with Airframe Services (SRx) and Sales.

- For aircraft product improvement subjects perform the maturity analysis and decide on the launching of the retrofit solution and planning.

- Define the most appropriate retrofit solution technical definition based on customer expectations,

- Coordinate and contribute to MOD TRS creation/update/justification with Design Office (MOD new) or internally (MOD CTK - Close To Known),

- Support Production Center during SB authoring phase,

- Perform optional SB Technical Approval as per DOS delegations (after a period of training),

- Answer to customer queries (Tech Request) and support working parties, provide RDAF (Technical Adaptation) if necessary,

- Identify and develop new products/retrofit solutions in collaboration with Airframe Services and Design Office.

You boarding pass:  

- Graduated from an Master in electronic or Aeronautical Engineering diploma

- Strong knowledge of aircraft avionics systems (at least one of the following ATA 22, 23, 27, 31, 34, 45, 46)

- Aircraft configuration management

- Airworthiness and safety

- Project management

- Aircraft maintenance experience would be a plus

- Proactive, good team player and good organizational skills

- Good communication skills and customer minded

- Curious and open-minded for change and continuous improvement

Good level in French

- Fluent in English

Your working environment:

Global capital of aeronautics and European capital for space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in the southwest of France served by an international airport. Ideally located between the Mediterranean sea and the Atlantic ocean and close to the Pyrenees mountains, it offers plenty of options for outdoor activities!

How we care for you:

Work / Life Balance:  Extra days-off for special occasions, holiday transfer option, a Staff council offering many social, cultural and sport activities and other services.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly.    Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

Take your career to a new level and apply online now!

En tant que  Avionics Retrofit Systems Manager, vous serez responsable d'un ensemble donné de produits avioniques, de mener des projets de modernisation et de mise à niveau avion, pour cela vous devrez piloter la définition technique et l'exécution de la solution de modernisation technique (Bulletin de service).

jobs.description:
Meiltä löytyy toimeksiantoja täyttämään uudenkin välittäjän työpäiviä! Tarjoamme sinulle paikan kasvavasta organisaatiosta, jossa pääset itse vaikuttamaan omaan työhösi. Saat meiltä hyvät työkalut ja tuen työssäsi menestymiseen.

Etsimämme henkilö on motivoitunut ja positiivinen tiimipelaaja, jolta löytyy kyky laadukkaan asiakaskokemuksen tuottamiseen. Edellytämme tehtävään valitulta henkilöltä suoritettua LVV- tai LKV-tutkintoa. Osaat aikatauluttaa omaa työntekoasi ja työskentelet tarkalla otteella. Pystyt työskentelemään asiakkaiden kanssa tarvittaessa myös englanniksi. Koska saat pitkälti suunnitella omien työpäiviesi aikataulun, toivomme, että pystyt myös itse tarpeen tullen joustamaan. Työ on lähtökohtaisesti osa-aikaista, mutta mahdollisuus myös kokoaikaiseen työhön. Oma auto on tässä työssä välttämätön.

Teemme välitystyötä modernilla otteella, suunnitelmallisesti ja jatkuvasti uudistuen. Toivomme, että sinulla on niin osaamista kuin halua erilaisten digitaalisten välineiden ja järjestelmien kuin sosiaalisen mediankin hyödyntämiseen.

Meidän rennossa ja ammattitaitoisessa työyhteisössä on helppo viihtyä. Saat aina tarvittaessa myös apua työkavereilta. Tulet saamaan työnantajan puolesta jonkin verran toimeksiantoja, jotta aloitus meillä olisi mahdollisimman sujuvaa.

Joustavan työajan lisäksi tarjoamme kannustavan provisiopalkkauksen ja korvaamme myös oman auton käytöstä johtuvat kilometrit. Työsuhde-etuna pääset seuraamaan asuntosijoittamista läheltä ja ensimmäisenä mukaan sijoitusasuntojen tarjouksiimme.

Hakuaika on 19.10.-1.11.2026. Hakemuksia käsitellään jo hakuaikana. Tehtävän aloitusajankohta sopimuksen mukaan. Työhön valitulta tarkistetaan luottotiedot.

jobs.title: Bli vår nye mekaniker i Ålesund – frihet, faglige utfordringer og et rått team!
jobs.description:
Er du en dyktig mekaniker som brenner for at maskiner skal fungere 100 %, yte maksimalt og se skikkelige ut? Motiveres du av varierte dager, god tillit og friheten til å legge opp din egen hverdag slik at arbeidet flyter best mulig? Da vil du trives hos oss i Cramo.

 

Hos oss blir du ikke bare en som skrur, du får det reelle ansvaret for at utleieparken i Ålesund spiller på lag. Verkstedet og maskinparken blir ditt stolte ansvarsområde, hvor du får styre prosessene, planlegge kapasiteten og ta de faglige avgjørelsene som utgjør en forskjell. Du får en nøkkelrolle med stor handlingsfrihet, samtidig som du blir en del av et uformelt og faglig sterkt team som deler erfaringer og mener at god humor er like viktig som godt håndverk.

 

Hva tilbyr vi deg?

Vi vet at en avdeling kun fungerer bra når folk trives. Derfor legger vi alt til rette for en forutsigbar og god hverdag med lavt stressnivå, selv når det koker litt ekstra.

 

  • Stor tillit og faglig eierskap: Du får styre hverdagen din i stor grad selv og ta avgjørelser som påvirker driften direkte.
  • Et sterkt fagmiljø å sparre med: Du står aldri alene! Teamet i Ålesund, sammen med erfarne mekanikere i resten av regionen, samarbeider tett og deler gladelig av sin erfaring.
  • Gode betingelser: Konkurransedyktig lønn, attraktiv bonusordning og solid pensjons- og forsikringspakke.
  • Balanse og trivsel: Vi har fokus på trivsel og at du har det bra både på og utenfor jobb. Du får støtte til trening og én betalt frivillighetsdag i året.
  • Uformell kultur: En «klart vi kan»-holdning med rom for god humor og høyt under taket.

 

Hva innebærer rollen hos oss?

Som mekaniker hos Cramo i Ålesund tar du styringen over arbeidshverdagen. Du sørger for at maskinene våre er funksjonelle, godt vedlikeholdt og fremstår visuelt flotte for kundene våre.

 

Dine viktigste oppgaver vil være:

  • Helhetlig eierskap til maskinparken: Feilsøking, service, reparasjoner og klargjøring før, under og etter utleie.
  • Styre kapasitet og innkjøp: Du vurderer arbeidsmengden fortløpende. Ved topper, servicer eller årskontroller har du mandat til å koordinere med eksterne leverandører/mekanikere.
  • Prosess- og kostnadskontroll: Du styrer hele reparasjonsløpet fra feilsøking til registrering og kostnadsføring på serviceordre, slik at drift kan fakturere reelle reparasjonskostnader videre.
  • Verksteddrift: Holde orden i delebestillinger, optimalisere verksteddriften og redusere antall maskiner som står «nede».
  • Utrykninger og feltoppdrag: Noen dager jobber du på verkstedet, andre dager drar du ut til kunden og blir helten som løser utfordringene på stedet.

 

 

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi leter ikke etter en superhelt som kan alt fra dag en, men etter deg som brenner for mekaniker faget, liker å ha oversikt og har god teknisk forstand. Du stolt av jobben du gjør, enten du løser en kompleks feilkode eller sørger for at en maskin ser skinnende ny ut for neste kunde.

 

Det er ideelt om du har:

  • Fagbrev innen anleggs-, landbruks- eller industrimekanikk, elektro (Gr. L) eller et annet relevant mekanisk fag.
  • …men har du lang, praktisk erfaring og en "skru-hjerne" som løser det meste? Søk likevel! Hos oss veier reell kompetanse, faglig engasjement og rett innstilling veldig høyt.
  • Førerkort klasse B (har du BE eller truckførerbevis er det en fin bonus. Har du det ikke, så finner vi ut av det sammen).

  • Grunnleggende digitale ferdigheter og gode norskkunnskaper.

     

Du er en vi passe sammen med dersom du:

  • Motiveres av tillit og frihet under ansvar, og liker å ha kontroll på egne prosjekter og kostnader.
  • Trives med at det koker litt ekstra i ny og ne, men mestrer kunsten å holde hodet kaldt slik at det aldri oppleves som uoversiktlig stress.
  • Er en utpreget lagspiller som bryr seg om kollegene sine, sprer god stemning i kaffepausene og skaper en trygg, inkluderende arbeidsplass.

 

Klar for nye utfordringer?

Send oss en søknad eller ta kontakt for en uforpliktende prat om rollen! Vi gleder oss til å bli kjent med deg.

 

 

 

 

For mer informasjon eller spørsmål, kontakt oss på:

Mail: Richard.taylor@randstad.no
Mobil: 982 95 163



For å søke:
Registrer din CV online på www.randstad.no og søk på denne stillingen.

  • Søknadsfrist - Senest 30.10.26. (Ansettelse kan bli gjort før frist)

Alle søkere vil få svar og blir kontaktet.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Cramo er et av Norges ledende utleieselskaper innen maskiner, utstyr og modulbygg for bygg, anlegg, industri og offentlig sektor. Vi har over 30 avdelinger, mer enn 300 ansatte og er sertifisert innen kvalitet, miljø og arbeidsmiljø (ISO 9001, 14001 og 45001).

Siden 2020 har Cramo vært en del av Boels Rental, en av Europas største og mest fremtidsrettede 

aktører innen utleiebransjen. Dette gir oss et solid apparat i ryggen og gode forutsetninger for videre utvikling.

I vår avdeling jobber vi målrettet for å levere de beste løsningene i markedet, med høy aktivitet, tett samarbeid med både små og store kunder, og et fremoverlent arbeidsmiljø preget av kontinuerlig utvikling og varierte arbeidsoppgaver.

jobs.title: Vuokravälittäjä Pori (osa-aikainen)
jobs.description:
Meiltä löytyy toimeksiantoja täyttämään uudenkin välittäjän työpäiviä! Tarjoamme sinulle paikan kasvavasta organisaatiosta, jossa pääset itse vaikuttamaan omaan työhösi. Saat meiltä hyvät työkalut ja tuen työssäsi menestymiseen. Työ on alkuun osa-aikaista, mutta myöhemmin mahdollisuus kokoaikatyöhön.

Etsimämme henkilö on motivoitunut ja positiivinen tiimipelaaja, jolta löytyy kyky laadukkaan asiakaskokemuksen tuottamiseen. Aiempi kokemus välitysalalta katsotaan eduksi. Osaat aikatauluttaa omaa työntekoasi ja työskentelet tarkalla otteella. Pystyt työskentelemään asiakkaiden kanssa tarvittaessa myös englanniksi. Koska saat pitkälti suunnitella omien työpäiviesi aikataulun, toivomme, että pystyt myös itse tarpeen tullen joustamaan. Oma auto on tässä työssä välttämätön.

Teemme välitystyötä modernilla otteella, suunnitelmallisesti ja jatkuvasti uudistuen. Toivomme, että sinulla on niin osaamista kuin halua erilaisten digitaalisten välineiden ja järjestelmien kuin sosiaalisen mediankin hyödyntämiseen. Järjestämme sisäisiä LKV/LVV-valmennuksia, joiden kautta sinun on mahdollista pätevöityä vuokra- tai kiinteistönvälittäjäksi työsuhteesi aikana.

Meidän rennossa ja ammattitaitoisessa työyhteisössä on helppo viihtyä. Saat aina tarvittaessa myös apua työkavereilta. Tulet saamaan työnantajan puolesta jonkin verran toimeksiantoja, jotta aloitus meillä olisi mahdollisimman sujuvaa.

Joustavan työajan lisäksi tarjoamme kannustavan provisiopalkkauksen ja korvaamme myös oman auton käytöstä johtuvat kilometrit. Työsuhde-etuna pääset seuraamaan asuntosijoittamista läheltä ja ensimmäisenä mukaan sijoitusasuntojen tarjouksiimme.

Hakuaika on 19.10.-1.11.2026. Hakemuksia käsitellään jo hakuaikana. Tehtävän aloitusajankohta on mahdollisimman pian. Työhön valitulta tarkistetaan luottotiedot.

Lähetä CV ja työhakemuksesi viimeistään 1.11.2026 osoitteeseen karoliina.peltola@asuntopehtoori.fi otsikolla Välittäjän rekry/Pori.

Kysy tehtävästä lisää: Karoliina Peltola, karoliina.peltola@asuntopehtoori.fi p. 044 768 0122

jobs.title: Support Specialist for BeeHealthy
jobs.description:
Join us in our mission to make care smarter!

At BeeHealthy, were on a mission to make care smarter through our configurable, white-label SaaS platform. We combine over 115 years of healthcare expertise with modern technology, serving social, healthcare, and veterinary providers alongside insurance organisations in over 10 countries across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

Were a team of 90+, with 60+ in our product organisation, growing fast and looking for people who want to do meaningful work. If you care about impact, quality, and building products that genuinely improve how care is delivered and received, wed love to hear from you.

Location: Helsinki, Turku, Tampere, or Jyväskylä (Finland) or Berlin (Germany)
Working mode: Remote-friendly, hybrid working model

About the role
As a Support Specialist, you handle support issues independently from intake to resolution, with high-quality ticket handling, customer communication, and documentation. Youll build strong product and platform knowledge, spot recurring issues, and help improve how Support operates.

What you will do
Handle tickets end to end: prioritise, categorise, troubleshoot, resolve, and document them
Investigate issues using logs, tooling, and platform knowledge, and decide when to resolve them yourself and when to escalate
Keep customers updated clearly during incidents, escalations, and follow-ups
Work with SRE and Engineering on complex cases, keeping ownership until issues are resolved or clearly handed over, so nothing gets lost between teams
Spot recurring issues and raise them for Problem Management with the Service Delivery Manager
Turn your troubleshooting into reusable troubleshooting guides and known solutions in our knowledge base
Mentor Junior Support Specialists, helping them build confidence and solve problems on their own
Proactively suggest improvements to support processes, documentation, and ways of working
Work with Service Delivery to ensure relevant customer context is understood and reflected in support communication

What you bring
Previous experience in technical support, IT service desk, or another customer-facing ICT role
Structured troubleshooting skills, including reading logs and narrowing down root causes
Sound judgement on when to dig deeper, when to resolve, and when to escalate
Clear written and spoken communication in English and Finnish, including with customers during incidents
Strong documentation habits
Willingness to mentor and support colleagues

Bonus points
Interest in exploring and developing AI-based solutions that make Support faster and more effective
Experience with Jira Service Management or similar
Familiarity with ITIL practices
Experience in healthcare or another regulated environment, and an understanding of handling sensitive data (GDPR)
German and/or Italian

What success looks like
You resolve support issues independently and efficiently
You make sound escalation decisions and involve SRE or Engineering at the right time
Your tickets are accurate, appropriately prioritised, and well documented
You communicate clearly with customers throughout the support lifecycle
You help Junior Support Specialists develop their troubleshooting and ticket-handling skills
You strengthen the Support knowledge base with practical, reusable documentation
You identify recurring issues and help reduce them through Problem Management and continuous improvement
You contribute to a more consistent and scalable Support operation

Benefits
Generous, Nordic-style paid holiday
Flexible remote-work policy and working hours
Wide range of IT equipment to choose from
Comprehensive occupational healthcare
Sponsored sports or culture memberships
Healthy snacks and drinks at the office
Regular team days, game nights, and social events

Culture at BeeHealthy
At BeeHealthy, freedom and responsibility go hand in hand. Youll be trusted to work independently while collaborating closely with your colleagues, sharing knowledge, learning continuously, and respecting each other both professionally and personally.

Our culture is guided by strong values:
Skill and Knowledge: we never stop learning.
Caring and Responsibility: we look out for each other and the people who use what we build.
Partners and Entrepreneurship: we innovate through collaboration.
Growth and Development: were committed to unlocking potential, both for ourselves and our customers.

Were a close-knit, international team where talent and knowledge-sharing thrive. We believe that building great healthcare technology starts with taking care of the people who build it.

Recruitment process
We read every application: Once the application period closes, we take time to review everyone who applied. You'll hear back from us, whatever the outcome.
Short meeting with our VP Talent: A chance to get to know each other. The focus here is on bringing BeeHealthy's culture and values to life, and exploring how they resonate with your own.
Meeting with the hiring manager: This conversation goes deeper into the role, its responsibilities and expectations, as well as the requirements.
Team meeting and case assignment: You'll get to meet your future teammates and work through an engaging case.
Possible meeting with our C-level team.
Offer: When the right person meets the right role, we'll be in touch to make an offer and talk through the details together.

Apply through our recruitment system by 8 November 2026 by sending your CV and a brief note about why this role excites you. We review applications on a rolling basis and look forward to hearing from you. The start date is flexible and can be agreed together.

Contact details:
Nikita Moldavanov
nikita.moldavanov@beehealthy.com

jobs.title: R&D Project Manager, Bluefors, Helsinki
jobs.description:
About the role

As a Project Manager, you will take ownership of bundling and driving a cluster of a several interrelated productization projects aimed at launching a few new hardware products to the market. You will collaborate daily with technical leads, design engineers, purchasing, and production teams to ensure smooth progress and seamless NPI transitions. Additionally, you will play a key role in developing and unifying project management best practices across the organization.

We are looking for a person who enjoys to work with different stakeholders and has an excellent skills in project management. We are also looking for a good understanding of technical concepts, but the role is focusing more in acting as a bridge between different stakeholders.

You are offered
- A role in a technically challenging, innovative and global environment
- Possibility to work with interesting projects and with a collaborative and supportive team
- Opportunity to develop processes and build best practices
- Flexible hybrid work model, combining weekly office presence and remote work

Work tasks
- Coordinating and driving a multi-project ensemble (including gas handling units, cryostat integration, and primary heat exchanger development)
- Gathering input from technical experts and maintaining accurate reporting and project portfolio visibility
- Facilitating smooth communication between cross-functional stakeholders (R&D, mechanical design, purchasing, and production)
- Supporting and refining New Product Introduction (NPI) processes and project management practices
- Managing task tracking, timelines, and documentation across internal tools

We are looking for

- Good practical experience in managing R&D, productization, or industrial production projects
- Good understanding of technical concepts (e.g., background in mechanical engineering, electronics, physics, or relevant industrial engineering)
- Practical experience working with cross-functional teams and managing stakeholder expectations
- Hands-on familiarity with project management or ERP softwares (e.g., Jira, Excel, Keto ERP or similar)
- Self-driven, proactive attitude with a desire to build and structure processes in a dynamic environment
- Fluent written and spoken English skills

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: Art educator, part-time
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about working in arts education and with young people, alongside other professionals?

We are looking for three part-time art educators for Annantalo Arts Centre for Children and Young People for The Call of Art - Advancing Equity and Accessibility in Cultural Education Plans project. The position is for the period 1 January 2027-31 May 2028. The position is a 30 % working time role, with working hours totalling approximately 11.5hours per week. The work will mainly take place at Annantalo on three weekdays per week during school year, which will be specified as the project moves on, between approximately 12.00 and 16.00. Outside school year, the working days and working tasks will be defined according to the projects phase and needs.

The job-specific salary for a full-time position would be EUR2,994.14 per month. We are seeking employees on a 30 % part-time basis, meaning that the job-specific salary is reduced proportionally, amounting to EUR898.24 per month.

As an art educator, you will primarily be working on the The Call of Art - Advancing Equity and Accessibility in Cultural Education Plans project, providing course-based arts education to groups of lower secondary school students. You will plan lessons and courses, teach classes and develop teaching practice in collaboration with other project staff. You will adapt your teaching to the needs of the participating groups. You will organise the students artwork exhibitions, shows or performances, for example. You will document your own work and communicate about it in line with the projects objectives, in addition to which you will also ensure that teaching materials and facilities are fit for purpose.

You are a professional in your own form of art and an experienced art educator. Your form of art could be, for example, animation, digital art, light art, sound art, performance art, dance, theatre, music, nail art, visual arts, architecture or some art form we have not even heard of yet! You enjoy working with young people and give them the space to express their own creativity. You are familiar with working in a multilingual environment. You enjoy collaborating with other professionals in the fields of art and education, and you want to share your expertise for the benefit of others. Documenting your own work and communicating about it comes naturally to you.

The course-based art education provided at Annantalo is part of the national The Call of Art - Advancing Equity and Accessibility in Cultural Education Plans project, which will run from 2026 to 2028. The aim of the project is to strengthen childrens and young peoples cultural participation, equity and motivation at school and prevent the decline of arts education amongst young people. The project is coordinated by the Association of Childrens Culture in Finland and it is co-funded by the European Social Fund (ESF+). The project consortium comprises the cities of Helsinki, Vantaa, Joensuu and Oulu; and Culture Cooperative Uulu.

The position requires a relevant bachelors degree, as well as either completed pedagogical studies or pedagogical competence gained through work experience.

In addition to this, the role requires expertise in ones own form(s) of art, as well as experience in working with children and young people. The language requirement is a good command of spoken and written Finnish or English.

Documentation and communication skills, as well as other language skills, particularly proficiency in the languages spoken by pupils at Helsinki lower secondary school, are considered an advantage for this role.

Successful candidates must, prior to commencing employment, provide the employer with a criminal record extract for inspection, in accordance with section 6, subsection 2 of the Criminal Records Act.

Please submit your application via our recruitment system.

jobs.title: Deltidsmedarbeider hos Hertz Stavanger – 30–50 %
jobs.description:
Hertz Bilutleie ved Auto Finans AS søker en serviceinnstilt deltids medarbeider til vår avdeling på Stavanger lufthavn.

Stillingsprosenten avtales med riktig kandidat. Vi ser for oss en stilling på omtrent 30--50 %. Arbeidstid vil omfatte kveld og helg, noe som kan passe godt ved siden av studier.

Stillingen passer for deg som liker kundekontakt og logistikk, har god oversikt og trives i en travel arbeidshverdag.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Besvare og følge opp kundehenvendelser i skranke, på e-post og telefon

  • Veilede kunder og presentere Hertz' produkter og tjenester

  • Planlegge og koordinere bilflåte ut fra reservasjonene

  • Kontrollere og følge opp leiekontrakter

  • Utføre rapportering og andre daglige kontoroppgaver

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Førerkort klasse B, innehatt i minst ett år

  • Gode norskkunnskaper og engelskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig

  • Du trives med kundekontakt og høyt tempo

  • Du er fleksibel og tar ansvar for oppgavene dine

Personlige egenskaper

  • Serviceinnstilt og imøtekommende

  • Strukturert og god til å holde oversikt

  • Positiv og løsningsorientert

  • Samarbeidsvillig

Tiltredelse etter avtale. Søknad og CV sendes til [roy@autofinans.no] (snarest mulig).

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Bli med på laget bak gode reiseopplevelser

Når noen skal på ferie, på jobb eller trenger en bil for å komme seg videre, er Hertz der. Siden oppstarten i Chicago i 1918 har Hertz vokst til å bli verdens eldste bilutleieselskap, med over 10 000 lokasjoner i mer enn 150 land og over 33 millioner bilutleier hvert år.

Hertz åpnet sin første lokasjon i Norge i 1968. I dag er Hertz Norge markedsledende, med over 500 utleiepunkter over hele landet, inkludert samtlige flyplasser. Nettverket omfatter rundt 170 corporate-utleiepunkter og cirka 250 lisenstakere.

Auto Finans AS representerer Hertz i Stavanger, Sola, Egersund, Haugesund, på Karmøy og Stord. Med mer enn 50 års erfaring innen bilutleie kjenner vi bransjen godt. Målet vårt er alltid å drive Norges beste Hertz-stasjoner. Med ekstra god kundeservice sørger vi for at både mennesker og biler kommer dit de skal.

Hos oss blir du en del av et lokalt lag med en sterk merkevare i ryggen -- og får en viktig rolle i kundenes reise.

jobs.title: KotiAvustajat - yrittäjä
jobs.description:
KotiAvustajat ovat palvelleet asiakkaita 15 vuoden ajan Seinäjoella ja vuosien varrella laajentaneet toimintaansa Alavudelle, Ilmajoelle, Kuortaneelle, Kaustiselle, Veteliin, Hausjärvelle, Hyvinkäälle, Körkölään, Mäntsälään, Riihimäelle, Lempäälään, Nokialle, Pirkkalaan, Sastamalaan, Tampereelle, Ylöjärvelle, Helsinkiin, Espooseen, Kauniaisiin ja Vantaalle

Haemme itsenäisiä KotiAvustaja - yrittäjiä ympäri Suomen, jotka toimivat yhteistyössä KotiAvustajien kanssa uniikin toimintamallin mukaisesti omalla asuinpaikkakunnallaan.

KotiAvustajana voit vaikuttaa omalla työlläsi siihen, että asuinpaikkakuntasi ikäihmiset saavat hyvää hoivaa ja huolenpitoa sekä konkreettista apua kotona asumiseen. KotiAvustajana autat ja huolehdit asiakkaan hyvinvoinnista antaen ohjausta terveydentilan ja toimintakyvyn ylläpitämiseksi. Kotikäynnit keskittyvät arkipäiviin ja sinulla on aikaa kohdata asiakas.

Kaikki KotiAvustajat toimivat uniikin KotiAvustajat® brändin mukaisesti, joka luo paremmat toimintaedellytykset yrityksellesi sekä mahdollisuuden kehittyä paremmaksi osaajaksi. Asiakkuudet ovat pääsääntöisesti pitkäkestoisia ja se tuo turvaa yrittäjyyteen. Sinulla on hyvät mahdollisuudet erittäin hyviin ansioihin, joka luonnollisesti riippuu sinusta ja aktiivisuudestasi.

Asiakastyötä tulet tekemään omalla persoonallasi ja täydellä sydämellä. Avoimuus, kyky kuunnella ja halu auttaa ovat tärkeimpiä ominaisuuksiasi. Lähtökohta toiminnallesi on hyvä asiakaspalvelu, jossa työtä teet aina asiakkaalle.

Sinulla on terveysalan koulutus (esim. sairaanhoitaja, terveydenhoitaja, toimintaterapeutti, farmaseutti, fysioterapeutti jne.), hygieniapassi, auto omaan käyttöön sekä hallitset erinomaisesti suomen kielen.

Saat yrittäjyyteen vankan tuen ja asiantuntevia neuvoja sekä ohjeita alkumetreiltä lähtien, "Liikkuvaan junaan" ja osaajien joukkoon on nyt helppo hypätä mukaan!

jobs.title: Assistant Professor (tenure-track) in Finance / Biträdande professor (nivå 1) i finansiell ekonomi (tenure track)
jobs.description:
[Se nedan för svenska]

Hanken School of Economics invites applications for an Assistant Professor (tenure-track) in Finance

beginning no later than August 2027, or as otherwise agreed. The position is at the Finance Unit at the Department of Finance and Economics in Helsinki. For this position, we will consider candidates in all fields of Finance.

The position is part of the Hanken tenure track system. It is open to talented individuals who have potential for an excellent scientific career. Individuals placed on the Hanken tenure track have the possibility to advance in their career through regular performance assessments, which consider their merits in all relevant qualification areas in accordance with [Hankens tenure track guidelines](https://www.hanken.fi/en/faculty-staff/job-opportunities/job-opportunities/hankens-tenure-track-system).

Hanken School of Economics is a research-oriented business school offering education in English and Swedish. Hankens Finance unit is committed to high-quality teaching and research. We offer full scale graduate and undergraduate programs.

We have a strong research climate, reflected in a growing volume and range of research activities. We value high-quality, practice-oriented research, as evidenced by our publications in top-ranked journals. In addition, Hanken's Finance unit is an active partner in the Graduate School of Finance (GSF), which offers the national doctoral program in finance. GSF also organizes seminars and workshops for faculty members and doctoral students.

Requirements
The applicants will be reviewed based on their research, teaching, institutional service, and societal impact. Applicants should hold a doctoral degree (or be near completion of the doctorate) in Finance (or a related field). When evaluating the applicants qualifications, the main focus will be on the potential to conduct high-quality scientific research and the potential to provide high-quality teaching. A focus on asset pricing is considered a strong merit.

Being a stand-alone business school with strong Nordic roots, Hanken offers degree programmes in Swedish and English. For this position, applicants are required to have fluent command of English, knowledge of Swedish is considered a merit. Hanken supports its faculty in learning the Swedish language, which serves as the administrative language of the business school.

Academic staff at Hanken are expected to carry out and supervise scientific research, provide academic teaching, closely follow the advances of their field, and contribute service to Hanken, the academic community, and society. Teaching tasks are allocated based on the curriculum needs of the subject and by considering relevant expertise.

The full-time position has an annual working time of 1612 hours. During the academic year, it is expected that a minimum average of three days per week is spent at the office in Helsinki to actively contribute to the research and teaching environment. Hanken requires academic employees to reside and work in Finland, and it offers relocation support for applicants coming from outside Finland.

Salary
The salary is based on the university salary system in Finland (includes employee healthcare as well as pension and holiday contributions). The exact salary level depends on the recruited individuals qualifications. Hanken will support the selected employee with a start-up research budget, and additional research, travel and teaching development grants can also be applied for. Hanken rewards excellence in both research and teaching.

For more Information
For additional information, please contact Head of Department Jesper Haga (jesper.haga@hanken.fi) or Head of Subject Karl Felixson (karl.felixson@hanken.fi).

General instructions for applicants are provided [here](https://www.hanken.fi/en/faculty-staff/job-opportunities/job-opportunities/hankens-tenure-track-system/research-track-0). Also, read more about Hanken as an employer [here](https://www.hanken.fi/en/node/2413861).

Recruitment process and timeline
The application deadline is 22 November 2026. Selected candidates will be interviewed online shortly after the application deadline. Short-listed candidates will be invited to on-site campus visits including an interview and research presentation.

How to apply
The application is to be addressed to the Rector and application materials should include:

- CV (proposed content [here](https://tenk.fi/en/advice-and-materials/template-researchers-curriculum-vitae)), including list of publications.
- Personal statement, which includes a description of past research and its scientific quality, academic impact, plans for future research and a description of the candidates service to the department and university and a description of the candidates societal impact.
- Teaching portfolio (proposed content [here](https://www.hanken.fi/en/faculty-staff/job-opportunities/job-opportunities/applications-and-selection-process)).
- Copies of no more than five research publications, including a job market paper
- Three letters of reference from academic researchers, to be submitted via [Econjobmarket](https://econjobmarket.org/positions?show=all&type=reg&searchType=quick&saved_search_id=0&cutoffDate=2007-01-01&position_type_id=&category_id=&iso2=&oid=1337#ad-11885) or directly to Hanken via humanresources@hanken.fi.

Please submit all application materials in English in Hankens recruitment database LAURA. The application deadline is 22 November 2026.

Hanken School of Economics is one of the leading business schools in the Nordic countries. It is located in Finland, with campuses in Helsinki and Vaasa. Hanken offers a range of B.Sc., M.Sc., EMBA, PhD, and Executive Development programmes taught mainly in English and Swedish. Hanken has 2 725 Bachelor and Masters students, and 118 Doctoral students. The School has close ties to the business community and an active alumni network with over 13 800 alumni working in more than 70 countries. The School is accredited by AACSB, AMBA, and EQUIS. The Masters programme was ranked 56 in the Masters in Management by Financial Times in 2026. Hanken is also recognized for its research quality, its international orientation, and its focus on sustainability.

----------------

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
About the role

Bittium SafeMove Comms is a quantum-safe, end-to-end encrypted communications platform for government agencies, defence forces, and critical infrastructure organisations. It covers voice, video, and messaging on Android, iOS, and Windows, and is built on a zero-trust architecture that customers can run on-premises, in air-gapped networks, in the cloud, or in isolated tactical environments.

Within our Security business, we are looking for an experienced and versatile Senior Full Stack Developer to join Bittium Wireless Oy and the team that develops, deploys, and maintains SafeMove Comms across our entire customer base. The position is based in Oulu, Finland, and offers a hybrid working model. You will work on both client and server, and you'll have real influence on how the product evolves. When the situation calls for it, you'll take the technical lead, both within the team and together with our customers.

We are a small team, and we see that as a real opportunity for you. You'll get to take ownership early, have a direct say in technical decisions, and learn faster than you would in a larger organisation, across clients, servers, security, and customer work. With that opportunity comes responsibility: you'll own what you build, and you should be comfortable handling the pressure that comes with work where our customers' security depends on us.

What you'll do

- Develop SafeMove Comms desktop and mobile clients as well as server-side components
- Solve demanding integration and architecture challenges without losing sight of the user experience
- Take ownership of problems and drive them to working solutions, independently or together with the team
- Lead technical discussions with the team and customers when needed
- Take part in deploying and maintaining the product in demanding customer environments

What we expect from you

- Solid experience in software development across both client-side and server-side technologies
- Strong software development skills and an agile mindset
- Good collaboration skills and the ability to solve demanding problems independently
- A willingness to take ownership and provide technical direction within the team and beyond
- Experience with desktop development using JavaScript/TypeScript and React, or with Android development
- Experience with server-side technologies such as Linux, Java, SQL databases, and Nginx
- Fluent Finnish and English

We especially value

- Knowledge of network security
- Knowledge of the Signal Protocol or similar end-to-end encryption protocols
- Knowledge of PKI and certificate management
- Experience in iOS development

Nice to have

- Broader expertise in information security and cryptography
- Experience with Rust, Redux, or Electron

Interested?

Send us your application as soon as possible. We will begin interviewing candidates during the application period.

About Bittium

Bittium specializes in the development of reliable, secure communications and connectivity solutions leveraging its 40-year legacy of expertise in advanced radio communication technologies. Bittium provides innovative products and services, customized solutions based on its product platforms and R&D services. Complementing its communications and connectivity solutions, Bittium offers proven information security solutions for mobile devices and portable computers. Bittium also provides healthcare technology products and services for biosignal measuring in the areas of cardiology and neurology. Net sales in 2025 were EUR 119.3 million and operating result was EUR 19.4 million. Bittium is listed on Nasdaq Helsinki

jobs.title: keittiön vuoropäällikkö
jobs.description:
**Tule luomaan elämyksiä Imatran Kylpylään keittiön vuoropäällikkönä!**

Haluatko työskennellä monipuolisessa keittiöympäristössä, jossa yksikään päivä ei ole samanlainen? Etsimme nyt energistä ja ammattitaitoista **keittiön vuoropäällikköä** vahvistamaan tiimiämme Imatran Kylpylässä.

Vuoropäällikkönä vastaat keittiön päivittäisen toiminnan sujuvuudesta, johdat työvuorosi tiimiä esimerkilläsi ja varmistat, että asiakkaamme saavat laadukkaita makuelämyksiä niin hotellin ravintoloissa, kokouksissa kuin juhlatilaisuuksissakin. Olet tärkeässä roolissa luomassa viihtyisää työilmapiiriä sekä kehittämässä keittiön toimintaa yhdessä muun esihenkilötiimin kanssa.

Rattaché(e) au Head of Commercial and Digital Solutions, vous vous coordonnerez avec le Program Lead, le Lead métier et l'intégrateur externe. Le delivery IT couvre principalement l'implémentation de la solution Front Crédit nCino (Salesforce), l'intégration avec le Core Banking Temenos, les flux Data (nCino, datawarehouse.) et l'organisation des phases de tests (sprint, intégration, UAT). Vos responsabilités principales : Revoir et optimiser les méthodologies de planification/estimation, d'implémentation et de test Gérer le stream en mode projet dans le cadre de la gouvernance globale du programme Rapporter et faire valider toutes les décisions au Head of Commercial and Digital Solutions Structurer et optimiser toutes les activités (spécifications, développements, testing, déploiement.) en mesurant les résultats via des KPI Mener la résolution des points bloquants et aligner les parties sur les objectifs Suivre les actions, décisions, planning, budget, dépendances, problèmes et risques du stream Rentrer dans les sujets fonctionnels pour être force de proposition sur des alternatives argumentées (fonctionnel, effort, technique) Votre profil : Vous combinez expérience bancaire, excellente capacité d'analyse, rigueur d'exécution et aptitude démontrée à mener des programmes à fort enjeu jusqu'à l'acceptance métier. Leadership & Influence : Expérience avérée dans le pilotage du delivery d'un programme de transformation Leadership naturel et forte capacité de mobilisation d'équipes multidisciplinaires Excellente gestion des parties prenant/antes , y compris le management exécutif Capacité à prendre des décisions difficiles, conduire les arbitrages et débloquer les situations Maîtrise de la planification, du suivi des jalons, des risques et des dépendances Capacité à produire des tableaux de bord, KPI et rapports de pilotage Delivery & Exécution : Expérience avérée des phases Build, SIT, UAT et Go-Live sur des packages similaires à Salesforce et Temenos Forte orientation résultats et capacité à revoir les méthodologies Excellente maîtrise de la planification, de la priorisation et de l'escalade Analyse & Compétences Personnelles : Excellentes capacités analytiques, rigueur méthodologique et esprit de synthèse Approche pragmatique et orientée solution Bonne connaissance des processus bancaires, du contexte réglementaire et des enjeux de transformation du secteur financier Capacité à travailler  et à gérer plusieurs chantiers en parallèle Autonomie, proactivité et orientation client Maîtrise des langues : français indispensable, anglais professionnel courant. Luxembourgeois ou allemand : un atout. Envoyez votre candidature comprenant une lettre de motivation et un C.V. détaillé à  ou contactez-nous directement au +   pour plus de renseignements. Votre candidature sera traitée en toute confidentialité.

jobs.description: LA CHAMBRE DE COMMERCE SE PROPOSE D'ENGAGER POUR LA HOUSE OF SUSTAINABILITY : Decarbonisation & Energy Transition Advisorà temps plein et à durée indéterminée La Chambre de Commerce est l'institution phare des entreprises et de l'économie du Luxembourg, regroupant l'ensemble des entreprises luxembourgeoises exerçant des activités industrielles, commerciales, financier/ières, de services et émanant du secteur de l'Horeca. La House of Sustainability est une initiative de la Chambre de Commerce visant à soutenir et à faciliter la transition durable des entreprises luxembourgeoises. Elle informe, sensibilise et accompagne les entreprises sur les enjeux de durabilité au moyen d'une offre de services dédiée. Celle-ci comprend notamment des événements, des ressources, des formations, des programmes d'accompagnement et des aides financier/ières. Au-delà de sa propre offre, la House of Sustainability constitue également un premier point de contact sur les questions de durabilité et oriente les entreprises vers les initiatives et les acteurs pertinents de l'écosystème. Au sein de la House of Sustainability de la Chambre de Commerce, le Decarbonisation & Energy Transition Advisor accompagne les entreprises ressortissant/antes dans leurs démarches de décarbonation et de transition énergétique, dans le cadre du programme Klimapakt fir Betriber (KPB).En tant que point de contact privilégié, il/elle sensibilise les entreprises aux enjeux et opportunités liés à la décarbonation et la transition énergétique. Il/elle fournit un conseil de premier niveau, identifie les besoins et les potentiels d'amélioration, et aide les entreprises à prioriser des mesures adaptées à leur situation. Il/elle accompagne ensuite les entreprises dans la mise en œuvre des actions identifiées en les orientant vers les dispositifs de soutien, outils et mécanismes de financement pertinents. Le rôle consiste ainsi à convaincre les entreprises ressortissant/antes de la Chambre de Commerce des opportunités offertes par la transition énergétique et la décarbonation, afin de réduire leurs coûts d'exploitation, de renforcer leur compétitivité et leur résilience, tout en diminuant leur dépendance aux énergies fossiles. RESPONSABILITÉS Réaliser des visites d'entreprises afin de présenter aux entreprises membres de la Chambre de Commerce les possibilités liées à la décarbonation et à la transition énergétique, et de formuler des recommandations adaptées à leur secteur d'activité, leur taille et leur niveau de maturité.Contribuer par son expertise à la conception d'événements thématiques en partenariat avec les parties prenant/antes du Klimapakt fir Betriber afin de promouvoir les opportunités liées à la décarbonation et à la transition énergétique, ainsi que les dispositifs d'accompagnement existants.Orienter les entreprises vers les outils et dispositifs du Klimapakt fir Betriber afin de leur permettre d'évaluer leur situation, de définir des plans d'action adaptés à leurs besoins et d'assurer le suivi de la mise en œuvre de leurs actions de transition.Développer des supports de conseil permettant d'informer les entreprises sur les dispositifs d'aide étatiques disponibles pour leurs investissements dans des mesures de protection du climat et de les accompagner dans leurs démarches administratives.Collaborer avec les partenaires institutionnels afin de faire évoluer et d'adapter les solutions et dispositifs d'accompagnement existants aux besoins des entreprises.Contribuer au développement de contenus thématiques et sectoriels mettant en avant les bénéfices économiques, environnementaux et stratégiques de la transition énergétique et de décarbonation.Alimenter les différents canaux de communication de la House of Sustainability (site web, newsletter, réseaux sociaux, publications spécialisées).Participer activement aux groupes de travail et réunions de coordination avec les partenaires du Klimapakt fir Betriber. Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide.
