jobs.title: Senior Application Carve-out Execution Specialist
jobs.description:
For our client were looking for a hands-on Application Carve-out Execution Specialist.

Role and responsibilities:
We are looking for a hands-on Application Carve-out Execution Specialist to increase the teams practical execution capacity across multiple applications and workstreams. This is not primarily a project management role. The person should independently take ownership of defined work packages, complete the necessary groundwork and execution and involve Service Managers when decisions or application-specific expertise are required.

Scope: Dedicated demerger resources supporting application portfolios currently managed by IT Service Managers.

Resource: Support for some subset of the applications TWIN360, TWIN8, GlobalTrade, 360T, Bloomberg, Oanda FX Rates, Nomentia Cash Management, SWIFT Alliance Lite2

Typical responsibilities include:
· Execute clearly defined application carve-out work packages independently.
· Perform application and dependency analysis and collect required technical information.
· Work with vendors and other IT teams to progress technical separation activities.
· Support and coordinate application, integration, access and environment-related changes.
· Prepare and execute testing, cutover and validation activities.
· Follow up open technical actions and proactively drive them to completion.
· Perform technical troubleshooting and resolve issues together with appropriate specialists and vendors.
· Prepare and maintain application, carve-out, test, cutover and handover documentation.
· Collect evidence and verify completion of agreed separation activities.
· Support solution handover and operational readiness.

Expected background and capabilities:
· Experience in hands-on work with enterprise/business-critical applications.
· Experience with application migrations, transformations, carve-outs, demergers or M&A environments is preferred.
· Practical understanding of application dependencies such as integrations, data, environments, access and infrastructure.
· Experience with testing, deployment/cutover and technical documentation.
· Ability to coordinate directly with application vendors and technical teams.
· Strong problem-solving skills.
· Self-driven and structured way of working with a proactive hands-on attitude.
· Ability to take an agreed task or work package and independently drive it to completion.
· Fluent written and spoken English.

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Do you have hands-on experience with application carve-outs, demergers &A, migrations, or similar separation projects?*
- Have you independently owned and driven technical work packages involving enterprise or business-critical applications?*
- Do you have practical experience analysing application dependencies, including integrations, data, environments, access, and infrastructure?*
- Have you been hands-on with testing, cutover, deployment, validation, and technical documentation for applications?*

Please apply with your updated CV in English, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role. We offer continuously, which means that we sometimes remove the assignments before deadline. If you are interested, we recommend that you apply immediately.

Contract start: November 2026
Contract end: Until July-August 2027
Allocation: 100 %
Location: Preferably Tampere or Jyväskylä. Remote within Finland also a possibility.

We offer you: We offer a versatile assignment where every day is different and interesting. We also offer a very competitive salary and good employee benefits.

Are you interested in becoming a part of our dynamic team? The position will be filled as soon as a suitable person is found, so please be quick and submit your application! 

Please include your salary expectation in your application. For more information, contact Kimmo Kärsämä, tel. 050 412 7500, kimmo.karsama@lokki.fi

jobs.title: Senior Signal Processing Engineer – Acoustics & DSP
jobs.description:
Triton Depth | Copenhagen, Denmark | Full-time

About Triton Depth

Triton Depth is a Danish defence technology company developing advanced maritime sensing and surveillance technologies.

We bring together expertise in electronics, embedded systems, signal processing, and artificial intelligence to develop innovative solutions for some of the most challenging problems in maritime security.

We are a fast-growing, multidisciplinary engineering team working on technologies with real-world applications in defence and critical infrastructure protection.

The Role

We are looking for a highly skilled Signal Processing Engineer with a strong background in digital signal processing (DSP), preferably specializing in acoustics.

You will work on complex signal-processing challenges, developing algorithms that extract meaningful information from real-world acoustic data. Your work will involve advanced mathematical modelling, spectral analysis, filtering, detection, and statistical signal processing.

We are particularly interested in engineers who enjoy exploring signals, understanding their underlying physical characteristics, and pushing the boundaries of what can be extracted through classical signal-processing techniques.

This is a research-intensive, hands-on engineering position with significant technical freedom and ownership.

You will work closely with our embedded software, electronics, and AI teams, taking ideas from mathematical concepts through experimental validation and practical implementation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and implement advanced digital signal-processing algorithms.

  • Analyze complex acoustic signals in both time and frequency domains.

  • Develop techniques for spectral analysis, digital filtering, noise reduction, and signal detection.

  • Apply statistical signal processing and estimation theory to extract meaningful information from noisy measurements.

  • Investigate new signal-processing approaches and evaluate their performance using real-world data.

  • Develop efficient implementations of algorithms for practical applications.

  • Design experiments, analyze results, and continuously improve algorithm performance.

  • Collaborate with our multidisciplinary engineering team to integrate signal-processing solutions into operational systems.

Qualifications

We value technical ability, curiosity, and problem-solving skills more than specific degrees or years of experience.

We would like you to have:

  • An MSc or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Signal Processing, Applied Physics, Mathematics, or a related field.

  • A strong theoretical foundation in digital signal processing.

  • Experience with spectral analysis, FFT, digital filters, and time-frequency analysis.

  • Knowledge of statistical signal processing, detection theory, and estimation methods.

  • Experience developing and evaluating signal-processing algorithms.

  • Strong programming skills in Python, MATLAB, and/or C++.

  • Experience working with real-world measurement data, including noisy or low-SNR signals.

  • The ability to independently investigate complex technical problems and develop practical solutions.

It would be an advantage if you have experience with:

  • Acoustic signal processing.

  • Adaptive filtering and advanced noise-reduction techniques.

  • Passive sensing systems.

  • Real-time or embedded DSP.

  • Advanced mathematical modelling and numerical methods.

  • Signal processing within defence, aerospace, telecommunications, or scientific instrumentation.

  • Academic research, including publications or a PhD in a relevant field.

Experience in the defence industry is not required. We welcome candidates from both industry and academia, including researchers looking to apply their expertise to real-world engineering challenges.

What We Offer

Work on meaningful challenges. Contribute to advanced technologies addressing real-world security challenges.

Technical freedom and ownership. Take responsibility for complex engineering problems, explore new approaches, and influence the technical direction of our products.

From research to reality. See your algorithms move beyond simulations and become part of real systems deployed in demanding environments.

A multidisciplinary engineering environment. Work alongside talented engineers specializing in embedded software, electronics, artificial intelligence, and systems engineering.

A growing defence technology company. Join Triton Depth at an exciting stage, where individual contributions have a direct impact on the company's technology and future.

Who You Are

You are someone who genuinely enjoys understanding signals.

You are curious about the information hidden within complex measurements and have the mathematical knowledge and practical skills to uncover it.

You are equally comfortable exploring theoretical concepts, experimenting with algorithms, and analyzing real-world data.

You enjoy difficult, open-ended technical challenges and take pride in developing solutions that work outside controlled laboratory environments.

Above all, you are motivated by the opportunity to turn advanced signal-processing research into technology with real-world impact.

Apply

If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.

Send us your CV and a short introduction describing your background and relevant experience.

We are particularly interested in hearing about signal-processing projects, research, or technical challenges you have worked on.

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark
Employment: Full-time

jobs.title: Kokki
jobs.description:
**Kokki, tule tekemään Saimaan makuja Sahanlahteen!**

Sahanlahti Resort on perheomisteinen, ympäri vuoden palveleva matkailukohde Saimaan rannalla Puumalassa. Meille tullaan hyvän ruoan, viihtyisän majoituksen, järviluonnon ja lämminhenkisten kohtaamisten vuoksi. Vieraanamme on niin lomailijoita, juhlaseurueita kuin yritysryhmiä Suomesta ja maailmalta. Haluamme, että jokainen tuntee olonsa tervetulleeksi ja saa mukaansa syyn palata.

Ruoka on Sahanlahden sydän. Keittiössämme lähiruoka tarkoittaa lähiseudun tuottajia, sesongin raaka-aineita ja omin käsin tekemistä. Lautasillemme päätyvät lähijärvien kalat, metsien sienet ja marjat sekä lähitilojen parhaat antimet. Arvostamme raaka-aineiden alkuperää, selkeitä makuja ja huolellista käsityötä.

Kolme erilaista ravintolaamme – maisemaravintola Koskivahti, avotuliravintola Pajapirtti ja kesäravintola Rantamakasiini – tarjoavat monipuolisen ympäristön kokin työhön. Pajapirtin avotuli-illallinen valittiin **Suomen parhaaksi ruokamatkailutuotteeksi Hungry for Finland -ruokamatkailukilpailussa 2026**. Olemme saavutuksesta ylpeitä ja haluamme jatkaa ruokatuotteemme kehittämistä yhdessä osaavan tiimin kanssa.

**Etsimme nyt ammattiylpeää kokkia joukkoomme**

Toivomme sinulta vähintään viiden vuoden työkokemusta kokin tehtävistä sekä innostusta ruokaan, ravintola-alaan ja lähiruokaan perustuvaan tapaamme tehdä työtä. Haluat oppia uutta, kehittää omaa osaamistasi ja tuoda ajatuksiasi yhteiseen tekemiseen.

Osaat suunnitella ja viedä työsi läpi itsenäisesti sekä toimia osana tiimiä. **Järjestelmällisyys ja siisteys ovat meille erityisen tärkeitä:** pidät työpisteesi kunnossa, ennakoit tulevaa ja huolehdit siitä, että keittiön arki sujuu myös kiireessä. Arvostamme hyvää yhteistyötä, vastuullista työotetta ja reilua suhtautumista työkavereihin.

**Työ elää vuodenaikojen mukana**

Sahanlahdessa työtehtävät ja työyhteisön koko vaihtelevat sesonkien mukaan. Kesäkaudella keittiötiimissämme työskentelee noin 15 henkilöä. Talvikaudella olet osa kolmen hengen keittiötiimiä, joka täydentyy tarpeen mukaan lisäkäsillä.

Työssäsi osallistut monipuolisesti ravintoloidemme ja tilaisuuksiemme ruoanvalmistukseen, esivalmisteluista annosten viimeistelyyn. Pienessä talvitiimissä korostuvat itsenäisyys ja kokonaisuuden hallinta, kesällä puolestaan yhteistyö suuremman tiimin kanssa. Ympäri vuoden yhteistä ovat hyvä maku, huolellinen tekeminen ja ylpeys omasta työstä.

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen työn lähiruoan parissa, mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi ja olla mukana rakentamassa Sahanlahden ruokaelämyksiä. Meillä laadukas tekeminen ja lupsakka yhdessäolo kuuluvat samaan keittiöön.

**Puumalassa on tilaa hyvälle arjelle**

Puumala tarjoaa Saimaan maisemien ja luonnon lisäksi myös käytännön etuja: maksuttoman varhaiskasvatuksen, alhaisen kunnallisveron sekä hyvin saatavilla olevia vuokra- ja omistusasuntoja. Täällä on tilaa asua, harrastaa ja viihtyä myös työpäivän jälkeen.

Työn aloitus sovitaan joustavasti, kuitenkin viimeistään **helmikuussa 2027**.

Kiinnostuitko? Kerro meille itsestäsi, kokemuksestasi ja siitä, mikä sinua ruoan tekemisessä innostaa.

**Tervetuloa tekemään hyvää ruokaa ja hyvää arkea Sahanlahteen!**

You are an experienced salesperson who combines commercial drive with a good understanding of technical products and services. jobs.title: Application Engineer
jobs.description:
Do you want to build the control systems that make ships cleaner and more efficient? Join WE Tech as an Application Engineer and help us deliver electrification solutions to vessels all over the world.

WE Tech Solutions is a Finnish clean-tech company that supplies shaft generator systems, hybrid and electric propulsion, energy storage and other electrification solutions for new and existing vessels.

**Your Opportunity**

This is a hands-on engineering role in an international team. You will develop and configure the control software for our WE Drive solutions, which measure and control electric power generation, distribution and energy storage on board ships. You will follow your work from design through manufacturing and factory testing to commissioning on board, in line with marine standards and the rules of the major classification societies.

**What will you do?**

- Develop and configure control system software for WE Drive solutions, mainly in IEC 61131-3 (Structured Text) on PLC-based platforms

- Build control systems that are secure by design, in line with IACS UR E27 and validate system functionality against customer and class requirements (DNV, ABS, LR, BV and others)

- Prepare and maintain project documentation, including functional descriptions, system block diagrams and other relevant or required documentation

- Give technical support to internal teams, customers, shipyards and partners during development, manufacturing and commissioning


**What are we looking for?**

We are looking for an experienced engineer who enjoys solving technical problems, takes ownership of their work and communicates well with colleagues and other stakeholders. You are comfortable working independently and as part of a project team.

**We expect you have**

- M.Sc. or B.Sc. in Automation or Electrical Engineering, or similar

- Relevant experience with industrial control systems, including PLCs and VFDs and a good understanding of electrical power systems and how power electronics work

- Hands-on programming experience with Structured Text and PLC development environments

- A structured way of working and high attention to detail, especially in documentation

- Full professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken

- Eligibility to live and work in Finland


**Strong advantages**

- Experience with control system development in marine or offshore projects and working with class requirements

- Knowledge of power electronics, variable frequency drives, DC grids or battery systems as well as experience with industrial communication protocols

- Knowledge of or previous experience with cyber security for industrial control systems, especially IACS UR E26/E27 is seen as an advantage.


**Why WE Tech?**

- Meaningful, hands-on work with clean technology for the global shipping industry

- Real ownership of your work, from design to commissioning on board

- Varied engineering tasks and interesting international projects

- A team of skilled professionals and real opportunities to grow your competence

- Hybrid working and flexible working hours


You will join a growing international company with an expanding global installed base and significant opportunities to develop lifecycle business with existing and future customers.

**What we offer**

- Hybrid working solutions and flexible work hours

- Competitive salary

- Culture and sports benefits (Epassi)

- Extensive lunch benefits

- Diverse working environment

- Meaningful, hands-on role where your participation is seen

- Central office location in the heart of Vaasa


Does this sound like a good fit for you?

Please apply before the 9th of November 2026. Learn more about WE Tech at **www.wetech.fi**.

jobs.description:
**Kimbtron Oy etsii myyntiedustajia kasvavalle tekoälyalalle!**

Haluatko päästä myymään moderneja tekoälyratkaisuja yrityksille ja rakentamaan omaa menestystäsi nopeasti kehittyvällä toimialalla?

Kimbtron on suomalainen tekoälyratkaisujen kehittäjä, joka rakentaa käytännönläheisiä AI-työkaluja yritysten arjen tehostamiseen, tiedonhallintaan ja liiketoiminnan kehittämiseen.

Etsimme nyt tavoitteellisia ja oma-aloitteisia myyntiedustajia viemään ratkaisuja uusille yritysasiakkaille.

**Mitä pääset myymään?**

Kimbtronin tuotevalikoimaan kuuluu muun muassa:

- **Johdon raportointi ja päätöksenteon tuki:** Ratkaisut yritysten tiedonhallintaan, raportointiin ja liiketoiminnan seurantaan.

- **Älykäs perehdytys ja työntekijöiden tuki:** Tekoälyratkaisut perehdytykseen, ohjeistukseen ja monikieliseen työntekijätukeen.

- **AI-tuotehaku:** Ratkaisut teknisen kaupan tuotetietojen, dokumenttien ja tuotteiden nopeaan löytämiseen.


Tuotteita kehitetään jatkuvasti, ja myyntiedustajilla on mahdollisuus päästä mukaan myös uusien ratkaisujen kaupallistamiseen.

**Mitä tehtävä sisältää?**

Tehtävässä vastaat uusien yritysasiakkaiden hankinnasta, asiakaskontaktien avaamisesta ja myyntimahdollisuuksien edistämisestä.

Sinun ei tarvitse olla tekoälyn tekninen asiantuntija. Saat tueksesi tuote-esittelyt, demot sekä Kimbtronin teknisen asiantuntemuksen.

Tärkeintä on kyky tunnistaa asiakkaiden tarpeita, rakentaa luottamusta ja saada kauppaa aikaan.

**Mitä tarjoamme?**

- Kiinnostavat ja kilpailukykyiset tuotteet nopeasti kasvavalla tekoälyalalla

- Selkeän provisiopohjaisen ansaintamallin, jossa oma aktiivisuus ja tulokset vaikuttavat ansioihin

- Valmiit tuotedemot ja teknisen asiantuntijatuen myyntiin

- Joustavuutta oman myyntityön organisointiin

- Mahdollisuuden rakentaa pitkäaikaisia asiakassuhteita

- **Etenemismahdollisuuksia** esimerkiksi myynnin vetovastuuseen, uusien tuotteiden kaupallistamiseen tai laajempiin liiketoiminnan kehitystehtäviin


**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Arvostamme erityisesti:

- Myyntihenkisyyttä, tavoitteellisuutta ja oma-aloitteisuutta

- Kykyä lähestyä yrityspäättäjiä ja avata uusia asiakassuhteita

- Kiinnostusta teknologiaan ja tekoälyn mahdollisuuksiin

- Hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja neuvottelutaitoja

- Halua kehittyä ja edetä urallasi


Aiempi kokemus B2B-myynnistä tai olemassa olevat yritysverkostot katsotaan eduksi, mutta ratkaisevinta on asenne ja kyky saada tuloksia aikaan.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Haluatko päästä mukaan rakentamaan seuraavan sukupolven tekoälyliiketoimintaa?

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja kerro lyhyesti itsestäsi, myyntikokemuksestasi sekä siitä, miksi juuri sinä sopisit tähän myyntitiimiin.

jobs.title: Keittiön vuoropäällikkö, Original Sokos Hotel Vaakuna, Kouvola
jobs.description:

KOUVOLA

Haussa on vakituiseen ja osa-aikaiseen (90 h/3 vko) työsuhteeseen

KEITTIÖN VUOROPÄÄLLIKKÖ, Original Sokos Hotel Vaakuna, Kouvola.

Vuoropäällikön tehtävä on huolehtia arjen toimivuudesta, jotta työntekijät keittiössä tietävät mitä heiltä odotetaan ja asiakkaat saavat toivomansa maku- ja palvelukokemuksen. Vuoropäällikkö huolehtii myös yhteistyöstä salin ja keittiön välillä osallistuen päivittäisiin, ihan tavallisiin työtehtäviin muun henkilöstön tapaan. Hänen roolissaan korostuvat tiimin ohjaaminen ja esimerkin näyttäminen muulle työryhmälle.

Original Sokos Hotel Vaakunan keittiössä valmistetaan makuelämyksiä hotellivieraille, kokousasiakkaille ja paikallisille herkuttelijoille. Ravintolapalvelut ulottuvat runsaasta hotelliaamiaisesta kokous- ja juhlatarjoiluihin sekä à la carte -annoksiin, joten työpäivät ovat vaihtelevia ja tarjoavat sopivasti vauhtia. Monipuolinen toimintaympäristö antaa mahdollisuuden hyödyntää laajasti omaa ammattitaitoa ja kehittää toimintaa yhdessä osaavan tiimin kanssa.

Vuoropäälliköltä odotamme:
💡 Kokemusta keittiötyöstä sekä alalle soveltuvaa koulutusta. Omaat ainakin useamman vuoden kokemuksen kokin työstä ja tiedät mitä ravintolakeittiössä työskentely vaatii.
💡 Paineensietokykyä ja taitoa priorisoida. Pääsi pysyy kylmänä myös paineen alla ja olet kykenevä tekemään tarvittaessa nopeitakin päätöksiä.
💡 Asiakaspalveluasennetta. Meistä jokainen on asiakasta varten – myös keittiössä.
💡 Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja ja tiimityövalmiuksia. Osaat toimia osana tiimiä ja huomioida tiimiläisten erilaiset tarpeet heidän työtään ohjatessasi.
💡 Valmiutta työskennellä kaikissa työvuoroissa aukioloaikojemme mukaisesti. Olet täysi-ikäinen ja puhut hyvää suomea, sillä se on pääasiallinen kieli työyhteisössämme.

Valitulle henkilölle tarjoamme:
💚 Ammatillisesti mielenkiintoisen ja kehittävän työn upeiden makumaailmojen äärellä.
💚 Vakituisen työsuhteen alueen suurimman yksityisen työnantajan palveluksessa.
💚 Matkailu-, ravintola- ja vapaa-ajan palveluiden esihenkilöitä koskevan työehtosopimukseen mukaisen palkan (15,60-16,93 €/h), jonka suuruuteen aiempi kokemuksesi alalta vaikuttaa.
💚 S-Ryhmän poikkeuksellisen hyvät henkilöstöedut, jotka ovat käytettävissä kautta koko Suomen heti työsuhteen alusta alkaen.

jobs.title: Energitekniker Ustekveikja Energi
jobs.description:
Vil du jobbe tett på vannkraftproduksjonen og ha en praktisk og variert arbeidshverdag?

Ustekveikja Energi Holding AS har ansvar for drift og vedlikehold av tre kraftverk i nærområdet rundt Geilo, som eies helt eller delvis av Hol kommune. Nå ønsker vi å styrke produksjonsavdelingen med dyktige og engasjerte energiteknikere.

Hos oss blir du en del av et lite fagmiljø der samarbeid, selvstendighet og sikker drift står sentralt. Arbeidshverdagen er praktisk og variert, med oppmøte på Geilo og arbeidsoppgaver ute ved kraftverkene.

Dette blir noen av dine oppgaver:

  • Drift, tilsyn og vedlikehold av kraftverkene

  • Feilsøking og praktisk problemløsning på tekniske anlegg

  • Planlagte og løpende vedlikeholdsoppgaver

  • Bidra til sikker og stabil drift av anleggene

  • Samarbeide tett med kolleger og relevante fagmiljøer

  • Delta i vaktordningen for kraftverkene

Vi ser etter deg som har:

  • Fagbrev innen elektro, gjerne med erfaring fra høyspentanlegg, og/eller fagbrev som mekaniker, gjerne med erfaring fra kraftbransjen

  • Relevant praktisk erfaring fra teknisk drift og vedlikehold

  • Gode IKT-kunnskaper

  • Førerkort klasse BE

  • Evne til å kjøre snøscooter under krevende forhold

  • Gode norskkunnskaper, muntlig og skriftlig

Hvem vi ser etter?

Vi tror du vil trives hos oss dersom du liker å løse praktiske og tekniske utfordringer, samtidig som du tar sikkerhet på alvor. Du arbeider godt både selvstendig og sammen med andre, tar ansvar for egne oppgaver og bidrar positivt når laget skal finne gode løsninger.

Vi ser gjerne at du er:

  • Løsningsorientert og praktisk anlagt

  • Positiv og nysgjerrig

  • Strukturert og ansvarsbevisst

  • Samarbeidsorientert og tillitsskapende

  • Fleksibel og åpen for varierte arbeidsoppgaver

  • Opptatt av HMS og sikkerhet

Hos oss får du

  • En variert og selvstendig jobb innen fornybar energiproduksjon

  • Mulighet til å arbeide med tre ulike vannkraftverk

  • Et inkluderende og samarbeidsorientert arbeidsmiljø

  • Konkurransedyktige lønnsbetingelser

  • Vaktordning med gode avspaseringsordninger

  • En arbeidshverdag som kombinerer oppmøte på hovedkontoret på Geilo med arbeid ute ved kraftverkene

Interessert? Ta gjerne kontakt med Linda Brusletto på telefon 416 76 428 eller Cathrine Svendsen på telefon 926 06 610

Alle henvendelser behandles konfidensielt.

Søknadsfrist: Snarest, vi behandler søkere fortløpende

Søknad med CV registreres i vårt digitale søknadssystem så snart som mulig.

For å unngå bedrageriforsøk vil vi presisere at vi aldri ber om BankID-informasjon i søknadsprosessen.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Skagerak Consulting er et tverrfaglig miljø innen rekruttering og rådgivning. Vi jobber med å utvikle mennesker og organisasjoner for å skape varige forbedringer og verdier i offentlige og private virksomheter. Vårt arbeid er basert på en kombinasjon av dokumentert metodikk, praktisk erfaring og en god porsjon sunn fornuft.

Vi utvikler mennesker og organisasjoner

jobs.title: Site Engineers
jobs.description:
Would you like to help build reliable and safe infrastructure that makes a real difference in people's everyday lives?

Destia is looking for several Site Engineers for projects starting in early 2027. Your role may focus on one of the following areas: scheduling, safety, quantity management, quality, or environmental management.

What kind of role and team would you be joining?

As a Site Engineer, you will play a key role in the project team. Within your area of responsibility, you will help ensure that schedules and quality are managed throughout the construction phase, while making sure that work is carried out safely, with due consideration for the environment and in accordance with agreed requirements.

Your key responsibilities

- Preparing, implementing and monitoring project schedules

- Quantity management, tracking and reporting

- Environmental engineering and management

- Financial management, including cost monitoring, forecasting and invoicing

- Managing additional and variation works, including identifying, calculating and submitting quotations for them

- Safety monitoring, guidance, preventive measures and documentation

- Quality assurance and documentation

- Quantity management and control

- Liaising with authorities and supporting permit processes

In your application, we would be pleased to hear which aspects of site engineering interest you most.

You will work closely with the Site Manager, site supervisors, designers and other stakeholders. In this role, you will have a tangible impact on the quality and smooth execution of our projects.

The position is permanent, and your first project will be located in Northern Ostrobothnia or elsewhere in Northern Finland. The role requires a willingness to travel and regular travel between project sites. If you are based in another location and travel to the project site for work, Destia will reimburse work-related travel expenses, pay daily allowances, and cover accommodation costs in accordance with the company's travel policy.

Watch the video below to hear how your future colleagues describe their experiences on site!
Learn more about Destias services on our website!

How can you succeed best in this role?

At Destia, everything we do is guided by our values: fairness, togetherness, renewal and success.

As a Site Engineer, you will help ensure that figures add up and quality standards are met, while understanding how decisions and solutions affect project delivery.

To succeed in this role, you will have:

- A relevant technical degree, such as a Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a Master of Science in Technology (M.Sc. Tech.) or equivalent qualification

- Experience in similar roles, with a focus on quality, safety, scheduling or environmental management

- Good IT skills and experience with industry-specific software

- Good English skills

You do not need to be an experienced professional; we also welcome applications from professionals at an earlier stage of their careers who are eager to learn and develop. What matters most is a proactive and analytical approach, strong collaboration skills, and a desire to grow as part of a team building high-quality, sustainable infrastructure for people.

What we promise at Destia

At Destia, you get to do meaningful work that impacts peoples everyday lives. We build and maintain infrastructure throughout its lifecycle together with experts from various fields in teams where everyones contribution matters. With us, you can develop your expertise and shape your career path in your own direction, including internationally as part of the Colas Group.

We want everyone to feel welcome at Destia, regardless of their background. We treat each other equally and with respect and believe that the best solutions emerge when people can be themselves at work and bring different perspectives to the table. Through our everyday actions, we take responsibility for people, the environment and society. For us, sustainability is reflected in how we work, how we care for one another, and how we develop infrastructure that serves people far into the future. Most importantly, we want these commitments to be reflected in Destia employees' everyday experiences. [Read more about our sustainability work and the way we operate on our website.](https://destia.fi/en/about-us/sustainability/)

Interested? Here's how to apply

For further information about the position, please contact us at rekrytointi@destia.fi.

Apply for the position using the Apply for this job section in the job advertisement. Please include your CV and cover letter, telling us about your experience, skills and career aspirations.

Keep an eye on your email, as well regularly send you updates on the progress of the recruitment process. We often start interviewing promising candidates while the application period is still open, and may move quickly to a hiring decision once we find the right person.

We also ask all applicants to share their feedback so that we can continuously improve our recruitment process!

- The lunch benefit is provided separately and is not included in the €400 annual allowance. Employees are eligible for either a lunch card or a meal allowance.

jobs.title: Assistant Professor in Materials for Power Electronics / Printed Electronics
jobs.description:
The cross-border region Denmark-Germany is a powerhouse in industrial electronics. The Centre for Industrial Electronics (CIE) at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) was established by a strong partnership between industry, academia and regional authorities. CIE is located at the campus of SDU Sønderborg and surrounded by a vibrant industrial environment. CIE is part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the Faculty of Engineering.

 

Job description 

We are seeking an innovative and visionary Assistant Professor to join the Centre for Industrial Electronics in Sønderborg. The Centre currently has 40 staff, including full and associate professors, assistant professors, postdoctoral researchers, PhD students, and support staff. Funding has been secured to support to establish new research and test laboratories in key areas of industrial electronics. Our ambition is to deliver excellence in research, innovation, and education.

It is our vision that the Centre for Industrial Electronics at SDU will excel in areas of key relevance for companies in the region of Southern Denmark and beyond. 

Candidates are thus required to have a proven research records at least one of the following fields:

  • General power electronics and its reliability

  • Multimaterial additive manufacturing

  • Printed electronics

  • Polymer composites and nanocomposites for energy applications

  • Surface and interface engineering

  • Dielectric materials and capacitor technology

  • Materials for power electronics

  • Energy-device manufacturing

  • Sustainable and circular electronics

 

Qualifications

The candidates must have a PhD in Electrical Engineering/Materials science/Mechanical engineering, or a closely related discipline. 

We also expect:

  • An outstanding research and publication track record 

  • Experience with industrial collaboration

  • Research experience in multi-material additive manufacturing of functional polymer composites

  • Experience developing polymer nanocomposite dielectrics and thin-film capacitors

  • Knowledge of nanoparticle surface modification, dispersion, and interface engineering

  • Hands-on experience in materials processing, device fabrication, and electrical characterization

  • Ability to investigate relationships between material structure, manufacturing conditions, and electrical performance

  • Peer-reviewed publications in functional materials, additive manufacturing, or energy-device research

  • Experience collaborating across materials science and electrical engineering.

Further desirable qualifications:

  • Experience with bio-based, self-healing, or temperature-resistant capacitor materials

  • Knowledge of scalable thin-film fabrication, including layer-by-layer deposition or coating.

  • Experience translating research into industrial applications, particularly embedded heating, sensing, or battery-conditioning systems.

  • Experience preparing research proposals, securing research resources, and training students.

 

Contact and further information

For information about the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical engineering, which encompasses SDU Electrical Engineering please see https://www.sdu.dk/en/ime.

For specific information on section and centre, please visit www.sdu.dk/ee and www.sdu.dk/cie. 

You are also welcome to contact the Head of the CIE, Professor Thomas Ebel (ebel@sdu.dk,  +45 93 50 72 05) for further information. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

A panel will assess the qualification of the candidate for the described post based on the submitted material. 

The application should include:

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Motivated application. 

  • Ideas for research and development activities.

  • Account of significant contributions to innovation in Electrical Engineering and Industrial Engineering Electronics.

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Publications most relevant to the position. 

  • Summary and documentation of teaching experience, including account of experience in training students and outreach. You may attach a Teaching Portfolio. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation). 

  • References/reference letters may also be included.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period, and the position is open from start of 2027.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

**Etsimme asiakkaallemme Autohuolto Seitoy Oy:lle mekaanikkoa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen**

**Mitä tulisit meillä tekemään?**

Tehtävässä pääset tekemään monipuolisesti mekaanikon perustöitä. Päivittäisiin työtehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa autojen määräaikaishuollot, jarru- ja alustatyöt sekä iskunvaimentimien vaihdot. Lisäksi hoidat rengastöitä ja muita huoltokorjaamon arkeen kuuluvia tehtäviä. Työ on käytännönläheistä ja sopii hyvin henkilölle, joka viihtyy käsillä tekemisessä ja haluaa kehittää omaa teknistä osaamistaan aidossa työympäristössä.

Työt alkavat joustavasti sopimuksen mukaan. Työaika on arkisin klo 7.30-15.30 tai 8-16 ja työtunnit ovat 37,5 viikossa. Työskentelypaikkasi sijaitsee Seinäjoella Päivölänkadulla.

**Mitä odotamme?**

Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on oikea asenne ja halu oppia. Tehtävä sopii vastavalmistuneelle automekaanikolle, eikä aikaisempi työkokemus ole välttämätöntä. Tarjoamme myös kokeneemmallekin osaajalle haastavia tehtäviä. Eduksi katsomme ilmastointilaitteiden pätevyyden ja sähköturvallisuusosaamisen, mutta ne eivät ole pakollisia. Suomen kielen taito on edellytys tehtävässä toimimiselle.

**Mitä tarjoamme?**

Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden liittyä mukaan käytännönläheiseen ja osaavaan työyhteisöön, jossa hyvä fiilis ja tekemisen meininki näkyvät arjessa. Työyhteisössä toimii autohuollon ammattilaisia ja meillä arvostetaan yhteistyötä, huumoria ja reipasta otetta työntekoon. Palkkasi määräytyy osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan – haarukka 11,50-20,20 €/h. Työsopimus kirjoitetaan Seitoyn kanssa.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Laitathan hakemuksesi linkin kautta mahdollisimman pian, mutta kuitenkin viimeistään **30.10.2026** mennessä, sillä aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Rekrytointiprosessi toteutetaan yhteistyössä Biisonin kanssa. Jos kaipaat lisätietoja työtehtävästä, niin olethan yhteydessä puh. 0504752852 tai roope.takala@biisoni.fi

jobs.title: Bogholder
jobs.description:
Jobtype: Fastansættelse

Geografi: København

Sprog: Dansk

Er du i starten af din karriere inden for bogholderi og økonomi, og leder du efter et sted med god oplæring, mere ansvar og højt til loftet? På vegne af vores kunde søger Work Supply en energisk, lærenem og talstærk profil til en central rolle i økonomiafdelingen.

Stillingen er skræddersyet til dig, der har opbygget dit første fundament (1-2 års erfaring) og er klar til at tage næste skridt. Virksomheden tilbyder en grundig oplæring i deres specifikke systemer og ønsker at forme den rette kandidat til holdet.

Dine primære opgaver:

  • Daglig drift: Bogføring af finansbilag, kreditor/debitor-styring og håndtering af købsfakturaer.

  • Afstemninger: Deltagelse i månedlige afstemninger og administrative økonomiopgaver.

  • Løn & Rapportering: Mulighed for løbende oplæring i lønbehandling.

  • Digitale værktøjer: Løbende arbejdsgange i moderne ERP-, løn- og BI-rapporteringssystemer.

Hvem er du?

  • Erfaring (1–2 år): Du har minimum 1 års reel erhvervserfaring fra et regnskabs- eller bogholderijob (udover evt. praktik). Du har en god grundforståelse for debitor/kreditor og bogføring, men er stadig i den tidlige fase af din karriere (maks. 2 års erfaring).

  • Uddannelse: Relevant teoretisk baggrund inden for økonomi og regnskab (f.eks. Finansøkonom, Financial Controller AK, Handelsassistent eller tilsvarende).

  • Systemstærk & Lærenem: Du knækker hurtigt koden til nye digitale systemer og software. Du er nysgerrig, arbejder struktureret og trives med at lære nye arbejdsgange.

Ansøgning og kontakt: For at søge stillingen bedes du sende et opdateret CV med et nutidigt foto (maks. 2 måneder gammelt).

Læs mere på: https://worksupply.dk/

Vi afholder samtaler løbende, så mail dit CV til: ak@worksupply.dk Husk at oplyse: JOB ID: 260616

jobs.title: Bussjåfør
jobs.description:
Yrkessjåfører søkes – buss, minibuss, lastebil og vogntog

Professional Drivers Wanted – Bus, Minibus, Truck.

English text below the Norwegian text.

Arbeidssted: Finnsnes, Troms

Ulf Trulsen AS, Senja Tours og Finnsnes Termotransport søker dyktige og pålitelige yrkessjåfører til våre virksomheter på Finnsnes.

Vi søker

• Bussjåfører – klasse D til turbuss og persontransport

• Minibussjåfører – klasse D1

• Lastebilsjåfører – klasse C/CE til godstransport, distribusjon og langtransport

Fleksible turnusordninger

Vi tilbyr flere arbeidsordninger og ønsker å finne en løsning som passer den enkelte sjåfør:

• Fast heltidsstilling med ordinær arbeidstid

• 14/14-turnus – 14 dager arbeid / 14 dager fri

• Månedsturnus – én måned arbeid / én måned fri

• Andre turnusordninger etter avtale

Turnusordningene gjør stillingene godt egnet for deg som ønsker å pendle mellom hjemlandet og Norge, samtidig som du får lengre perioder fri.

Bolig og innkvartering

Vi kan hjelpe sjåfører som ønsker å flytte til Norge med å finne bolig i Finnsnesområdet.

For deg som ønsker å pendle, kan vi undersøke rimelige løsninger for innkvartering i arbeidsperiodene, for eksempel:

• Hybel

• Leilighet

• Boligmodul

• Annen egnet innkvartering

Vi ønsker å gjøre det enkelt å kombinere arbeid hos oss med bosted og familieliv i hjemlandet.

Vi hjelper deg med overgangen til Norge

For kandidater fra Norden og EU/EØS kan vi bistå med praktiske spørsmål knyttet til oppstart i Norge, blant annet:

• Førerkort og YSK

• Norske krav og regler

• Skatteregistrering

• Bolig og innkvartering

• Andre praktiske og administrative forhold

Vi vurderer hver kandidat individuelt og forsøker å finne gode løsninger for både arbeid, turnus, bolig og pendling.

Om Finnsnes

Finnsnes ligger i Senja kommune i Troms i Nord-Norge og er et viktig transport- og regionsenter i Midt-Troms. Området byr på spektakulær nordnorsk natur, samtidig som Finnsnes har et aktivt næringsliv og gode servicetilbud.

Vi ser etter deg som

• Har førerkort D, D1, C eller CE, avhengig av stillingen

• Har nødvendig YSK

• Er en trygg og ansvarsfull sjåfør

• Er serviceinnstilt og profesjonell

• Kan arbeide selvstendig og fleksibelt

• Behersker norsk, svensk, dansk, finsk eller engelsk

Erfaring som yrkessjåfør er en fordel.

Interessert?

Send oss gjerne CV og en kort presentasjon av deg selv. Oppgi hvilken førerkortklasse du har, hvilken type kjøring du er interessert i, og om du ønsker fast arbeid, turnus eller pendling.

Vi oppfordrer kvalifiserte sjåfører fra Norge, Norden og EU/EØS til å søke.

Arbeidssted: Finnsnes, Troms

Stillinger: D / D1 / C / CE

Arbeidsform: Fast stilling og ulike turnusordninger

Oppstart: Etter avtale

In ENGLISH:

Professional Drivers Wanted – Bus, Minibus, Truck.

Location: Finnsnes, Troms, Northern Norway

Ulf Trulsen AS, Senja Tours and Finnsnes Termotransport are looking for skilled and reliable professional drivers to join our operations in Finnsnes.

We are looking for

• Bus drivers – Category D for coach/tour bus and passenger transport

• Minibus drivers – Category D1

• Truck drivers – Category C/CE for freight transport, distribution and long-haul transport

Flexible shift and rotation schedules

We offer several work arrangements and aim to find a solution that suits each individual driver:

• Full-time positions with regular working hours

• 14/14 rotation – 14 days working / 14 days off

• Monthly rotation – one month working / one month off

• Other rotation schedules by agreement

Our rotation schedules are particularly suitable for drivers who wish to commute between their home country and Norway, while enjoying longer periods of time off.

Accommodation and housing

We can assist drivers who wish to relocate to Norway in finding accommodation in the Finnsnes area.

For drivers who prefer to commute, we can also look into affordable accommodation during working periods, such as:

• Rooms

• Apartments

• Modular accommodation

• Other suitable housing solutions

Our goal is to make it as easy as possible to combine working with us with living and family life in your home country.

We help you with the transition to Norway

For candidates from the Nordic countries and EU/EEA, we can provide guidance and practical assistance with matters related to starting work in Norway, including:

• Driving licences and Driver CPC / YSK

• Norwegian rules and requirements

• Tax registration

• Housing and accommodation

• Other practical and administrative matters

We assess each candidate individually and aim to find good solutions regarding work arrangements, rotation schedules, accommodation and commuting.

About Finnsnes

Finnsnes is located in Senja Municipality in Troms, Northern Norway, and is an important transport and regional centre in Mid-Troms. The area offers spectacular Northern Norwegian nature, while Finnsnes has an active business community and good local services.

We are looking for someone who

• Holds a Category D, D1, C or CE driving licence, depending on the position

• Holds the required Driver CPC / YSK

• Is a safe and responsible driver

• Is service-minded and professional

• Works well independently and is flexible

• Speaks Norwegian (or another Scandinavian langiage) and/or English

Previous professional driving experience is an advantage.

Interested?

Please send us your CV and a short introduction about yourself. Let us know which driving license category you hold, what type of driving you are interested in, and whether you are looking for a full-time position, rotation work or a commuting arrangement.

We welcome qualified drivers from Norway, the Nordic countries and the EU/EEA to apply.

Location: Finnsnes, Troms, Norway

Positions: D / D1 / C / CE

Work arrangements: Full-time and various rotation schedules

Start date: By agreement

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ulf Trulsen AS, Senja Tours og Finnsnes Termotransport søker dyktige og pålitelige yrkessjåfører til våre virksomheter på Finnsnes.

jobs.title: Haemme nyt liikenteenohjaajia datakeskushankkeelle Vaasaan!
jobs.description:
**Haemme liikenteenohjaajia datakeskushankkeelle Vaasaan!**

**Työt alkavat heti.**

**Keitä olemme?**

Ramudden luo kokonaisvaltaisia työturvallisuusratkaisuja tietöihin, rakennuksiin, tiloihin, rautateille ja erilaisiin infrastruktuurin projekteihin. Teemme työmme turvallisesti ja välittäen!

**Ketä haemme?**

Haemme liikenteenohjaajia Vaasassa sijaitsevalle datakeskushankkeelle. Mitä tarjoamme? Tarjoamme turvallisen ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön. Tavoitteenamme on varmistaa se, että sinä ja kaikki muut liikenteessä liikkujat pääsevät turvallisesti töihin tai kouluun sekä takaisin kotiin. Minne sitten olettekin matkalla, turvaamme matkasi!

**Mitä työ sisältää?**

Liikenteenohjaajan työhön datakeskuksella kuuluu varmistaa työmaan läpikulkevan liikenteen turvallinen kulku ja eteneminen. Pidämme huolta myös kollegoistamme.

Työtä tehdään kahdessa vuorossa arkisin ja lauantaisin 06-21 välisenä aikana. Työajoista on mahdollista sopia joustavasti.

**Mitä vaaditaan?**

Sinun tulee olla täysi-ikäinen

Sinulla tulee olla normaalit aistit: näkö, kuulo ja reaktiokyky

Sinulla tulee olla vähintään AM121 tai B-luokan ajokortti

Odotamme liikenteenohjaajiltamme myös hyvää liikennetuntemusta.

**Koulutamme ja perehdytämme sinut tehtävään alla olevien koulutusten avulla:**

Tieturva 1-koulutus

Työturvallisuuskoulutus

Liikenteenohjaajan pätevyys

**Palkkaa maksamme Asfalttialan työehtosopimuksen (TES) mukaisesti.**

**Sen lisäksi tarjoamme sinulle:**

Turvallisen ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön

Laadukkaat työvälineet ja -varusteet

Reilun ja tasapuolisen kohtelun

Mahdollisuuden edetä uralla sekä

Erilaisia työsuhde-etuja

**Lisätietoja arkisin klo 9–15**

**Evi Ahtola, 0504653301, evi.ahtola@ramudden.fi**

**Marianne Granlund, 0503373384, marianne.granlund@ramudden.fi**

Sähkö-Team Oy on vuonna 1977 perustettu sähköalan yritys, jonka ydinosaamista ovat sähkökoneiden ja sähkömoottoreiden huolto ja korjaus. Yrityksen korjaamolla huolletaan ja korjataan monenlaisia sähkömoottoreita ja sähkökoneita eri käyttötarkoituksiin. Työhön kuuluu muun muassa sähköisiä ja mekaanisia korjauksia, moottoreiden vianmääritystä, huoltoja sekä tarvittaessa käämintätöitä. Sähkö-Team toimii monimerkkikorjaamona ja palvelee asiakkaita pääasiassa pääkaupunkiseudulla, mutta sähkömoottoreita saapuu huoltoon myös muualta Suomesta.

Etsimme käytännönläheistä ja teknisesti osaavaa henkilöä osaksi Sähkö-Teamin korjaamotiimiä. Työ on kokoaikainen ja vakituinen ja työtä tehdään arkisin klo 07.30 – 16.00. Tehtävässä työllistyt suoraan asiakasyrityksemme kirjoille.

Työ painottuu sähkömoottoreiden huoltoon, vianmääritykseen ja korjaukseen. Tehtävässä pääset käsittelemään erilaisia sähkömoottoreita ja sähkökoneita aina vian selvittämisestä moottorin purkamiseen, korjaamiseen, kokoonpanoon ja testaukseen asti.

Työskentely tapahtuu pääsääntöisesti korjaamolla, mutta työhön kuuluu tarvittaessa asiakaskohteissa tehtävät vianmääritys- ja mittaustyöt. Joskus isoja sähkömoottoreita huolletaan myös paikan päällä asiakkaan tiloissa, jolloin työskennellään työryhmässä yhdessä muiden Sähkö-Teamin asentajien kanssa.

\- sähkömoottoreiden huolto, korjaus ja testaus

\- moottoreiden purku, tarkastus ja kokoonpano

\- asiakaskohteissa tehtävät vianmääritys- ja kuntokartoituskäynnit

Työnhakijalta odotamme:

jobs.title: Student Assistant in our Control Center - night shift position
jobs.description:
Nordic RCC is looking for candidates with a technical background and interest in the role as operator in our control center – is this something for you?

Do you like working by firm and well-defined procedures, yet alert to interfere in the process when needed? Are you open-minded and enjoy working in a diverse and international team? And are you eager to be part of something new and meaningful?

The position will mainly cover the operator position during the shift from 21.00 PM- 07.15 AM during both weekdays, weekends and holiday periods. The shifts, of individually 10.25 hours length, are distributed throughout the operator team. The schedule is planned and updated 3 times a year, securing at least a planned period of 4 months into the future. You can expect an average of around 70-80 working hours per month.

You will be working alone in the office during the shifts, with an on-call colleague standby to assist in any technical matters if needed.

If you can say yes to the above, then you may be just the person we are looking for.

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system.

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green transition

Nordic RCC provides calculations and recommendations to the four Nordic Electricity Transmission System Operators (TSOs), Energinet, Fingrid, Statnett and Svenska Kraftnät. The main aim of the services is to ensure transparency and help the TSOs with operational planning to ensure continued security of supply with an increase of renewables in the system. In short: We play a small but important part of enabling the green transition.

You will join a team of young, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues of currently more than 20 nationalities, and at times work in virtual teams with expert colleagues from the Nordic TSOs and potentially from all of Europe.

We are not looking for a specific educational background, but an engineering or similar technical or data-scientific background is preferred.

Whether you are in your bachelor’s program, or master’s degree program, that is not critically important. What is more important is your profile as a whole and how you are assessed to fit within the Nordic RCC organization.   

Key responsibilities for the operator role will be:

  • Participating in the 24/7 control center shift roster: mainly covering the night hours 21.00 - 07.15.

  • The shift starts in the control center relieving a colleague operator from the evening shift. When time allows, and the processes for the evening have finalized successfully, you have an opportunity to enter an adjacent resting facility. During the shift, when alerted, your responsibility is to enter the control center within minutes, intervening in the operational challenge faced. Next morning at 07.00, the morning operator will relieve you from your shift responsibility.

  • Become an expert in executing the services provided from the 24/7 Nordic RCC control center.

  • Maintaining your qualifications and knowledge in the operator control systems, including through routinely joining parallel shift during office hours to train in all NRCC services under the guidance of operators.

  • Interface to the Nordic TSOs control centers.  

  • Cooperation with the TSOs securing the process of services.

  • Trouble shooting and fixing challenges in the services together with NRCC IT support.

  • KPI recording and reporting, weekly and monthly.

  • Aid the back-office operators in small tasks, such as visit approval to the core room.

Additional tasks and involvement

Depending on the flexibility and the competence of the candidate, together with the department needs, there will be an opportunity to be involved in other areas of responsibility. This way one will get a better understanding of the NRCC in general and meet fellow NRCC colleagues during normal business hours.

Other working areas, depending on department needs, can be:

  • Involvement in testing system updates and features to be introduced to the control center.

  • Quality assurance and updating operational procedures.

  • Quality assurance and data retrieval for operational reporting.

  • Provide analytical insights on operational planning scenarios.

You are open-minded, international mindset and excellence at working within structured patterns, at the same time the ability to maneuver within a huge spectrum of corner cases quickly, reliably, and independently.

You are structured and can appreciate a fast-paced environment from time to time. On a personal level you are open-minded, team-oriented and take responsibility.

Nordic RCC is an international office, so fluency in spoken and written English is required as well as a motivation for working in an international environment.

You will join a diverse and enthusiastic team in our office at Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. Nordic RCC is home to over twenty nationalities, with a healthy gender balance and a wide range of ages and backgrounds. We value curiosity, fellowship, respect, and transparency—and we hope you see yourself in these values. 

Your daily workplace will be in the NRCC control center at the office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad.

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) and no later than November 15th 2026.

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.  

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.   Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. 

If you have any questions, please contact Kenneth Nielsen, Head of Service Operations, KEN@nordic-rcc.net

jobs.title: Sähkö- ja automaatioasentaja, Algol Technics Oy
jobs.description:
_Algol Technics on teollisuuden kumppani ja materiaalinkäsittelyn asiantuntija. Algol Technics on osa suomalaista Algol-konsernia, jolla on kokemusta kansainvälisestä kaupasta vuodesta 1894 alkaen. Uskomme, että asiakkaidemme maailma automatisoituu, nopeutuu ja muuttuu aiempaa kompleksisemmaksi. Olemme vahvasti mukana tässä muutoksessa tarjoten asiakkaillemme sisälogistiikan ratkaisuja, mm. nostureita, robottisoluja, kuljettimia ja automaatiovarastoja sekä laajan valikoiman teknisiä tuotteita. Kaikkiin toimittamiimme ratkaisuihin tarjoamme kattavat kunnossapito- ja huoltopalvelut._

_Algol-konsernin yhteistyökumppaniverkosto on maailmanlaajuinen ja yhtiöllä on toimipisteitä kymmenessä eri maassa._

Miltä kuulostaisi vaihtelevat työtehtävät huollon ja kunnossapidon saralla? Lue eteenpäin, mitä Algol Technicsillä on tarjolla ja työllisty heidän kirjoilleen vakituiseen työsuhteeseen!

**Mitä tulisit tässä tehtävässä tekemään?**

Kunnossapidon ja huollon tavoitteena on pitää laitteistot toiminnassa keskeytyksittä. Algol Technicsin huoltoverkosto huolehtii siitä, että huoltotyöt sekä käynnissäpito hoidetaan ammattimaisesti ympäri Suomen.

Algolilla toimit huolto- ja kunnossapitotehtävissä eri asiakaskohteissa Varsinais-Suomen alueella. Päiviisi kuuluvat vaihtelevat tehtävät, jotka sisältävät monipuolisia sähköasennus- ja huoltotöitä pääsääntöisesti teollisuusnostureiden parissa. Huolehdit asiakasyrityksissä, että hommat etenevät ja linjastot liikkuvat. Pääset toimimaan itsenäisesti ja työssä liikkumiseen saat Algolilta käyttöösi auton. Toimit osana osaavaa tiimiä, jolta saat myös kattavan perehdytyksen tehtävään. Työaikasi on arkisin 7:00–15.30.

**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Sinulla on taustaa teollisuussähköstä, mutta tartut mielelläsi myös mekaanisiin töihin. Sähköalan osaamisen olet voinut hankkia koulutuksen tai käytännön työkokemuksen kautta. Työssä tehdään paljolti myös mekaanista asennusta, joten esimerkiksi autojen, koneiden tai muun tekniikan parissa harrastaminen antaa tehtävään hyvän pohjan.

Arvostamme omatoimista ja palveluhenkistä työotetta. Turvallisuussyistä tehtävässä edellytetään sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.

**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**

Tarjoamme sinulle vakituisen työn mielenkiintoisissa tehtävissä ja osaamistasi vastaavan palkkauksen. Työsuhde on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen, ja työllistyt suoraan Algol Technicsin palvelukseen.

Pääset osaksi osaavaa ja sitoutunutta työyhteisöä, jossa tekeminen perustuu yhteistyöhön ja keskinäiseen luottamukseen. Työntekijöiden viihtyvyys näkyy arjessa ja vaihtuvuus on poikkeuksellisen pientä.

Algol Technics tarjoaa vakaan työympäristön osana pitkän historian omaavaa perheyritystä, jossa asiat tehdään suunnitelmallisesti ja luotettavasti. Taustalla on yli 130 vuoden historia saman perheen omistuksessa, mikä näkyy pitkäjänteisyytenä ja varmuutena arjessa.

Saat käyttöösi nykyaikaiset työkalut ja järjestelmät sekä kattavat työsuhde-edut, kuten työterveyshuollon ja Epassin.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Tahdomme kuulla sinusta! Jätäthän hakemuksesi meille pikimmiten, mutta kuitenkin viimeistään **30.10.2026.** Tehtävässä aloitus sopimuksen mukaan. Tehtävään valittu henkilö työllistyy suoraan Algol Technicsin kirjoille.

Tehtävän rekrytoinnista vastaa Biisoni ja Algol Technicsin toiveesta mahdolliset yhteydenotot: roope.takala@biisoni.fi, p.0504752852

jobs.description:
Location: Gémenos, France

Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance
Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d'activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l'environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d'euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l'innovation tels que l'IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays.






Nos engagements, vos avantages- Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée

- Un package de rémunération attractif

- Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes

- Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l'équilibre des collaborateurs

- Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu





Votre quotidienEn nous rejoignant à Gémenos, vous intégrez un site localisé entre mer et collines provençales, regroupant nos activités d'identité et de sécurité numériques et nos activités de défense alliant à la fois ingénierie et production, et favorisant un environnement de travail collaboratif et convivial.

En tant que Product Engineering Manager, vous rejoignez le département Software Product Engineering au sein du Centre de Compétence pour l'Industrie de Thales CDI.
Au sein d'une équipe composée d'une dizaine de personnes sur le site de Gémenos, vous êtes responsable de l'industrialisation des nouveaux produits dans les domaines de l'identité numérique, du cloud sécurisé et/ou des transactions bancaires.
Votre rôle est centré sur le pilotage du développement des logiciels et programmes de production qui assurent la programmation des microcontrôleurs embarqués dans les cartes à puce, ainsi que sur leur optimisation industrielle, leur déploiement et leur suivi tout au long de la vie des produits

A ce titre, vous aurez notamment à :
- Définir et optimiser les processus de programmation industrielle adaptés à des produits de type carte à puce

- Gérer l'industrialisation logicielle : intégration des programmes dans les puces, qualification des procédés de codage et documentation technique

- Suivre le produit tout au long de son cycle de vie, jusqu'à son retrait du marché

- Coordonner les parties prenantes internationales (développement logiciel embarqué, production, qualité, supply chain) et assurer une communication fluide en anglais avec les équipes et partenaires du Groupe.

- Piloter des projets d'optimisation industrielle (performance des programmes, rendement, coûts)

- Participer à l'amélioration continue des outils et méthodes d'engineering


Profil
Votre priorité est de mettre votre expertise logicielle au service de produits industriels à forte valeur technologique ?
Vous avez l'ambition de porter des projets à l'interface entre R&D logicielle, systèmes embarqués et production ?
Vous avez envie de découvrir les coulisses de l'industrialisation de produits sécurisés dans un environnement international ?
Vous disposez d'un diplôme d'ingénieur ou Master en électronique, informatique ou équivalent, et avez de l'expérience sur :
- La conception logicielle ou le support technique de systèmes embarqués (JavaCard, OS sécurisés, firmware)

- Les technologies carte à puce, cryptographie ou électronique embarquée

- La gestion de projets industriels multi-acteurs (R&D, production, qualité...)

- Le pilotage transverse dans un contexte international


Curiosité, esprit d'équipe, rigueur, leadership sont des atouts que l'on vous reconnait ?

Alors ce poste est fait pour vous !

jobs.title: Part-Time Driver Alnabru
jobs.employer: ODA NORWAY AS AVD OSLO DISTRIBUSJON
jobs.description:
We’re looking for Part-Time Drivers to join Oda!

At Oda, we develop affordable grocery services to make the logistics of living surprisingly easy. First we built Norway’s leading online grocery store and now, partnered with Mathem in Sweden, we’re on our way to becoming the world’s most effective grocery system, delivering to thousands of Scandinavian doorsteps every week.

As part of our team, you’ll work with smart, passionate colleagues who bring their whole selves to work every day. It’s a fast-moving, collaborative environment where everyone is welcome and everyone’s opinion matters. Whether you're shaping the future of online retail, tackling complex logistical problems, or making everyday life better for our customers, your work will have a real impact. Read on to find out what part you could play in our story.


What you’ll be doing as a Driver 🚚

  • Report directly to our Driver Operating Managers and Team Leaders at your site as an essential part of our dedicated delivery team.

  • Be a Customer Hero: You’ll be on the road bringing groceries and smiles directly to our customers, ensuring a top-notch "Oda experience" at every doorstep.

  • Keep the wheels turning: You’ll handle loading and unloading with speed and care, ensuring every box arrives in perfect condition.

  • Own your ride: You’ll take pride in your van, keeping it clean, presentable, and ready for the road.

  • Pay it forward: You’ll help onboard and train new colleagues, sharing your best tips and tricks from the road.

  • Make us better: We value your brain as much as your driving! You’ll contribute your ideas to help us improve our routines and ways of working.


What you’ll need to succeed 🌟

  • A valid driving license (Class B). You’ve had your license for at least 2 years and feel confident and safe behind the wheel.

  • Good communication skills: Comfortable in speaking and writing English. If you also know Norwegian or another Nordic language, that’s a big plus!


What would be nice to have 💡

  • Enjoy being active and thrive in a physically demanding job

  • Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team

  • A strong work ethic and a "can-do" mindset

  • Service-minded and always looking for the best solutions

  • A genuine desire to make our customers happy

  • Responsible and always prioritize safety in traffic


What we offer 🚀

  • A chance to make a real impact as a Part-Time Driver in a fast-moving company with a product people love-while shaking up the grocery industry.

  • Teammates who aim high and have each other’s backs. We care about people, and that means supporting each other every step of the way.

  • A flat structure where we team up across disciplines to solve exciting challenges. Big ideas come from everywhere!

  • A transparent way of working. We use Slack to stay in the loop-less email, fewer meetings, more getting things done.

  • A chance to shape the future of grocery shopping while building a company that’s here to stay.


Practical information

  • Application deadline: We review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the process once the right candidates are found. We encourage you to apply as early as possible.

  • Start date: As soon as possible.

  • Position: 20% Part-time

  • Working hours: Saturday and Sunday, every other weekend.

    • Morning shift: 05:45-13:45

    • Evening shift: 13:30-21:30

  • Location: Verkseier Furulunds Vei 1, 0668 Oslo


To ensure a fair and efficient process for everyone, we use Hubert, our virtual assistant, to help us with the first selection. 🤖 Keep an eye on your inbox – shortly after applying, you’ll receive an email with an invite to a chat-based interview. Just make sure your email address is correct so the invite finds its way to you!

A few final words

At Oda, you’ll join a passionate, ambitious team working to change the future of grocery shopping. We’re all different—just like you—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just let us know, and we’ll do our best to help. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and want everyone to have an equal shot at landing the job.

Come build the future of grocery with us! Want to know more about how we work? Check out these posts on Medium.

We can’t wait to hear from you! 🧡

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Oda is the leading online grocery retailer in Norway, but as a company, we’re first and foremost an ambitious tech and logistics company - not a classic retailer. We’re one of the fastest-growing startups in the Nordics, working with huge, complex challenges to make the lives of our customers simpler and easier. Want to join us? Our goal is to create the world's most efficient retail system. Through smart work, passionate customer focus and our own technology we make a difference in the lives of thousands of customers and change society for the better through a completely re-imagined value chain for grocery shopping. Our customers save more than 60 hours a year, time we believe can be better spent than going to the store. Our effective value chain and logistics save society tonnes of food waste each year and our distribution network replace almost 13,000 individual trips by car to the grocery store each year.

jobs.title: Kafémedarbeider - deltid
jobs.description:
Vi søker fire kafémedarbeidere til mindre deltidsstillinger ved Skalmstadsetra på sørsiden av Hafjell. Arbeidet vil hovedsakelig foregå på lørdager januar til april 2027, samt enkelte dager i vinterferien og påsken.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi ser først og fremst etter deg som er pålitelig, selvstendig, serviceinnstilt og ryddig, og som klarer å beholde oversikten når flere ting skjer samtidig. Du må være komfortabel med å ta initiativ, følge med på det som skjer rundt deg og vurdere hva som bør prioriteres.

Erfaring fra kafé, restaurant eller butikk er selvfølgelig positivt, men ikke nødvendigvis avgjørende. Det viktigste for oss er at du er lærevillig, tar ansvar og bidrar der det trengs. Du får god opplæring og tydelige rutiner før du skal stå på egne ben.

Vi søker primært medarbeidere over 20 år, blant annet fordi arbeidet innebærer servering av alkohol. Det er likevel mulig for yngre å søke, og vi vurderer søkere ut fra egnethet og hvilke arbeidsoppgaver de kan utføre.

Arbeidet innebærer mye kontakt med gjester, og du må kunne kommunisere godt med gjestene på norsk, et annet skandinavisk språk, eller engelsk.

Arbeidsstedet har begrenset kollektivtilbud, så du må på forhånd ha avklart hvordan du kommer deg til og fra jobb.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Arbeidet vil hovedsakelig være på dagtid, og dere vil alltid være to medarbeidere på jobb. Oppgavene består av kundeservice, servering, drikke/bar, rydding og oppvask samt enkel klargjøring og servering av mat og kaker. Mye bestilling og betaling skjer ved disken, men vi ønsker at medarbeiderne ser hva som er naturlig i den enkelte situasjonen. Vi jobber fleksibelt mellom oppgavene og forventer at begge bidrar der det til enhver tid er behov. Noen ganger betyr det å ta imot bestilling ved disken, andre ganger å gå bort til et bord, servere, rydde eller følge opp gjestene der. God service hos oss handler derfor mye om å være oppmerksom, ta initiativ og samarbeide godt med den man er på jobb sammen med. Kaféen er liten og oversiktelig og du må trives med å ta ansvar for flere deler av kafédriften i løpet av en vakt.

Matservering vil være enkel og godt tilrettelagt på forhånd. Det kan være oppvarming og enkel ferdigstilling av mat og anretning av kaker. Det forventes ikke at medarbeiderne skal lage mat fra bunnen av samtidig som de betjener kaféen.

Vi tilbyr

Arbeidstid og omfang

Det faste behovet er primært lørdager i januar og mars, med utgangspunkt i omtrent annehver lørdag per medarbeider. I tillegg trenger vi bemanning enkelte dager i vinterferien (uke 8) og påskeperioden (uke 12)

Kaféens åpningstid er normalt kl. 13-18, med arbeidstid noe før åpning og etter stenging. Vi forsøker å tilpasse vaktene etter tilgjengelighet, og det er derfor mulig å søke både dersom du ønsker omtrent det beskrevene omfanget, eller om du ønsker å jobbe noe mer eller mindre. Det kan også bli mulighet for ekstravakter ved arrangementer og andre behov gjennom året. Vi håper gjerne å finne medarbeidere vi kan spørre igjen ved senere behov, men kan per i dag ikke love et fast omfang utover periodene som er beskrevet over.

Hva vi tilbyr vi?

Stillingen passer godt for deg som ønsker en mindre deltidsjobb ved siden av annen jobb, studier eller andre forpliktelser.

Vi tilbyr et hyggelig og uformelt kafémiljø, med varierte arbeidsoppgaver og tett samarbeid med en kollega.

Du får god opplæring, tydelige arbeidsrutiner og mulighet til å jobbe selvstendig innenfor trygge rammer.

Lønn etter gjeldende satser for serveringsbransjen.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Skalmstadsetra ligger på sørsiden av Hafjell, et lite tun med gamle bygninger og mange faste hyttegjester i nærområdet. Vi ønsker å skape en hyggelig og uformell kafé der både hyttefolk, fastboende og andre besøkende kan stikke innom.

jobs.title: Service Instructor
jobs.description:
**Join us as a Service Instructor in hotel cleaning services in Turku!**

Are you an experienced cleaning services professional interested in a guiding role where you can support the team in their daily work and help ensure high-quality service? With us, work is carried out responsibly as part of a reliable team.

You will work as a Service Instructor under the supervision of your manager and have a key role in ensuring the smooth operation and quality of cleaning services at the customer site. You work responsibly and ensure that all tasks are carried out safely and in accordance with our shared quality standards and operating procedures. You act as a key link between employees, management and the customer, supporting your manager, but the role does not include actual managerial responsibility.

Customer service plays a central role in this position, and succeeding in the role requires a customer-oriented mindset and good interpersonal skills. In your role, you have a direct impact on the customer experience and the smooth running of the customer relationship. Active cooperation, clear communication and a solution-oriented approach are therefore essential.

**Your duties include, among other things:**

- ensuring the smooth running and quality of daily cleaning work, planning the division of tasks and using resources in a cost-conscious manner

- continuously developing operations together with your manager and actively contributing ideas for improvement

- guiding and onboarding employees and ensuring safe working practices

- customer cooperation

- regularly participating in practical cleaning work


**We expect you to have:**

- experience in cleaning work

- the ability to guide and support the team in everyday situations, promote an equal and respectful working environment, and provide clear feedback

- good organisational skills and a proactive approach

- a customer-friendly approach and a positive attitude

- the ability to work under pressure and solve problems

- the ability to communicate both verbally and in writing in Finnish or English. Language skills play an important role in this guiding position, as they are essential for understanding work instructions, ensuring safe working practices and managing employment-related matters. We value a diverse workplace where different language and cultural backgrounds are considered a strength

- a valid work permit if you are not a Finnish citizen


**We offer you:**

- a permanent, part-time employment contract of 30 hours per week

- shifts on weekdays and weekends, including morning, daytime and evening shifts

- a starting date to be agreed together

- comprehensive onboarding through our renewed Onboarding path and N-Clean Academy

- fair employment terms, a safe working environment and support for employee wellbeing

- competitive pay in accordance with the collective agreement for employees in the property services sector, €2,235/month


**Equality and responsibility**

Every employee is important to us. We treat everyone equally and with respect, and we do not accept discrimination in any form. We operate responsibly and are committed to providing a safe and healthy working environment.

**Did you know?**

Employees enjoy working at N-Clean, and our employee eNPS is at an excellent level of **55**! This is reflected in our everyday work through mutual respect and the way we work and succeed genuinely together.

N-Clean has succeeded in the HUMAN POWER competition for several years, reflecting our long-term commitment to developing a people-oriented and responsible working life. In 2024, we were selected as the most people-oriented workplace, and in 2025, we placed third in the competition and also achieved third place in the Finland's Most People-Oriented Working Life Act category. This recognition reflects our people-oriented approach to recruitment, where personal interaction, appreciation and the candidate experience are at the heart of what we do.

**Join our amazing team!**

**Send us your application as soon as possible, but no later than 29 October 2026.**

We only accept applications submitted through the application form on our website.
