jobs.title: Tenure track assistant professor/Associate professor positions in Veterinary medicine
jobs.employer: Technical Sciences - Institut for Husdyr- og Veter
jobs.description:
The Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences (ANIVET) is seeking three new staff members for teaching and research in veterinary medicine. The positions are available from 1 August 2027 or soon thereafter.

The educational activities for these positions are aimed at students in veterinary medicine at both the bachelor’s and master’s levels.

The veterinary medicine programme is organised into courses covering educationally relevant themes and integrates a range of disciplines, and this is done with the vision to create a professional engagement while ensuring scientific depth for the students of veterinary medicine.

ANIVET is part of the Faculty of Technical Sciences at Aarhus University. The department is located near Viborg (Campus AU Viborg – Research Centre Foulum) and encompasses five research units with approximately 200 dedicated employees of which 50% are scientific staff. The AU Viborg campus will gradually grow to a student population of 800 – 900. The positions will be integrated into the department’s existing scientific research units, in which scientists at all career stages work together with skilled technical staff such as laboratory technicians and data analysts.

The positions
  1. Clinical veterinary science – livestock
  2. Veterinary public health
  3. Veterinary pathology

If you wish to apply for more than one position, please apply for each position separately. Please read more down below in “How to apply”.

1. Tenure track assistant professor or Associated Professor in Clinical veterinary science – livestock
We are seeking a candidate with a clinical background in veterinary science within production animals - Livestock.

Research tasks
The focus of the position is to:
  • Perform clinical veterinary science within production animals, with emphasis on individual or group-level animal diagnostics, clinical decision-making, and evidence-based treatment and prevention strategies.
  • Research in major production diseases in cattle and/or pigs of significant importance in Europe, including development of clinically applicable knowledge and tools supporting veterinary decision-making in practice.
  • Integrate clinical findings with herd-level data to improve disease prevention and health management in modern production systems.



Within his/her area of expertise, it is expected that in addition the candidate will:
  • Conduct research-based advisory work for authorities and have an active role in externally funded research projects.
  • Contribute to the development and delivery of teaching in clinical veterinary science for production animals, with emphasis on case-based and hands-on learning.
  • Provide academic leadership within the clinical production animal field, including mentoring and coordination of junior teaching staff (e.g., assistant lecturers/teaching assistants).
  • Contribute to strengthening collaboration with the veterinary profession and industry stakeholders in Denmark.


Your profile
The preferred candidate should demonstrate:
  • The ability to independently conduct research within veterinary clinical science related to pig or cattle production
  • Danish authorization as a veterinarian or can achieve it
  • Preferably experiences within obstetrics



2. Tenure track assistant professor or Associated Professor in Veterinary Public Health
We are seeking a candidate with strong expertise in veterinary public health, including popu-lation-level animal health, food safety/meat inspection, and the role of veterinarians in society.

Research tasks
The focus of the position is to:
  • Conduct research within veterinary public health, including epidemiology, zoonoses, food safety/meat inspection, disease dynamics, risk assessment or animal welfare.
  • Contribute to interdisciplinary One Health research integrating animal, human and environmental health on population level.
  • Support evidence-based policy and advisory work for authorities.
  • Participate in externally funded research projects.


Within his/her area of expertise, it is expected that in addition the candidate will:
  • Develop and deliver teaching in Veterinary Public Health for example to apply case-based and problem-oriented teaching methods with focus on real-world scenarios in veterinary services.
  • Do research within monitoring of animal welfare issues across the EU.
  • Contribute to teaching across the veterinary curriculum where public health perspectives are relevant.

Your profile
The preferred candidate should demonstrate:
  • The ability to independently conduct research within veterinary public health preferably with an interdisciplinary research profile integrating biological, social and economic aspects in projects
  • Danish authorization as a veterinarian or can achieve it. Experience with Danish conditions is an advantage.
  • Preferably, experience with antimicrobial use at the population level.


3. Tenure track assistant professor or Associated Professor in Veterinary Pathology
We are seeking a candidate with a broad background in veterinary pathology, encompassing both gross and histopathological examinations for diagnostic purposes with a strong interest in developing and innovating teaching within veterinary pathology.

Research tasks
The focus of the position is:
  • General and comparative veterinary pathology, including the mechanisms, diagnosis, and characterization of disease processes across animal species.
  • Diagnostic pathology, encompassing post-mortem investigations, histopathology, and the integration of pathological findings into veterinary practice and meat inspection.
  • Pathological assessment of animal welfare aspects of mortality in livestock


Within his/her area of expertise, it is expected that in addition the candidate will:
  • Teach and supervise students and early-career researchers at bachelor, master, and PhD levels.
  • Conduct research-based advisory work for authorities and have an active role in externally funded research projects.
  • Contribute to the collection and curation of pathological specimens for teaching purposes and reporting of findings to referring veterinarians and animal owners.
  • Contribute to the continued development of the department's digital histopathology teaching platform, TUTOR.
  • Support in the administration and further development of the department's animal donor programme for anatomy and pathology.

Your profile
The preferred candidate should have experience with:
  • Post-mortem examinations, including diagnostic necropsies, case reporting, and communication of findings.
  • Diagnostic histopathology.


Your profle as Tenure Track assistant professor
You are a skilled researcher with a solid background within your specific field of research, and you possess:
  • Documented research qualifications at a high international level
  • Teaching and supervision experience
  • Qualifications for the Tenure-Track assistant professor level at Aarhus University must include postdoctoral training or similar with a relevant research profile and a strong scientific publication record in one or more of the areas of the position you are applying for.

Please refer to the tenure track guidelines for the tenure review criteria and for the tenure review process.

Your profile as Associate professor
You are established as a prominent researcher within your specific field of research, and you possess:
  • The ability to carry out independent and well-organized research work, as well as work as part of an interdisciplinary team.
  • Documented teaching qualifications at a high international level.
  • Experience with project management

In order to be assessed as qualified as associate professor, you must meet the academic criteria as outlined here

How to apply
  • You must indicate the specific position you are applying for by selecting it in the menu. You may only select one position. If you wish to apply for one of the other positions, you must submit a separate application for each position.
  • Please also indicate in your written application which position you are applying for.
  • Furthermore, please indicate whether you are applying for a tenure-track assistant professor position, an associate professor position, or both by ticking the box. .

Who we are
The Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences is well-known for its skilled and very innovative interdisciplinary research environments with a high international impact. We perform world-class research, which contributes with solutions to address essential societal challenges within the green transition; the food production and veterinary medicine – nationally and globally.

The department generates novel research at the highest international level within sustainable food production, the environment, climate, and the health and welfare for animals and humans. The activities form the basis for our research-based public authority consultancy and degree programmes covering bachelor’s, master’s and PhD degree programmes within animal science and veterinary medicine. We offer a lively, engaged and innovative learning and study environment, which is closely integrated with the research environment.

Our department has unique and advanced animal experimental research facilities and technologies located close to the research environment, and a comprehensive national and international research network and strong industrial and professional collaborations.

What we offer
  • A well-developed research infrastructure, laboratories and access to shared equipment and animal experimental facilities.
  • An informal and multicultural research environment with high professionalism and close collaboration and networking activities.
  • A workplace characterised by equality and a good work-life balance, and open discussions across different fields of research.


Living in Denmark
Please visit the international staff https://internationalstaff.au.dk/prearrival/ for information about arriving to and living in Denmark for both the applicants and their potential families.

Area of employment and place of work
The area of employment is Aarhus University (AU), with related departments The place of work is AU Viborg, Research Centre Foulum, Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, Blichers Allé 20, DK-8830 Tjele.
AU Viborg is approximately 10 km from Viborg. You can read more about it here: https://international.viborg.dk/

Contact
For further information, please contact Deputy head of department, Professor Henrik Callesen (henrik.callesen@anivet.au.dk)
or Head of department, Professor Charlotte Lauridsen (charlotte.lauridsen@anivet.au.dk)

Technical Sciences Tenure Track
Aarhus University offers talented scientists from around the world attractive career perspectives via the Technical Sciences Tenure Track Programme. Highly qualified candidates are appointed as Assistant Professors for a period of six years with the prospect of performance- based advancement to a tenured Associate Professorship.

The aim of the Technical Sciences Tenure Track Programme is to:
  • attract outstanding talented individuals that are competitive at an international level
  • to promote the early development of independent research success early in the career of scientists
  • to create transparency in the academic career path

As part of the tenure track position, the candidate is offered:
  • access to research infrastructure
  • capability development, including postgraduate teacher training
  • a mentoring programme
  • support to develop scientific networks and to secure interdisciplinary research at the highest level

As part of the Aarhus University Tenure Track Programme, the University carries out a mid-way evaluation to review the progress of the tenure track candidate after three years, according to the same criteria used in the final tenure review. The final tenure review is conducted after five and a half years. If the review is positive, the candidate will be offered a tenured position as Associate Professor at Aarhus University.

Please refer to the tenure track guidelines for the tenure review criteria and for the tenure review process.

Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the assessment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. The selection is made on the basis of an assessment of who of the candidates are most relevant considering the requirements of the advertisement. All applicants will be notified within 6 weeks whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee and will receive his/her assessment.

Read the full text and apply online

jobs.title: Are you studying for an IT degree and looking for a student job where you'll gain hands-on experience with modern workplace technology, cloud services, cybersecurity, and IT operations? Then join us!
jobs.employer: International Council for The Exploration Of The Sea
jobs.description:
We have an exciting opportunity for a service-minded IT student to join our team as a Student Assistant in Copenhagen.

About ICES

The International Council for the Exploration of the Sea (ICES) is an intergovernmental organization which advances marine science and promotes sustainable use of the seas. Our Secretariat is located in central Copenhagen and consists of approximately 85 staff representing more than 30 nationalities.

We are a small, collaborative workplace with an international outlook and a strong focus on learning, innovation, and knowledge sharing.

Your role

As our new Student Assistant, you'll help support the day-to-day IT needs of colleagues across an international workplace. Working alongside four other members of the IT team, you'll gain practical experience with modern workplace technologies while helping ensure that staff can work securely and effectively both in the office and remotely.

Responsibilities
You will help with:

  • IT support and troubleshooting

  • Device setup and user administration

  • Microsoft 365 services and workplace technology

  • Meeting room and conferencing equipment

  • IT improvements, documentation, and security activities

  • Support cybersecurity and compliance activities, including CIS controls, using cloud and Microsoft 365 security solutions.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for a student who has completed at least 3 years of education within IT, computer science, business informatics, technical engineering, or a related field, and who is currently pursuing further studies.

You do not need to know everything already. We are more interested in your curiosity, motivation, and willingness to learn.

For this role, we expect you to have:

  • A strong interest in IT support and workplace technology

  • Good understanding of Windows and Microsoft 365

  • Confidence troubleshooting common technical issues

  • Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken

  • A structured and detail-oriented approach to your work

  • The ability to work independently while also being a strong team player

Experience with Microsoft 365 administration, cloud technologies, device management, cybersecurity, or scripting is an advantage, but not required.

Why join ICES?

At ICES, you'll do more than provide IT support. You'll gain practical experience with modern workplace technology, work closely with experienced colleagues, and help support an international community of staff and scientists. We offer flexible working hours to fit around your studies, along with plenty of opportunities to learn and develop your skills.

Terms of Appointment

This is a paid student role, and the working hours are 15 hours per week. This position will be established with an initial duration of 6 months, with a starting date as soon as possible (preferably January 2027).

Apply Now!

Don’t miss out on this opportunity to kickstart your IT career with us! Submit your application (CV and letter of motivation) by clicking the following link: Student Assistant (IT Support and Cybersecurity) Vacancy - ICES

Deadline for application submission is midnight 28 October 2026.

Questions about the role can be directed to IT Team Lead and Enterprise Architect, Nasrullah Iqbal (nas@ices.dk)

For more information about ICES, please visit our website:  www.ices.dk

Spar Nord Arena - Aalborg Væddeløbsbane SØGER NY BANEFORVALTER

Da vores nuværende baneforvalter ønsker at gå ned i tid, søger vi en ny til at afløse ham.

Spar Nord Arena – Aalborg Væddeløbsbane er med 40 årlige løbsdage Danmarks mest aktive væddeløbsbane. Vi afvikler både trav- og galopløb på vores 18 ha. store område, og som baneforvalter får du ansvaret for at både vores baner og vores område spiller til såvel løb som træning. Stillingen er fuld tid, og vores nye baneforvalter skal i tæt samarbejde med ledelsen og tre kollegaer der hjælper med at passe bane og område, sikre at vi opretholder et højt niveau på vores sportslige faciliteter og omgivelser.

Dine vigtigste arbejdsopgaver bliver:

·At passe opvisnings- og træningsbaner.

·At foretage reparationer / vedligehold på maskiner og bygninger.

·Øvrigt forefaldende arbejde.

Indgangsvinklen til jobbet kan f.eks. være maskinfører, landmand, greenkeeper, vicevært, banemand eller aktiv udøver.

jobs.title: Perheohjaaja, Lastensuojelun laitospalvelut, Turku
jobs.description:
Tehtäväsi

Työskentelet perheohjaajana Turussa sijaitsevassa lastensuojelun perhekuntoutusyksikössä, joka on osa Varsinais-Suomen hyvinvointialueen omien lastensuojelulaitosten kokonaisuutta.

Perheohjaajana vastaat yhdessä työryhmän kanssa perheiden tilanteen kartoituksesta sekä tavoitteellisesta kuntoutusprosessin mukaisesta työskentelystä. Asiakasperheiden elämäntilanteet ovat usein kriisiytyneitä, ja he tarvitsevat tehostettua lastensuojelullista tukea. Työskentelysi voi tapahtua päivittäin kuntoutusasunnossa perheen arjen rinnalla tai intensiivisesti perheen omassa kodissa.

Työtäsi ohjaavat suhdeperustainen työote, systeeminen ajattelu sekä muutokseen tähtäävä tavoitteellisuus. Hyödynnät työssäsi mentalisaatio- ja kiintymyssuhdeperusteista arviointia ja kuntoutusta.

Toimit osana moniammatillista tiimiä ja laajaa verkostoa, jossa lapsi ja hänen perheensä ovat kaiken työn keskiössä. Vahvistat työssäsi lapsen asemaa ja näkökulmaa perheessä sekä hyödynnät erilaisia työmenetelmiä ja tiimin yhteistä osaamista.

Työpaikan osoite on Kunnallissairaalantie 36, 20810 Turku.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Tarjoamme sinulle merkityksellisen työn lastensuojelun perhekuntoutuksessa, jossa pääset työskentelemään tiiviisti perheiden arjen ja muutoksen tukena.

Saat työsi tueksi säännöllisen työnohjauksen sekä perheterapeutin konsultaation. Työskentelet moniammatillisessa tiimissä, jossa osaamista jaetaan ja kehitetään yhdessä.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Arvostamme hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja, itseohjautuvuutta sekä kykyä kuunnella ja kohdata empaattisesti. Tärkeää on myös valmius ottaa asioita puheeksi rakentavalla tavalla.

Toivomme sinulta kiintymyssuhdeymmärrystä sekä traumasensitiivistä työotetta. Aikaisempi kokemus lastensuojelutyöstä luetaan eduksi.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on soveltuva sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon korkeakoulututkinto tai aikaisempi opistotasoinen tutkinto. Tehtävässä edellytetään hyvää suomen kielen taitoa.

Odotamme hakemustasi - tule mukaan tekemään vaikuttavaa työtä perheiden kanssa!

jobs.title: Diakon
jobs.description:
Karis-Pojo svenska församling lediganslår en diakontjänst. Diakoniarbetarna i församlingen utför klient- och påverkansarbete, uppsökande arbete samt organiserar frivilligverksamheten och den samlande verksamheten inom diakonin. Församlingen utvecklar sitt diakonala arbete bland familjer, barn och ungdomar. Till arbetsuppgifterna hör också själavård, att hålla andakter samt att medverka i gudstjänstliv och i församlingens övriga verksamhet enligt behov.

Vi söker dig som har god samarbetsförmåga och förmåga till självständigt arbete.

Du har intresse och förmåga att arbeta med ungdomar, barn och familjer, att utveckla det diakonala arbetet bland dem samt erfarenhet av och förmåga till självständigt och mångsidigt klientarbete.
Uppgifterna kräver ofta förflyttning mellan församlingens olika områden, tillgång till bil är därför önskvärt. Församlingens arbetsspråk är svenska, men i samarbetet med andra aktörer behövs kunskaper i finska. I klientarbetet behövs också andra språk.

Behörighetskrav är fastställda i kyrkans författningssamling nr 162. Språkkrav enligt kap. 8 §4 i kyrkoordningen. Övriga kunskaper än svenska och finska ses som merit.
Lön utbetalas enligt kravgrupp 503 i KyrkTAK.
Den som utses till tjänsten förväntas vara konfirmerad medlem av den evangelisk-lutherska kyrkan (KL 6 §1).
Till ansökan bifogas meritförteckning samt arbetsintyg.
På tjänsten tillämpas sex månaders prövotid.
Den som väljs till tjänsten skall uppvisa i straffregisterlagens 6 § avsedda registerutdrag samt förete intyg över sitt hälsotillstånd.
Arbetet inleds 4.1.2027 eller enligt överenskommelse.
Ansökan inlämnas senast 3.11.2026.
Sökande ombeds reservera torsdag 5.11.2026 för eventuell intervju.

jobs.title: Verkkoinsinööri / Power System Engineer
jobs.description:
Haluatko työskennellä sähköenergia-alan ytimessä ja vaikuttaa siihen, miten sähköverkot suunnitellaan ja miten ne toimivat tulevaisuudessa? Etsimme Power Engineering -tiimiimme verkkoinsinööriä, joka osallistuu uusiutuvan energian sähköverkkoprojektien suunnitteluun ja analysointiin eri puolilla Suomea sekä kansainvälisesti.

Power Engineering -tiimin tehtävä on auttaa asiakkaitamme heidän projekteissaan tuottamalla heille arvokasta informaatio sähköteknisen laskennan, analyysien ja suunnittelun avulla heidän hankkeissaan.

Tässä tehtävässä roolisi mukautuu osaamisesi ja kiinnostuksesi mukaan – voit keskittyä esimerkiksi verkostolaskentaan, tekniseen suunnitteluun tai asiantuntijatukeen projekteissa. Olemme edelläkävijöitä uusiutuvan energian suunnittelussa ja meillä voit rakentaa juuri sinulle sopivan asiantuntijaroolin, jossa voit hyödyntää ja kehittää osaamistasi. Desprolla työnteko ei ole sidoksissa paikkaan, vaan työtä voi tehdä joustavasti etänä tai toimistoiltamme useilla eri paikkakunnilta.



Tehtäväkenttäsi voi painottua eri tavoin – tässä esimerkkejä mahdollisista vastuualueista:

- Sähköverkon laskentojen tekeminen varmistaen verkon tehokkuuden ja luotettavuuden (kuormanjako-, loistehokapasiteetti-, vikavirta-, komponenttien kuormitus- ja mitoituslaskelmat sekä selektiivisyystarkastelut)


- Maadoituslaskelmat, -tarkastelut ja vaarajänniteselvitykset


- Verkkotietomallien ylläpito, kehittäminen sekä laskenta/analysointi


- Laskentatulosten analysointi ja raportointi suunnittelun tueksi


- Yhteistyö eri sidosryhmien välillä


- Dokumentaation laatiminen


- Osallistuminen sähköverkkosuunnittelun kehitysprojekteihin




Eduksi hakijalle lasketaan:

- Kokemus keski- ja suurjänniteverkkojen laskennasta ja suunnittelusta


- Tuntemus sähköverkon rakenteista ja toimintaperiaatteista


- Uusiutuvan energian järjestelmä- ja laitetuntemus


- Laskentaohjelmistojen (esim. PowerFactory, openDSS, PSCAD, PSS/E, Safegrid, Cableizer) hallinta


- Hyvät ongelmanratkaisu- ja analysointitaidot


- Tarkka, järjestelmällinen ja oma-aloitteinen työote


- Sujuva suomen ja/tai englannin kielen taito




Katsomme eduksi myös oppimishalukkuuden ja sinut perehdytetään työhösi, eli voit hakea työpaikkaa myös, vaikka et vielä osaisi kaikkea edellä mainittua.



Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

- Meillä tehdään merkityksellistä asiantuntijatyötä alan huipulla ja voidaan hyvin. Otamme henkilöstömme hyvinvoinnin ja osallistamisen tosissaan. Toimintaamme ohjaavat luottamus, rohkeus, arvostus ja vastuunotto. Onnistumme yhdessä joukkueena, toisiamme tukien.


- Rakennamme konkreettisin teoin hyvinvoivaa ja innostavaa työyhteisöä, jossa jokainen pääsee loistamaan omilla vahvuuksillaan. Meillä pääset vaikuttamaan niin omaan työhösi kuin asiakkaiden ja koko yhteiskunnan energiatehokkaaseen tulevaisuuteen. Tarjoamme mielenkiintoisia projekteja, erinomaiset henkilökuntaetuudet sekä kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen. Tarjoamme työntekijöillemme viimeisimmät laitteet ja ohjelmistot, jotta työnteko on mahdollisimman sujuvaa. Monipuolisen tehtävänkuvan lisäksi pääset kehittymään huippuasiantuntijoiden joukkueessa, alan edelläkävijäyrityksessä.




Kiinnostuitko?

Ota rohkeasti yhteyttä ja kysy lisää tehtävästä Sami Mattilalta (+358442430872) arkisin klo 9-15. Mikäli olen varattuna, soitan takaisin vapauduttuani.

jobs.title: Financial Manager
jobs.description:
Me EMU Growth Partnersilla yhdistämme modernilla tavalla tuotetut taloushallinnon ja palkanlaskennan palvelut monipuoliseen valikoimaan neuvonta-, HR-, laki- ja järjestelmäpalveluita. Haluamme luoda alan parhaan asiakaskokemuksen olemalla yrityksille inhimillinen huolenpitäjä ja luotettava suunnannäyttäjä. Ihmiskeskeiset arvot ovat tekemisemme ytimessä ja se näkyy sekä kuuluu jokaisessa päivässä.

EMU jatkaa kasvuaan ja etsimme uusia työkavereita rempseään joukkoomme! EMU on erilaisista taustoista tulevien ihmisten tiivis yhteisö, toimintamme keskiössä ovat EMUlaiset ja asiakkaat. Meitä EMUlaisia on jo reilu 100 kolmessa eri maassa ja haluamme, että meillä on taloushallintoalan paras yrityskulttuuri.

Haemme nyt joukkoomme uutta Financial Manageria!

Onko konsernitilinpäätös sinulle palapeli, jonka ratkaiseminen palkitsee? Kaipaatko työtä, jossa et jumiudu yhden yrityksen kuukausirutiiniin? Silloin tämä rooli voi olla sinulle.

EMUlla työskentelet useammalle erikokoiselle asiakkaalle, kasvuyrityksistä kansainvälisiin konserneihin. Yhtenä päivänä täsmäytät konsernin eliminointeja, seuraavana rakennat kasvuyritykselle ensimmäistä kunnon ennustemallia. Työsi ytimessä on asiakkaidemme konserniraportointi, ja sen rinnalla laajennat business controlling -tehtäviin asiakkaiden tarpeiden ja oman kiinnostuksesi mukaan. Näet talousjohtamista monesta kulmasta ja kehityt samalla.

Työssäsi:

- Vastaat konserniraportoinnista: Laadit kuukausi- ja kvartaaliraportit sekä koordinoit konsernitilinpäätökset ajallaan maaliin.

- Hoidat konsolidoinnin: Huolehdit sisäisistä eristä ja eliminoinneista, valuuttamuunnoksista, vähemmistöosuuksista sekä konsernirakenteen muutoksista.

- Hallitset työkalut ja rakenteet: Rakennat ja ylläpidät konsolidointityökalujen mappauksia sekä raportointirakenteita.

- Koordinoit ja ohjaat: Toimit yhteyshenkilönä konserniyhtiöiden kirjanpitäjille, ja varmistat aikataulujen, sisäisten saldojen täsmäytysten sekä kuukauden sulkemisen sujuvuuden.

- Ennustat ja raportoit johdolle: Teet konsernitason budjetointia ja ennustamista sekä laadit raportteja johdon ja hallituksen päätöksenteon tueksi.

- Kehität ja sparraat: Toimit yhteyshenkilönä tilintarkastajien suuntaan sekä kehität aktiivisesti asiakkaidemme talousprosesseja ja kontrolleja. Automatisoit toistuvan työn ja otat uusia työkaluja, myös tekoälyä, rohkeasti käyttöön.

Odotamme sinulta:

- Vahva tausta konsernilaskennasta: Vähintään 5 vuoden kokemus konserniraportoinnista ja konsernitilinpäätösten laatimisesta sekä vahva osaaminen erityisesti kirjanpitolain (FAS) mukaisesta konsernitilinpäätöksestä.

- Käytännön kirjanpito- ja järjestelmäosaaminen: Vahva kirjanpidon ja tilinpäätöksen käytännön osaaminen sekä kokemus vähintään yhdestä konsolidointityökalusta.

- Koordinointi- ja johtamistaidot: Hyvät koordinointitaidot ja kyky johtaa tekemistä – saat selkeillä ohjeilla, aikatauluilla ja seurannalla useamman yhtiön ja ihmisen toimittamaan oman osuutensa ajallaan.

- Järjestelmällinen ja tarkka työskentelyote: Pidät kokonaisuuden hallussa myös kiireessä. Huomaat, kun luvut eivät täsmää, ja selvität syyn.

- Selkeät viestintätaidot: Viestit sujuvasti ja selkeästi suomeksi ja englanniksi – niin asiakkaan johdolle kuin konserniyhtiöiden tekijöille. Ruotsin kielitaito on plussaa, mutta ei välttämätöntä.

Eduksi katsomme:

- BrightAnalytics-osaaminen

- IFRS-osaaminen

- Tilintarkastus- tai konsulttitausta

- Kokemusta kasvuyhtiöistä

- Vastuullisuusraportoinnin (ESG) tuntemus

Mitä tarjoamme:

- Nykyaikaiset työvälineet ja erinomaiset edut, mm. lounas-, työmatka-, terveys-, hieronta-, liikunta- ja kulttuuriedun sekä kattavan työterveyshuollon.

- Etätyömahdollisuuden ja joustavuuden oman osaamisen kehittämiseen.

- Jäykästä hierarkiasta vapaan työyhteisön.

- Persoonalliset, motivoituneet ja innostuneet kollegat.

- Loistavan työntekijäkokemuksen, jota mitataan ja tutkitaan säännöllisesti.

Työ on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen. EMUlla etätyö ja joustavuus ovat olleet normaaleja tapoja toimia jo pitkään. Etätyön lisäksi olet aina tervetullut EMUn toimipisteille Helsinkiin, Turkuun tai Kajaaniin.

Palkkahaarukka tehtävään on 5000–5700 euroa kuukaudessa osaamisesta ja kokemuksesta riippuen. Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan, mutta toivomme, että voisit aloittaa mahdollisimman pian. Täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, joten lähetäthän hakemuksesi jo tänään!

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Head of CFO Services Matias Helle, matias.helle@emu.fi puh. 0407070299. Tavoitat Matiaksen parhaiten puhelimitse 16.10 klo 9.30-10.30 ja 23.10 klo 10-11 välisenä aikana.

Voit tutustua tuleviin työkavereihin ja EMU-meininkiin EMUn Instagramissa (https://www.instagram.com/emulaiset/) ja EMUun työnantajana verkkosivuillamme (https://emugroup.com/ura-emulla).


EMU Growth Partners

jobs.title: International Private Bank Managed Investments Platform – Product Owner (m/f)
jobs.employer: J.P. Morgan SE - Luxembourg Branch  S.E.
jobs.description:
International Private Bank Managed Investments Platform – Product Owner, Vice President, Luxembourg

• Job Identification 210784789
• Job Category Product Management
• Business Unit Asset & Wealth Management
• Locations 6 route de Treves, Building H, Senningerberg, Luxembourg, L-2633, LU
• Job Schedule Full time
• Job Shift Day

Job Description

Build the platform that helps advisors deliver exceptional investment experiences for clients around the world. You'll own meaningful outcomes—turning user needs into scalable product capabilities that improve proposals, portfolio implementation, and ongoing servicing. You'll grow your product leadership through mobility, mentorship, and exposure to senior stakeholders across business, technology, and control partners. You'll join a collaborative team that values curiosity, accountability, and inclusive problem-solving. If you're energized by complex challenges and tangible impact, you'll thrive with us.

As a Product Owner (Vice President) in the International Private Bank Managed Product team, you will shape and deliver enhancements to our managed investments platform that supports advisors, portfolio managers, and partners globally. You'll translate user needs into a clear roadmap and actionable delivery plans, balancing scalability, resiliency, and stability. You'll work with us in a fast-paced, partnership-driven culture where you can influence outcomes and learn from diverse perspectives. Together, we'll improve the tools and workflows that help teams serve clients with excellence.

Job responsibilities

• Partner with advisors, portfolio managers, and stakeholders to understand investment workflows and prioritize platform opportunities
• Collaborate with business stakeholders, technology and operations partners to deliver resilient, scalable, and stable platform capabilities
• Lead discovery activities, including user research and journey mapping, to define problems and validate solutions
• Define product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned to business outcomes and user needs
• Translate requirements into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized backlogs for delivery teams
• Use data, performance metrics, and qualitative feedback to inform prioritization and design decisions
• Facilitate cross-functional decision-making and align stakeholders across multiple initiatives and timelines
• Communicate progress, dependencies, and trade-offs through clear updates and governance routines
• Identify risks and issues early and escalate appropriately to keep delivery on track
• Drive continuous improvement across product processes, controls, and user experience

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

• Demonstrated experience owning a digital product or platform from discovery through delivery
• Proven ability to build and manage a product roadmap and translate strategy into measurable outcomes
• Strong capability to gather requirements, write user stories, and manage a prioritized backlog
• Experience partnering cross-functionally with technology, operations, and business stakeholders to deliver outcomes
• Ability to navigate ambiguity, competing priorities, and tight timelines while maintaining high standards
• Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics for different audiences
• Comfort presenting to and influencing senior stakeholders through structured updates and clear recommendations
• A collaborative, inclusive working style and commitment to shared team success

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

• Experience supporting wealth management or private banking investment workflows (proposals, portfolio implementation, servicing)
• Knowledge of investments products, platforms, or related operating models
• Experience contributing to platform modernization or strategic transformation initiatives
• Experience working across multiple regions and time zones with globally distributed partners
• Background partnering with risk, controls, and governance functions within a regulated environment

About Us

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About the Team

J.P. Morgan Asset & Wealth Management delivers industry-leading investment management and private banking solutions. Asset Management provides individuals, advisors and institutions with strategies and expertise that span the full spectrum of asset classes through our global network of investment professionals. Wealth Management helps individuals, families and foundations take a more intentional approach to their wealth or finances to better define, focus and realize their goals.

jobs.description:
International Supply Chain Manager
Luxembourg
Full time
R69674

Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We're working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!
Join our Luxembourg team where your expertise directly contributes to humanity's greatest adventure, while maintaining the work-life harmony that makes great engineering possible. Be part of a collaborative, inclusive culture where safety and technical excellence drive every decision as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight from the heart of Europe.
At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We're working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!
As part of a hardworking team of supply chain professionals, technicians, and engineers, you will play a crucial role in ensuring our organization adheres to all relevant regulations, develops automated compliance reports, and educates our teams on designing compliant processes. The International Supply Chain Manager manages relationships with non-US external vendors and suppliers, ensuring contractual obligations are fulfilled while protecting the organization's interests, maintaining compliance, and optimizing.

Special Mentions:

Relocation provided
Travel expected up to 25% of the time
Interviews may will include a technical assessment

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Global Supplier Development & Relationship Management

Identify, evaluate, and onboard suppliers across international markets based on quality, capacity, reliability, and cost
Build and nurture cross-cultural business relationships that respect regional practices and communication styles
Monitor supplier performance against KPIs and implement improvement strategies across global operations

International Contract & Financial Management

Negotiate and administer agreements compliant with multiple legal jurisdictions and international standards
Leverage global market intelligence to secure optimal pricing while balancing quality and risk
Manage currency fluctuations, payment terms, and financial controls across international transactions
Maintain comprehensive documentation of all contract activities and changes

Global Compliance & Risk Mitigation

Ensure adherence to international trade regulations, export/import laws, and country-specific requirements
Identify and address risks unique to global procurement (political instability, logistics disruptions, trade disputes)
Implement appropriate risk management strategies through contract terms, insurance requirements, and contingency planning
Coordinate quality assurance across international suppliers to maintain consistent standards

Global Supply Chain Optimization

Manage international logistics, customs clearance, and documentation requirements
Implement efficiency improvements in global procurement processes and inventory management
Generate performance analytics on international supplier metrics and compliance reporting
Stay informed about international market trends and regional business conditions that impact supply chain decisions

Strategic Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with legal, finance, engineering, and logistics teams across global operations
Align international procurement activities with organizational objectives and program requirements
Facilitate effective communication between international suppliers and internal stakeholders
Serve as subject matter expert on global sourcing strategies and international supply markets

Minimum Qualifications:

Education: Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, international business, or related field
Experience: 5+ years in international procurement or supplier management
Language Skills: Proficiency in multiple languages relevant to key supplier regions
Knowledge: Understanding of international trade laws, customs regulations, and global logistics
Travel Capability: Willingness to travel internationally (typically 20-30%)
Cultural Competence: Demonstrated ability to work effectively across cultures and business environments
Technical Skills: Proficiency with global procurement systems and international payment platforms
Domain Expertise: Engineering, Manufacturing or Procurement experience across multiple aerospace domains and commodities

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelors degree and/or previous working experience as an Engineer, Apprentice or Technician
Experience working in a multi-cultural environment with both internal and external customers and stakeholders
Experience with ISO 9001, AS9100, or other quality management systems in aerospace
Fluent in multiple languages

Culture Statement

Don't meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right
candidate for this or other roles.

Criminal Record Check

Given the nature of the work we do at Blue Origin, which allows access to sensitive and proprietary information of our company and customers, please be aware that, in accordance with the amended law of 29 March 2013 on the organisation of criminal records, the selected candidate will be requested to provide an extract from the criminal record (bulletin n°3)

We're committed to building the road to space so our children can build the future. We are a mission-driven company focused on ideas and innovation, and encourage fresh perspectives from bold voices. At Blue, our team is building the future as their unique selves. Thank you for your interest in working at Blue Origin

Are you looking for an internship where no two days are the same and where you can discover the many facets of Human Resources? Join our Luxembourg HR team and gain hands-on experience in an international environment where your ideas, curiosity and initiative will be valued.
You will take ownership of day-to-day absence administration while contributing to a broad range of HR activities, including employee communication, engagement events, training, recruitment and HR projects. As your confidence grows, you may also lead selected initiatives from idea to implementation and, if you are interested, gain exposure to payroll preparation.
This internship is designed as a genuine learning experience: you will work closely with an experienced and collaborative HR team, interact with employees and managers, and see how HR supports both people and the business.

Key responsibilities

• Track and follow up on employee absences, including sickness, parental and maternity leave, holidays, business trips, training and other leave types.
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date HR data in the relevant systems and trackers, and complete routine data entry activities on time.
• Collect, check and file employee documents, ensuring records are complete, well organized and handled confidentially.
• Respond to day-to-day employee questions, provide guidance on HR processes and escalate sensitive matters when required.
• Draft employee communications, practical guides, presentations and intranet content, and support their review, formatting and publication.
• Help organize employee events and engagement initiatives, coordinating communications, suppliers and on-site logistics.
• Support training activities, including registrations, coordination with employees, managers and providers, session logistics, attendance records and follow-up documentation.
• Support recruitment and onboarding by preparing job postings, screening applications, scheduling interviews, coordinating with candidates and interviewers, and welcoming new hires.
• Contribute to HR projects, process improvements and digitalization initiatives; depending on scope and readiness, independently lead selected projects.
• The scope of the internship may evolve over time based on business needs as well as the intern's skills, interests, initiative and readiness to take on new challenges.

What we're looking for

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, Psychology, Communication or a related field.
• Organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage recurring administrative activities accurately and meet deadlines.
• Curious, proactive and comfortable suggesting ideas, improving ways of working and taking ownership of tasks.
• Interpersonal and written communication skills, with an interest in supporting employees and working as part of a team.
• Able to handle personal information with discretion and maintain confidentiality.
• Comfortable using Microsoft Office; good Excel and PowerPoint skills are an advantage.
• Fluent in English; French or German is an advantage. Any additional language is welcome.
• Previous HR experience is not required—we are looking above all for motivation, reliability and the willingness to learn.

What you will gain

• Practical experience across HR operations, employee engagement, learning and recruitment—not just observation.
• Real responsibility, regular feedback and the opportunity to develop project ownership.
• Exposure to an international business and a broad understanding of how an HR team operates day to day.

What we believe

• Inclusion - We value diversity in people, ideas, and experiences.
• Integrity - We believe in transparency, authenticity, and depend on each other to deliver what we promise.

Fière d'appartenir au Groupe AXA, une marque d'assurance internationale et un leader mondial des services financiers, la société AXA Assurances Luxembourg est un acteur majeur du secteur des assurances au Grand-Duché.
Nous aidons nos clients à traverser les petites et grandes difficultés de la vie. Chaque jour, nous agissons ensemble pour inventer la meilleure manière de les protéger et voulons donner à chacun les moyens de vivre une vie meilleure.
Un challenge qui donne le sourire et envie de se lever le matin !

Chez AXA, nous sommes persuadés que pour bien prendre soin de nos clients, nous devons commencer par bien prendre soin de nos collaborateurs. C'est pour cette raison que nous menons une politique RH engagée qui favorise la diversité, qui préserve l'équilibre vie privée-vie professionnelle et accompagne le développement des compétences et des carrières.
Quelle que soit l'équipe que vous rejoignez au sein de notre organisation, certaines choses sont vraies pour nous tous : une culture forte fondée sur la confiance, le respect et où nous sommes bienveillants les uns avec les autres, parce que c'est la meilleure façon d'être les meilleures versions de nous-mêmes. Nous cherchons toujours à attirer des talents dans notre entreprise, tout en continuant à développer notre personnel existant.
  
Vos missions

Au sein du département Finance d'AXA Assurances Luxembourg S.A., la fonction est rattachée au service Contrôle de gestion et Pilotage Commercial. Votre rôle consiste à participer au suivi et au pilotage de l'activité commerciale.

Dans ce rôle, vous serez amené(e) à :

Responsabilités récurrentes :

jobs.description:
SD-26155- POST-DOC SOIL HEALTH AND REMEDIATION

Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 24 Months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defense technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

As part of LIST's SUSTAIN unit (Environmental Sustainability Assessment and Circularity), the Environmental Policies (EPS) group provides science-based input to the definition and implementation of environmental policies at national and EU level, in particular policies around chemical safety, soil pollution, circular (bio-)economy (e.g. construction, textile, water), and climate - and feeds, at the interface of science, technologies and policies, the regulatory perspective into RDI projects around these topics.

As postdoc (R&T Scientist), you will further strengthen the activities around soil health and the management of contaminated sites via contributing to:
• The further development (implementation-phase) of an Urban Soil Living Lab in Luxembourg (Horizon Europe project URSOILL - Innovative Solutions for Sustainable Urban Soil Restoration Through Living Labs) and participation in a working group on soil remediation and stabilization with nature-based solutions, especially phytoremediation and phytomanagement. Main tasks: literature review; design of field experiments and monitoring protocols across multiple urban sites; support and supervision of fieldwork; data analysis and interpretation; stakeholder engagement in the Living Lab; and scientific publications and project deliverables.
• The establishment of a cross-border network of ‘Lighthouses' of phytomanagement for soil remediation, biodiversity and the regenerative economy in the Greater Region (Interreg project Light4Green),
• Scientific and regulatory support, e.g. via bibliography and the preparation of a review article, on nature-based remediation solutions for Persistent organic pollutants (POPs) contamination (Interreg project Naturem),
• The set-up of a laboratory for testing and evaluating soil remediation technologies (especially bioremediation and phytoremediation),
• Support the definition, submission and implementation of research and collaborative project proposals of the group, and participate to the network of LIST's different activities around soil protection.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!
Education

• You hold a Master's degree and a PhD in soil or environmental sciences/engineering, or another relevant natural science or engineering domain.
• You have practical and solid experience in the design, testing, evaluation and application of nature-based soil remediation technologies, e.g. phytoremediation, bioremediation, mycoremediation.
• Interdisciplinary thinking, well-developed communication skills (oral and written) and team spirit to successfully integrate into the multicultural, multilingual and multidisciplinary work environment at LIST and effectively communicate with LIST's partners,
• Client orientation mindset and great sense of service are required. The candidate should be highly motivated, pro-active and open for new challenges and can work independently,
• Not mandatory but considered an asset:
o First experience in an RTO/academic environment, scientific/technical consulting, authorities, or industry on contaminated site management, pollution risk assessment or remediation
o Knowledge of Luxembourg and the Greater Region

Language skills

• Fluency in English, both oral and written. Other relevant languages, especially French, German, or Luxembourgish are a strong asset.

Your LIST benefits

• An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects
• Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society
• Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square metres, including innovations in all that we do
• An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas
• Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills
• Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce
• Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfil their personal and professional ambitions

ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion sits at a rare intersection: a product people love, a flexible system businesses run on, and a new platform for people and AI to work together. We’re hiring a Product Manager to turn that opportunity into products that feel inevitable. You’ll find consequential customer problems, set a bold but grounded strategy, and build alongside design, engineering, data science, research, and go-to-market partners. This is a high-agency role for someone excited to shape what Notion becomes next—and make powerful new capabilities feel simple, trustworthy, and delightful to millions of customers.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.



WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Uncover the customer problems and product opportunities that will define Notion’s next chapter, then turn them into a focused strategy and roadmap.

 - Take ambitious ideas from first principles to launch, building closely with design and engineering to create experiences that feel simple, useful, and distinctly Notion.

 - Make the hard calls—balancing customer impact, business opportunity, technical complexity, speed, and long-term product quality.

 - Shape how AI changes both the product and the way we build, using it to improve research, decisions, experimentation, and execution.

 - Raise the bar for product thinking across the team by creating clarity, accelerating learning, and establishing principles and success measures that endure.

 - Strong product judgment and the ability to make sound tradeoffs among user experience, business impact, technical complexity, quality, and speed.

 - A track record of moving ambiguous, cross-functional work from problem definition to shipped outcomes while creating clear ownership and alignment.

 - Customer depth: you can learn directly from users across segments and translate differing needs into a coherent strategy rather than a collection of one-off requests.

 - Practical AI fluency: you use AI to sharpen research, product thinking, decisions, and execution, and you’re excited to rethink how people and agents work together.


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience building collaborative, productivity, or AI-powered products used by a broad range of customers.

 - Experience operating across both zero-to-one product development and the improvement of products at scale.

 - Technical fluency and comfort partnering deeply with engineering on complex product systems.

jobs.description: Uvjeti (potrebna znanja i kvalifikacije) koje kandidati moraju zadovoljiti za navedeno radno mjesto su: • SSS/KV – tehničkog smjera (vodoinstalater, monter strojarskih instalacija ili srodni stručnjaci strojarskog ili građevinskog smjera) • vozačka dozvola B kategorije Opis poslova radnog mjesta: • organizira i samostalno obavlja složeni popravak svih vrsta vodomjera radi pripreme za njihovo mjeriteljsko ispitivanje i ovjeru • organizira raspoređivanje rezervnih dijelova vodomjera unutar servisa • prema potrebi izrađuje pojedine dijelove vodomjera • sudjeluje u radovima remonta baždarnice Izabrani kandidat obavljat će poslove radnog mjesta MONTER I (822416) u Odjelu izmjene vodomjera, temeljem ugovora o radu na neodređeno vrijeme s probnim radom u trajanju od 6 (šest) mjeseci. Mjesto rada je u Zagrebu. Uz predaju ponude koja sadrži kontakt podatke (broj telefona ili mobitela, e-mail adresa) kandidati trebaju obvezno priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta, kako slijedi: • životopis s opisom dosadašnjeg rada • dokaz o odgovarajućem stupnju obrazovanja u skladu s uvjetima iz javnog natječaja (presliku svjedodžbe, odnosno rješenje o priznavanju inozemne stručne kvalifikacije koju je izdalo nadležno tijelo) • uvjerenje da se ne vodi kazneni postupak (ne starije od 3 mjeseca od dana objave natječaja) • presliku važeće vozačke dozvole Ponude na javni natječaj podnose se elektroničkim putem. Rok za dostavu tražene dokumentacije je 14 dana od dana objave, na adresu elektroničke pošte: vio.karijera@zgh.hr S naznakom „Za javni natječaj za radno mjesto MONTER I (822416) u Odjelu izmjene vodomjera“. Urednom ponudom smatra se ponuda koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u javnom natječaju. Nepotpune i nepravodobno pristigle ponude neće se razmatrati. jobs.title: Tech Lead Full-Stack Rails Engineer
jobs.description:
About Mitre Media

Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

About the Role

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and maintain Rails applications (Rails 8)

  • Integrate LLMs into our microservices architecture for state management and real-time user experiences.

  • Enhance front-end experiences with Hotwire, StimulusJS, or React, ensuring seamless AI-driven interactions.

  • Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.

Required Technical Skills

Back-End

  • Ruby (5+ years, expert-level)

  • Ruby on Rails (Rails 6-8 preferred)

  • PostgreSQL (or MySQL)

  • Elasticsearch

  • Redis

  • Docker

Front-End

  • StimulusJS or JavaScript ES6

  • Tailwind CSS

  • HTML

  • HTTP

AI Integration

  • Experience integrating AI/ML models (e.g., LLMs, NLP) with web applications

  • Familiarity with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Hugging Face) or APIs (e.g., xAI, Anthropic)

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

  • Kubernetes for microservices orchestration

  • React for advanced front-end components

  • Graph databases for complex financial data

  • Contributions to open-source RoR or AI projects

Required Soft Skills

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for AI and FinTech

  • Natural leader who mentors and inspires teammates

  • Problem-solver with a “get things done” mentality

  • Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration

  • Attention to detail, ensuring clean, maintainable code

  • Team player comfortable as an individual contributor

Why Join Us?

  • Impactful Work: Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights.

  • Cutting-Edge Tech: Work with Rails 8, LLMs, and modern tools like Hotwire, Databricks, and xAI’s API in a microservices architecture.

  • Autonomy and Influence: Collaborate directly with our CEO and CTO to shape our AI-driven platform, with freedom to innovate.

  • Competitive Compensation: $160,000–$200,000 CAD/USD (based on experience) and benefits.

  • Remote Flexibility: Remote-first (±3 hours from ET) with hybrid in office collaboration in Toronto or NYC

  • Growth Opportunities: Budget for AI and Rails conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, RailsConf), plus access to cutting-edge AI tools for experimentation.

  • Dynamic Culture: Join a small, no-ego team passionate about trust, innovation, and making a difference in FinTech.

About Mitre Media’s AI-Driven Platform

Mitre Media powers premium financial brands like Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com with the Mitre Platform. This platform integrates traditional content management, financial data, first-party data, ad revenue, and subscription tools, all enhanced by LLMs for rich, user-focused experiences. Our data-derived insights delight users, while our advertising solutions deliver unmatched performance for partners like BlackRock and Vanguard, leveraging advanced targeting and first-party data.

How to Apply

 

Submit your resume, GitHub profile, and a brief note on why you’re excited about building AI-driven FinTech to jobs@mitremedia.com.

jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager, Campaign Strategy & Execution
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is looking for an experienced Lifecycle Marketing Manager, Campaign Strategy & Execution to develop and execute campaigns that help users discover value, adopt key workflows, and deepen their use of Notion.

You'll own campaigns end to end: translating business and customer opportunities into clear strategies, defining audiences and journeys, coordinating creative and technical production, launching across email and in-product channels, and measuring incremental impact.

This role combines strategic judgment with hands-on execution. You'll partner closely with Lifecycle Marketing, Product Marketing, Product Growth, Data Science, Marketing Operations, and creative partners. You should be equally comfortable shaping a campaign brief, building a journey in Customer.io http://Customer.io, resolving execution details, and interpreting results.

Scope guardrails: this role owns campaign strategy, hands-on execution, cross-functional delivery, and performance analysis. It is not the primary Customer.io http://Customer.io architect or incident-response owner, a general intake coordinator, or a production-only role receiving prewritten briefs. The person should operate as an independent campaign owner who can take work from an ambiguous opportunity to a high-quality, measured launch.

This role may be based in either our San Francisco or New York City offices. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the campaign portfolio. Independently lead a portfolio of launch, one-off, and evergreen lifecycle campaigns with clear prioritization and predictable delivery.

 - Turn opportunities into strategies. Translate product launches, lifecycle moments, and business priorities into clear objectives, audiences, journeys, channel plans, and success metrics.

 - Build high-impact lifecycle programs. Develop campaigns across onboarding, activation, adoption, collaboration, monetization, retention, and resurrection.

 - Execute from brief to measurement. Own audience creation, build, QA, localization, launch readiness, and post-campaign analysis across email and in-product messaging.

 - Improve foundational journeys. Audit existing programs and recommend which should be maintained, improved, rebuilt, or retired; lead the rebuild of priority onboarding or adoption journeys.

 - Raise the experimentation bar. Develop testable hypotheses and use segmentation, personalization, holdouts, and A/B tests to understand incremental impact.

 - Measure customer and business outcomes. Connect campaigns to activation, product adoption, collaboration, conversion, retention, or qualified sales outcomes—not only opens and clicks.

 - Lead cross-functional delivery. Coordinate dependencies across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Product Marketing, Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, Sales, and external partners.

 - Create repeatable systems. Turn recurring campaign work into templates, playbooks, and reusable operating patterns that improve quality and velocity.

 - Enable safe self-service. Help cross-functional partners execute effectively while maintaining Lifecycle's strategic, customer-experience, and quality standards.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Significant experience owning lifecycle, CRM, growth, or product-marketing campaigns from strategy through execution.

 - A track record of independently leading complex, cross-functional campaigns at meaningful scale.

 - Strong customer-journey thinking across activation, adoption, engagement, conversion, and retention.

 - Hands-on experience with a lifecycle platform such as Customer.io http://Customer.io, Braze, Iterable, or Salesforce Marketing Cloud.

 - Strong audience segmentation, personalization, experimentation, and campaign-measurement skills.

 - Ability to use data to prioritize opportunities, evaluate results, and change strategy; working knowledge of SQL or self-serve analytics is a plus.

 - Excellent project leadership: clear briefs, dependable execution, proactive risk management, and crisp stakeholder communication.

 - Strong editorial and customer judgment—you care about sending useful, relevant messages rather than maximizing message volume.

 - Comfort operating in a product-led, highly cross-functional environment with incomplete information.

 - Experience with B2B or product-led growth, product telemetry, in-product messaging, or AI-assisted campaign workflows is a plus.

 - 8+ total years relevant + transferrable experience.
   
   


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THE FIRST SIX MONTHS:

 - Establish a clear operating rhythm for launch, one-off, and evergreen campaigns.

 - Independently own a meaningful portfolio from strategy through performance analysis.

 - Launch a materially improved onboarding, activation, or adoption journey with a defined experiment and measurement plan.

 - Establish consistent briefs, segmentation standards, QA, launch-readiness checks, and post-campaign readouts.

 - Demonstrate credible incremental movement in a product or business outcome.

 - Create meaningful capacity for senior Lifecycle teammates to focus on systems architecture, journey strategy, personalization, and modernization.

The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $190,000 – $220,000 per year.

jobs.title: AI Trainer
jobs.description:
Remote | Independent Contractor | Get certified for future project opportunities

Prove your skills. Get certified. Be ready for what comes next.

Robotics AI is advancing rapidly, and high-quality video data helps intelligent systems better understand the world around them. We are inviting detail-oriented professionals to complete our certification process for potential robotics AI projects. Demonstrate your skills now and be considered when project opportunities become available.

What You Will Do

As part of the certification process, you will demonstrate your ability to:

  • Annotate short video clips by identifying objects, actions and events.
  • Evaluate video quality, relevance and accuracy against established guidelines.
  • Assess the clarity and plausibility of movements.
  • Apply instructions consistently and identify potential quality issues.

What You Bring

  • Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking.
  • Strong written English and the ability to follow detailed instructions independently.
  • A commitment to accuracy and consistency.

jobs.title: Pædagogiske og sundhedsfaglige medarbejdere samt en sygeplejerske med fokus på kvalitet og undervisning
jobs.description:
Vil du bruge din faglighed til at skabe tryghed og udviklingsmuligheder for børn og unge? Hos MerVib søger vi både medarbejdere til det daglige arbejde på vores børne- og ungehjem i Herrestrup og Grevinge og en sygeplejerske til sundhedsfaglig kvalitet, medicinhåndtering og undervisning.

Vores tilgang
Et barn eller en ung kommer med erfaringer, interesser og håb – og ofte med andres fortællinger, der med tiden kan være blevet til faste sandheder om, hvem de er.

Hos MerVib er vi nysgerrige på barnets egen oplevelse: Hvad er vigtigt? Hvad lykkes? Og hvad kan vi voksne have overset?

På vores fire børne- og ungehjem arbejder vi for, at børn og unge oplever tryghed, tilhørsforhold og indflydelse på eget liv. Vores narrative tilgang præger, hvordan vi taler med og om børnene. Vi undersøger vores egne antagelser og får sammen med barnet øje på færdigheder, initiativer og håb. Barnets perspektiv er med til at forme vores støtte.

Pædagogiske og sundhedsfaglige medarbejdere til Herrestrup og Grevinge
Du arbejder med tydelig struktur, professionel omsorg og relationer – både i fællesskaber og i individuelle opgaver med 1:1-støtte. Du tilpasser støtten til det enkelte barn og bidrager til en tryg og forudsigelig hverdag.

Vi søger dig der
  • Har en relevant faglig uddannelse og erfaring med børn og unge i sårbare positioner.
  • Har viden om og erfaring med autisme, ADHD og omsorgssvigt.
  • Har erfaring med eller interesse for narrativ praksis og TEACCH.
  • Er nysgerrig på barnets perspektiv og kan tilpasse støtten inden for trygge, tydelige rammer.
  • Arbejder ud fra en Low Arousal-tilgang, tager ansvar, dokumenterer systematisk og er åben for faglig sparring.

Du kan eksempelvis være uddannet pædagog, socialpædagog, pædagogisk assistent, social- og sundhedsassistent, sygeplejerske, socialrådgiver, skolelærer, fysioterapeut eller ergoterapeut. Du kan også have en anden relevant socialfaglig, sundhedsfaglig eller pædagogisk uddannelse.

Der er tale om faste fuldtidsstillinger med 12-timers dagvagter, 24-timers døgnvagter og weekendarbejde. Arbejdsstederne er vores børne- og ungehjem i Herrestrup og Grevinge.

Sygeplejerske til sundhedsfaglig kvalitet medicinhåndtering og undervisning
Som sygeplejerske skal du have et solidt fagligt og lovgivningsmæssigt fundament. Du kombinerer praktiske medicinopgaver med undervisning og kvalitetsudvikling og hjælper ledelsen og medarbejderne med at omsætte gældende regler til tydelige og forsvarlige arbejdsgange.

Dine opgaver omfatter at
  • Varetage medicinopgaver, herunder dispensering efter gældende ordinationer og instrukser.
  • Undervise og vejlede medarbejderne i medicinhåndtering og følge op på oplæring og kompetencer.
  • Gennemgå, opdatere og versionsstyre sundhedsfaglige instrukser i overensstemmelse med gældende regler og vejledninger samt følge op på, at de anvendes korrekt i hverdagen.
  • Omsætte faglige krav til brugbare arbejdsgange inden for blandt andet ansvar og kompetencer, journalføring, samtykke, hygiejne, utilsigtede hændelser og egenkontrol.
  • Indgå i det pædagogiske arbejde i husene i dagtimerne eller i weekender. Tilrettelæggelsen aftales med udgangspunkt i dine interesser og stillingens øvrige opgaver.

Vi søger dig der
  • Er uddannet og autoriseret sygeplejerske med solid erfaring med medicinhåndtering, dispensering og sundhedsfaglig dokumentation.
  • Har solidt kendskab til relevant sundhedslovgivning, herunder regler om medicinhåndtering, journalføring, samtykke, tavshedspligt og delegation af sundhedsfaglige opgaver.
  • Kender og kan anvende relevante vejledninger fra Sundhedsstyrelsen og Styrelsen for Patientsikkerhed og holder dig ajour med ændringer.
  • Kan underbygge din vejledning med gældende regler og faglige kilder og afklarer tvivlsspørgsmål, før du vejleder eller ændrer en instruks.
  • Kan skrive klare instrukser og gøre faglig viden anvendelig for medarbejdere med forskellige uddannelsesbaggrunde.
  • Kan undervise og vejlede præcist og praksisnært samt følge op på, at medarbejderne forstår deres opgaver, ansvar og kompetencegrænser.
  • Arbejder systematisk og selvstændigt og trives i et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde.
  • Møder børn og unge med respekt, nysgerrighed og blik for deres perspektiv.

Erfaring fra et børne- og ungehjem eller et andet socialt tilbud er en fordel.

Stillingen er en fast fuldtidsstilling med opgaver på MerVibs børne- og ungehjem i Herrestrup, Grevinge og Jyderup. Vi har desuden undervisningslokaler i Herlev. Du skal være villig til at bruge egen bil.

Hos MerVib får du
Et arbejdsfællesskab med varme, engagement og høj faglig standard. Du introduceres til vores hverdag, værdier og metoder og deltager fra start med støtte fra kolleger og ledelse.

Vores årshjul rummer intern og ekstern undervisning samt faglige oplæg gennem hele året. Derudover får du tæt ledelsesmæssig sparring og supervision.

For begge stillingsprofiler gælder:
  • Løn og tiltrædelse efter aftale.
  • Pension og sundhedsforsikring.
  • Kørekort til almindelig bil (B) er et krav.
  • Vi indhenter børne- og straffeattest før ansættelse.

Ansøgning og kontakt
Fortæl os, hvorfor du har lyst til at bringe din faglighed i spil hos MerVib.

Angiv tydeligt i din ansøgning, om du søger en medarbejderstilling i Herrestrup eller Grevinge eller stillingen som sygeplejerske med fokus på sundhedsfaglig kvalitet og undervisning.

Upload din ansøgning, CV og dit uddannelsesbevis via linket "Ansøg" her på siden.

Vil du høre mere om stillingerne, er du velkommen til at kontakte:
  • Medarbejderstillinger i Grevinge: Afdelingsleder Rikke Gjesing, telefon 92 90 42 24.
  • Medarbejderstillinger i Herrestrup: Afdelingsleder Nada Shouhani, telefon 92 90 42 16.
  • Sygeplejerskestillingen: Gitte Praastrup, specialkonsulent – drift, HR og kommunikation, telefon 92 90 42 22 eller job@mervib.dk .
