jobs.description:
Senior Relationship Manager - AIF Depositary (M/F)
Luxembourg
req1167

Apply Now

BIL is a leading player in Luxembourg's financial market. Founded in 1856 as the country's first bank, BIL has contributed significantly to the development of Luxembourg's social and economic landscape. Today, BIL operates across digital banking, wealth management and corporate finance, supporting individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and both private and institutional investors. Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

Your Key Objectives:

You will be responsible for implementing the Bank's commercial strategy and risk policy within the Alternative Funds segment, both in Luxembourg and abroad. You will manage and develop profitable client relationships, promote the Institutional Banking Value Proposition, and contribute to the growth of the Alternative Investment Funds business.

Your next challenge:

• Manage and develop a portfolio of clients in the Custodian Banking/Depositary segment and foster long-term relationships through regular client interactions.
• Act as the primary point of contact for clients within BIL, ensuring effective coordination between clients and all relevant internal stakeholders.
• Achieve assigned objectives in terms of revenue, costs, deposit collection and credit production, while actively contributing to the performance of the Alternative Investment Funds (AIF) team and Institutional Banking (IB).
• Promote the IB Value Proposition by developing a thorough understanding of clients' situations and proposing solutions that address their current and future needs.
• Maintain a strong knowledge of BIL's products and services, particularly those dedicated to AIF clients.
• Leverage the expertise available across IB to deliver comprehensive client solutions, drive cross-selling initiatives and identify business growth opportunities in collaboration with the Business Developers.
• Ensure compliance with all applicable policies, procedures and regulatory requirements, including KYC and AML obligations.
• Oversee the operational follow-up of client requests and instructions, working closely with the Business Office and Compliance teams to ensure service quality and efficiency.
• Contribute to knowledge sharing and training initiatives within Institutional Banking by supporting colleagues and continuously developing specialized expertise.
• Act as an ambassador of the BIL Group through participation in conferences, presentations, training sessions and industry events, while maintaining a strong professional network.
• Contribute to the development and enhancement of products and services for AIF clients through an innovative and client-focused approach.

Your skills:

jobs.title: Expert en Communications Unifiées (m/f)
jobs.description:
Expert en Communications Unifiées (H/F) – CDI temps complet

Vous souhaitez rejoindre une société dynamique, leader sur son marché et disposant d'un large portefeuille de solutions. Telkea Group est à la recherche d'un Expert en Communications Unifiées

Missions

Vous intégrerez l'équipe UC Alcatel & NetPBX de Telkea ICT en tant qu'Expert en Communications Unifiées, avec une spécialisation sur les environnements Alcatel- Lucent Enterprise.

Vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie des solutions : analyse des besoins, conception, installation, configuration, mise en production, maintenance, support et amélioration continue.

Vous serez également amené à évoluer progressivement vers les technologies de notification serveur (Mobicall), d'appel malade et de communication dans les environnements de soins, ou à mettre directement à profit une expérience existante dans ces domaines.

Dans le cadre de vos missions, vous interviendrez sur les plateformes de Telkea ICT ainsi que chez nos clients au Luxembourg et dans la Grande Région. Vous serez un interlocuteur technique privilégié et contribuerez à garantir la qualité des installations, la continuité de service et la satisfaction de nos clients.

Dans le cadre de vos activités, vous serez notamment amené à ;

• Réaliser les nouvelles installations et mises en service de solutions Alcatel OXE/Rainbow ;
• Installer, configurer et maintenir les systèmes de téléphonie et de communications unifiées ;
• Assurer le support technique de niveau 2 et 3 ;
• Traiter quotidiennement les tickets MACD — Move, Add, Change, Delete — ainsi que les incidents et pannes ;
• Diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes liés à la téléphonie, aux réseaux, à la signalisation SIP et aux flux audio ;
• Assurer l'installation, la configuration et le support des solutions de notification serveur Mobicall et d'appel malade ;
• Participer à l'intégration des solutions d'appel malade avec les environnements téléphoniques et les systèmes clients ;
• Évoluer vers une expertise complète des solutions de notification serveur, d'appel malade et de communication destinées aux établissements de soins ;
• Assurer la maintenance préventive et corrective des infrastructures installées ;
• Participer aux migrations, montées de version et évolutions techniques des plateformes ;
• Assurer la permanence technique selon un système de roulement ;
• Prendre en charge le suivi administratif et technique des projets ;
• Mettre à jour la base de données et la documentation des clients ;
• Rédiger les rapports d'intervention, dossiers techniques, procédures et documents d'exploitation ;
• Produire et maintenir les documentations de configuration et les dossiers « as-built » ;
• Assurer une communication technique claire et professionnelle avec les clients ;
• Collaborer avec les fournisseurs, les équipes internes et les autres intervenants des projets ;
• Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des méthodes, procédures et outils internes ;
• Développer régulièrement vos compétences techniques ;
• Respecter les exigences de qualité, de confidentialité et de service propres à la clientèle de Telkea ICT.

Profil recherché

Vous disposez d'une expérience d'au moins 5 ans dans un rôle similaire, dans le domaine des télécommunications, des communications unifiées, des réseaux ou des systèmes d'appel malade.

Vous avez une large culture technique et êtes capable d'intervenir sur des solutions dans leur ensemble, depuis l'installation et la configuration jusqu'au dépannage avancé et au support client.

Une expérience ou des connaissances dans les domaines suivants sont particulièrement appréciées:

• Solutions de téléphonie Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise ;
• Plateformes Alcatel OmniPCX Enterprise et/ou OXO ;
• Téléphonie IP, SIP, VoIP et trunks opérateurs ;
• Réseaux IP, VLAN, DHCP, DNS, routage et QoS ;
• Solutions de notification serveur Solutions Mobicall ou technologies équivalentes ;
• Solutions d'appel malade et environnements hospitaliers ou résidentiels ;
• Intégration entre systèmes de téléphonie, DECT, systèmes de recherche de personnes et dispositifs d'alerte ;
• Supervision, ticketing et outils de diagnostic réseau.

Compétences:

• Expertise des environnements de téléphonie (la connaissance d'Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise OXE et Rainbow constitue un atout) ;
• Bonne maîtrise de la téléphonie IP et du protocole SIP ;
• Solides bases en réseaux TCP/IP, VLAN, DHCP, DNS, routage et QoS ;
• Solides bases systèmes Windows, Linux et virtualisation ;
• Capacité à analyser des traces et captures réseau, notamment à l'aide de Wireshark ;
• Expérience en installation, configuration et dépannage de systèmes complexes ;
• La connaissance des environnements DECT et des solutions de mobilité Rainbow constitue un atout ;
• La connaissance des solutions de notification serveur Mobicall et d'appel malade constitue un atout ;
• Capacité à comprendre les flux d'alerte, de notification, d'acquittement et d'escalade ;
• Aptitude à rédiger des documents techniques clairs et structurés ;
• Sensibilité aux aspects de sécurité, de disponibilité et de continuité de service ;
• La connaissance d'outils de supervision et de gestion des tickets est appréciée.

Langues

• Maîtrise du français requise, à l'écrit comme à l'oral.
• Bon niveau d'anglais requis (documentation et échanges techniques).
• La maîtrise du luxembourgeois est un atout.

Ce que nous proposons

• Un CDI à temps complet.
• Un package attractif.
• Un cycle continu de formation et la possibilité d'évoluer dans l'entreprise.
• Une équipe dynamique et soudée créant un cadre de travail très agréable.
• Une société où l'employé et le client sont au cœur de toutes les attentions.
• Un groupe leader dont le siège au Luxembourg facilite l'adéquation entre organisation, solutions et attente du marché.

A propos de Telkea Group

Fondé en 1929 au Luxembourg, Telkea Group compte actuellement plus de 150 collaborateurs dans de multiples domaines d'activités et actifs dans les secteurs de la finance (agrément PSF), la santé, l'hôtellerie, l'industrie, les services, le secteur public et
les Institutions européennes.

Telkea Group (Telkea ICT, Telkea Security, Telkea Telecom et Telkea Soft) fournit des solutions d'intégration ICT, de services Cloud, de sécurité des bâtiments, d'intégration audiovisuelle et d'opérateur téléphonique au Luxembourg et dans la Grande Région ainsi qu'une large palette de solutions IT et un service d'éditeur d'applications métiers.

Nous accompagnons les administrations, les grandes entreprises et les PME avec la même vision claire : se poser en partenaire fiable, flexible et innovant.

Vous possédez les qualités requises ci-dessus ? Veuillez s'il vous plaît envoyer votre lettre de motivation et votre curriculum vitae (en français ou en anglais) à l'adresse : jobs@telkea.com en indiquant « Candidature au poste d'Expert en Communications Unifiées (H/F) ».

Votre candidature sera traitée en toute confidentialité.

jobs.title: Lower School Teaching Assistant (Gr2 Classrooms) 6-months contract (m/f)
jobs.description:
Lower School Teaching Assistant (Gr2 Classrooms) 6-months contract

We're delighted that you're considering joining our learning community at ISL. As you consider this opportunity, we kindly ask that you apply only if you can join us on the stated start date and will be fully free from any existing contractual or notice-period obligations by that time. We appreciate your understanding.

The role?
At ISL, we believe our young learners are capable, curious and full of ideas. They learn through relationships, play, inquiry and meaningful exploration of the world around them. We are seeking a Lower School Classroom Teaching Assistant to assist our Grade 2 teachers (students ages 7-8) in creating caring, inclusive environments where every student feels a sense of belonging, develops agency and independence, and experiences the joy of learning.

Working in partnership with the classroom teacher and wider Lower School team, the Teaching Assistant is an important resource for students and parents.

What will you do?

Working alongside the Grade 2 classroom teachers, you will:

• help create a caring and inquiry-rich learning environment;
• support individuals and small groups during student-initiated and teacher-directed learning;
• encourage curiosity, communication, collaboration, creativity and problem-solving;
• observe and document students' learning and emerging needs;
• prepare materials and learning spaces that invite exploration;
• support arrival, dismissal, transitions, specialist lessons, lunch, playground and other daily routines;
• help children develop positive relationships, independence and a sense of responsibility; and
• supervise and accompany students during activities, field trips and other experiences beyond the classroom.

What skills do you bring?

We are interested in what you can do, how you work with others and your potential to learn and grow. Your skills may have been developed through education, employment, volunteering, or community activities.

You will be able to demonstrate your ability to:

• Build trusting relationships with young students, helping them feel safe, known and valued.
• Support learning through inquiry, using conversation, thoughtful questions and exploration to extend students' thinking.
• Notice and respond to learners, observing students and collaborating with the teachers to document learning and development.
• Foster agency and independence, knowing when to support, when to question and when to give students space to try for themselves.
• Support multilingual learners and communicate clearly and sensitively with students developing English as an additional language.
• Create inclusive environments that value different languages, cultures, experiences and ways of learning.
• Collaborate effectively with teachers and colleagues and build positive, professional relationships with
• families.
• Support students' wellbeing, relationships, routines, transitions and self-management in developmentally appropriate ways.
• Adapt and take initiative in the dynamic environment of a classroom.
• Reflect and grow, welcoming feedback and taking responsibility for your own professional learning.

Who you are?

You genuinely enjoy being with young students and see them as capable learners. You are patient, curious, dependable and proactive. You understand that learning happens throughout the day—from a student's question to developing independence during routines or navigating a disagreement with a friend. You communicate thoughtfully, value different perspectives and cultures, and know that excellent support sometimes means stepping forward and sometimes stepping back.
Above all, you bring care, curiosity, collaboration and a commitment to helping every student participate, learn and belong.
Our commitment to students
Through this role, you will support ISL's Strategic Plan by helping deliver a Lower School programme that meets high creative and academic standards and enables students to be active, engaged and successful learners.
ISL is committed to safeguarding and prioritising the wellbeing of children and young people and expects you to share this commitment. You will be expected to maintain appropriate professional boundaries, demonstrate sound judgement and follow ISL's child protection, health, safety and security policies and procedures.
We are keen to attract applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly those whose nationality, identity, gender or race is currently under-represented in international education.
Profile: (training, experience, skills and aptitudes necessary to do the job)

Required:

• A minimum of a secondary school diploma or equivalent.
• Fluency in English, with strong spoken and written communication.
• Successful experience working with children, ideally ages 7-8;
• Strong interpersonal, communication and collaboration skills;
• Confidence with digital technology relevant to the role.
• The ability to work positively and responsibly with children and adults.

Valued experience includes:

We value experience working with young students in educational settings, childcare, after-school programmes or other environments where children learn and develop together. Particularly relevant experience includes supporting play- or inquiry-based learning, multilingual learners, children's social-emotional development and
independence, and working collaboratively with colleagues and families in culturally diverse communities. Experience in an IB PYP or another child-centred, inquiry-based setting is an advantage, but is not essential.
We recognise that strong candidates bring different experiences and pathways. We encourage you to apply if you believe your skills, approach and experience equip you to succeed in this role, even if you do not meet every preferred criterion.

Among main responsibilities:

General:

• Assist in creating a caring, positive learning environment as directed by the classroom teacher;
• Promote mutual respect and understanding among all members of the group;
• Establish and maintain positive relationships with students, parents, colleagues and leadership;
• Assist in maintaining expectations of student behaviour in and out of the classroom to create a well-functioning and consistent learning atmosphere in school;
• Comply with School policies and procedures relating to child protection, health, safety, welfare, security, confidentiality and data protection, reporting any concerns to the appropriate person;
• Collaborate with the classroom teacher to gather and document evidence of student learning;
• Maintain familiarity and understanding of the ISL curriculum and assist in its delivery as directed by the classroom teacher and appropriate for level of qualification;
• Support the Lower School culture of thinking;
• Be familiar with all school rules and conscientiously assist in enforcing them;
Within the Classroom:
• Assist with classroom related tasks (including preparation, set-up and clearing up of materials for learning activities and supervision thereof) as directed by the classroom teacher;
• Assist the teacher at the start and end of the day welcoming and dismissing students (including taking attendance and lunch count as well as supervising students during transitions);
• Assist with large group activities and work with smaller groups on teacher-directed tasks;
Outside of the Classroom:
• Supervise and escort students as they go to and from specialist lessons;
• Perform supervisory duties within other areas of the school (cafeteria, playgrounds, etc) as directed;
• Assist a student in the event of sickness or accident;
• Accompany the classroom teacher and students on field trips and other excursions outside school;
Additional:
• When absent, leave information concerning daily tasks for substitute;
• Handle personal problems and grievances in a professional way as outline [...]

jobs.title: Sales Manager – Packaging Equipment and Automated Packaging Solutions
jobs.description:
Your main responsibility will be to identify industrial companies whose production and packaging processes could be automated or made more efficient using our equipment.
Automated packaging lines and packaging equipment.

Work tasks: Alpina Electronics OÜ is expanding its activities in the field of automated packaging equipment and packaging lines and is looking for a Sales Manager for the Estonian and Finnish markets.
Your main responsibility will be to identify industrial companies whose production and packaging processes could be automated or made more efficient using our equipment. Our range of solutions includes: Automated packaging lines and equipment in cooperation with the Polish manufacturer RADPAK. Palletizing equipment, including solutions developed by Alpina Electronics. Thermoforming packaging machines for the food industry, primarily for the Finnish market, supplied by Colimatic. Your Key Responsibilities Identifying potential customers and establishing new business relationships in Estonia and Finland. Visiting customers to understand their production processes and packaging requirements. Presenting suitable packaging equipment and automated packaging solutions. Working closely with equipment manufacturers and technical specialists. Managing sales projects from initial customer contact through to order confirmation. Every manufacturing company and project is different. Your role will be to understand each customer's specific needs and work together with our team and the manufacturers' technical specialists to develop the most suitable solution.

We offer: We offer an opportunity to play an active role in establishing a new sales division and developing the market for automated packaging equipment and packaging lines in Estonia and Finland.
We offer: A competitive base salary combined with performance-based bonuses. An independent and responsible position with a high degree of autonomy. Flexible working arrangements, including the opportunity to work from home. A company car, computer, mobile phone, and all other necessary work equipment. Comprehensive technical support from equipment manufacturers and our own specialists. Manufacturer-provided training and opportunities to attend international trade fairs. The opportunity to contribute to the development of a new business area and influence the range of solutions we offer. The position involves regular customer visits throughout Estonia and Finland. Administrative and office-based tasks can be carried out from a home office. We prefer a full-time employee but are also open to part-time arrangements for the right candidate.

Other requirements: This position is ideal for someone who values independence, enjoys planning their own work, and wants to see a direct connection between their efforts and achievements.

Option to work from home: Yes

Working load, shifts: 0,5

jobs.description:
Work tasks: - Prepare a variety of dishes and baked goods according to established recipes and quality standards.
- Handle and prepare fresh ingredients, including meat, vegetables, and dough. - Ensure that all baked products meet established standards for quality, taste, and presentation. - Follow precise measurements and preparation techniques to maintain consistent product quality. - Monitor the baking process to achieve optimal results. - Maintain a clean, organized, and compliant kitchen environment while operating modern kitchen equipment efficiently. - Monitor inventory levels, assist with ordering supplies, ensure proper storage and labeling of ingredients, and minimize waste. - Ensure compliance with food safety and sanitation standards by conducting regular inspections of kitchen equipment, workspaces, and storage areas. - Effectively prioritize and manage multiple tasks, particularly during peak operating hours. - Adhere to work schedules and deadlines, ensuring that all products are prepared on time. - Collaborate with team members to ensure smooth kitchen operations and maintain a positive working environment. - Communicate and collaborate effectively with service staff, cleaners, management, suppliers, contractors, and other service providers to ensure the smooth operation of the kitchen and restaurant. - Monitor customer service quality and assist service staff when necessary, particularly during peak hours, employee breaks, staff shortages, or employee absences.

jobs.title: Breakfast Cook
jobs.description:
Work tasks: Kolm Õde boutique hotel (Pikk 71, Tallinn Old Town) is looking for a breakfast chef to join our team. Our breakfast is a buffet focused on Estonian produce and bread and pastries baked on site, and it is open to guests of the hotel and our apartments as well as to outside visitors.
Your main duties: - preparing hot and cold breakfast dishes (egg dishes, porridges, hot sides, salads, cold cuts, smoked fish, etc.); - baking bread, buns and morning pastries on site; - setting up the buffet before opening and keeping it replenished during breakfast; - taking care of the taste, freshness and attractive presentation of the food; - preparing for the next day (doughs, prep work, etc.); - monitoring stock, preparing orders and receiving deliveries; - following food hygiene and self-monitoring (HACCP) requirements, checking temperatures and shelf life; - keeping the kitchen, equipment and tools clean and in order; - working closely with the breakfast server and reception, and helping develop the menu. You are responsible for making sure every morning starts with a tasty, fresh and beautifully presented breakfast for our guests.

jobs.title: Technical Customer Support
jobs.description:
QuickMail is a cold email and LinkedIn outreach platform for markets you can't afford to burn. Our customers can't easily replace leads that land in spam, which is why deliverability matters more to us than anything else. We have been running since 2014, and we pioneered deliverability technology such as Inbox rotationâ¢ and deliverability AIâ¢.

The Role

We are hiring a technical customer support person with an owner's mentality.

You will own support for QuickMail and Mailflow, our deliverability add-on. There is no first or second line. You are the first and last person our customers talk to.

Customers count on you to solve their problems and find the real cause when something breaks. You work closely with engineering, and you tell the founder what we need to know to make the product better: where the friction is and where the opportunities are.

The role covers the help desk, system health checks, testing new releases before they ship, and leading the weekly team meeting. It takes excellent communication, solid technical understanding and sharp critical thinking.

This is not a script-reading job. Most tickets involve deliverability, DNS records, LinkedIn automation or campaign setup. You dig into customer accounts in our Support Dashboard, reproduce the issue, then decide what to do and how to explain it to the customer.

We are a remote team spread across time zones. Most routine tasks have a written guide with a checklist, so you know what done looks like. You are expected to refine and improve those processes. When something new comes up, you work out the most efficient way to handle it.

If you want a lot of autonomy across many areas, real responsibility and a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.

What Work Looks Like

You own two things: customers get unstuck fast, and the product stays reliable.

Every day

  • Set the day's support priorities and work the Help Scout queue for QuickMail and Mailflow. Triage, resolve, and dig deeper when a ticket needs it.
  • Check the support dashboard: job queue, event-stream latency, blacklist status, newly purchased domains. If something is off, investigate, diagnose, and drive it to resolution.
  • Review fraud alerts and disable accounts that are scams or abusing the platform.

Delighting customers

  • Comfortable jumping on calls with customers, building rapport fast, and setting them up for success.
  • Update the changelog and help articles based on what shipped and what customers asked.
  • Share customer feedback with the team, ask happy customers for reviews and case studies, and watch NPS for testimonial candidates.

Making support smarter with AI

  • Improve the AI support agent. Review its answers, fix the docs it drew from when it is wrong, and contact the customer when its reply was off.
  • Write and maintain automated tests, built with AI, that try to break staging before customers do.
  • Use the MCP connections we have in place (Helpscout, GitHub, Postmark, and others) to get an accurate picture of support and find the next thing worth improving.

Keeping the product solid

  • Gatekeep releases. New fixes and features land on staging every week. Test them, confirm when staging is ready to ship, and think through how existing and new users will be affected.
  • Report bugs as GitHub issues with everything the developer needs: steps to reproduce, screenshots or a Loom, and any GraphQL or console errors.
  • Captain red alerts. When a core feature breaks (emails not sending, login down), confirm it, alert the team on Slack or Telegram, update the status page every 30 minutes, keep affected customers informed, and drive the fix. Then run the retrospective so it does not happen twice.

Running the week

  • Lead the weekly team meeting in MonsterOps: issues written up, to-dos done, numbers updated.
  • Keep rock status and KPIs current in MonsterOps.

Tools you'll use: Helpscout, our Support Dashboard, Sidekiq, GitHub, Slack, Telegram, MonsterOps, Outline, MxToolbox, Postmark, Bento, TidyCal, Fathom, Visual Code and Claude.

Who You Are

  • You build rapport fast. You are warm, positive, and relatable in writing and on calls.
  • You are a good communicator. Externally, you can show warmth, empathy and care. Internally, you are able to communicate clearly and concisely about important things.
  • You can operate with minimal instructions. You understand a short brief without every detail spelled out. You can prioritize well (especially when you have a lot on your plate), and get things done without hand-holding.
  • You are comfortable on video. You are natural on live calls with Zoom and Meet, and on recorded video through tools like Loom.
  • Your teammates can always count on you. You say what you'll do and you do what you said.
  • You act with a constant sense of urgency. You can execute fast and find new ways to improve your productivity.
  • You are resourceful. You use all the tools at your disposal to get great results.
  • You have a low ego. You don't take offense easily and you handle disagreement as a discussion, not a personal attack.
  • Growth mindset. You are positive about new workflow/process/product/tool changes. You love giving and receiving positive and negative feedback without getting defensive.
  • Hours that overlap with East coast US and UK, where most of our customers are.

A Plus If You Have

  • Experience with customer facing work, or if you don't have it, tell us why you are perfect for this role.
  • Working knowledge of deliverability and LinkedIn outreach. Warmup, DNS, inbox rotation, DKIM, SPF, Outlook and Gmail technical setup. We can teach this, but a head start helps.
  • Comfort with agency setups. Workspaces, guest seats, inbox purchases and what happens when an agency loses a client.
  • Light data skills. You can pull numbers from Help Scout or our MCP to back up what you report.
  • An eye for happy customers. You notice them and ask for testimonials and case studies at the right moment.

How We Work Together

You'll work directly with the founder and with our lead developer.

Working with the founder can be intense. Here is what that looks like in practice:

  • Replies are short and can come across as harsh. If something written lands badly or isn't clear, ask.
  • Direction can change. The founder may say one thing, then something different a few days later as they learn more. When that happens, check what changed and adapt.
  • Information should be short and to the point. Lead with what matters, then give more details if asked.
  • The founder can stay frustrated about a problem until it's solved. That's something they are aware of and working on. You'll do well here if you can stay calm and focused when the pressure is on.
  • The team often thinks fast and interrupts each other when discussing ideas. If that would bother you, this role probably isn't for you.

This role suits someone with high emotional intelligence, who doesn't take things personally, asks when something is unclear, and keeps many things moving at once.

Your schedule can be flexible. If you have a martial arts class every Thursday at 3 pm, go and make up the time later. In return, on the rare occasion the team needs your help on a weekend, we ask you to be flexible too.

Benefits

  • Contract type: full-time or part-time
  • Compensation: $2,500 to $4,000 USD per month, depending on experience and location. US-based hires will work as independent contractors (1099).
  • Start date: negotiable

jobs.title: Senior Security Consultant – Incident Response
jobs.description:
Do you want to be on the frontline when serious cyber incidents hit? You will lead complex investigations, guide customers through crises, and help shape our incident response services. You will join a highly skilled, collaborative team working with some of the most interesting and challenging cyber cases in the market. 

 

Make a real impact in high‑stakes incidents 

You will be part of a small, expert Incident Response team handling everything from ransomware to targeted attacks across large, complex environments. You will work closely with customers, helping them stay calm, informed and in control during critical situations. You will collaborate with specialists across MDR, Intelligence and Consulting, learn from unique cases, and contribute to the development of tools, methodologies and publications. At CSIS, we invest in your growth with dedicated training time, certifications, and peer learning - in an open, diverse and friendly culture built on “We commit, We care, We succeed together.” 

When you join CSIS, you will get an interesting job in a company and an industry which is growing. You will get interesting challenges, that truly make a difference for our customers, and you will be able to take ownership for your work from start to finish. And you will not least get 130+ fantastic colleagues from all over the world. Besides that, you will get: 

  • Flexible work from home arrangements 

  • A competitive salary and personal benefit package 

  • 5 weeks holiday, plus 5 extra days off each year 

  • Health Insurance, a pension, plus life and disability insurance 

  • Healthy, varied lunches (incl. vegetarian and allergy options) 

  • Home-baked goods, healthy snacks, coffee, tea and sodas in the office

  • Social activities and company events throughout the year

  • Paid mobile phone subscription and home internet 

 

Your new job 

In this client-facing role, you will lead major incident response engagements, support multiple customers, guide junior responders, and help clients strengthen their detection and response capabilities. You will work across diverse environments, industries, and technologies, making adaptability and strong communication essential.  

Your responsibilities will be: 

  • Incident Response & Investigations (Client-Facing) 

  • Lead complex and high-severity incident response engagements for customers across varied infrastructures (on-prem, cloud, hybrid). 

  • Perform advanced forensic analysis across a variety of data sources (disk, memory, network, malware, cloud) and provide clients with clear, actionable findings. 

  • Coordinate response activities with client technical teams, management, and legal/compliance contacts. 

  • Develop accurate incident timelines, attribution assessments (where possible), and root-cause analyses. 

  • Customer Communication & Advisory 

  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients during and after incidents, providing guidance on containment, recovery, and long-term improvements. 

  • Deliver polished, professional technical reports and executive summaries for clients. 

  • Present findings to technical teams as well as to senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders. 

  • Preparedness, Consulting & Continuous Improvement 

  • Assist clients with incident readiness assessments, IR playbook creation, tabletop exercises, and contribute to CSIS’s MDR detection engineering. 

  • Contribute to development of internal incident response methodologies, tooling, and best practices. 

  • Mentor and guide junior team members during engagements and internal training. 

 

About you 

You are an experienced incident responder who remains calm and structured under pressure. You enjoy working closely with customers, translating complex technical issues into clear business language, and you value collaboration and knowledge sharing. You are curious, proactive and driven by making a real difference in the fight against cybercrime. 

You bring most of the following: 

Qualifications & Technical Expertise 

  • Hands-on incident response experience, ideally in a consultancy, MSSP, DFIR, or CSIRT environment. 

  • Proven track record leading multi-client or multi-environment incident investigations. 

  • Deep knowledge of Windows, Linux, and Active Directory security.  

  • Strong knowledge of network protocols and security 

  • Strong experience with SIEM and EDR tools, including detection logic, log correlation, and threat analysis. Hands-on experience with Sentinel/Defender and CrowdStrike a plus. 

  • Advanced digital forensics experience (memory, disk, log, network). 

  • Familiarity with evidence handling, chain-of-custody standards, and forensic reporting. 

  • Strong understanding of attack techniques and threat actor behaviours (MITRE ATT&CK). 

  • Experience in cloud investigations (Azure/AWS/GCP logs, identity, telemetry). 

 

Consultancy-Specific Requirements 

  • Ability to manage multiple parallel client engagements and prioritize effectively. 

  • Excellent client-facing communication: confident, calm, and credible during crises. 

  • Strong written documentation skills for both highly technical and non-technical readers. 

  • Ability to scope engagements, set expectations, and represent the company professionally. 

 

Regulatory & Governance Knowledge 

  • Familiarity with European cybersecurity requirements, especially NIS2, GDPR breach handling, and relevant ISO standards. 

  • Ability to advise clients on improving governance, detection maturity, and incident readiness. 

 

Preferred Skills 

  • Danish speaker – English only can be accomodated. 

  • Threat hunting experience or development of hunting hypotheses. 

  • Scripting/automation (Python, PowerShell, Bash). 

  • Experience in red team/purple team activities or adversary emulation. 

  • Experience providing IR training or running tabletop exercises. 

 

Relevant Certifications  

  • GIAC: GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, GCFE, GPEN, GNFA. 

  • OSCP, CISSP, CISM, or cloud security certs (Azure/AWS/GCP). 

  • Equivalent real-world experience also highly considered and appriciated. 

 

Personal Competencies 

  • Professional, customer-oriented communication style. 

  • Ability to remain composed and decisive under pressure. 

  • Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail. 

  • Leadership qualities and ability to mentor junior responders. 

  • Curiosity and passion for threat research, attacker behaviour, and continuous learning. 

 

This is a 24/7/365 function — flexibility, out-of-hours work, on-call coverage and occasional travel is required. 

 

Other conditions 

  • Security Clearance: As you may work with some of our public sector customers, a Security Clearance may be required. 

  • Relocation: The position is based out of our offices in Denmark, with some flexibility of remote working. Relocation can also be offered to Denmark if relevant

jobs.title: Postdoc in environmental medicine
jobs.description:
The translational pharmacology research group at Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacy and Environmental Medicine (CPPEM), Department of Public Health, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark, invites applications for a fully funded 18 months postdoctoral position. The position is to be filled from January 1st, 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.


About the Research Environment

The research areas of CPPEM span from pharmacoepidemiology to clinical studies, and cell-based basic pharmacology and environmental medicine. Collectively, CPPEM has a strong background in exposure to environmental chemicals, pharmacoepidemiology, pharmacogenetics, pharmacokinetics, drug-drug interactions, and therapeutic drug monitoring. Specifically, the translational pharmacology group aims to understand variability in drug toxicity, drug metabolism and drug transport. Examples of this include cell-based models such as induced-pluripotent stem cells, primary human hepatocytes, and clinical studies. The pharmacoepidemiological research group utilizes the world-class Danish registries as well as international data sources to assess pharmacological questions in large populations. The environmental medicine group studies the impact of early life exposures to environmental chemicals. In particular PFAS is a focus area, with studies of the adverse health effects of exposure, biomonitoring and advising national and international authorities. The analytical chemistry laboratory analyzes concentrations of drugs or environmental chemicals in various matrices. 

In the Environmental Medicine group we are looking for a post doc funded by Novo Nordic Foundation and ERC advanced grant. The projects focus on the Odense Child Cohort and study the impact of early life exposures to environmental chemicals. Especially PFAS and their adverse effects on maternal and child health (e.g. the brain, immune, metabolic and reproductive system). In addition, we aim to identify toxicity of short PFAS including trifluoroacetic acid, widely used but considered less toxic due to their short half-life. 

We are seeking a candidate with a PhD in medicine, pharmacology, public health, or a related discipline. Work within environmental medicine is an advance, and epidemiological and statistical skills are essential. Motivation, curiosity, and a strong drive to excel in environmental research are very important. Excellent communication skills in written and spoken English is a requirement. The position includes independent scientific writing, clinical project leading, and supervision of students. You should be interested in contributing both to the scientific armamentarium in our department and to our collegial culture. It is also expected that the post doc contributes to additional fundraising for the projects as well as research collaborations and the continuation of the Odense Child Cohort, and takes on teaching responsibilities within the department. You will, in your daily work, refer to Professor Tina Kold Jensen, but also engage in a very active collaboration with the full research group.


Your qualifications

  • PhD in medicine, pharmacology, public health, or a related discipline.

  • Experience within environmental medicine is considered an advantage

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

  • Ability to work independently with scientific writing and publication

  • Interest in and experience with supervision of students

  • Commitment to contributing to both scientific excellence and a positive collegial culture within the department

  • Interest in establishing and maintaining national and international research collaboration
     

Further information

Interviews can be performed online if needed. If you will need to relocate to Denmark for the position, both the University and the research group will provide ample support.

Additional information about the position can be obtained from Tina Kold Jensen (tkjensen@health.sdu.dk; 0045 29464350).


Salary and terms of employment

The successful applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).


Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now".

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivational letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (including documentation of Master’s and PhD degree) 

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • Up to 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. 

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a description of research experience

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk 

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered. 


Application deadline

November 4, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET).


Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.


Living and working in Denmark 

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment.  

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark.  

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background. 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding society and encourages all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of personal background.
 

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark is a world-class university driven by an ambition to promote research results that develop society. The major challenges of the 21st century are complex and multifaceted; sustainable change and solutions require new – often interdisciplinary – research-based knowledge, and the University of Southern Denmark is an indispensable stakeholder in the transition process. 

Value, quality, talented people and outstanding environments are pivotal for the University of Southern Denmark’s strategic initiatives. 

Read more: https://www.sdu.dk/en/om_sdu

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding society and encourages all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: PhD Position in Data-driven Critical Raw Material Supply Chain Resilience
jobs.description:
Do you want to investigate the resilience of critical raw material supply chains supporting low-carbon and digital technologies? Join us as a PhD student at SDU Life Cycle Engineering, University of Southern Denmark.

The Department of Green Technology at the University of Southern Denmark invites applications for a three-year PhD position in data-driven critical raw material supply chain resilience.

The position will be based at SDU Life Cycle Engineering, Department of Green Technology, Faculty of Engineering, at the SDU Odense campus. The expected starting date is 15 February 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

 

Project Overview

The deployment of low-carbon technologies, electrification and digital infrastructure is increasing global demand for critical raw materials. At the same time, the production and processing of many of these materials are geographically concentrated and exposed to geopolitical, economic, environmental and logistical disruptions.

Understanding how technology development affects material demand, in-use stocks, end-of-life flows and global supply dependencies is therefore important for assessing and strengthening the resilience of critical raw material supply chains.

The PhD position is jointly funded through research projects on critical raw material supply chains and material requirements for Denmark’s climate-neutral transition. The project will be embedded in an interdisciplinary research environment combining environmental systems analysis, supply-chain research and data science.

 

PhD Topic Description

The PhD project will develop modular and data-driven approaches for analysing critical raw material demand, supply-chain dependencies and resilience.

A central methodological contribution will be the development of transparent, reusable and reproducible computational modules for dynamic material flow analysis. The modules will support the integration of technology deployment scenarios, material intensities, product lifetimes, stocks and flows, end-of-life management, recycling, production, trade, facility and ownership data.

The developed approaches will be applied to selected technology systems, including Denmark’s wind-energy infrastructure and the rapidly expanding infrastructure supporting data centres and AI computing. These cases will be analysed within a common methodological framework to examine how infrastructure expansion and technological change influence demand for critical and scarce materials, in-use stocks, future waste flows, recycling potential and global supply-chain dependencies.

The project may also investigate overlapping material requirements and competition for materials across low-carbon and digital technologies. Particular attention may be given to supply concentration, host–by-product dependencies, trade and ownership structures, supply bottlenecks, cascading risks and potential resilience strategies.

Depending on the candidate’s academic background and the specific research questions, the project may include network analysis, geospatial analysis, scenario modelling, uncertainty analysis, machine learning and other AI-supported approaches.

The candidate will build on selected existing models, datasets and research activities in the group and further develop scientifically robust and reusable methods that improve transparency, comparability and reproducibility in material-system research.

The exact research focus and detailed PhD plan will be developed jointly with the successful candidate, taking into account the project objectives, academic background and research interests.

In addition to a PhD dissertation and high-quality scientific publications, the project is expected to produce reusable modelling methods, documented datasets and reproducible computational workflows.

 

PhD Position and Research Environment

As a PhD student, you will conduct independent research under the supervision of an interdisciplinary team, contribute to high-quality scientific publications and participate actively in a collaborative research environment.

You will join SDU Life Cycle Engineering, where research covers industrial ecology, material flow analysis, life cycle assessment, circular economy, resource systems and sustainability transitions.

The project connects expertise in engineering, data science, mathematics, business, supply-chain research and geological resources. The wider research environment includes competences in material flow analysis, critical raw material systems, data mining, network analysis, supply-chain science, finance, investment, ownership structures, geological resources and technology systems.

The position provides opportunities for collaboration across SDU faculties and with external research partners. It may also include participation in international conferences, research visits and collaboration with relevant industrial and public-sector stakeholders.

The PhD programme follows the Danish PhD framework and includes coursework, participation in active research environments, dissemination activities, and teaching or other knowledge-dissemination duties.

 

What We Expect

We are looking for a highly motivated, independent and collaborative candidate with a strong interest in critical raw materials, quantitative modelling, data-driven research and sustainability.

Applicants must hold a relevant master’s degree or equivalent by the time of enrolment. Relevant academic backgrounds may include engineering, industrial ecology, sustainability science, resource management, data science, computer science, applied mathematics, operations research, supply-chain management, geoinformatics, mining or geological sciences, or another relevant natural science or quantitative discipline.

The successful candidate should demonstrate:

  • A solid academic foundation in quantitative analysis, system modelling, data science or related methods. 

  • Experience with programming and data analysis, preferably using Python or a similar programming language. 

  • Experience with data handling, including data cleaning, transformation, integration and exploratory analysis. 

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 

  • The ability to work independently and collaboratively in an interdisciplinary research environment. 

  • Good written and spoken English. 

  • A strong interest in sustainability, critical raw materials and supply-chain resilience. 

Experience in one or more of the following areas will be considered an advantage:

  • Material flow analysis, industrial ecology or material systems modelling. 

  • Network, supply-chain or geospatial analysis. 

  • Scientific computing and reproducible research workflows. 

  • Statistics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, optimisation, uncertainty or scenario analysis. 

  • International trade, production facility or corporate ownership data. 

  • Critical raw materials, wind energy, digital infrastructure or data centres. 

Applicants are not expected to possess expertise in all these areas. Prior experience with material flow analysis is an advantage but is not a requirement. Relevant training will be provided according to the candidate’s background and the needs of the project.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

The application must be submitted in English through the SDU online recruitment system.

Assessment of applicants will be based on the submitted application material. The application must include:

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • A motivated application describing the applicant’s research interests, relevant qualifications and motivation for applying. 

  • Documentation of academic qualifications, including bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates and complete transcripts of grades. 

  • Official English translations of documents not issued in English or Danish. 

  • Two letters of recommendation. 

  • A list of publications and up to two examples of relevant publications, if available. 

  • The completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • The completed TEK form for calculation of grade-point average. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Official documentation describing the grading system of the awarding university, if the degree was not obtained in Denmark. 

  • Examples of relevant thesis work, software, code repositories or other research outputs, where available. 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

For administrative questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact our email support.

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step. The place of employment is in Odense, Denmark and preferred starting date is February 15, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

 

SDU Life Cycle Engineering

The successful candidate will be affiliated with SDU Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology. The research environment conducts interdisciplinary research on the global and systemic interactions between materials, technologies, energy, the environment and society.

The Department of Green Technology is located in Odense, the main campus of the University of Southern Denmark. Odense offers an international research environment and an open Scandinavian working culture.

 

Further Information

Further information about the scientific content of the position is available from:

Wu Chen
Associate Professor
Department of Green Technology
SDU Life Cycle Engineering
University of Southern Denmark
Email: wuc@igt.sdu.dk

For administrative questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact our email support.

jobs.title: Remote Office Assistant
jobs.description:
Coalition Technologies is seeking a reliable, detail-oriented, and highly organized Remote Office Assistant to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, data entry, and internal operations tasks. This role is ideal for someone with strong communication skills, discretion, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and grow within a fast-paced remote work environment.

As an Office Assistant, you will help support daily administrative operations, assist with entry-level bookkeeping, organize client documents, support internal reporting, and help maintain accurate company records. This position offers strong growth potential for the right candidate, including opportunities for advancement within the Accounting team or other departments.

We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong skills test performance may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement.

 

Why Join Coalition Technologies?

Coalition Technologies is committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients while providing our team with a fun, thriving, innovative, and growth-focused work environment. We offer:

  • 100% remote work with a company that has supported remote team members for more than a decade
  • Competitive profit-sharing bonus plan, with up to 50% of company profits paid to full-time employees each month
  • Competitive Paid Time Off plan that supports work-life balance
  • Subsidized gym memberships
  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance packages for eligible US-based team members
  • International Health Insurance Reimbursement Program for eligible international team members
  • Device upgrade and learning reimbursement programs
  • Career development plans with clearly defined goals and rewards
  • Additional job-specific incentives and bonuses

 

Office Assistant Responsibilities

As an Office Assistant, your duties will include:

  • Answering phones and emails
  • Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records
  • Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members
  • Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members
  • Supporting quality assurance checks for internal and client-facing reports
  • Organizing new client contracts, creating invoices, and processing client payments
  • Contributing to internal database maintenance, upkeep, and data entry
  • Researching, ordering, and distributing company-wide gifts two to three times per year
  • Organizing company events, competitions, and special projects throughout the year
  • Facilitating company holiday calendars, time-off calendars, and schedule variation calendars

 

Required Skills and Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Willingness to learn, grow, and collaborate with the team and company as a whole
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, and data entry tasks
  • Innovative thinking and willingness to challenge existing methods when improvement is possible
  • Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time
  • Reliable remote workspace with a fast computer, quality internet, camera, microphone, and speakers

 

Preferred Skills

  • The following experience is preferred but not required:
  • Intermediate spreadsheet skills
  • Experience with bookkeeping or financial record keeping
  • Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Google Workspace
  • Experience supporting billing, invoicing, reporting, data entry, or administrative operations

 

Remote Work Environment

Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. Our team works remotely with the support of time tracking software, structured communication, and a company culture designed to help remote team members succeed. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world.

 

Growth Opportunity

This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. Successful Office Assistants at Coalition Technologies have advanced quickly and earned promotions within the Accounting team and across other departments.

 

Compensation

For candidates located in California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, the starting base pay for this position ranges from $15 to $25 per hour. Compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills test performance, geographic location, and seniority of the position offered. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.

jobs.description:

Welcome to Miaplaza!

Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive homeschool curriculum platform where all students can be successful!

MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio is our newest offering for Ohio families looking for a flexible public school option. The school will serve grades 7-11 in its first year. The school aims to serve 250 students year one, with plans to grow to over 1,000 students by 2030. ð

Role Summary

The Academic Dean leads the instructional team and is the school's authority on academic standards at MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio (MOAO), including student conduct, attendance compliance, and academic integrity. This person is the primary leader for teacher supervision and development, oversees academic data and testing coordination, and works closely with the Student Support team (counselors and advisors), who lead student interventions and support. As a member of the MOAO leadership team, the Academic Dean contributes to schoolwide strategy and helps keep instruction, student culture, and compliance with Ohio requirements working together. The role calls for someone who can coach teachers with warmth and rigor, handle sensitive student and family situations with sound judgment, and use data to make decisions.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Instructional Staff Management

  • Directly supervise instructional staff, holding weekly 1:1s focused on coaching, support, and goal setting.

  • Lead recruiting, onboarding, and training for new teachers.

  • Observe live instruction and office hours on a bi-weekly basis and provide actionable feedback.

  • Monitor grading practices to ensure students receive timely, high-quality feedback.

  • Complete annual and semi-annual walk-throughs and performance reviews as outlined by the ODEW and manage bi-weekly timecard approvals.

  • Coordinate instructional and grading coverage for teacher absences.

  • Address performance concerns through clear expectations, documentation, and, when needed, formal improvement plans in partnership with People Operations.

Student Conduct, Attendance & Academic Integrity

  • Own the school's student conduct process, from initial report through investigation, determination, and documentation, applying policy consistently and fairly and creating policy where needed.

  • Oversee academic integrity cases, including investigating suspected plagiarism, AI misuse, and other violations, and ensuring consistent, well-documented outcomes.

  • Own the school's truancy and attendance compliance process, including required notifications, documentation, and filings under Ohio law.

  • Partner with the Student Support team, which leads outreach, intervention plans, and ongoing student support. Hand off cases and coordinate so that accountability and support work together.

  • Serve as the escalation point for teachers and Student Support on conduct, attendance, and integrity concerns.

  • Communicate with students and families about conduct and integrity decisions in a way that is clear, respectful, and focused on getting students back on track.

  • Maintain accurate records and report on trends in conduct, attendance, and integrity cases to school leadership.Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â 

  • Keep handbooks, policies, and procedures current in these areas.

Academic Data & Testing Coordination

  • Analyze course-, teacher-, and school-level data on performance, engagement, and attendance to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.

  • Turn data into action by recommending and implementing instructional strategies, and share insights with Student Support to inform their interventions.

  • Serve as the school's testing coordinator for Ohio state assessments and other required or school-administered testing, including scheduling, proctoring logistics, test security, accommodations coordination, and make-up testing.

  • Partner with the appropriate teams on state data reporting, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.

  • Prepare clear summaries of academic and testing data for leadership, teachers, and families.

Professional Development

  • Design and lead regular PD sessions for instructional staff, informed by teacher feedback, observation, and student data.

  • Build a culture of continuous improvement, reflective practice, and growth for the instructional team.

  • Collaborate with school and company leadership on schoolwide professional learning priorities.

Curriculum & Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Serve as the primary point of contact between the instructional team and the Content team on curriculum, checkpoint assignments, and MiaPrep platform issues.

  • Gather teacher and student feedback and make curriculum recommendations.

  • Support consistency in instructional practice and expectations across courses and departments.

  • Lead regular instructional team meetings to align resources, expectations, and practices.

  • Assist teachers in comparing their curriculum to the OST blueprints to identify gaps, and create a plan to fill these gaps in the short and long term.Â 

What We're Looking For

jobs.title: Product Engineering Lead
jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, weâre not just building products, weâre pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businessesâfrom exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMsâto seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the worldâs most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But thatâs just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If youâre passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. Weâve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices. It gives people real control over their data and how they use AI. No cloud dependency, no data harvesting, and no one else's servers between you and your assistant. Our focus is local, on-device, privacy-preserving AI, connected across Tether's peer-to-peer ecosystem. We're building the AI assistant people actually own. Product sets the direction.

We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up on real devices with real constraints. You lead the teams that build QV.AC's features and app experience on top of our local AI stack, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar.

The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product. You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for AI systems and their limits, so you can turn emerging capabilities into features that work reliably on-device, without needing to build the models yourself.

Responsibilities

  • Engineering - Run the app and feature teams day to day: unblocking, reviewing, and keeping them shipping.- Set and hold a high engineering bar for performance, reliability, and clean APIs.- Own the technical design of features and the API surface between our AI core and the app.- Make sure your teams work closely with our AI research and deep tech teams on code reviews, design, and anything that touches models or inference.

  • Product Partnership - Work alongside QV.AC's product managers to turn vision and roadmap into scoped, buildable work.- Push back when scope and reality don't match, and propose better paths when they exist.- Bring an engineering perspective to product decisions, especially on what local models can do well today and what they can't yet.- Help the team move fast, using AI tools and quick prototypes to validate ideas before committing to them.

  • Leadership - Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.- Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.- Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it.



Mandatory:

  • Experience managing engineers or engineering leads who ship consumer product, ideally AI-powered apps.

  • Strong product sense: you can tell a good feature from a busy one.

  • Intuition for applied AI and on-device constraints: model size, latency, memory, battery, and the gap between a good demo and a reliable feature. You don't need ML research expertise, because our core abstracts it away.

  • You use AI tools heavily in your own work and enjoy experimenting with new models and capabilities.

  • Deep JavaScript and React.

  • Initiative, curiosity, resilience, and the ability to give and receive direct critique.

Preferred:

  • Bonus: Experience with local or on-device inference, LLM evals, cross-platform mobile and desktop apps, or open source.

  • Double-check email addresses.Â All communication from us will come from emails ending inÂ @tether.to orÂ @tether.io

jobs.title: Projektstilling i projekt med at være kirke for unge i Aarhus
jobs.description:
Kan du se dig selv i en vision om at folkekirken tilbyder et sted for unge i Aarhus, hvor man kan hænge ud og indgå i fællesskaber? Er du relationelt orienteret? Og har du det fint med både at sidde til planlægningsmøder og løfte konkrete, praktiske opgaver – så tror vi, at du vil finde dette opslag interessant.

For godt et års tid siden åbnede Christianskirken i Aarhus STEDET. Her kan unge i Aarhus hænge ud, sidde med deres studier, deltage i aktiviteter, møde andre unge til fællesspisning og få et møde med kirken i øjenhøjde. Er du den, som skal være med til at videreudvikle og konsolidere dét arbejde?

 

STEDET er fysisk lokation på Katrinebjerg, men det er også en måde at vise at kirken er mere end gudstjenester; at kirken er fællesskaber, samtaler om stort og småt, mulighed for at møde andre unge og et pitstop i den hverdag, som unge lever i.

 

Der er tale om en etårig projektstilling på 30 timer ugentligt, med eventuel mulighed for forlængelse, hvis den fremtidige finansiering falder på plads.

Opgaver

Som projektmedarbejder ved Christianskirken, skal du overordnet set være med til at udleve kirkens vision:

Christianskirken - et livstræ med mange grene, der

·        Rækker synligt ud i sognet

·        Peger opad og inspirerer til at søge Gud

·        Styrker og engagerer den enkelte og menigheden

 

    - for at gøre evangeliet kendt, troet og levet.

 

Konkret betyder det, at…

·        du – i samarbejde med bl.a. menighedsrådet, projektets styregruppe og den anden projektmedarbejder – sikrer den daglige drift på STEDET, og i mange sammenhænge er du STEDETs ansigt udadtil.

·        du er vært på STEDET, så de unge der kommer ind ad døren, mærker at de er velkomne her.

·        du ærligt kan sige, at du har lyst til at arbejde sammen med unge, er imødekommende og kan tage initiativ til fx en snak eller igangsætte brætspil.

·        du indgår i et samarbejde med ansatte og frivillige om at planlægge og afvikle forskellige typer af aktiviteter. Fx fællesspisning hvor du veksler mellem at stå i front og ”være den” og stå i baggrunden og få andre til at lykkes i deres frivillige opgave.

·        du sidder med i styregruppen (som består af repræsentanter for menighedsråd, ungdomsråd og ansatte ved Christianskirken) for STEDET, og er med til at sætte retning for projektet, og i mange tilfælde er du ansvarlig for at det som besluttes dér, bliver til virkelighed.

·        du vil være ansvarlig for rekruttering, fastholdelse og udrustning af frivillige. For STEDET er ikke noget, som laves for de unge, men noget vi laver sammen med unge.

·        du får til opgave at pleje og videreudvikle vores netværk med samarbejdspartnere og interessenter i Aarhus. Det er fx uddannelsesinstitutioner, NGO’er som arbejder med unge, naboer på Katrinebjerg, nøglepersoner i Aarhus kommune og kirker i Aarhus.

·        du løser forskellige administrative og koordinerende opgaver såsom at have overblik over vores forbrug og sørge for at betalinger sker rettidigt; booking af lokaler; forberedelse af møder, at vores tillidsbod har varer på hylderne m.v.

 

I det daglige er din nærmeste kollega vores projektmedarbejder, som har fokus på kommunikation og aktiviteter og den præst, som er tilknyttet STEDET og er projektleder. I har hver jeres ansvarsområder, men arbejder sammen om meget af det som sker på STEDET.

 

Vi forventer at du…

·        har en konstruktiv tilgang til tingene og kan samarbejde med både professionelle og amatører.

·        har erfaring fra selv at have frivilligt engageret, og gerne at du har erfaring med engagere, motivere og samarbejde andre frivillige på en måde, så de føler sig påskønnede og som en aktiv del af STEDETS liv og aktiviteter.

·       er nysgerrig på nye mennesker og har det godt med at samle mennesker.

·        kan se idéen i at vi som kirke laver dette tilbud til unge i vores by.

·        er i stand til at omsætte strategiske beslutninger til konkrete handlinger.

·        har syn for både helheden og detaljen, og trives med at arbejde både på et overordnet og et praktisk plan. Nogle dage vil du derfor sidde og udvikle en idé, og andre dage svinger du støvsugeren, så der er klar til næste event.

·        kan lide at arbejde i team med andre, samtidig med at du er god til at arbejde selvstændigt, systematisk og struktureret med dine opgaver.

·        har en faglig eller erfaringsmæssig baggrund, som er relevant for dette job.

·        er fleksibel ift arbejdstid. Der er primært tale om arbejde i dagtimerne, men der er også aftenarbejde i skiftende omfang.

·        kan identificere dig med Christianskirkens samspilsværdier - åbenhed, respekt, omsorg og engagement - samt evner at omsætte disse i relation til andre mennesker.

 

 

Om kirken:
