jobs.title: Global Demo Engineer
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As one of Notion’s founding Demo Engineers, you’ll build the global demo engine behind how we bring Notion’s most important customer stories to life. You’ll shape the standards, systems, and experiences that help our Sales teams demonstrate what is possible with Notion, from the first customer conversation through implementation and deployment.



This is a high-impact opportunity to create the function from the ground up. You’ll establish global standards, turn our strongest customer solutions into repeatable demos, and give regional teams the tools and autonomy to innovate. Your work will directly influence how customers understand Notion’s platform, AI capabilities, and potential to transform how their organizations work.



This role reports to the Global Head of Acquisition and partners closely with Sales, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), Enablement, and PMM.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Build the global demo engine that brings Notion’s most important customer stories to life
   
   - Partner with Enablement and PMM to define the core narratives, scripts, environments, and assets for each demo
   
   - Create a durable release and versioning process so demos stay current as the product evolves
   
   - Automate repeatable setup and maintenance wherever possible so the system can scale globally

 - Turn Notion’s strongest customer and internal solutions into reusable GTM assets
   
   - Identify high-impact use cases and transform them into repeatable, field-ready demos
   
   - Partner with FDE to package customer solutions, implementation guidance, and technical patterns into demos the field can confidently deliver
   
   - Work with GTM Systems to translate demos into workspaces that can be deployed in customer environments

 - Set the global standard for demo quality and help the field deliver it
   
   - Define what great looks like for each demo moment, from the first customer conversation to a tailored technical experience
   
   - Train and coach customer-facing teams on storytelling, environment setup, delivery, and troubleshooting
   
   - Partner with Enablement to create practical resources and programs that raise demo quality across regions

 - Create a clear path from experimentation to global scale
   
   - Give customer-facing teams a structured way to safely build, test, and pilot new demo concepts
   
   - Evaluate the strongest ideas and turn them into scalable standards, templates, and reusable assets

 - Serve as the strategic demo partner for high-impact opportunities
   
   - Advise teams on custom or personalized demos that fall outside the standard portfolio
   
   - Help teams balance customer relevance, technical credibility, and speed without compromising quality




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years in a technical or customer-facing role such as Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Demo Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or Software Engineering

 - Experience designing and delivering technical demos, prototypes, or solution experiences for a SaaS product

 - Strong systems thinking, with experience building scalable standards, templates, documentation, versioning practices, and operating processes

 - Ability to translate complex product capabilities into clear, compelling customer stories tied to business value

 - Technical fluency across APIs, integrations, automation, data, permissions, and enterprise security concepts

 - Working proficiency with scripting or automation tools such as Python or JavaScript

 - Experience partnering across Sales, Product, Engineering, Enablement, and Marketing to drive alignment and deliver shared outcomes

 - Strong communication and coaching skills, with the ability to raise the capabilities of customer-facing teams

 - Comfort creating structure, setting priorities, and making progress in a fast-moving environment with evolving requirements




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience building or scaling a demo engineering, solutions engineering, or technical enablement function

 - Experience with enterprise sales cycles and complex, multi-stakeholder customer environments

 - Hands-on experience with demo automation platforms such as Consensus, Navattic, Reprise, Storylane, or Demostack

 - Experience supporting major product launches or global go-to-market programs

 - Familiarity with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor

 - Experience with productivity, collaboration, AI, or horizontal SaaS products

 - Notion power user
   


TOOLS YOU'LL USE:

 - Demo environments: Notion, plus demo automation platforms as needed

 - Collaboration: Slack, Salesforce, Gong for call review

 - Automation: Zapier, scripting tools, API clients (Postman or similar)

 - AI Coding Tools: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor
   

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is $220,000 - $250,000 per year.


By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

ICOS is seeking an experienced Policy and Information Officer to join our Communications Team. Key responsibilities Information and enquiries •Respond to enquiries from international students and ICOS members, providing accurate, accessible information, signposting and referrals within the boundaries of ICOS’ role; escalate complex or sensitive issues as appropriate. •Research, verify and maintain practical information resources on the issues affecting the rights of international students, including: immigration, employment, accommodation, education and student welfare. •Record and analyse enquiries and member feedback, identifying recurring and emerging issues to inform ICOS’ policy positions, communications and reporting. jobs.title: Student Assistant - Data & Analytics (BluePool and Data Governance)
jobs.description:
Do you want to help shape the future of Europe’s energy system and contribute to a fully carbon‑neutral, sustainable power grid? Are you a data engineer who is curious, open‑minded, and initiative-taking — someone who enjoys working in an explorative and collaborative environment? Do you want to collaborate with engineers, application developers, and data scientists to unlock insights from the vast amounts of data behind our services? 

We are looking for a Student Assistant to support our Data & Analytics department. This is an excellent opportunity for a student who wants practical experience working with data platforms, governance processes, documentation, and operational support activities in an international and highly technical environment. 

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition 

Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time. 

Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnett, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet. 

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centres, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.  

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system. 

Right now, we are looking for a Student Assistant to join our Data & Analytics Department. 

What You Will Be Working On 

The Data and Analytics team consists of 10 employees and consultants and plays a central role in enabling data-driven decision-making across Nordic RCC. The team develops and maintains data pipelines, analytics products, BI solutions, platform services, and information services that support operational, strategic, and regulatory needs. 

As Student Assistant, you will support various initiatives across the department, with a primary focus on NRCC's analytics platform ‘BluePool’, and data governance activities. 

Examples of tasks may include: 

BluePool Support 

  • Assisting with user onboarding and access administration 

  • Maintaining onboarding guides and user documentation 

  • Supporting training sessions and workshops 

  • Gathering and tracking user feedback 

  • Assisting with testing of new BluePool functionality 

Data Governance 

  • Supporting data governance processes and documentation 

  • Maintaining data catalogues and metadata documentation 

  • Assisting with data classification and governance activities 

  • Supporting compliance and process-related initiatives 

General Department Support 

  • Coordinating meetings and workshops 

  • Maintaining team documentation and knowledge bases 

  • Preparing presentations and communication materials 

  • Supporting project coordination and follow-up activities 

  • Assisting with ad hoc analytical and administrative tasks 

Who We Are Looking For 

You are currently enrolled in a relevant university programme, for example within data science, computer science, engineering, information management, business analytics, economics, mathematics, or a similar field. 

You do not need extensive professional experience. What matters most is that you are curious, structured, and comfortable taking ownership of practical tasks — from organizing documentation and following up on details to supporting colleagues with day-to-day needs. 

We are looking for someone who: 

  • Is detail-oriented and follows tasks through carefully 

  • Enjoys turning information into clear documentation, guides, or overviews that others can use 

  • Communicates clearly in writing and verbally 

  • Can work independently while also asking for input when needed 

  • Has an interest in data, analytics, and digital platforms 

  • Is comfortable using Microsoft Office tools 

It is an advantage, but not a requirement, if you have experience with one or more relevant tools or concepts, such as Python, SQL, Power BI, enterprise architecture, data governance, or technical documentation. 

What We Offer: 

  • A flexible student position that can be adapted to your studies 

  • Exposure to large-scale data and analytics initiatives within the energy sector 

  • Experience working in an international environment with Nordic stakeholders 

  • Insight into data governance, analytics platforms, and digital transformation 

  • Opportunities to build practical skills that are highly relevant for a future career in data and analytics 

  • A friendly and collaborative team with experienced data scientists, data engineers, and analytics specialists 

Application & Security Clearance 

Please apply online in English no later than 5 November 2026. Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis. 

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.   

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.  

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.  Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: OT Security Architect - Renewables, Location: Denmark , DK - Esbjerg, DK - Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced and motivated OT Security Architect and do you want to leave your mark on the global energy industry? If so, we want to hear from you! 
 
Your position
 
In your new position as OT Security Architect in the Renewables division, you will be a valuable member of the OT Security Team, whose mission is to ensure excellent OT security deliveries on large-scale EPC substation projects. You will have the chance to take the architectural lead and help shape a collaborative team culture built on expertise and knowledge-sharing. Above all, your work will make a real difference to the global energy sector.

Your place of work will be at one of our offices in either Esbjerg or Copenhagen. The position is full-time, and you can expect to travel 10–30 days per year.

“Every day, we help enable the green energy transition by building secure, resilient OT solutions that ensure renewable energy assets operate safely and reliably.” - OT Security Architect & Team Lead, Reza Sarafrazjoo.
 
Your tasks & responsibilities 

In our Renewables division, we have major EPC projects in the pipeline for both short- and long-term operations. As an OT Security Architect, you will take the architectural lead and support all OT Security areas across the EPC substation projects.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

  • Contributing to the implementation of industry-accepted good practice and required Cyber/OT Security architecture at solution level, typically based on standards such as IEC 62443, ISO 27001, and NIS
  • Helping define products and standards relevant to OT Security and infrastructure
  • Hands-on experience with cybersecurity audits and compliance frameworks, including ISO 27001, Critical Infrastructure regulations, and IEC 62443
  • Reviewing requirements/ITT packages and providing input to tenders consisting of calculations, solutions, descriptions, clarifications, and reservations
  • Taking on an advisory or active role in infrastructure, identity access management, or logging/event-based activities
  • Being responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing FAT, SAT, and SIT activities to ensure successful system delivery and integration
  • Implementing customer-specific Cyber/OT Security requirements in substation design for multiple systems and subsystems, such as SCADA, low-voltage, HVAC, Auxiliary Control and Monitoring System, etc.


Crucial to this position is your ability to take ownership of project deliverables and coordinate OT Security deadlines with internal and external stakeholders. You should thrive in a leading role where your skills, collaboration, and structured approach help ensure that requirements are met.
 
Your profile & qualifications

You are a team player who enjoys leading projects and working with stakeholders to align on timing, scope, and objectives. You know when technical expertise should be brought in to support delivery. To us, this means that you have a structured and solution-oriented approach, the ability to influence stakeholders, and the dedication to see tasks through to completion.

You will be part of a team of six colleagues that values quality, attention to detail, and a flexible working environment. We are sociable, helpful, and open to input, and we work in a dedicated, structured, and execution-focused way while respecting the agility that is a natural part of our core tasks. We want the same from you.

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

  • A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in OT Security from a similar position
  • A Tech Lead mentality – we are not seeking an extreme subject matter expert, but a well-rounded colleague who can work through heavily structured large projects involving many stakeholders 
  • The ability to know when additional technical specialists or resources are needed to complete a project
  • Excellent communication skills and fluency in English
  • Experience working in complex engineering projects, as well as project and stakeholder management, is an advantage


If you have any questions, you are more than welcome to contact OT Security Architect & Team Lead, Reza Sarafrazjoo.
 
Welcome to Semco Maritime

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey: how to get there. We provide the answers needed to make change real, because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever, pragmatic solutions. This is what we do, and this is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

jobs.title: Data engineer for analytics platform with BI expertise and an interest in the green energy transition
jobs.description:
Do you want to help shape the future of Europe’s energy system and contribute to a fully carbon‑neutral, sustainable power grid? Are you a data engineer who is curious, open‑minded, and initiative-taking — someone who enjoys working in an explorative and collaborative environment? Do you want to collaborate with engineers, application developers, and data scientists to unlock insights from the vast amounts of data behind our services? 

We are looking for a Data Engineer with BI expertise to join our Data and Analytics team at Nordic RCC. If you are excited about building robust data pipelines, developing high‑quality BI products, and enabling data‑driven decision‑making in a mission‑driven organization, we encourage you to apply — even if you don’t meet every requirement. 

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition 

Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time. 

Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnett, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet. 

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centres, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.  

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system. 

Right now, we are looking for a Data Engineer who likes to make a difference! 

Job description

The Data and Analytics team consists of 10 employees and consultants and plays a central role in enabling data-driven decision-making across Nordic RCC. The team develops and maintains data pipelines, analytics products, BI solutions, platform services, and information services that support operational, strategic, and regulatory needs. 

As a Data Engineer with BI expertise, you will help design, build, operate, and improve our analytics platform and the data products built on it. You will work closely with data scientists, engineers, developers, infrastructure teams, external providers, and stakeholders to deliver reliable data pipelines, intuitive BI solutions, and user-friendly data services. 

Your work will directly influence how Nordic RCC uses data to improve processes, services, and operational decision-making. Your key responsibilities will include: 

  • Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines, data models, integrations, and curated datasets. 

  • Develop BI dashboards, reports, and data products that turn complex data into clear insights. 

  • Operate and improve analytics platform services, including data platforms, BI solutions, JupyterHub, user-facing analytics environments, and supporting applications. 

  • Ensure data quality, reliability, monitoring, and operational visibility across pipelines, BI products, and platform services. 

  • Monitor and optimize platform performance, resource use, computer storage, and analytical workloads. 

  • Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, developers, infrastructure teams, external providers, and stakeholders to deliver production-ready analytics solutions. 

  • Support the development of platform architecture, metadata, governance practices, and service-oriented delivery models such as Data-as-a-Service and Platform-as-a-Service. 

  • Document data flows, platform components, operational procedures, and technical solutions to support maintainability and knowledge sharing. 

We are looking for someone with several of the following qualifications: 

  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, BI Developer, Platform Engineer, Application Developer, or similar. 

  • Strong experience with ETL/ELT pipelines, modern data architectures, SQL, and data warehousing concepts. 

  • Hands-on experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, or similar. 

  • Experience operating and optimizing analytics platforms in production environments. 

  • Experience with cloud-native technologies and analytics platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Azure Synapse, Snowflake, or similar. 

  • Familiarity with orchestration, monitoring, DevOps, CI/CD, Python, containerization, Kubernetes, storage solutions, or data platform infrastructure 

  • Experience operationalizing analytics models, enabling data consumption, or supporting service-oriented delivery models is an advantage. 

  • Knowledge of power systems and the energy sector is a plus, but not a requirement. 

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the listed requirements. Your experience and perspective could be exactly what we are looking for. 

Working Environment 

You will join a diverse and enthusiastic team in our office at Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. Nordic RCC is home to over twenty nationalities, with a healthy gender balance and a wide range of ages and backgrounds. We value curiosity, fellowship, respect, and transparency—and we hope you see yourself in these values. 

We offer flexible work arrangements to support a healthy work-life balance, including the option to work from home part of the time. Due to the collaborative nature of our work, physical presence in the office is expected on most days. 

You’ll report to Data & Analytics team-lead and collaborate regularly with colleagues from the Nordic RCC and occasionally also from the Nordic TSOs. Travel is limited and will not exceed 15 days per year. 

Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. 

Application & Security Clearance 

Please apply online in English no later than 5 November 2026. Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis. 

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.   

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.  

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.   Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Produktionskoordinator & Creative Specialist – barselsvikariat / Production Coordinator & Creative Specialist (Maternity Cover)
jobs.description:
Hos AVdesign i Billund søger vi en erfaren produktionskoordinator til et barselsvikariat i vores videoteam.

Du skal være god til at planlægge, holde overblik og få produktionerne til at hænge sammen – også når der kommer ændringer undervejs. Du får tæt kontakt med vores kunder og kolleger og deltager både i koordineringen og de praktiske opgaver i studiet og på location.

Om jobbet

Du får en central rolle i planlægningen og gennemførelsen af vores produktioner. Vi arbejder med video, livestreaming, produktoptagelser i studiet og andre medieproduktioner. Opgaverne varierer, og du skal have lyst til at hjælpe til, hvor der er brug for dig.

Vi søger dig, der har erfaring som producer, produktionsleder eller koordinator og er vant til at holde styr på planer, mennesker og deadlines.

Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

  • Planlægge og koordinere produktioner i samarbejde med teamet.

  • Holde styr på tidsplaner, logistik og praktiske aftaler.

  • Have løbende kontakt med kunder og samarbejdspartnere og sikre, at de er godt informeret undervejs.

  • Deltage i produktionerne og hjælpe med praktiske og kreative opgaver.

  • Følge op på opgaver og sørge for, at projekterne bliver leveret til tiden.

  • Håndtere ændringer og finde løsninger, når noget ikke går som planlagt.

Du bliver en del af et team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og deler viden, idéer og erfaringer.

Om dig

Du arbejder struktureret, tager initiativ og følger dine opgaver til dørs. Du er god til at kommunikere med både kunder og kolleger og kan bevare overblikket, når flere opgaver skal løses samtidig.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

  • Har erfaring med koordinering, projektarbejde, administration eller produktionsplanlægning.

  • Er god til at planlægge og holde styr på flere projekter og deadlines.

  • Er omhyggelig og har øje for detaljerne.

  • Tager ansvar og selv følger op på det, der mangler.

  • Kan tilpasse dig, når planer og prioriteringer ændrer sig.

  • Har lyst til en hverdag med forskellige opgaver og både koordinering og praktisk arbejde.

  • Er en god kollega, der samarbejder og hjælper til.

Erfaring med video, livestreaming eller broadcast er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det samme gælder lettere billedbehandling, videoredigering eller grundlæggende grafisk arbejde. Dansk er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Om AVdesign

AVdesign er en international produktionsvirksomhed i Billund, grundlagt i 2005. Vi er 16 kolleger inden for blandt andet animation, filmproduktion, lyd og produktionsledelse og løser opgaver for kunder over hele verden.

Du bliver en del af vores videoteam på seks personer. Vi går op i vores fag, godt samarbejde og muligheden for at udvikle os både fagligt og personligt.

Vi deler lokaler med My Instore Radio og er samlet 26 kolleger med forskellige nationaliteter.

Praktisk information

Stillingen er et barselsvikariat med tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt. Arbejdsstedet er Billund, og stillingen kræver fysisk fremmøde.

Send din motiverede ansøgning og dit CV til application@avdesign.dk. Har du spørgsmål, er du også velkommen til at skrive.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og lukker opslaget, når stillingen er besat.

ENGLISH:

Production Coordinator & Creative Specialist (Maternity Cover)

Do you imagine a position where you play a key role in an engaged and committed team creating professional film projects?

Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment and still deliver great results? 

Are you able to facilitate film production and at the same time create a supreme client experience, both in the studio and on location?

As producer at AVdesign you will get the chance to work in a top professional, positive and encouraging work environment with like-minded individuals who have a strong passion within their field. We value rich opportunities for professional and personal development. 

 

About us

We are a Billund based international production company. AVdesign was founded in 2005 and now employs 16 colleagues including animators, CG generalists, producers, production assistants, sound designers, videographers etc.

We create a great variety of content across different platforms and support clients worldwide with a range of exciting projects.

AVdesign is located together with My Instore Radio and in total we employ 26 skilled colleagues of different nationalities.

We are looking for a new colleague to join our video team, where we have gathered some of the most skilled and dedicated enthusiasts from the business. The team consists of 6 people.

 

About the role

This is a maternity cover position, offering a unique opportunity to join AVdesign and play a key role in coordinating and delivering a wide range of media productions.

We are looking for an experienced Producer / Production Manager with a strong background in production planning and project coordination.

 

The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, and adaptable, with an open mindset and a flexible approach to a broad range of assignments. Our projects vary across video production, live streaming, studio product shoots, and other media-related productions, so versatility and a willingness to take on different challenges are important.

At AVdesign, we foster an open, supportive, and collaborative working environment where sharing knowledge, ideas, and experience is highly valued.

Experience within the media industry, such as video production, live streaming, or broadcast, is an advantage, but not a strict requirement.

This is a hands-on role that combines operational coordination with practical involvement in productions. It requires a genuine interest in planning, problem-solving, and collaborating with colleagues, clients, and partners to ensure successful project delivery.

 

About you

You are a natural coordinator who enjoys bringing people, plans, and ideas together. You communicate confidently with clients and colleagues and thrive in a dynamic environment where priorities can change quickly.

You are proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple tasks at once. Whether coordinating logistics, supporting creative productions, or solving last-minute challenges, you take ownership and help keep projects on track. Fluency in Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Your profile:

·      Experience in a coordination, project support, administrative, or production-related role.

·      Strong planning and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

·      Thrives in a dynamic environment and enjoys wearing multiple hats, contributing wherever needed to support the team and deliver great productions.

·      Excellent attention to detail and a structured approach to your work.

·      Experience with light photo editing, video editing, or basic graphic design is an advantage.

·      A proactive, solution-oriented mindset with a flexible approach to changing priorities.

·      Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

·      A positive team player who enjoys collaborating and helping others succeed.

 

Additional information

If you are interested in the position, we would like to hear from you soon. Potentially we are looking for someone to start as soon as possible.

The role is based in Billund, Denmark. Remote working is not an option. 

If you have any question about the job, please get in touch on: application@avdesign.dk

We look forward to receiving your motivated application and CV on: application@avdesign.dk

We will interview potential candidates on an ongoing basis and deactivate the job advert once the position has been filled.

Fuel50 is a workforce transformation platform helping organisations understand workforce capability, build skills and enable internal mobility in an AI-driven world. Our products combine skills intelligence, talent marketplace experiences and responsible AI to help people and organisations take their next step.Â 

We are looking for a Product Design Lead to shape the next chapter of our product experience and design organisation.Â 

This is a senior player-coach role. You will lead and develop our product design team while staying close to the work, setting direction, shaping product strategy, prototyping ideas and helping teams ship high-quality experiences.Â 

You will work closely with Product and Engineering as a leadership trio, influencing decisions across the organisation and helping Fuel50 build products that are simple, trusted and valuable.Â 

If youâre a strategic design leader who still loves getting close to the work, developing people and shipping real product, weâd love to hear from you!Â 

What you'll do:
  • Lead, manage and coach our product designers, supporting their growth and helping them reach their next level.Â 
  • Set and communicate a clear product design vision across Fuel50's skills intelligence, talent mobility and AI-powered experiences, and tell the story of where our products are going in a way that excites customers, colleagues and leadership.Â 
  • Own the design direction without waiting for it to be handed to you. Spot opportunities, form a point of view, and prototype ideas to make them tangible.Â 
  • Bring a strong point of view to senior conversations, challenge assumptions constructively and influence decisions across the business.Â 
  • Partner with Product and Engineering from discovery through to delivery, balancing customer value, design quality, technical reality and pace.Â 
  • Design human-centred AI experiences with appropriate trust, explainability, user control and clear handoffs, including agent and assistant experiences that work across multiple surfaces such as the Fuel50 platform, Microsoft Teams and Copilot.Â 
  • Grow our design engineering capability, and be comfortable building and shipping working prototypes or code yourself.Â 
  • Evolve our design system, accessibility standards (including WCAG compliance) and design-to-code practices so Fuel50 feels coherent and high quality across every product.Â 
  • Shape design team structure, capability, hiring, planning and ways of working as the organisation evolves.Â 
What you'll bring:
  • Experience in product design in a SaaS or technology environment (we suggest 7 or more years), including at least 2 years leading, managing or coaching designers, and a track record of building healthy, high-performing teams.Â 
  • Strong product design craft across discovery, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, research and shipped digital products.Â 
  • Experience designing complex, connected systems and journeys for multiple personas, ideally in an enterprise or B2B product.Â 
  • The ability to think big and set a compelling vision, while staying pragmatic about what can be learned and shipped next.Â 
  • The ability to originate ideas and direction, and to communicate them clearly through stories, prototypes and design narrative.Â 
  • Confidence working with experienced senior stakeholders and influencing through clarity, judgement and strong communication.Â 
  • Experience working closely with Product and Engineering as a genuine cross-functional trio.Â 
  • Technical fluency and a willingness to get into the code. You should be comfortable building working prototypes using HTML, CSS, JavaScript or similar tools, and have contributed code that has shipped to production, for example front-end changes or design system components submitted through pull requests.Â 
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding and design tools, such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, to prototype faster and ship real work. We want someone who uses these tools well and can show how they have changed the way their team works.Â 
  • Working knowledge of accessibility and WCAG. You have designed to WCAG standards, tested for it, and built accessibility into your team's design system and review process.Â 
  • An interest in design systems and data-informed decision-making.Â 

You do not need to tick every box. We care about the quality of your thinking, the way you work with people and your ability to turn ambitious ideas into better product experiences.Â 

All Fuellies are a core part of our culture and making Fuel50 an amazing place to work. Some additional benefits are:Â Â 

  • A day off on your birthday and your Fuel50 anniversaryÂ 
  • A âReFuel Dayâ once a quarter to relax and refuelÂ 
  • Remote work and flexible work times - we're supportive of school commitments, traveling in off-peak hours, and attending to lifeâs eventsÂ 
  • A progressive parental leave policyÂ 
  • Comprehensive fully subsidised health insurance with Southern CrossÂ 
What's it like to be a Fuellie?

Fuel50âs team is fully remote, with an HQ in New Zealand, and team members across five countries. We have a co-working space in the BHive in Takapuna that we use to meet occasionally for team and strategic planning and other team events. If youâre based outside of Auckland and are needed on-site for anything, weâll pay for you to get here.Â 

We know that having the right people with the right attitude and behaviour is a big part of what makes us successful.Â  Living our values is an important part of being successful in this role.Â Â 

  • We have a culture around continuous and respectful feedback and recognition - be part of a team working towards a common goal and helping each other every step of the way.Â Â 
  • We have #SuperheroAwards at quarterly planning meetings and spontaneous recognition and shout-outs across the business.Â Â 
  • We'll have your back when you need help - your colleagues want to see you succeed and work hard to help you do so.Â Â 
  • We work hard and deliver amazing results to our clients - when you see our amazing feedback, you'll be proud to be a Fuellie.Â

If this sounds like you, then please apply. If youâre not sure you're ready or perhaps you don't meet all requirements yet, please apply anyway. We'll review every application that we get.Â Â

jobs.title: Skønne Frederik i Farum mangler sin voksenven. Så søger du et deltidsarbejde, hvor hyggelige cykelture er i højsædet så se her!
jobs.description:
Måske er du uddannet socialpædagog, pædagog eller har masser af erfaring med børn med særlige behov. Og kan du betegne dig selv som værende moden, med en mental robusthed, og trives med en fast struktur så se her!

Om Frederik                                             

Frederik er 8 år gammel men grundet hans kognitive udfordringer er han sammenligning med et barn på 1,5. Han har diagnoserne infantil autisme og mental retardering i sværere grad. Derudover har Frederik ADHD og har ikke et talesprog. Frederik er en sød og kærlig dreng som hurtigt viser tillid til de personer han omgås. Kvag hans diagnoser er Frederik meget afhængig af en fast struktur, rutiner og forudsigelighed, så det er et krav at du som hjælper har erfaring indenfor området og kan bidrage til en struktureret og forudsigelig dag. 

 

Om opgaven 

Opgaven går ud på at aflaste forældrene i eftermiddagstimerne, hvor en stor del af dette er, at hjælpe Frederik ud på sin faste daglige tur ud af huset, på en fast rute i det naturskønne område omkring familiens hjem. Til turen som varer ca. en time, har familien en el dreven ladcykel til formålet. 

Derudover holder Frederik også af at hoppe på familiens trampolin i haven, så du skal som hjælper også bruge tid på trampolinen, sammen med ham. Det er vigtigt at du er klar på at Frederik skal overvåges hele tiden og have hjælp til det meste i løbet af dagen, inklusiv eventuel hjælp til bleskift.. Familien vil stå for grundig oplæring af alle opgaver omkring Frederik, da det er vigtigt for dem at du som hjælper føler dig tryg og du vil derfor blive budt indenfor i et kærligt og omsorgsfuldt hjem. 

Hvem er du?

Du skal være i stand til at skabe de trygge rammer og forudsigelighed som Frederik har behov for. Have et kærligt sind, let til smil og sidst men ikke mindst, lyst til at være fysisk aktiv på de daglige cykelture året rundt som jobbet kræver. Kan du sige ja til disse ting, vil du blive budt indenfor hos en kærlig, rummelig familie hvor du vil gøre en kæmpe forskel.

Timerne

Stillingen er på 18 timer om måneden fordelt på 1 til 2 vagter om ugen om eftermiddagen i hverdage fra ca. kl. 14.00 og 3-4 timer per vagt som planlægges med familien. Der vil på sigt når der er dannet en solid tryg relation imellem Frederik, hans familie og dig være mulighed for flere timer, hvor disse også kan placeres om natten.               

                                
 Hvem er Olivia Danmark ? 

  • Vi står for kvalitet, viden og dedikation og arbejder med det daglig. 
  • Vi tror på ordentlighed i alt det, vi gør 
  • Vi arbejder med at vi meningsfuldt forskellige
  • Vi tager ansvar og skaber løsninger – hver dag


  Løn og vilkår

Som ansat hos Olivia Danmark er du sikret Løn og ansættelsesvilkår som følger overenskomst med FOA, og fastsættes ud fra dine kvalifikationer og erfaring.

Ansøgning og kontakt 

Ansøg stillingen hurtigst muligt eller inden deadline. Vi kalder løbende til samtale, så skriv gerne til os i dag.   

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte Charlotte Bay Wedebye på mail charlotte.wedebye@oliviadanmark.dk 

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Chip Ecosystem Partnership and Funding Manager, The position is a Senior Advisor at TEK Innovation
jobs.description:
Do you want to help facilitate and grow the semiconductor and chip ecosystem in Denmark and beyond, working with the leading researchers in the field, and to turn potential into opportunities, partnerships and projects? Then this job could be for you.  

About the position 

SDU Microelectronics at TEK, headed by professor Farshad Moradi, is part of the Danish Chips Competence Centre (DkCCC) - the new Danish hub for chip technology and your strategic platform. The position offers an opportunity to play a central role in strengthening Denmark’s chip ecosystem and to help connect the ecosystem with fast-growing application areas such as drones, robotics, sensors and autonomous systems, where advanced chip technology is becoming increasingly critical for performance, reliability, energy efficiency and future innovation. 

You will work closely with SDU researchers, DkCCC partners, Danish universities, companies, incubators, industry organizations, funding advisers and European chip networks. Learn more here www.dkccc.eu 

The position involves regular travel within Denmark and occasional travel elsewhere in Europe. 

Your main responsibilities will include:  

  • Identifying relevant national and European funding opportunities in chip technology, semiconductor development, and chip-enabled applications. 

  • Developing and maintaining a strategic pipeline of funding calls, project ideas and potential consortium partners. 

  • Engaging proactively with Danish start-ups, SMEs and established companies to understand their technological needs and funding requirements. 

  • Connecting companies with relevant researchers, facilities and competencies at SDU and other Danish universities. 

  • Helping companies and researchers translate technical and business ideas into fundable project concepts. 

  • Initiating and facilitating Danish and European consortia for chip-related funding calls and identifying opportunities to join existing consortia. 

  • Promoting Danish chip competencies and contribute to the visibility and strategic development of DkCCC.  

  • Supporting the full process of funding applications, from project objectives and facilitating consortiums, to coordinating proposals with partners and funding advisers. 

  • Building relationships with key stakeholders, organizing activities, and events supporting the ecosystem.   

Your profile 
You have a relevant master's degree, for example within engineering or natural sciences, business development or innovation management, economics or business administration, European studies or public policy, research and innovation management, or another relevant field. 

You have documented experience in one or more of the following: 

  • National or European research and innovation funding 

  • Development of collaborative funding proposals 

  • Consortium building and partner identification 

  • University–industry collaboration or innovation/business development 

  • Supporting start-ups, SMEs or deep-tech companies 

  • Stakeholder management and professional networking 

We are looking for a colleague who: 

  • Is proactive and comfortable initiating contact with companies, researchers and potential partners.  

  • Is a strong relationship builder who can establish trust across organizational and disciplinary boundaries 

  • Understands both commercial needs and academic interests and can structure complex consortium-development processes, while maintaining momentum towards a deadline 

  • Communicates clearly with different stakeholders, technical, academia and experts, business 

  • Works independently and is persistent and solution oriented, while also contributing actively to a team 

Experience with semiconductors, microelectronics, integrated circuits, quantum technologies, photonics, sensors or other deep-tech fields is a significant advantage — though you don't need to be a chip designer. What matters more is your ability to grasp technology-based opportunities, engage technical specialists, and turn complex ideas into fundable partnerships. Knowledge of European research and innovation programs, including EU Chips Act calls, is also an advantage. 

What we offer 

  • Become part of SDU’s growing environment for microelectronics and chip technology. 

  • Build partnerships that may lead to new products, technologies, companies, and investments. 

  • Work directly with promising Danish start-ups, companies and research environments. 

  • Help create new university–industry collaborations. 

  • Develop national and European networks within a strategically important technology area. 

  • Influence the formation of projects from their earliest stages.  

  • Collaborate with leading researchers and industry specialists, in an international and interdisciplinary environment. 

  • A role with considerable independence and the opportunity to shape the methods, networks, and activities used to identify funding opportunities and develop consortia. 

Your organizational home will be TEK Innovation, the research support and innovation unit at TEK, where you will have colleagues with similar jobs, supporting emerging ecosystems, as well as funding advisors and project managers. Your academic home with SDU Microelectronics, where you will work closely with professor Farshad Moradi and his team.  

For further information about the position, please contact: 

Thit Juul Hvid, Head of TEK Innovation, The Technical Faculty at The University of Southern Denmark tjuul@tek.sdu.dk 

Professor Farshad Moradi, SDU Microelectronics, The Technical faculty at The University of Southern Denmark at moradi@sdu.dk  

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support. 

The application deadline is November 1, 2026 at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST).

First Interview: week 46, second interview, week 47.

The startdate will be January 1, 2027, or at the earliest convenience.

Salary and employment terms:  

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”. 

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Application must include cover letter, CV and exam certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

All documents must be in English and PDF format.  All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected.  

You can only apply for the position at – https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu. 

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

jobs.title: Two-year Postdoctoral Position on Spintronics for Advanced Computing: Spintronic Device Fabrication, Characterization and Advanced Computing
jobs.description:
The Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a 2-year position as a postdoctoral researcher within spintronic computing. The position offers an exciting opportunity to advance spintronics through device physics, simulation, fabrication, experimental characterization, and integration of spintronic devices for advanced computing applications.

We are seeking a highly motivated candidate to investigate, design, fabricate, and characterize spintronic devices, with particular emphasis on Anisotropic Magnetoresistance (AMR), Giant Magnetoresistance (GMR), and Tunneling Magneto Resistance (TMR) devices. The work will combine magnetic and spintronic device physics, materials and multilayer structures, device fabrication, electrical measurement, modelling, and data analysis, with the aim of developing reliable spintronic technologies for advanced computing and emerging semiconductor applications.

The research will focus on understanding, controlling, and exploiting thermal fluctuations and stochastic switching in MTJs for physical entropy generation and energy-efficient computing, with particular emphasis on True Random Number Generators (TRNGs) and Stochastic Neural Accelerators (SNAs).

The successful candidate will work on the physics-based design, modelling, simulation, fabrication, and experimental characterization of spintronic devices and their integration into advanced computing systems. The position also includes a role in the Danish Chips Competence Center, where the candidate will contribute to connecting the Danish semiconductor and spintronics ecosystem with relevant EU pilot lines, facilitating collaboration, technology development, prototyping, and access to European semiconductor fabrication capabilities. The candidate will also contribute to preparing and writing research proposals and funding applications related to spintronics, semiconductor technologies, and advanced computing.

As a spintronic postdoc, you are expected to: 

  • Perform atomistic and micromagnetic simulations of s-MTJ structures and magnetization dynamics to investigate switching mechanisms, thermal activation, stochasticity, variability, and operating conditions relevant to TRNG and SNA applications.

  • Contribute to the electrical, magnetic, and transport characterization of fabricated AMR, GMR, and TMR devices, including resistance states, magnetoresistance, switching behaviour, current/voltage dependence, temperature dependence, and device-to-device variability, and correlate experimental results with modelling and simulation.

 

What we offer 

  • A stimulating research environment within SDU Microelectronics, a growing section integrating expertise in analog/digital IC design, spintronics, advanced computing, semiconductor technologies, and energy-efficient system architectures. 

  • Access to advanced facilities and infrastructure for spintronic device design, fabrication, electrical and magnetic characterization, and system prototyping, together with opportunities to collaborate with relevant Danish and European pilot-line and semiconductor facilities. 

  • Excellent opportunities for collaboration across SDU and with national and international academic and industrial partners in microelectronics, semiconductor technology, photonics, spintronics, and advanced computing, including activities connecting the Danish ecosystem with EU pilot lines.

  • An open and collaborative research culture within SDU’s Faculty of Engineering (TEK), The Mads Clausen Institute (MCI), promoting interdisciplinary innovation across electronics, materials science, semiconductor processing, spintronics, and artificial intelligence.

 

What we expect 

Applicants should hold a PhD in Electronic and Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, or a closely related field (the degree should have been completed within the last 6 years at most): 

  • Expertise in spintronics, magnetism, magnetic device physics, or related areas, with demonstrated experience in physics-based modelling and/or simulation of magnetic or spintronic devices. Experience with s-MTJ devices, stochastic magnetization dynamics, or thermal switching is highly desirable and electrical modeling of sMTJs using Verilog to be used in Cadense

  • Experience with experimental characterization of AMR, GMR, MTJ, or related spintronic devices, including electrical and magnetic measurements, resistance and magnetoresistance characterization, switching behaviour, and data analysis. jobs.title: Two-year Postdoc position on Spintronic Quantum-inspired Computing
jobs.description:
Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a 2-year Postdoctoral Researcher position within the newly funded QUANTRONIC – Spintronic Pseudo-Qubits for Room-Temperature Quantum Computing project, supported by the Villum Experiment programme of Villum Fonden.

We are seeking a highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to investigate a new class of spintronic pseudo-qubits (p-qubits) based on spin-orbit torque magnetic tunnel junctions (SOT-MTJs). The project explores whether engineered stochastic spintronic devices can reproduce key computational mechanisms associated with quantum systems - including superposition-like states, probability-amplitude-based interference, and entanglement-like correlations—without relying on fragile quantum coherence or cryogenic operation.

QUANTRONIC is a high-risk, high-gain research project positioned at the intersection of spintronics, probabilistic computing, quantum-inspired computing, nanoelectronics, and integrated circuit design. The central concept is a novel SOT-MTJ architecture designed to represent and manipulate probability amplitudes and to enable synchronization between multiple pseudo-qubits. The project will combine physics-based modelling, device design and fabrication, experimental characterization, and system-level demonstrations.

The successful candidate will work within SDU Microelectronics and collaborate closely with international partners, particularly INL – International Iberian Nanotechnology Laboratory, on the design and fabrication of spintronic devices.

The position is expected to start in February 2027, with the specific starting date to be agreed with the successful candidate.

 

As a Postdoctoral Researcher in QUANTRONIC, your key responsibilities will include:

  • Develop and refine physics-based compact models of SOT-MTJ-based pseudo-qubits, including stochastic switching and inter-device coupling.

  • Develop Verilog-A models and integrate them into circuit-level simulation environments such as Cadence.

  • Investigate the physical requirements for controlling probabilistic states and representing probability amplitudes in spintronic devices.

  • Collaborate with project partners on the design and fabrication of SOT-MTJ devices and arrays.

  • Experimentally characterize standalone devices and coupled arrays, including stochastic switching, synchronization, and entanglement-like correlations.

  • Investigate quantum-inspired gate operations and system-level demonstrations using networks of pseudo-qubits.

  • Contribute to proof-of-concept demonstrations, including integer factorization and other quantum-inspired computational problems.

  • Publish research results in high-quality international journals and conferences and contribute to the dissemination of project results.

  • Collaborate with researchers in spintronics, probabilistic computing, microelectronics, materials science, and quantum information.

 

What we offer

  • A unique opportunity to work on a high-risk, high-gain research concept exploring a new computational regime between classical probabilistic and quantum computing.

  • A stimulating research environment within SDU Microelectronics, a growing research section with expertise in spintronics, probabilistic computing, neuromorphic computing, analog/digital IC design, and emerging computing architectures.

  • Access to advanced facilities for electronic design, device characterization, measurement, and system prototyping.

  • Close collaboration with INL – International Iberian Nanotechnology Laboratory on spintronic device technology and fabrication.

  • Opportunities to collaborate with national and international researchers in spintronics, quantum-inspired computing, quantum technologies, and nanoelectronics.

  • An open, international, and collaborative research environment within SDU's Faculty of Engineering, supporting interdisciplinary research across electronics, physics, materials science, and computing.

  • Strong opportunities for developing an independent research profile in an emerging area of probabilistic and quantum-inspired hardware.

 

What we expect

Applicants should hold a PhD in electronic engineering, electrical engineering, applied physics, nanotechnology, spintronics, or a closely related field.

The ideal candidate should have experience in one or more of the following areas:

  • Spintronics and magnetic devices, particularly MTJs, STT-MTJs, SOT-MTJs, or related technologies.

  • Physics-based modelling of nanoscale or magnetic devices.

  • Verilog-A, SPICE, and Cadence or comparable circuit/device simulation environments.

  • Experimental characterization of electronic, magnetic, or spintronic devices.

  • Stochastic or probabilistic computing systems.

Experience in micromagnetic simulation, magnetotransport measurements, nanofabrication, probabilistic computing, or quantum/quantum-inspired computing will be considered a strong advantage.

We are particularly interested in candidates who are enthusiastic about working across traditional disciplinary boundaries and are comfortable combining device physics, modelling, experimentation, and computing concepts.

The successful candidate should be able to work independently while contributing actively to an interdisciplinary and international research team. Excellent written and spoken English and strong communication skills are required.

The section conducts internationally recognized research in integrated circuits, spintronics, photonics, and neuromorphic computing, and plays a central role in SDU’s ambition to be a national and European hub for semiconductor and chip innovation.

jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.




ABOUT THE ROLE: 

We're seeking an Engineering Manager, Mobile to lead the future of our mobile experiences at Replit. In this role, you'll build and manage a team that bridges design and engineering to create intuitive, performant mobile interfaces that make software creation accessible on any device. You'll guide your team in building production-ready frameworks and patterns that enable high-quality in-product experiences, ensuring users can create apps from their phones or tablets with the same power as desktop.




YOU WILL:

 - Build, mentor, and grow a team of mobile design engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and design craftsmanship

 - Define the technical vision and strategy for mobile design systems, establishing frameworks and patterns that ship to production and scale across iOS, Android, and responsive web

 - Partner closely with design, product, and engineering leadership to prioritize mobile initiatives and ensure seamless collaboration between design and development teams

 - Drive best practices for mobile-first development, ensuring your team builds production-grade patterns that deliver consistent, high-quality experiences while optimizing for performance

 - Oversee the architecture of complex mobile UI components and systems, providing technical guidance and code review to maintain high standards

 - Champion accessible, responsive interfaces through well-architected frameworks, and establish processes that improve mobile design-to-development workflow

 - Balance hands-on technical contribution with people management, staying close enough to the code to guide architectural decisions




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 3+ years of engineering management experience with a track record of building and scaling high-performing teams, plus proven experience building production frameworks and component systems that scale across products

 - Deep technical background with mobile development, including experience with some of the following: mobile-specific web APIs, native mobile development (Swift/Kotlin), React and React Native (or similar cross-platform frameworks), PWAs, mobile design patterns, and complex UI animations and gesture-based interactions

 - Excellent communication skills to balance technical leadership with people management, including mentoring, performance management, and career development




BONUS QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Active Replit mobile user passionate about accessible software creation, with experience building or leading mobile design or developer tools teams

 - Interest in AI on mobile devices and contributions to open-source mobile design systems or UI libraries

jobs.title: Sjúkraþjálfari - Physiotherapist
jobs.description:
Physiotherapist – Akureyri Hospital

We are looking for a physiotherapist to join our excellent team at Akureyri Hospital (SAk). This is a 75–100% permanent position, available immediately or by mutual agreement.
Physiotherapists at Akureyri Hospital work in the hospital’s acute care departments at Eyrarlandsvegur and/or in the rehabilitation department. Following the relocation of the rehabilitation department from Kristnes, rehabilitation services will now be provided in two locations: an inpatient rehabilitation unit at SAk’s facility at Eyrarlandsholt, and a day and outpatient rehabilitation unit outside the hospital. The service will provide multidisciplinary rehabilitation both individually and in groups. The location of the position may depend on the applicant’s interests and area of expertise.
The position is primarily daytime work. The current working week for full-time employees is 36 hours. Occasional weekend and public holiday shifts in the hospital’s acute care departments are also required. These shifts are paid separately and provide additional earning opportunities.
The position is varied and offers excellent opportunities to develop professional and specialised knowledge and to participate in the development of a day and outpatient rehabilitation service at a new location. We warmly welcome new colleagues and provide a comprehensive induction supported by experienced physiotherapists. This is an excellent opportunity for both experienced physiotherapists and newly qualified professionals to deepen their knowledge and become part of a strong and supportive team.

Main Duties and Responsibilities
•    General physiotherapy practice in a multidisciplinary environment
•    Providing education and guidance to patients and their families
•    Multidisciplinary collaboration within hospital departments
•    Duties and responsibilities will be tailored to the applicant’s experience
•    Participation in professional development

Qualifications and Requirements
•    A recognised qualification in physiotherapy and a valid Icelandic professional licence (we will assist applicants in applying for icelandic license)
•    In the recruitment process, emphasis will be placed on professional knowledge, experience and interest, independence in working methods, and strong communication and teamwork skills
•    Applicants must demonstrate integrity and professionalism, including a good reputation and conduct, both inside and outside the workplace, that is compatible with the requirements of the position
•    A clean criminal record

Further Information
Salary is in accordance with the current collective agreement between the Minister of Finance and Economic Affairs and the Icelandic Association of Physiotherapists.
All applications must be submitted electronically through the Icelandic government’s recruitment system. Applications should include detailed information about education and employment history, as well as copies of diplomas/certificates and professional licences, where applicable.
Akureyri Hospital’s equality policy is taken into consideration when recruiting staff. Applications may remain valid for six months from the date of publication of the advertisement, in accordance with Article 2, paragraph 2, item 3 of Regulation No. 1000/2019 on the advertising of vacant positions, as subsequently amended. All applicants will receive a response.
Akureyri Hospital provides internationally DNV-GL-certified healthcare services through an ISO-certified quality management system, with an emphasis on the active participation of all employees in meeting the quality requirements set out in the international standard under which the hospital is certified.
According to Akureyri Hospital’s human resources policy, emphasis is placed on recruiting and retaining talented individuals. When selecting employees, education, experience, skills and competence are taken into consideration. The human resources policy serves as a guiding principle for managers and staff, supporting the hospital as a progressive and desirable workplace. It is based on the hospital’s core values:

SAFETY, COLLABORATION and PROGRESSIVENESS

We take pride in operating advanced, automatic drilling rigs that create a safe and positive working environment for our highly motivated crew members. As a driller, you will be responsible for operating and supervising the drilling operations on the rig. You will ensure that all drilling activities are conducted safely, efficiently, and in compliance with company standards and regulations. Your expertise will be critical to maintaining the smooth operation of the drilling process and ensuring that all objectives are met.

• Provide training, guidance, and leadership to junior crew members.
• Communicate effectively with the Tool Pusher, engineers, and other staff to assess drilling progress and resolve any issues.
• Maintain detailed records of drilling operations and report progress to management.
• Manage equipment and materials to ensure smooth operations and prevent delays.

jobs.title: Join Landspítali as a Consultant in Respiratory Medicine in Iceland
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Consultant in Respiratory Medicine to join Landspítali University Hospital, with a start date of 1 November 2026 or as otherwise agreed.
The position is full-time; however, a lower employment ratio may be considered by mutual agreement.

Our Department of Pulmonary Medicine consists of a strong and ambitious team of physicians managing a broad range of clinical responsibilities in close collaboration with other healthcare professionals. We are looking for a dedicated and motivated specialist who wishes to contribute to highly specialised care and follow-up of patients with respiratory diseases.

Why Join Landspítali?

At Landspítali, we offer:
•    A stimulating and rewarding consultant-level position at Iceland's national university hospital, with diverse and interesting clinical responsibilities.
•    A 36-hour work week that supports a healthy work-life balance.
•    Close collaboration with experienced multidisciplinary teams and specialists across a range of clinical disciplines.
•    An academic environment where clinical practice, research, teaching, and innovation go hand in hand.
•    A supportive workplace that values staff wellbeing, professional development, and continuous learning.
•    Opportunities to learn Icelandic, including language courses offered partly during working hours during the first two years of employment.
•    The opportunity to live and work in Iceland and enjoy a high quality of life in a safe and well-functioning society.
•    Easy access to spectacular nature, clean air, and year-round outdoor activities, including hiking, skiing, geothermal bathing, and unique natural experiences.

Duties and Responsibilities
•    Care of patients on hospital wards and in the intensive care unit.
•    Outpatient clinics and day-ward services involving a broad range of pulmonary conditions, including but not limited to:
   o    Interstitial lung diseases
   o    Severe asthma
   o    Lung cancer diagnostics and follow up
   o    Advanced COPD and other late-stage obstructive lung diseases
   o    Acute and chronic respiratory failure
   o    Home mechanical ventilation and other ventilatory support therapies
•    Performance of interventional procedures, including:
   o    Bronchoscopy
   o    Pleural procedures/thoracentesis
   o    Exercise testing (cardiopulmonary excercise testing)
•    Participation in the pulmonary medicine on-call service.
•    Participation in acute internal medicine services, including on-call duties, as agreed with the Head of Pulmonary Medicine.
•    Teaching and supervision of medical students, intern/foundation doctors, and specialty trainees.
•    Participation in research activities.
•    Other duties as agreed with the Head of Department.

Qualifications
•    Specialist certification in Pulmonology/Respiratory Medicine.
•    Icelandic medical licence and specialist recognition in Pulmonology, or eligibility to obtain these credentials.
•    Broad knowledge and experience in Internal Medicine and Pulmonology.
•    Proven ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams.
•    Positive attitude, flexibility, and strong collaborative skills.
•    Experience in teaching and research is considered an advantage.

Additional Information
A full-time position is exclusively affiliated with the hospital in accordance with Article 3.3 of the current collective agreement between physicians and the Icelandic State.

The position is available from 1 November 2026 or by mutual agreement. The application deadline is 23 October 2026.

For further information, please contact:
Sif Hansdóttir, Consultant Physician
E-mail: sifhan@landspitali.is

Application Requirements
Applications should include information on:
•    Previous employment, education, and professional qualifications
•    Positions of trust and references

Mandatory Attachments
•    Certified copies of degree certificates and specialist qualifications/licences
•    Curriculum Vitae (CV), including teaching, research, and leadership experience
•    List of scientific publications in peer-reviewed journals. Applicants should either provide a link to their Google Scholar profile or submit publication documentation from PubMed.
•    Cover letter describing the applicant's qualifications and interest in the position

All attachments must be submitted in PDF format.

Selected candidates will be invited for interviews. Appointment decisions will be based on interviews and submitted documentation. Recruitment is conducted in accordance with Landspítali's Equal Opportunities Policy. All applicants will be informed of the outcome of the recruitment process.

Information regarding residence and work permits is available on our website.
To apply for the position, click the dark blue button "Sækja um starf" (Apply for Position). You may then switch the website language to English and log in to the Icelandic Government's recruitment system.

About Landspítali
Landspítali is a dynamic and diverse workplace where approximately 7,000 employees work in multidisciplinary teams and in close collaboration across professional groups. The hospital's vision is to provide healthcare of the highest quality, based on science, professionalism, and compassion, delivered by skilled staff and supported by modern facilities and a positive working environment.
Landspítali is certified according to the Icelandic Equal Pay Standard ÍST 85:2012. The certification has been awarded following an audit conducted by Versa Vottun ehf.

Applications may remain valid for up to six months from the publication date of the advertisement, in accordance with Icelandic Government Regulation No. 1000/2019 on the advertisement of vacant public positions, as amended.
