jobs.title: Tenure Track Assistant Professor in Infectious Animal Disease Modelling for Sustainable One Health Actions
jobs.description:
Tenure Track Assistant Professor in Infectious Animal Disease Modelling for Sustainable One Health Actions Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences
Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences
University of Copenhagen

The University seeks to appoint a tenure track assistant professor to commence 1 May 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Information on the department can be found at: http://www.sund.ku.dk/.

Subject area: Infectious disease epidemiology, modelling, animal health, One Health, and sustainable health systems

The Tenure-Track Assistant Professor will lead research on the dynamics of infectious disease spread in health systems, with particular emphasis on how changes in environmental conditions, animal populations, production systems, and management practices influence disease emergence, transmission, and control. The position will combine infectious disease epidemiology, mathematical and statistical modelling, data science, and economic analysis to generate evidence supporting disease preparedness, prevention, and control.

The successful candidate will:

  • Lead independent research on the dynamics of infectious disease spread in health systems, including the influence of environmental and production system changes.
  • Develop and apply simulation, epidemiological, and statistical models to assess disease and spillover risks, evaluate mitigation and control strategies, and quantify their economic implications.
  • Demonstrate strong programming skills in R and other relevant programming languages, including experience in managing, processing, and analysing large and complex datasets.
  • Have experience in developing and applying epidemiological disease-spread models, including model calibration, validation, parameter estimation, and calculation of epidemiological indicators such as the basic reproduction number (R₀) across different animal species and production systems.
  • Design and implement epidemiological modelling frameworks.
  • Validate and calibrate models using large-scale national datasets, ensuring scientific robustness, methodological validity, and relevance for policy and decision-making.
  • Translate research findings into evidence supporting risk-based disease prevention, preparedness, and control.
  • Establish and maintain collaborations with key stakeholders, including the Danish Veterinary and Food Administration, industry partners such as SEGES and Landbrug & Fødevarer (L&F), and international organisations such as the FAO.
  • Lead and secure independent research funding through competitive national and international funding calls. The position requires demonstrated experience in securing external funding, as well as the ambition to develop research ideas into externally funded projects and provide scientific leadership for such projects within the TIPTON Research Group.
  • Contribute to the development and delivery of One Health and sustainability teaching, with a particular focus on infectious diseases, disease preparedness, and the interactions between animal, human, and environmental health.
  • Contribute to teaching in data science, including data management, dataset preparation and handling, statistical analysis, programming, and the analysis of large-scale and complex datasets.
  • Supervise students and contribute to research capacity building within infectious disease epidemiology, disease modelling, data science, and One Health.
  • Contribute to the delivery of government services undertaken by the Department, including research-based advice, preparedness activities, risk assessments, and other activities relevant to infectious disease modelling and control.
The position is expected to combine methodological excellence in infectious disease modelling and data science with applied epidemiological research, generating evidence that is directly relevant to disease preparedness, private and public bodies, sustainable production systems, animal health and resilient health systems.

The tenure track assistant professor’s responsibilities will primarily consist of:

  • research, including publication/academic dissemination
  • research-based teaching
  • sharing knowledge with society
  • participation in formal pedagogical training programme for assistant professors
The tenure track assistant professor’s performance will be evaluated through annual evaluations. Furthermore, the tenure track assistant professor will be evaluated in a mid-track appraisal.

After no more than six years of employment and on condition of a positive final appraisal, the tenure track assistant professor will be employed as associate professor. Find more information about tenure track at the University of Copenhagen.

Required qualifications
To be qualified for an assistant professor position, you will be assessed according to these five overall criteria for recognising merit at the University of Copenhagen: Research, teaching, innovation & societal impact, organisational contribution and leadership. Find information about each criterion.

Furthermore, each applicant must be able to document:

  • a PhD degree or similar qualifications within the subject area
  • research experience within the field of the position
The tenure track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact.

The assistant professor is also required to possess good interpersonal and communicative skills.

Salary and employment conditions
The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week.

The position is permanent.

Employment is as Tenure Track Assistant Professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant professional organisations.

There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector at www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2025.

Questions
For further information, please contact Research Group Leader: Professor Beate Conrady, bcon@sund.ku.dk

Foreign applicants may find the university’s International Staff Mobility useful.

Application
The application must be submitted in English, and must include the following documents:

  • Application (Including motivation for applying for this position (Maximum 2 pages))
  • Curriculum vitae (Including information about external funding)
  • Diplomas (Master’s, PhD and other relevant diplomas)
  • A complete list of publications
  • Research plan (2-4 pages)
  • Teaching plan
  • Uploads of maximum 5 publications to be considered in the assessment
  • Teaching portfolio, if applicable (Guidelines)
Please note: It is mandatory to upload a teaching plan in the online application form. Should you not be able to produce a teaching plan, please upload a blank document in this box instead.

Application procedure
After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Appointments Committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment. The Dean then appoints an expert assessment committee in order to make an assessment of the selected applicants for the specific post. Selected applicants are notified of the composition of the committee and each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself. You can read about the recruitment process at the university's Job Portal.

Please note that the applicant will be contacted if the assessment committee requires further documentation.

The application will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

The University of Copenhagen encourages all interested in this post to apply.

Please submit the application with the required attachments. Only online applications will be accepted. The closing date for applications is 23.59 p.m. CET, 18 November 2026.

Interviews for this position are likely to be held on 7 April 2027.

jobs.title: Talent Sourcer
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We're looking to hire a new Talent Sourcer in Tokyo to build top-of-funnel talent pipelines and shape talent strategy across our Go-To-Market (GTM) organization. In this role, you'll partner with regional leadership to fill critical GTM roles like Solutions Consultants https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/notion/15dde0f5-b3fd-4d46-8ec2-0858ebdd888d and Outcomes Architects https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/notion/7030916f-4277-45db-9fed-644bb3fba059 primarily in Japan.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - You'll manage the sourcing process from inception through successful close, ensuring an exceptional experience for candidates and hiring managers at every step

 - You'll serve as a strategic advisor and talent sourcing expert, leading successful searches across GTM roles

 - You'll conduct initial qualification screenings and casual chats with candidates to assess fit and build relationships

 - You'll collaborate with the broader team on process improvements, programs, and strategic initiatives

 - You'll lead talent branding initiatives, including organizing hiring webinars and publishing blogs and articles that feature our employees

 - You'll provide talent mapping and market insights to support local and global recruiting and hiring teams

 - You'll make informed data-driven decisions that build efficiencies into the sourcing process

 - You'll find creative and unconventional ways to help us build a diverse top-of-funnel for GTM roles across all levels

 - You'll help build and manage partnerships to bring more underrepresented talent to Notion

 - You'll advance our Inclusion, Diversity, Equity, and Accessibility (I.D.E.A) strategy, working to build more diverse and inclusive teams

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Manage sourcing for multiple complex and evergreen searches, creating innovative strategies and engagement to bring the best and most diverse talent to Notion

 - Help develop and execute comprehensive sourcing plans, analyzing role requirements to define target profiles and identify qualified candidates

 - Partner closely with other members of the Recruiting team to ensure we hit our hiring targets without sacrificing quality

 - Collaborate closely with Hiring Managers throughout the recruiting process to ensure we meet their hiring needs and goals

 - Establish and maintain meaningful relationships with management and key cross-functional stakeholders

 


SKILLS AND TOOLSET YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - At least 3 years of experience in talent sourcing or recruitment, whether in-house or agency, or relevant transferable skills from related fields

 - Experience using LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing tools, with skills in Boolean and AI-powered searches (or eagerness to learn these tools)

 - Persistence, consistency, and attention to detail - if we hire one person out of 200 candidates, you'd ensure the other 199 have a great experience. You care deeply about your craft.

 - Strong time management, prioritization, and organizational skills. You are self-motivated and committed to excellence

 - You are kind, warm, and thoughtful - you'll represent the company when you interact with thousands of candidates each year

 - You'll contribute across the full scope of recruiting operations, from maintaining our ATS database and finding new ways to source candidates to analyzing data to improve recruiting efficiency and managing sourcing channels

 - Fluency in Japanese and business-level English




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator - AMER
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The People Team at Notion exists to help build a generational company - one that enables people to do their best and most meaningful work. Hiring exceptional talent, at the right time and with care, is central to that mission.

We’re looking for a Recruiting Coordinator to partner closely with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to create a thoughtful, well-run, and genuinely human candidate experience. This role sits at the center of our hiring process and plays an important role in how candidates experience Notion.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:



CREATE A CANDIDATE EXPERIENCE THAT REFLECTS NOTION

You’ll be one of the first and most consistent touchpoints candidates have with Notion. From scheduling interviews to answering questions and resolving issues, you’ll help ensure every interaction feels organized, respectful, and intentional. You’ll collaborate closely with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to continually refine our processes—so candidates leave feeling excited about what we’re building, regardless of the outcome.



COORDINATE INTERVIEWS WITH CARE AND PRECISION

You’ll manage and schedule a high volume of interviews across primarily non-technical roles, balancing speed with attention to detail. You’ll anticipate needs, communicate clearly, and keep candidates and interviewers aligned - making the process feel smooth and predictable, even as things move quickly.



BUILD STRONG RECRUITING FOUNDATIONS

This role is designed for someone early in their recruiting career who wants to build durable fundamentals. Over time, you’ll gain exposure to how we plan, execute, and scale hiring at Notion. With support from the team, you could take on light sourcing work, process improvements, and additional ownership as your skills grow - creating a strong foundation for future growth in recruiting, operations, or people-focused roles.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 6–12 months of experience in recruiting coordination or interview scheduling, ideally in a high-volume environment

 - Strong organizational and prioritization skills - you’re proactive, reliable, and thoughtful about details

 - A steady, calm approach in fast-moving environments

 - Ability to navigate ambiguity with optimism

 - Clear, kind, and professional communication skills - you’ll represent Notion to a large and diverse group of candidates

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience supporting both technical and non-technical roles, including remote and in-person interview scheduling

 - Experience with Ashby, Workday, Slack

 - Experience in a high-growth or startup environment



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $85,000 - $95,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: SISTEM INŽENJER/KA
jobs.description:
OPIS POSLA

Kao Sistem inženjer, bit ćeš ključna osoba za osiguravanje stabilnosti, sigurnosti i optimalnih performansi naše IT infrastrukture. Tvoji glavni zadaci uključivat će:

  • Virtualizacija i serveri: Instalacija, konfiguracija i proaktivno održavanje Windows servera te upravljanje Hyper-V virtualizacijskom okolinom i virtualnim strojevima (VM).
  • Sigurnost podataka: Konfiguracija, nadzor i redovito testiranje sustava za sigurnosnu pohranu (backup) i oporavak podataka korištenjem Veeam rješenja.
  • Upravljanje domenom: Administracija Active Directoryja (upravljanje korisničkim računima, grupama, pravima pristupa i GPO politikama).
  • File serveri: Održavanje i strukturiranje mrežnih dijeljenih mapa (File servers), dodjeljivanje prava i praćenje dostupnosti.
  • Korisnička podrška i oprema: Instalacija, održavanje i rješavanje problema na radnim računalima (hardware i software) te konfiguracija mrežnih printera i ostale periferne opreme.
  • Nadzor sustava: Praćenje rada cjelokupnog informacijskog sustava i pravovremeno rješavanje tehničkih poteškoća.

UVJETI

  • Minimalno 1 godina radnog iskustva na istim ili sličnim poslovima.
  • Napredno poznavanje Microsoft Windows Server okruženja je prednost.
  • Praktično iskustvo s Hyper-V tehnologijom virtualizacije.
  • Iskustvo u radu s Veeam Backup & Replication alatima.
  • Odlično poznavanje Active Directory, DNS, DHCP servisa.
  • Sposobnost samostalnog rješavanja problema s računalima (Windows 10/11) i perifernom opremom (printeri, skeneri).
  • Poznavanje osnovnih mrežnih koncepata (LAN, WAN, TCP/IP, VPN).

ŠTO NUDIMO

  • Ugovor na neodređeno vrijeme uz probni rok.
  • Pristup najnovijim tehnologijama.

jobs.title: Er du den fagperson, man kan regne med, når det bliver komplekst?
jobs.description:
Hos MerCare søger vi erfarne socialfaglige vikarer, der vil mere end bare tage en vagt.

Hos MerCare leder vi ikke efter flest muligt.

Vi leder efter de rigtige.

Vi arbejder med socialfaglige opgaver, hvor relation, stabilitet og faglighed gør en reel forskel.

Vi ved, at det ikke er ligegyldigt, hvem der træder ind ad døren – hvad enten det er på et bosted, i en institution, på en specialskole eller i en familie, hvor der er brug for en ekstra voksen.

Derfor matcher vi ikke bare mennesker med ledige timer.

Vi matcher faglighed, erfaring og menneske med den konkrete opgave. Er du den fagperson

Hvem er du?
Du har erfaring fra det socialpædagogiske område og ved, hvad det vil sige at være en del af en hverdag, hvor mennesker har brug for tydelige, stabile og fagligt stærke voksne.

Din erfaring kan fx være fra:
  • bosteder eller botilbud
  • institutioner
  • specialskoler
  • børne- og ungehjem
  • støtteopgaver i hjemmet
  • arbejde med børn, unge eller voksne med særlige behov

Du behøver ikke have prøvet alt.

Men du skal have faglig erfaring, dømmekraft og lyst til at gøre en forskel i praksis. Er du den fagperson

Det lægger vi vægt på
Hos MerCare leder vi efter medarbejdere, der:
  • kan skabe ro – også når situationen bliver presset
  • kan balancere relation og struktur
  • arbejder fagligt og reflekteret
  • tager ansvar for det, de siger ja til
  • kan samarbejde og indgå i en eksisterende praksis
  • møder mennesker med respekt og ordentlighed
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt og søge sparring, når det er nødvendigt

Du skal ikke være perfekt.
Men du skal være ansvarlig. Er du den fagperson

Hvilke opgaver kan du få?
Vi matcher altid opgaven med den medarbejder, der har de rette kompetencer og den relevante erfaring.

Det kan blandt andet være:
  • støtte på bosteder, botilbud og institutioner
  • støtte i skole- og specialtilbud
  • 1:1-støtte i hjemmet, skolen eller fritiden
  • ledsagelse
  • aflastning i hjemmet
  • støtte omkring struktur og trivsel i hverdagen
  • længerevarende individuelle støtteforløb

Nogle opgaver kræver bred socialpædagogisk erfaring. Andre kræver en mere specialiseret profil.

Det er netop derfor, vi matcher grundigt. Er du den fagperson

Hos MerCare bliver du valgt til opgaven
Når du bliver en del af MerCare, bliver du ikke bare oprettet i et system og sendt videre.

Vi lærer dig at kende og spørger ind til din erfaring, dine kompetencer og de opgaver, du fungerer bedst i.

Vi tager kun nye medarbejdere ind, når vi kan se et fagligt og menneskeligt match.

For kvalitet må aldrig være tilfældig. Er du den fagperson

Det får du hos os
  • opgaver, der matcher din erfaring og dine kompetencer
  • tæt dialog og opfølgning
  • mulighed for både fleksible opgaver og længerevarende forløb
  • et bureau med rødder i socialpædagogisk praksis
  • mulighed for faglig udvikling og undervisning
  • en organisation, der tager ansvar, også når noget bliver svært Er du den fagperson

Praktisk information
  • Arbejdet foregår primært på Sjælland
  • Opgaver kan ligge dag, aften, nat og weekend
  • Relevant erfaring fra det socialpædagogiske område er et krav
  • Straffe- og børneattest skal kunne godkendes
  • Relevante referencer indhentes inden opstart
  • Dokumentation for uddannelse og kvalifikationer skal foreligge Er du den fagperson

Lyder MerCare som et sted for dig?
Hvis du kan genkende dig selv i det, vi beskriver, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Hos os handler det ikke om at være den, der kan mest.

Det handler om at være den medarbejder, der passer til opgaven – og som vi trygt kan sende ud.

Vi matcher ikke bare opgaver.

Vi matcher mennesker. Er du den fagperson

jobs.title: Senior Support Specialist, Telecom, Location: Danmark - Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Are you technically curious, service-minded, and motivated by helping customers resolve critical technical issues? Do you enjoy combining troubleshooting with coordination and clear communication? If so, this could be your next career opportunity. 

Your position 

As our new Senior Support Specialist, Telecom, you will support the daily operation of our customers communication Systems. You will take ownership of incoming requests, gather the necessary technical information, assess urgency and operational impact, and perform structured troubleshooting. When specialist assistance is required, you will coordinate the correct escalation and ensure that customers remain informed throughout the process.

You are not expected to be the specialist for every system. Your role is to establish a clear overview, perform the agreed initial checks, document findings and decisions, and ensure that each case is resolved.

Your place of work will be at our Global HQ located in Esbjerg in a full-time position. You must be willing and able to participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation according to an agreed schedule.

Your tasks & responsibilities 
Your work will include receiving customer calls and service requests, monitoring tickets and alarms, carrying out remote troubleshooting, and coordinating technical responses. You will maintain technical records, contribute to service reporting and preventive-maintenance activities, and help improve service procedures and documentation.

Your main responsibilities will be to:

  • Manage service tickets from initial request through resolution.
  • Perform troubleshooting and monitor systems through Zabbix or comparable platforms
  • Keep customers informed and ensure that technical findings, communication, and agreed actions are documented accurately


Your profile & qualifications
 
You are service-minded, technically curious, and comfortable taking responsibility. You approach technical issues systematically and communicate clearly with customers and colleagues. You do not need to be a specialist in every system, but you are motivated to investigate issues, perform structured trouble shooting, and coordinate the right technical support.

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you:

  • Have a technical background within telecom, networking or related field
  • Have practical experience with technical troubleshooting and fault handling
  • Strong Microsoft Office software knowledge
  • Are comfortable using ticketing systems and documenting technical findings, customer communication, and agreed actions
  • Communicate clearly in written and spoken English
  • Are willing and able to participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation

Experience with telecom systems such as PABX, TETRA, VHF, AIS, CCTV, PAGA, LTE or Network infrastructure would also be beneficial. General knowledge with, Window, Linux, Proxmox, Zabbix, TOPdesk, or comparable systems, but your technical curiosity and willingness to learn are equally important.

Welcome to Semco Maritime

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too. 

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.  

Care to join the movement?
Change. With us.

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.title: Experienced Massage Therapist – AIRE Ancient Baths Copenhagen
jobs.description:
The role:

As a Massage Therapist in our Copenhagen team, your role is to ensure clients' well-being by performing relaxing and cosmetic treatments following our established protocols. You'll also maintain our relaxation spaces in top condition with all the necessary materials for a perfect AIRE experience.

Key responsibilities:
Customer Experience:

  • Deliver relaxing treatments, including body and facial treatments and exfoliations, following AIRE's protocols and techniques for each.

  • Clearly communicate treatment details and product information to clients, following our provided manual and protocols.

  • Keep an ample supply of necessary products for customer experiences, promptly reporting any shortages or low stock.

  • Maintain consistency in couples' treatments and coordinate effectively with partner therapists for a seamless experience.

Workplace:

  • Keep work areas clean and ready for customer experiences per company protocols.

  • Supervise facility sanitation, product maintenance, and cleaning between treatments.

  • Ensure environmental conditions meet protocol standards for noise, temperature, and humidity.

You'll receive thorough training to explore our diverse range of treatments and truly grasp the essence of AIRE's unique approach.

We're excited to welcome you to our team in Copenhagen and invite you to immerse yourself in the AIRE experience!

Who we are looking for:

  • You have at least one year of experience in a similar role.

  • You hold a valid Massage Therapist course or certification

  • Fluent in English, and if you know Danish, that's a fantastic bonus!

  • You're genuinely customer-focused and excel at connecting with people

  • Your schedule is flexible, allowing you to work evenings, holidays, and weekends when necessary

Why you should join us:

  • Salary: Your hourly salary will be 182DKK

  • Permanent Contract and Working Hours: You will have a permanent contract with 20 hours per week

  • Working days: Friday, Saturday and Sunday.

  • Supplement Pay: You will earn a supplement pay on weekends and holidays

  • Additional Pay Opportunities: You can earn extra pay through tips.

  • Career Progression: Explore career progression opportunities within our Therapists team: Senior Therapist, Supervisor, Manager

  • Pension Contribution: AIRE will contribute to your pension scheme

  • Referral Program: Get rewarded for referring potential colleagues

  • Birthday Gift: Enjoy an AIRE experience on your birthday!

  • Discounts: Benefit from 30% off on all our AIRE experiences

  • Canteen Perks: Access to coffee at our canteen, and fruits on the weekends!

  • Inclusive Work Environment: At AIRE, team spirit is our greatest asset! We are proud to have a welcoming and inclusive work environment where everyone's opinions and backgrounds are heard and respected.

Copenhagen location
You will be delighted with our place in Copenhagen, located in the Carlsberg Byen district, where the former Carlsberg factory has been given a new lease of life and now is part of the magical AIRE atmosphere.

About AIRE:

AIRE Ancient Baths offer a timeless relaxation experience, inspired by ancient Roman, Greek, and Ottoman traditions, set in restored historical buildings in major global cities.

At AIRE, we're delighted to have a global presence with eight established centers in cities such as NYC, Chicago, London, Copenhagen, Barcelona, Sevilla, Almeria, and Vallromanes. Looking ahead, we're excited about our upcoming Upper East Side and Toronto facilities in 2024.

jobs.title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
jobs.description:
Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating.

 

We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you.

 

Duties

 

·       Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients

 

·       Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success

 

·       Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required

 

·       Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services.

 

·       Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines

 

·       Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues

 

·       Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management

 

·       Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment

 

·       Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices

 

·       Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives

 

Our Technology Stack

 

·       Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA

 

·       Documentation – Hudu

 

·       RMM – Intune / Immybot

 

·       Networking – Meraki

 

·       Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365

 

·       Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon

 

·       Door Access – Avigilon

 

Qualification

 

·       6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support

 

·       Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry

 

·       Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service

 

·       Proven experience leading IT projects

 

·       A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications

 

·       Background in providing direct end-user support

 

·       High level of attention to detail

 

·       Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 

·       IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent)

 

·       Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents

 

Our Core Values

 

Dream Big, Then Make it Real

 

We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard.  Do, rather than talk and tell.

 

Client Driven Results

 

Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results.  When they succeed, we succeed.

 

Own Your Progress

 

We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes.  Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution.

 

We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

jobs.title: MONTER/KA III (821206) U ODJELU STROJARSKOG ODRŽAVANJA
jobs.description:
Uvjeti (potrebna znanja i kvalifikacije) koje kandidati moraju zadovoljiti za navedeno radno mjesto su:

• SSS/KV – strojarskog ili metalskog smjera • 2 godine radnog iskustva • vozačka dozvola B kategorije

Opis poslova radnog mjesta:

• sudjeluje u svim monterskim radovima na terenu i u radionici; izmjeni crpnih agregata, izmjeni zaporno - regulacijske armature (zasuni, hidrostopovi, leptirice ručne i elektro-mot.), rekonstrukcije cijelih strojarnica, komora, objekata, generalnih popravaka crpnih agregata, kompresora i ostalih strojeva, utovar i istovar crpnih agregata i ostale opreme uz pomoć dizalice na kamion • sudjeluje u izmjeni, montaži i demontaži svih vrsta cijevnih instalacija, ventila, uređaja i opreme vezane uz objekte crpljenja • vrši izradu raznih konstrukcija, pomoćnih naprava, bravarskih radova na izradi fazonskih komada, upora i sl. • samostalno izvodi popravke i remonte crpnih agregata i ostalih pomoćnih uređaja manjih kapaciteta i gabarita • po potrebi, sudjeluje u radovima na održavanju hidroforskih postrojenja • obavezan je odazvati se na poziv dispečera poradi intervencije i izvan radnog vremena

Izabrani kandidati obavljat će poslove radnog mjesta MONTER III (821206) u Odjelu strojarskog održavanja, temeljem ugovora o radu na neodređeno vrijeme s probnim radom u trajanju od 6 (šest) mjeseci. Mjesto rada je u Zagrebu.

Uz predaju ponude koja sadrži kontakt podatke (broj telefona ili mobitela, e-mail adresa) kandidati trebaju obvezno priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta, kako slijedi:

• životopis s opisom dosadašnjeg rada • dokaz o odgovarajućem stupnju obrazovanja u skladu s uvjetima iz javnog natječaja (presliku svjedodžbe, odnosno rješenje o priznavanju inozemne stručne kvalifikacije koju je izdalo nadležno tijelo) • dokaz o radnom iskustvu (elektronički zapis/potvrda o radnom stažu Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje ne stariji od 7 dana od dana prijave na natječaj) • presliku važeće vozačke dozvole • uvjerenje da se ne vodi kazneni postupak (ne starije od 3 mjeseca od dana objave natječaja)

Ponude na javni natječaj podnose se elektroničkim putem. Rok za dostavu tražene dokumentacije je 14 dana od dana objave, na adresu elektroničke pošte:

vio.karijera@zgh.hr

S naznakom „Za javni natječaj za radno mjesto MONTER III (821206) u Odjelu strojarskog održavanja“.

Urednom ponudom smatra se ponuda koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u javnom natječaju. Nepotpune i nepravodobno pristigle ponude neće se razmatrati.

Kandidati koji zadovoljavaju tražene uvjete iz natječaja, bit će upućeni na daljnji selekcijski postupak koji uključuje, prema potrebi, pisano testiranje (testovi općeg znanja, stručnih znanja, opće pismenosti, informatičke pismenosti i sl., psihologijsko testiranje i dr.) i/ili intervju.

Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima dužni su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu te imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidati koji se pozovu na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskoga rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine, br. 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), a u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjavaju uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na javni natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz javnog natječaja i dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju.

Popis dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju nalazi se na internetskoj stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf

Kandidati koji se pozovu na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj 84/21 i 13/26) a u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjavaju uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na javni natječaj priložiti i sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz javnog natječaja i dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju. Popis dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju nalazi se na internetskoj stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf

Kandidati koji se pozovu na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine, br. 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13 i 98/19), uz prijavu na javni natječaj dužni su, uz dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz javnog natječaja, priložiti rješenje ili potvrdu o priznatom statusu, izjavu da do sada nisu koristili pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju po toj osnovi te dokaz iz kojeg se vidi na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (rješenje, ugovor, sporazum i sl.).

Kandidati koji se pozovu na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 9. jobs.title: Senior Network Security Engineer (m/f/d) (Netzwerkadministrator/in)
jobs.employer: DP World Logistics Germany B. V. & Co. KG
jobs.description:
ABOUT DP WORLD

Trade is the lifeblood of the global economy, creating opportunities and improving the quality of life for people around the world. DP World exists to make the world’s trade flow better, changing what’s possible for the customers and communities we serve globally.

With a dedicated, diverse and professional team of more than 120,000 employees spanning 75 countries on six continents, DP World is pushing trade further and faster towards a seamless supply chain that’s fit for the future.

We’re rapidly transforming and integrating our businesses -- Ports and Terminals, Marine Services, Logistics and Technology – and uniting our global infrastructure with local expertise to create stronger, more efficient end-to-end supply chain solutions that can change the way the world trades.

What's more, we're reshaping the future by investing in innovation. From intelligent delivery systems to automated warehouse stacking, we’re at the cutting edge of disruptive technology, pushing the sector towards better ways to trade, minimising disruptions from the factory floor to the customer’s door.

WE MAKE TRADE FLOW
To Change What's Possible For Everyone

SENIOR NETWORK SECURITY ENGINEER (M/F/D)

Lódz, Poland | Hybrid (3-4 days onsite)

DP World, one of the world's leading logistics providers, is looking for a Senior Network Security Engineer (m/f/d) to join our European Network team in Lódz.

In this role, you will take ownership of our network security landscape across Europe, ensuring the stability, security, and continuous improvement of critical network infrastructure. You will act as a subject matter expert for network security technologies, work closely with Information Security and global IT teams, and support projects across multiple European locations. Please note that regular travel within Europe and occasional out-of-hours work are required.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

* Own and continuously improve the network security environment across Europe.
* Administer and enhance the Forescout NAC and network segmentation platform.
* Design, implement, and support secure LAN, WAN, Wireless, SD-WAN, and Firewall solutions.
* Manage Check Point and Palo Alto firewalls, IPS technologies, and vulnerability remediation activities.
* Collaborate with Information Security teams on threat detection, investigations, and security improvements.
* Support network projects end-to-end, including design, implementation, testing, documentation, and operational support.

YOUR PROFILE

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 7+ years of experience in enterprise network installation, configuration, and support.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with Forescout or similar NAC/segmentation technologies.
* Strong expertise in Cisco Routing, Switching, Wireless, and enterprise networking.
* Proven experience with Check Point and Palo Alto firewall technologies.
* Fluent English (at least C1), strong troubleshooting skills, and willingness to travel across Europe.

jobs.title: Cloud Security Lead
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



Join us at the forefront of AI and cloud-native security as we work to secure one of the most innovative developer platforms in the world. As the Cloud Security Lead, you will shape the cloud and infrastructure security program that protects millions of developers, enables safe AI-assisted development, and ensures organizations can confidently bring our platform into enterprise environments.

In this role, you will own cloud security across GCP (primary) and supplemental environments in AWS and Azure, as well as containerized systems, SaaS platforms, and our multi-tenant AI infrastructure. You’ll improve our security posture through strong architecture, posture management, secure-by-default development practices, and close partnership with Engineering, Compliance, Security Architecture, and Platform teams.

This is a highly impactful, hands-on leadership role—perfect for someone who wants to solve complex security challenges at scale while influencing product, engineering, and go-to-market teams.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:


CLOUD SECURITY ENGINEERING

 - Lead configuration hardening across GCP, with additional oversight of workloads and integrations running in AWS and Azure.

 - Own and optimize CSPM platforms across multi-cloud environments—establishing configuration baselines, guardrails, and remediation workflows.

 - Secure critical SaaS platforms, ensuring proper configurations, access controls, and engineering integrations.

 - Lead infrastructure vulnerability management across multi-cloud systems, containers, registries, and platform services.

 - Enhance security across containerized and Kubernetes (GKE/EKS/AKS) workloads, including runtime protections, network policies, and workload identity.

 - Assess secure logging configurations across cloud/SaaS providers, ensuring audit logs, retention, and routing meet monitoring and architecture needs.
   


SECURE DEVELOPMENT & ARCHITECTURE ENABLEMENT

 - Partner with engineering teams to make services secure by default, embedding security into development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native deployments.
   


CROSS-FUNCTIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Collaborate with Security Monitoring, Compliance/GRC, Architecture, DevOps, Platform Engineering, and ML Infrastructure.

 - Participate in communicating security advisories, best practices, and updates to Replit’s customers.

 - Support incident investigations as a cloud security subject-matter expert.




REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:

 - 7+ years of experience in cloud engineering, with 3+ years in a senior or lead role.

 - Hands-on experience with CSPM tools (Wiz, Lacework, Prisma, Orca, SCC, etc.).

 - Deep expertise in GCP security (IAM, VPC, KMS, GKE, Cloud Logging).

 - Experience securing and governing SaaS platforms and identity integrations.

 - Operational experience with infrastructure vulnerability management across cloud and container environments.

 - Working knowledge of AWS and/or Azure security services and configurations.

 - Experience with container and Kubernetes security across GKE, EKS, or AKS.

 - Strong IaC security experience with Terraform, Pulumi, or similar tooling.

 - Familiarity with compliance standards (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS).




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Experience supporting engineering teams in building secure-first, cloud-native or PaaS environments.

 - Background securing AI/ML pipelines, model-serving infrastructure, or developer platform services.

 - Experience in high-growth technology or cloud-native product companies.

 - Experience with securing AI/agentic systems and sensitive data pipelines.

 - Automation/scripting with Python.

 - Relevant certifications (e.g., GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer, AWS/Azure security certs).
   
   


WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Problem-solving mindset — Ability to break down complex security and operational challenges into clear engineering solutions.

 - Autonomy — Comfortable leading initiatives, collaborating effectively,  and driving outcomes with minimal oversight.

 - Communication excellence — Able to translate deep technical concepts for engineers, executives, and enterprise customers.

 - Continuous learning — Passion for staying current with AI security, cloud-native advances, and emerging threats.

 - Automation-first approach — Belief in reducing operational toil and building scalable, self-healing systems.



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

jobs.title: Underviser i robotteknologi til Absalons ingeniør-uddannelser - genopslag
jobs.description:
Click for version in English

Vil du være med til at opbygge en ny engelsksproget diplomingeniøruddannelse i robotteknologi? Brænder du for at udvikle en ny uddannelse i tæt samarbejde med dygtige og engagerede kolleger, studerende og lokale virksomheder? Så kan det være dig, vi står og mangler til vores studerende på diplomingeniøruddannelserne og ved efter- og videreuddannelsen i Automation og Drift.

På Absalon får du mulighed for at kombinere din erfaring fra robot-, automations- eller maskinområdet med undervisning. Samtidig sætter du dit faglige aftryk på uddannelsens indhold, laboratorier og samarbejde med industrien.

Absalon etablerer i september 2027 en ny engelsksproget diplomingeniøruddannelse i robotteknologi. Uddannelsen har fokus på integration af robot- og automationsløsninger og en forståelse for helheden i det produktionssystem, hvor løsningen skal indgå. Diplomingeniøruddannelse i robotteknologi indgår i tæt sammenhæng med diplomingeniøruddannelsen i maskinteknologi samt efter- og videreuddannelsen på akademiniveau i Automation og Drift.

På ingeniøruddannelserne er det vores ambition at uddanne de bedste ingeniører i Danmark. Vi målretter vores uddannelse til arbejdsmarkedet ved at samarbejde tæt med den danske automations-, maskin- og procesindustri samt virksomheder og andre aktører i Biotekbyen Kalundborg og i Campus Kalundborgsamarbejdet. Læs meget mere her. https://www.biotekbyen.dk/

Din profil
Vi søger en underviser, der brænder for at uddanne inden for grænseområdet mellem robotteknologi, automation, produktionsstyring og maskinteknologi. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du kan genkende dig selv i nedenstående:

Dygtig og motiverende underviser, der er engageret i de studerende. Du bidrager sammen med dine kolleger til at skabe et aktivt, fagligt og socialt studiemiljø. Det er vigtigt, at du kan bidrage positivt til den nære faglige relation, vi har mellem undervisere og studerende.

Medvirker til at få det faglige, det praktiske og samarbejdet til at fungere godt. Vi er mere end en arbejdsplads, og du skal ligesom os, være drevet af et stærkt kammeratskab og en fælles faglig interesse. Du sparrer med din kolleger omkring din undervisning, og sammen finder vi løsninger på praktiske opgaver.

Du har desuden nemt ved at indgå i dialog med virksomheder, både i forhold til muligheder for efter- og videreuddannelse og hvad angår samarbejde med studerende på diplomingeniøruddannelserne.

Du har lyst til at indgå i et arbejdsfællesskab og være med til at etablere en ny uddannelse. Vi opbygger og udvikler løbende vores ingeniøruddannelser, og meget skal gøres for første gang. Du får en central rolle i beskrivelsen og opbygningen af den nye uddannelse i robotteknologi og automation. Du skal bl.a. være med til at indrette og skaffe det rette udstyr til kommende robot- og automationslaboratorier.

Din ingeniørfaglighed kommer i spil når du skal undervise, vejlede og sparrer med kolleger inden for dele af følgende områder:
  • Integration og programmering af industrirobotter, f.eks. Universal robots, ABB, KUKA, FANUC
  • Industri 4.0
  • Siemens TIA-portal
  • Industrielle netværk
  • Vision-systemer og sensorteknologi
  • Sikkerhedssystemer og cyber security
  • CE-mærkning og gældende standarder for fagområdet
  • Integration af AI i robot- og automationsløsninger
  • PLC-, HMI- og SCADA-løsninger
  • CAD og 3D print

Derudover forventer vi os, at du:
  • har en baggrund som ingeniør, det kan f.eks. være robot-/automationsingeniør, produktionsingeniør, elektroingeniør, maskiningeniør eller lignende
  • har relevant erhvervserfaring inden for ingeniørfaget
  • kan undervise på engelsk og gerne også på dansk
  • gerne er lektorbedømt
  • har indsigt i industriens behov for ingeniørkompetencer inden for robot og automationsområdet. Det er ikke et krav, men vil det være en fordel.

Dine arbejdsopgaver
Som underviser på diplomingeniøruddannelserne og ved Automation og Drift har du en række forskellige opgaver i løbet af en arbejdsuge.

Opbygge en uddannelse. Du har interesse i at spille en central rolle i etablering af ny uddannelse inden for robotteknologi og eventuelt have en koordinerende rolle i beskrivelse af uddannelsen, udarbejdelse af studieordning, etablering af studenter-, og virksomhedsnetværk samt indkøb af udstyr og indretning af laboratorium. Har du erfaring med og interesse i enkelte administrative opgaver vil det være en fordel.

Undervise og projektvejlede studerende. Du skal primært undervise og vejlede vores studerende både teoretisk og laboratorie- og projektbaseret inden for dine fagområder. Du skal selv tilrettelægge, gennemføre og evaluere undervisningen. Du skal også være med til løbende at udvikle vores undervisning.

Undervise på efter- og videreuddannelse (EVU) og på grunduddannelse. Du skal undervise studerende på fuldtidsstudium såvel som kursister med et fuldtidsarbejde ved siden af deres uddannelse på EVU. Til undervisningen på EVU kan der også være opgaver med opsøgende kontakt til virksomheder og præsentation af uddannelsesudbud.

Fagligt samarbejde som en del af hverdagen. Du bliver en del af et fagligt fællesskab, hvor du sparrer og samarbejder med dine kolleger. Sammen sørger I f.eks. for at tilrettelægge gode undervisningsforløb, udvikle undervisningsmaterialer, og måske er der et arrangement tilknyttet centret, som skal stables på benene.

Undervisningen på de forskellige uddannelsesudbud vil fortrinsvis være på vores Campus Kalundborg, men på EVU-området kan der forekomme undervisning på Absalons campus i Roskilde. Du skal være forberedt på, at noget undervisning kan foregå i weekend eller på aftener.

Dine kolleger
Du bliver ansat i Centre for Engineering and Science, som driver uddannelserne Bioanalytiker, Radiograf, Diplomingeniør i bioteknologi, Diplomingeniør i maskinteknologi samt efter- og videreuddannelserne Diplomuddannelse i bioteknologi, Procesteknologi og kemi, Akademiuddannelse i Automation og Drift samt Akademiuddannelse i Innovation, produkt og produktion.

Du bliver en del af et team med uddannelsesleder, adjunkter og lektorer. På vores ingeniøruddannelser i Kalundborg er vi ca. 20 ansatte undervisere. Vi arbejder på at skabe den bedste ingeniøruddannelse i tæt samarbejde med biotekindustrien i Nordvestsjælland, samt vores engagerede studerende. Vi værdsætter høj faglighed og løser opgaver, samt udfordringer i fællesskab, hvor vi alle er bevidste om vigtigheden af at bidrage til fællesskabet og til centrets samlede målsætning.

Vi holder til i nybygget campusbygning fra 2021 og i nabobygningen Helix Lab. Absalon er desuden med i Campus Kalundborginitiativet, hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen med fem andre uddannelsesinstitutioner, og fra 2028 vil vi være en del af et nyt fælles Campus Kalundborg-byggeri.

Der kan blive tale om ansættelse som lektor Du bedes tilkendegive i din ansøgning, hvilken type ansættelse du søger.

Sådan ansøger du
Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst på statens område.
  • For dig der er nyuddannet og ansættes som adjunkt, vil en forventet startløn være 41.232,- kr. inkl. pension.For dig der er en erfaren underviser og ansættes som lektor, vil en forventet startløn være 53.537,- kr. inkl. pension.Der er mulighed for at forhandle et kvalifikationstillæg på baggrund af kvalifikationer og erfaring.
  • Stillingen er på fuld tid med ansættelse pr. 1. januar 2027, meget gerne før
  • Hvis du har nogen spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte uddannelsesleder Jesper Stensbo Knudsen, jesk@pha.dk, 7248 3224
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem her: https://phabsalon.dk/job-i-absalon/ledige-stillinger, eller ved at klikke på 'Søg stillingen' til højre på denne side senest den 15. november 2026
  • Vi forventer at afholde samtaler løbende, dog senest i uge 47 og 48.

Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen.

For stillingen gælder det, at du ansættes som adjunkt eller lektor alt efter dine kvalifikationer.
På Absalon er adjunkturet en 4-årig uddannelsesstilling. Det understøtter vi gennem Absalons lektorkvalificeringsforløb, som alle nyansatte adjunkter deltager i, og hvor alle får tilknyttet en vejleder. For at blive ansat som lektor forudsætter det en positiv lektorbedømmelse inden for stillingstrukturens anvendelsesområde.

Ved ansættelse af lektorer, der er lektorbedømt før 2013-stillingsstrukturen, sker ansættelse på hidtidige centralt fastsatte løn- og ansættelsesvilkår. Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer, afvejet med stillingens konkrete indhold, kan fornyet lektorbedømmelse efter den aktuelle stillingsstruktur (fast-track ordningen) eventuelt aftales. Læs mere her i kap. 5: https://www.retsinformation.dk/eli/lta/2020/673

Du kan læse mere om rammerne for ansættelse som adjunkt eller lektor i vores stillingsstruktur her: https://www.retsinformation.dk/eli/lta/2021/1458

Om Absalon
Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for.

I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder.

Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner - og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund.

jobs.title: Account Executive, Enterprise
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 25,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America and Europe, and now expanding across Asia Pacific. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Over the past few years, Linear has experienced incredible organic growth and has become the default tool of choice for many of the world’s best product teams. We are now layering a product-led sales motion on top of our existing self-serve business to further accelerate our ambitions and bring the magic of Linear to even more and larger companies. You’ll play an instrumental role in defining our enterprise sales motion, contribute to the future of our product, and help high-impact companies build better software.

Location & work mode

While Linear is a remote-first company across the US and Europe, this role in APAC is office based 2–3 days per week, as this role will be closely connected to in-person collaboration with our growing sales presence in the region.

What you'll do

 - Become a product expert and help customers use Linear effectively; assist prospects through the trial and evaluation phase

 - Generate a strong pipeline and exceed quarterly targets

 - Stay up to date with our product offering, industry trends, competitive landscape, and market trends to continuously adapt sales strategies and approaches for maximum impact

 - Build relationships with key stakeholders within accounts; understand client needs deeply, align Linear’s solutions to business objectives + shape decision criteria. Effectively communicate and align our value proposition to decision-makers

 - Be the voice of the customer; advocate for customers by surfacing product or adoption blockers to our product team

 - Help build the foundation and define our enterprise sales process

Requirements

 - 3+ years selling to the enterprise, and 7+ years in a quota-carrying sales role

 - Experience selling a technical product to both engineering and product leadership; bonus if you have experience selling collaboration or project management software

 - SaaS and startup experience; comfortable working and adapting in a fast-paced and flexible environment

 - Ability to understand complex client needs, craft tailored discovery, and drive sales through consultative approaches.

 - Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, and product demonstration skills

 - Highly autonomous with a bias for action. Owner’s mindset to quickly come up to speed on product, market, ICP, and unique differentiators.

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

jobs.title: Security Engineer - Incident Response
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Security Engineer with deep incident response experience to help defend Replit, a fast-moving, cloud-native AI vibe-coding platform. You'll be the person who takes charge when something goes wrong. You'll lead investigations from first signal to root cause, coordinate containment across Security, SRE, and Engineering, and keep stakeholders informed while the incident is moving fast.

This isn't a pure responder role. We want a well-rounded security engineer who has run real incidents and wants to make the next one faster. You'll write the scripts, automations, and tooling that take manual work out of triage, evidence collection, and containment. You'll also turn lessons from each incident into better detections, playbooks, and platform hardening.

 


RESPONSIBILITIES

Incident Response

 - Serve as incident commander or technical lead for security incidents, from detection and triage through containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review.

 - Coordinate response across Security, SRE, Engineering, Legal, and leadership. Drive decisions under pressure and keep a clear record of actions taken.

 - Communicate incident status, impact, and risk clearly to technical and executive audiences.

 - Participate in and help shape the security on-call rotation.


Investigation & Forensics

 - Investigate suspicious activity across cloud infrastructure, containers, identity systems, and application layers using SIEM, Cloud Logging, telemetry, and host and container artifacts.

 - Determine scope, root cause, attacker behavior, and blast radius for confirmed incidents.

 - Quickly assess whether emerging threats (0-days, active exploitation campaigns, bug bounty findings, customer reports) apply to Replit, and whether we're already affected.


IR Automation & Tooling

 - Build scripts, automations, and tools (Python, Go, Bash, or directly on Replit) that speed up response, such as automated enrichment, evidence collection, credential and session revocation, workload isolation, and alert triage.

 - Develop and maintain response playbooks and runbooks, and automate them where possible.

 - Integrate response workflows with SIEM, SOAR, ticketing, and chat tooling to cut time-to-contain.



Detection & Continuous Improvement

 - Turn incident findings into new or improved detections, logging coverage, and visibility.

 - Lead blameless post-incident reviews and drive remediation items to completion.

 - Run tabletop exercises and simulations to test readiness and find gaps.

 


REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - Proven experience leading or serving as technical lead on security incidents in a cloud or SaaS environment.

 - Strong hands-on investigation skills with SIEM, cloud audit logs, and log-based analysis. Comfortable working through large datasets under time pressure.

 - Proficiency writing production-quality scripts or tools in Python, Go, or Bash for investigation and automation.

 - Solid knowledge of cloud architecture and security, especially Google Cloud Platform (IAM, audit logging, GKE, networking).

 - Working knowledge of Kubernetes and containers, including how to investigate and contain compromised workloads.

 - Understanding of identity systems, SaaS architectures, and common cloud attack paths (credential theft, privilege escalation, supply chain, token abuse).

 - Familiarity with software engineering fundamentals, CI/CD pipelines, and package ecosystems, so you can work effectively with Engineering on code-level fixes.

 - Understanding of IR frameworks and lifecycle (for example NIST 800-61), plus the vulnerability lifecycle and exploitability analysis.

 


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience building or operating SOAR or other response automation platforms.

 - Digital forensics experience with cloud, Linux hosts, or containers.

 - Experience with threat intelligence, threat hunting, or security research.

 - Experience with bug bounty programs or coordinated vulnerability disclosure.

 - Familiarity with detection-as-code practices and writing detection rules.

 - Experience in fast-paced, cloud-native, or AI/ML-driven environments.

 - Relevant certifications (such as GCIH, GCFA, GCFR), or equivalent hands-on experience.
   


WHAT WE VALUE

 - Curiosity & initiative: Strong desire to understand attacker behaviors, emerging threats, and how they apply to real-world systems.
   

 - Speed & analytical rigor: Ability to quickly assess high-risk vulnerabilities with clear, evidence-based reasoning.
   

 - Collaboration: Comfort working across cross-functional teams spanning Security, SRE, Engineering, and Infrastructure.
   

 - Clear communication: Ability to explain findings, risks, and mitigation strategies to stakeholders at all levels.
   

 - Ownership mindset: Takes initiative to drive investigations, improvements, and remediations to completion.
   

 - Continuous learning: Passion for staying up to date on new vulnerabilities, exploit trends, and cloud-native security best practices.
   





Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

jobs.title: Office Assistant
jobs.description:
Work tasks: The Role:
Dal’s Kitchen is looking for an organised and proactive Office & Food Safety Assistant to support our CEO and daily office operations while helping maintain our food-safety and BRCGS compliance systems. This is a varied position divided between office and executive-assistant duties and food-safety administration and internal auditing. It is suitable for someone who is highly organised, comfortable working with documents and systems, and interested in developing a career within food manufacturing and quality management. Office responsibilities: • Provide general administrative support to the CEO and wider management team. • Manage the CEO’s diary, appointments, meetings and reminders. • Organise meetings, prepare agendas, take minutes and follow up on agreed actions. • Maintain accurate customer, distributor and supplier information in the company CRM. • Prepare and issue customer invoices, credit notes and supporting documentation. • Monitor outstanding invoices and coordinate payment follow-ups. • Conduct research for the CEO, including suppliers, customers, distributors, competitors, logistics providers and new markets. • Prepare reports, presentations, spreadsheets and business correspondence. • Manage office documents, digital filing and confidential company information. • Coordinate travel arrangements, visits and external meetings when required. • Assist with purchasing, quotations and communication with service providers. • Support recruitment administration and employee-document management. • Monitor deadlines and ensure important actions are completed on time. Food-safety responsibilities • Support the implementation and maintenance of the Dal’s Kitchen food-safety and quality-management system. • Help maintain BRCGS, HACCP, food-safety, quality and operational records. • Plan, conduct and document scheduled internal food-safety and BRCGS audits. • Support external BRCGS and customer audits by preparing documentation, evidence and follow-up information. • Maintain the internal audit schedule and monitor completion against deadlines. • Record non-conformities and coordinate corrective and preventive actions with responsible team members. • Follow up corrective actions and verify that they have been completed effectively. • Assist with document control, including procedures, work instructions, forms and records. • Review production, cleaning, temperature, traceability, allergen and hygiene records for completeness. • Support traceability exercises, product-recall tests and other compliance checks. • Assist with supplier approval, specifications, certificates and food-safety documentation. • Monitor staff training records and help organise refresher training. • Report food-safety concerns, overdue actions and compliance risks to the CEO. • Help ensure the site remains prepared for announced and unannounced audits. BRCGS Food Safety Issue 9 provides a framework covering product safety, integrity, legality, quality and operational controls within food manufacturing; official certification is completed by an independent certification body, while this position would conduct internal audits and support certification audits.

We offer: What we offer
• A varied position with direct involvement in business operations and food safety. • The opportunity to work closely with the CEO and gain experience across multiple business functions. • Practical exposure to BRCGS, HACCP and food-manufacturing compliance. • Training and development relevant to the position. • The opportunity to grow with Dal’s Kitchen as the company develops. • Salary based on experience and qualifications.

Other requirements: • Väga hea eesti- ning inglise keele oskus, vene keel on eelis, kuid mitte kohustuslik. • Kehtiv B-kategooria juhiluba ja valmisolek regulaarseks reisimiseks Eestis ja välismaal. • Suurepärane suhtlemis-, läbirääkimis- ja esinemisoskus. • Tugev ärisuhete loomise võime ning praktiline, tulemustele orienteeritud tööstiil. • Hea MS Office’i kasutusoskus (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) ning kogemus CRM-i või müügiaruandluse tööriistadega. Positsioon sobib Sulle, kui oled: • Proaktiivne ja iseseisev algataja, kes suudab ise uusi kontakte luua ning oma müügitööd juhtida. • Struktureeritud, usaldusväärne ning valmidus töötama eesmärkide ja KPI-dega. • Kirg toidu vastu ning huvi Aasia köögi trendide vastu Eesti turul. • Meeskonnamängija, kes naudib koostööd kolleegidega müügi-, tootmis- ja turundusvaldkonnas.

Option to work from home: No
