jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact.

You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and customer success planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re a builder who loves helping customers solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role.



This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts, ensuring customers expand their use of Notion and as a result, Notion sees high NRR

 - Partner closely with the Solutions Consultant on account strategy for expansion and renewal, including owning the renewal opportunity for flat and at-risk customers

 - Shape customer outcomes, strengthen executive and team-level partnerships, and contribute directly to predictable revenue through retention, renewal, and expansion impact

 - Design and deploy workflows that solve specific business problems as a build-beside partner to the customer, translating goals into durable systems in Notion

 - Partner with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, customer planning, and identifying and qualifying expansion opportunities within existing accounts

 - Co-define, build, and manage against customer success plans that help every customer achieve their desired objectives and realize measurable value

 - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be the best build-beside partner for customers navigating new ways of working

 - Innovate and iterate on Outcomes Architect programs that retain and grow customers while mitigating churn or contraction risk




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment

 - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans

 - Technical fluency and genuine comfort building live in software—you can co-design, configure, and troubleshoot with customers in the room

 - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy

 - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working

 - Fluency in English and Italian




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path

 - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based models and the ability to connect adoption patterns to commercial outcomes

 - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams

 - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. jobs.title: Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

The Data team works across Linear, supporting Product, Engineering, and GTM. We own our data pipelines, warehouse, dashboards, analysis, and integrations with third-party tools. As a small team, we focus on building systems that make data accessible and useful across Linear. We’re looking for someone who wants to help shape how we architect, build, and use data as we grow.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in North America. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you’ll do

 - Work across Product and GTM (Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Finance) to turn ambiguous questions and operational needs into useful metrics, models, analyses, and workflows

 - Build and maintain dbt models and pipelines that create trusted views of our product, customers, and business

 - Design clear, maintainable data models and improve the testing, documentation, performance, and reliability of our data stack

 - Build dashboards and self-service reporting in Metabase and Hex, and dig deeper when the answer requires more than a chart

 - Operationalize data through reverse ETL and partner with GTM Engineering on the scoring, segmentation, automations, and internal tools that help our teams scale

 - Balance fast, pragmatic answers with durable solutions, recognizing when a one-off request should become a reusable model or workflow

 - Find ways to leverage emerging tools, LLMs, and coding agents to accelerate development, analysis, testing, and documentation while maintaining a high bar for correctness

What we're looking for

 - 8+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data analytics, or data engineering, ideally at a fast-moving software company

 - Exceptional SQL and strong hands-on experience with dbt and a modern cloud data warehouse

 - Track record of owning data projects end-to-end, from shaping an ambiguous problem to shipping something people rely on

 - Strong data modeling judgment: you think clearly about grain, reusable components, interfaces, dependencies, and maintainability without relying on a single prescribed methodology

 - Analytical judgment: you know when to answer quickly, when to investigate deeply, and how to turn complex findings into a clear recommendation

 - Comfortable moving between technical implementation and business context, from debugging a data model to understanding product adoption or sales efficiency

 - High ownership mentality: self-directed, pragmatic, and willing to challenge a request or approach when something does not make sense

 - Strong communication skills and experience partnering directly with both technical and non-technical teams

 - Comfortable using LLMs and coding agents as part of your day-to-day development workflow

Our tech

This stack reflects the systems you’ll work in. You’re not expected to have experience with everything listed, but you should be comfortable learning quickly and working across the full lifecycle of data.

 - Data Warehouse: Snowflake, dbt Cloud

 - Dashboards / Analysis: Metabase, Hex

 - ETL / rETL: Hevo, Fivetran

 - GTM tools: Hubspot, Pocus, Clay

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

jobs.title: Production Designer
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

We’re looking for a Designer with strong visual taste to help scale Linear’s creative work across web, brand, and marketing. You’ll create polished, high-quality designs across a wide range of surfaces — from landing pages and ad campaigns to sales decks and launch materials — helping bring Linear’s visual language to life everywhere people experience our brand.

When it comes to design, we’re looking to work with people who can pick up any problem and solve it. For us, it’s both how it works and how it looks. At its core, Linear is a developer tool where speed, interactions, and small details matter. We expect a broad set of design skills and the ability to create high-quality designs, interactions, and prototypes.

In this role, you will help communicate Linear's story (what we're building and why it matters) as part of our internal creative agency: the Magic Team.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company. This role is open to candidates based in North American or European time zones. You can work from anywhere within those regions. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you'll do

 - Work with Marketing to design landing pages, ad campaigns, sales decks, and launch materials

 - Partner with the Magic Team to extend and scale Linear’s visual language across new campaigns and creative surfaces

 - Collaborate with designers, developers, and copywriters to create cohesive marketing experiences across web, social, and brand

What we're looking for

 - Around 2+ years of experience designing for web, marketing, or brand.

 - Excellent visual, UI, motion and interactive design skills

 - Eye for good design, attention to detail, and a genuine love for the craft

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Learn how we think and work

Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



TEAM

Brand & Creative defines how Replit shows up in the world and leads the creative work that brings it to market. On the Brand side, the function sets company-level direction: defining the brand, shaping the narrative, and establishing how Replit is understood and expressed in the market. On the Creative side, the function leads the planning, development, and execution of creative work across campaigns, launches, events, and major company initiatives; translating strategy into high-quality outputs across every touchpoint. The role focuses on core brand foundations and their application across key surfaces, including product and marketing. jobs.title: Business Development Representative, France
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is rebuilding its go-to-market motion around a workflow-first, builder-led model—and the BDR is at the front of it. As a Business Development Rep, you'll be the force that turns the right accounts into the right conversations. You'll partner closely with Solutions Consultants to identify and target companies that are ready to rethink how they work—and your job is to get them in the room. This isn't generic pipeline work: you're qualifying for workflow-first, build-ready opportunities that set SCs up to win. If you're competitive, curious, and energized by outbound that actually means something, this is the role for you.



This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Generate qualified, workflow-first pipeline by identifying and targeting high-potential accounts in your assigned book, partnering with your sellers on account and outbound strategy

 - Run multi-channel outbound campaigns—email, phone, LinkedIn, and events—to create urgency and secure first meetings with the right decision-makers

 - Conduct initial qualification to ensure meetings handed to sellers are "ready to build," not just "ready to talk"—validating ICP, intent, and workflow fit before the handoff

 - Document and deliver clean handoff packets in Salesforce with ICP signals, pain points, workflow hypothesis, and stakeholder context so sellers can hit the ground running

 - Leverage GTM System tooling and intent data to sharpen targeting, prioritize accounts by signal strength, and increase the quality and consistency of your outbound motion




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Proven track record in outbound pipeline generation, with hands-on experience in cold prospecting across phone, email, and social channels

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to craft compelling, persona-specific outreach that earns a response

 - Sharp qualification instincts—able to quickly assess ICP fit, identify urgency, and set solutions consultants up for high-quality first conversations

 - Passion for AI/ML and understanding of API-first or consumption-based business models

 - High-activity mindset with the discipline to prioritize based on signal and data, not just volume

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - Fluency in French.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience with Salesforce, Outreach, or similar GTM tooling

 - Familiarity with Notion as a product or prior experience selling productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Background in a high-velocity, metric-driven outbound environment with clear pipeline targets

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €70,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy.

You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role.

 


WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE

 - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline.

 - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path.

 - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate.

 - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps.

 - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature.

 


SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING

 - 1-3 years of Experience in selling technical products to technical buyers

 - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles.

 - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room.

 - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working.

 - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria.

 - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve.

 - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles.

 - Native or bilingual-level Korean fluency and business-level English proficiency

 


NICE TO HAVES

 - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions.
   
   - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals.

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion.

The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role.



This role will be based in Munich, Germany. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the commercial performance of your team across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, and UBP outcomes—accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them

 - Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off

 - Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion—driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met

 - Partner with the regional BDR manager on pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, and qualification standards to ensure the team's book of business is healthy and growing

 - Partner with Outcomes leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy—owning the overall commercial arc for the region while collaborating on the execution that follows close

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Track record as a quota-carrying B2B seller with direct experience in workflow design, live demos, or technical sales—you can coach the builder motion because you've run it yourself

 - Frontline sales management experience: built an operating cadence, ran performance management, and developed talent from onboarding through consistent overperformance

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change—not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, and drive urgency across a team without micromanaging individual deals

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - Fluency in English and German.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience selling or managing in a consumption or usage-based business where adoption signals matter as much as closed ARR

 - Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model—able to navigate the SC/CSA hand-offs and hold the commercial arc across the full customer lifecycle

 - Conduct initial qualification to ensure meetings handed to sellers are "ready to build," not just "ready to talk"—validating ICP, intent, and workflow fit before the handoff

 - Document and deliver clean handoff packets in Salesforce with ICP signals, pain points, workflow hypothesis, and stakeholder context so sellers can hit the ground running

 - Leverage GTM System tooling and intent data to sharpen targeting, prioritize accounts by signal strength, and increase the quality and consistency of your outbound motion

 - Proven track record in outbound pipeline generation, with hands-on experience in cold prospecting across phone, email, and social channels

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to craft compelling, persona-specific outreach that earns a response

 - Sharp qualification instincts—able to quickly assess ICP fit, identify urgency, and set solutions consultants up for high-quality first conversations

 - Passion for AI/ML and understanding of API-first or consumption-based business models

 - High-activity mindset with the discipline to prioritize based on signal and data, not just volume

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - Experience with Salesforce, Outreach, or similar GTM tooling

jobs.title: Mobile Product Designer
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires. 

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Quality is our competitive advantage. Every member of our fully remote team is a maker at heart, caring deeply about the quality and feel of our work. While the industry optimizes for speed and metrics alone, we believe that craft and quality have lasting value. Quality creates gravity — it pulls people toward our team and product rather than requiring us to push. This philosophy drives everything we do, from product decisions to hiring choices.

For this role, we expect robust design skills, sharp product thinking, and the ability to engage in technical discussions. We work in small, autonomous project teams, where engineers are paired tightly with designers to explore ideas, build prototypes, deploy internal builds, and ultimately ship to customers. You will be a key element of projects from beginning to end.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in North America. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you'll do

 - Own the experience of our iOS and Android mobile apps, including guiding the adaptation of desktop features to mobile

 - Pair closely with mobile engineers and product leads to initiate and complete mobile-specific projects, no hand-offs

 - Take opportunities to redesign or refine key screens and flows, as well as smaller quality issues and “paper cuts” as you use Linear

 - Create mockups, prototypes, and high-fidelity visuals to communicate ideas and describe their execution

 - Guide and inspire fellow designers through collaborative critique of work-in-progress across both mobile and desktop platforms

 - Use and improve our lightweight design system components

 - Help with hiring new teammates that can elevate our team and product

What we’re looking for

 - 5+ years experience designing software, with mobile-specific emphasis

 - Courage to ask questions, experiment, and advocate for what you feel is right

 - Humility to accept feedback, adapt your thinking, and iterate toward the best solution

 - Experience with prototyping directly in code, or with tools like Figma, Origami, etc

 - Ability to distill problems and feedback, then design clear, focused solutions

 - Effective written and verbal communication skills — much of our work is async

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

jobs.title: Product Engineer, New Products
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Product Engineer, you’ll take emerging ideas from concept to polished experiences. You’ll build sophisticated, intuitive user experiences while working across AI models, agentic workflows, and all parts of web infrastructure to ship complete products.




The Goal: Build products that can define major new categories for Replit. You will combine the flexibility of software with the accessibility of presentations, spreadsheets, dashboards, and visual editors, enabling anyone to create powerful, interactive artifacts through natural language.




The Audience: We build for the next generation of creators, knowledge workers, and high-leverage teams. Our users should be able to turn an idea, dataset, or business problem into a polished, editable, and shareable product just by themselves.

Candidates who thrive here often have the product judgment, technical range, and ownership mindset associated with founders. This is a high-visibility role working closely with product leadership.





HOW WE WORK

Structure: We operate as a collective of in-house technical founders, not narrowly specialized engineers. Initiatives are run by lean, autonomous teams built for velocity and technical leverage. Engineers maintain meaningful ownership over technical direction, product quality, and launch success, supported by Product and Design partners.



Cadence: We work in focused three-week sprints, shipping quickly, observing real user behavior, and incorporating feedback into each iteration. We value decisive execution, thoughtful experimentation, and the ability to make progress without perfectly defined requirements.





WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own major product experiences from initial concept through design, implementation, launch, measurement, and continued improvement

 - Invent and build intuitive interfaces for generating, editing, arranging, and collaborating on AI-created presentations, data applications, and visual artifacts

 - Deliver exceptional frontend experiences across interaction design, typography, layout, motion, accessibility, performance, and error recovery

 - Partner directly with users, Product, Design, and AI engineers to understand real workflows, test ideas, and turn feedback into better products

 - Create reusable editing, visualization, and collaboration primitives that accelerate future products across Replit
   
   
   


REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

 - 4+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong record of shipping high-quality, user-facing products

 - Understanding of the full agentic software development stack, helping coding agents build, test and review correct code

 - Deep experience with TypeScript, React, HTML, and CSS, along with strong knowledge of browser performance, application state, responsive design, and accessibility

 - Strong product judgment and visual taste, with the ability to balance usability, speed, correctness, polish, and long-term maintainability

 - Comfort working across the full stack, including Node.js, APIs, Postgres, data models, and production debugging

 - Familiarity with agentic software development and how coding agents build, test, review, and operate software
   
   
   


BONUS POINTS

 - Building visual editors, presentation software, creative tools, data applications, developer tools, or collaboration products

 - Working with canvas or graphics systems, rich text, direct manipulation, real-time collaboration, data visualization, or complex interactive interfaces

 - Designing user experiences around AI generation, streaming responses, tool calls, and long-running agent workflows

 - Founding a technical company, working as a founding engineer, or shipping a high-visibility independent project

These experiences are preferred, but not required. We care most about what you have built, the quality of your product thinking, and your ability to learn quickly.





EXAMPLE PROJECTS YOU’LL WORK ON

 - Building on top of our Replit Slides AI-native presentation product where users can generate beautiful decks, directly edit elements, collaborate with others, and reliably export their work

 - Enable Replit Agent to turn raw datasets and natural-language questions into interactive, trustworthy data applications

 - Design visual tools that make AI-generated work feel as precise, editable, and controllable as traditionally authored content

 - Build reusable editing, visualization, collaboration, and artifact-management systems that power multiple new Replit products

 - Develop feedback loops and evaluations that improve the visual quality of Agent-generated artifacts
   

This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The hybrid role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Business Development
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


Replit is seeking a Senior Business Development Manager to lead and scale our outbound sales development team as we expand our go-to-market efforts. This role will oversee a team of BDRs (Business Development Representatives) proactively targeting and engaging high-potential accounts to build a robust pipeline for our Account Executives.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on outbound prospecting experience and proven leadership skills, a strong understanding of the modern GTM technology, previous experience in creating systems and orchestrating technology to support an efficient & scalable 0->1 outbound workflow, and previous experience collaborating tightly with marketing and sales ops to build highly-targeted account lists and multi-channel outreach sequences. Experience & interest in vibe coding and/or technical experience is highly valued.

This position is critical to our go-to-market strategy, responsible for defining our outbound playbook, identifying key target personas, hiring top-tier talent, coaching team members, and ensuring persistent, high-quality outreach & pipeline generation across all segments from SMB to Enterprise. You'll establish the foundation for scalable revenue growth while architecting a personalized first-touch experience that sets the tone for their Replit journey.

We believe this role offers a distinctive opportunity for proven sales development professionals who excel in both strategic account targeting and team leadership, with a passion for technology and AI. You'll leverage your expertise to build a world-class BDR organization that effectively cuts through the noise to communicate Replit's value proposition: a world where anyone can create software using natural language.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL…

 - Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of Business Development Representatives

 - Develop and implement BDR processes, playbooks, and best practices for cold and warm-outbound channels

 - Coach and mentor BDRs on qualification methodology, objection handling, and pipeline generation techniques

 - Partner with sales leadership to provide feedback on territory assignments, quotas, performance metrics, lead handoff processes

 - Evangelize a future where anyone can create software in natural language, ensuring your team can articulate this vision compellingly

 - Collaborate with marketing and operations to optimize lead routing, provide feedback on campaign effectiveness, and improve lead quality & conversion

 - Analyze team performance data and implement strategies to improve conversion rates and meeting quality

 - Recruit, hire, and onboard new SDR/BDR team members as the organization scales

 - Maintain accountability for team quota attainment and individual BDR development

 - Work closely with Account Executives and AE leaders to ensure smooth handoffs and tight feedback loops

 - Uphold CRM hygiene and reporting accuracy across the SDR organization

 - Stay current on industry trends and competitive landscape to inform team strategy




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 5+ years of sales development experience with at least 3 years in a leadership or management role, preferably some with a technical ICP

 - Proven track record of building and scaling BDR teams, preferably in a high-growth environment

 - Strong individual contributor background with deep understanding of both inbound & outbound prospecting, demand gen strategies, and industry best practices

 - Excellent coaching and mentoring abilities with experience developing junior sales talent

 - Data-driven approach to performance management and process optimization

 - Outstanding written and verbal communication skills

 - Experience with CRM systems and sales tools (e.g., Hubspot/SFDC, LinkedIn, ZoomInfo, Clay, SmartLead, Outreach, Default, etc)

 - Ability to recruit, interview, and assess SDR candidates effectively

 - Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, particularly with marketing and sales teams

 - Passion for technology and ability to quickly learn and teach complex technical concepts

 - Experience with or strong interest in AI and machine learning is a plus




NICE TO HAVE:

 - You're an active Replit user

 - You've worked at an early-stage startup or in developer tools

 - Experience building inbound SDR programs from 0-1 and/or scaling from early stage

 - Basic understanding of software development or coding concepts

 - Experience with multi-channel prospecting (email, phone, social)

 - Degree in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent practical experience)




TOOLS + TECH STACK FOR THIS ROLE

 - Replit

 - Hubspot CRM (Salesforce coming soon)

 - ZoomInfo

 - Outreach

 - Gong

 - Chorus

 - Clay

 - SmartLead

 - Nooks

 - Default

 - LinkedIn Sales Navigator

 - Hashboard, Hex
   
   


THIS ROLE MAY NOT BE A FIT IF

 - You're not based in the Salt Lake City area and/or willing to relocate

 - You have no interest in understanding the software development lifecycle or learning basic coding concepts

 - You're not passionate about AI

 - You prefer individual contributor work over people management and team building

 - You're uncomfortable with a fast-paced startup environment where priorities may shift quickly



This is a full-time hybrid role and has an in-office requirement.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)



Want to learn more about what we are up to?

 - Self-driving Company https://replit.com/blog/self-driving-company

 - Replit Agent at Scale https://replit.com/blog/evaluating-and-improving-agent-at-scale

 - AI Adoption https://replit.com/blog/ai-adoption

 - Build Open-Source Apps https://replit.com/build/open-source-app-builder
   
    

Interviewing + Culture at Replit

 - Operating Principles https://blog.replit.com/operating-principles

 - Reasons not to work at Replit https://blog.replit.com/reasons-not-to-join-replit

We welcome your unique perspective and experiences in shaping this product. We encourage people from all kinds of backgrounds to apply, including and especially candidates from underrepresented and non-traditional backgrounds.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is looking for a Head of Demand Engine to build the engine that turns our best product stories, customer proof, and market opportunities into scaled pipeline. You’ll lead demand programs across campaigns, digital, paid strategy, webinars, email, web, and emerging channels. You’ll partner closely with Product Marketing on audience and offer strategy, with Performance Marketing on paid execution, and with Field Marketing & Events on the moments that benefit from in-person activation.




This is a senior leadership role with both AMER and global scope. You’ll help set the global standard for how Notion plans, runs, tests, and measures demand programs, while learning from strong regional teams and making the best ideas repeatable across markets. You’ll lead a growing team spanning demand programs and digital demand, with room to expand into areas like partner marketing over time.




This is a build job as much as a run job. We’re looking for someone with real taste who can spot a strong idea, turn it into a sharp program, and build a repeatable engine around what works. You should care about quality and craft, but also love testing, data, systems, and execution. The opportunity is to modernize demand generation at one of the companies defining how teams work with AI.




This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the demand programs strategy, calendar, and operating rhythm across priority audiences, segments, and offers.

 - Turn strong product stories, content, customer proof, and market opportunities into integrated programs that can scale across channels and regions.

 - Build a high-velocity testing practice. Set a high bar for creative and execution, learn quickly, and put more weight behind what works.

 - Serve as the global point person for paid digital demand strategy. Define the audiences, offers, creative, programs, and goals, then partner closely with Performance Marketing on execution and optimization.

 - Lead digital demand across webinars, email, web, review sites, nurture, and new formats, creating new programs where the strategy calls for them.

 - Partner with Marketing Ops and RevOps to build a trusted global approach to marketing ROI, attribution, forecasting, MQA/MQL methodology, and campaign reporting.

 - Work closely with Enterprise Product Marketing on audience, offer, and campaign strategy, and with Field Marketing & Events on coordinated execution.

 - Help build our muscle in account-based marketing and partner marketing as those motions develop.

 - Be a trusted partner to Sales and executive leadership. Bring a clear point of view, make the numbers legible, and advocate for what will have the most impact.

 - Hire, coach, and lead a strong team across demand programs and digital demand.




WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - A track record of building and scaling B2B demand programs that create qualified pipeline.

 - Strong judgment and taste. You can point to specific programs that worked because the audience, offer, creative, and execution were sharp.

 - Deep digital demand experience across paid strategy, email, web, webinars, nurture, and integrated campaigns.

 - A testing mindset and the operating discipline to turn learnings into repeatable programs, systems, and investment decisions.

 - Comfort with data. You can work closely with Marketing Ops and RevOps on attribution, reporting, forecasting, and ROI, and translate the numbers into clear action.

 - Executive presence. You earn trust with Sales and company leaders, hold a strong point of view, and are comfortable making hard calls.

 - Experience leading and developing strong teams in a fast-moving environment.

 - Experience operating across regions, or genuine curiosity and appetite to build globally.

 - Comfort with ambiguity. This model is still being written, and you’ll help write it.




NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience building account-based marketing programs.

 - Experience with partner or ecosystem marketing.

 - Experience working across both product-led and sales-assisted growth motions.




WHY THIS ROLE

This is one of the most visible, highest-impact seats in Notion’s marketing org. You’ll have the mandate to build the demand engine, shape how we measure marketing ROI globally, and work directly with Sales, RevOps, company leaders, and regional marketing teams.



The playbook for B2B demand generation is changing. Buyers expect better content and experiences, AI is reshaping how programs get built, and old attribution models are under pressure. If you want to apply what already works, challenge what doesn’t, and help define a more modern model, this is the job.




Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $245,000 – $275,000 per year.

You will partner directly with customers to design, build, and launch AI-native workflows that drive adoption, usage, and measurable business outcomes.



This role sits at the center of Notion’s workflow-led GTM motion. You will partner directly with customers to understand their business goals, operating processes, technical environment, governance needs, and adoption barriers, then translate that context into scalable Notion architectures that drive measurable value.



You will be hands-on across discovery, solution design, workspace architecture, workflow build, AI implementation, launch planning, adoption and handoff. You should be comfortable reasoning through technical tradeoffs, designing scalable solutions, and partnering closely with Forward Deployed Engineering when deeper engineering support is required.

 - Partner with customers on forward deployed engagements from discovery through launch, translating business goals and workflow requirements into scalable clear solution design and Notion solutions that drive durable adoption.

 - Design scalable Notion architectures that translate customer workflows, permission and governance needs, integrations and AI use cases into optimal workspaces that are easy to adopt, manage and scale.

 - Design and deploy AI-native workflows using Notion AI, custom agents, automations, Workers, Developer Platform capabilities and adjacent AI tools, partnering with Forward Deployed Engineering when advanced technical depth is needed for migrations, API constraints, security architecture or frontier implementation.

 - Help customers navigate change by designing adoption plans, enablement materials and launch approaches that drive sustained usage and measurable business value.

 - Identify repeatable patterns across customer engagements and convert them into packaged solutions, templates, reference architectures, run books, enablement assets and product feedback.

 - Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, simplifying complex technical requirements, making practical tradeoff recommendations and helping stakeholders align around a clear implementation path.

 - Partner cross-functionally with GTM, Product, Engineering, PMM, Services leadership and the partner ecosystem to scale what works beyond individual customer engagements.

 - Create clear implementation plans, handoff materials and success measures that align customers and internal teams on the path to value.

 - 5+ years of experience in tech services/consulting, solutions architecture, implementation, customer engineering, or a similar customer-facing role.

 - Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer goals into clear workflows, implementation plans, solution architectures, and measurable success criteria.

 - Strong consultative discovery skills, including the ability to map current-state workflows, identify customer pain, understand operating models, surface technical constraints, and define practical future-state solutions.

 - Hands-on AI builder mindset, with experience using AI tools to design, prototype, automate, or improve real business workflows.

 - Technical fluency with APIs, integrations, data models, automation, enterprise systems, developer workflows and implementation tradeoffs. You do not need to write production code but you should be able to reason through technical constraints and troubleshoot effectively.

 - Strong experience delivering implementations that drive adoption, change management and long-term customer value.

 - Strong project and engagement management skills, including ownership of scope, timeline, deliverables, stakeholder alignment, risks, decisions, dependencies and launch readiness.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business, technical, and executive audiences.

 - Strong executive presence and customer judgment, with the ability to build trust, frame tradeoffs clearly, and move ambiguous decisions forward.

 - Bias toward action, high learning velocity, and comfort building in fast-changing AI-native product environments.

 - Written and spoken Japanese fluency to communicate directly with external customers, partners, and internal teams




NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience designing or deploying Agents, automations or AI-powered workflows with Customers.

 - Experience with Notion, APIs, MCPs, Workers, coding agents or developer platform workflows.

 - Experience developing discovery methodologies, reusable delivery assets, internal tooling, packaged services or reference architectures from the ground up.

 - Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to turn field learnings into roadmap signal, reusable architecture patterns or scalable product improvements.

 - Previous experience in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment.

 - Business level English proficiency to communicate effectively with global stakeholders and peers.

 - Experience working with Japanese enterprise customers or familiarity with Japan market dynamics and business practices.

The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. - You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).

-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months

-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)

-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)

-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)

-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)

-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)

-Medical First Aid (STCW VI/4-1)

-Medical Care (STCW VI/4-2)

-GMDSS Radio Operator GOC (STCW IV/2)

-COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2)

-German Endorsement for COC Master Course

-Seafarer's book or the German Seafarer's ID Card

-Excellent and fluent English language skills

-Confidence in decision-making, strong team leading skills, and the ability to cooperate well within a team of volunteers with various levels of nautical experience and skill.

Desired:

- Previous SAR experience
- Italian, French and Arabic language skills

 - Mastery of language, storytelling, and voice, with a proven eye for detail and craft.

 - Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams at the intersection of marketing, product, and design.

 - Ability to drive work from concept to final execution in fast-paced, iterative environments.




NICE TO HAVE:

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Imagine yourself in the 1970s or 80s thinking through how computing should look and feel for people who had never seen one before. That's what we're trying to do at Notion — make software that feels timeless, with the craftsmanship of German cameras, playfulness of Japanese toys, and mass appeal of Coca-Cola. We have no end of fascinating challenges that can only be solved by someone with innate product & UX sense, technical aptitude, great taste, and impeccable craft.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Design product concepts that balance vision, craft, speed, and business potential.

 - Craft every detail of new product features, from idea to UX to pixel-perfect execution.

 - Run projects end to end with engineers to drive your vision to the ship line.

 - Partner closely with our Customer Experience, Sales, and Customer Success teams to understand what each of our diverse user segments need, want, and love about Notion. Use this data and acquired intuition to prioritize, plan, and scope our product roadmap.

 - Work with Marketing to devise new ways to tell great stories throughout the user lifecycle, and across our site, product, help guides and other channels.

 - Create new patterns that are intuitive, practical, and convergent. Evolve our design system intentionally as we scale.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - You have well-rounded skills and experience to run projects independently end to end. 5+ years of working experience.

 - You seek to understand the needs of customers then explore and advocate for the strongest user experiences to solve their problems

 - You enjoy untangling vague conceptual problems and have a sharp intuition for the most accessible mental models and flows, so users can immediately start gaining value out of the product.

 - You create clear, intuitive, and visually appealing human interfaces.

 - You care about business needs, implications, and practicality of your designs. You don't get stuck on pretty UI or deep abstractions and can balance between craft, speed, and the bottom line.

 - You have strong beliefs, loosely held. You're a good listener who collaborates well with different stakeholders. You observe and internalize all inputs and feedback to help you reach an optimal decision.

 - You understand how to tell stories using both words and visuals, and strategize the best ways to drive alignment.

 - You value working cross-functionally with project management, engineering, research and data — as well as design peers.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You've designed and built great tools with small teams in the past.

 - You bring unique strengths and perspectives to the team. We're looking to build a diverse team where our skills and experience can complement each other.

 - You've experienced the pain of fragmented tools and information silos created by them, and have a strong urge to fix it.

 - You're familiar with the work of computing heroes like Douglas Engelbart, Alan Kay, Bret Victor, etc. — and understand why we're big fans.

 - You are a designer who can code!

This full-cycle sales position encompasses new client acquisition. We believe this role offers a distinctive opportunity for people who excel in client-facing situations and have a passion for driving sales and AI. You'll leverage your skills to effectively communicate Replit's value proposition: a world where anyone can create software using natural language.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

We’re hiring a Product Marketing Manager to help shape how Linear’s products are brought to market and understood by customers. This role sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Design, CX, Sales, and Marketing, and is responsible for turning technically sophisticated product work into clear narratives, strong launches, and high-quality customer-facing experiences. You’ll go deep on the product, define positioning and messaging, and drive execution across the surfaces that matter most—from in-product copy and changelogs to enablement, documentation inputs, email, and launch communications. This is a hands-on role for someone who combines product judgment, excellent writing, and strong cross-functional leadership.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in North America and the United Kingdom. You can work from anywhere within these regions. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you’ll do

 - Develop positioning, messaging, and core narratives for feature releases, key launches, and strategic product narratives

 - Partner closely with Product management, Engineering, and Design to refine how products are presented across in-product and external surfaces

 - Create and coordinate launch deliverables such as changelogs, demos, enablement materials, email, social copy, and go-to-market communications

 - Equip Sales, CX, and other customer-facing teams with the context and materials they need to communicate new launches effectively

 - Bring customer insight, product understanding, and market context back into product and launch decisions

What we’re looking for

 - Exceptional writing and editorial judgment, with the ability to make complex ideas feel clear and compelling

 - Strong positioning and messaging skills grounded in customer problems, product truth, and differentiation

 - Great project management skills and ability to track large amounts of detail.

 - Comfort going deep on product details and building credibility with Product, Engineering, and Design

 - Strong judgment, ownership, and the ability to operate autonomously while maintaining a high quality bar

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Learn how we think and work

 - How we work: Designing remote work at Linear https://linear.app/now/designing-remote-work-at-linear

jobs.title: Recruiting Program Manager
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is looking for a Recruiting Program Manager to help design, build, and scale the systems and programs that power how we hire. This is a role for someone who moves fast, takes ownership, and doesn't wait to be told what to do — someone who operates with both strategic altitude and operational precision, and knows how to bring clarity and momentum to complex cross-functional work.



We're at an inflection point in how we think about recruiting at Notion, and this role sits at the center of it. You'll partner closely with Recruiters, Recruiting Operations, People Operations, and senior leadership to drive some of our highest-priority initiatives — building the programs and processes that define how Notion finds, evaluates, and brings in exceptional talent.



This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

The scope of this role will evolve with the team's highest priorities. Some examples of what you might work on:

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Build AI-powered developer experience that makes engineers enabled.

You’ll join our Developer Experience team, united by the mission of “Engineers can do their work quickly, easily, comfortably, and safely.” You’ll be part of a team spanning the US and India that turns ambiguous goals into shippable projects that meaningfully improve developer throughput and reliability.

Your team owns AI experiences, remote and local dev environments, builds and CI, deploys, testing, and verification. You’ll work on a relatively broad scope within a well-resourced team.

This role is based in Hyderabad, India. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - You build an AI harness to auto-resolve bugs reported for the Notion app. This is high-leverage work for the engineering org and requires solid engineering to improve resolution accuracy.

 - You improve CI and build reliability so engineers get early feedback when changes break CI. We’re committed to a 5-minute CI time and are already on track.

 - You improve developer features for our in-house, AI-first remote development environments - helping shape the future of software engineering.

 - You execute a shared roadmap with our US engineering team to increase developer satisfaction and enablement, informed by our DevEx survey.

 - You collaborate with engineers across the company to deliver an industry-leading developer experience, working deeply with tools like the TypeScript language server, lint tooling, and the Notion CLI to improve developers’ day-to-day experience.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - Over 10 years of experience with strong software engineering fundamentals and a track record of turning ambiguous goals into well-scoped, shippable milestones.

 - Leadership: Can create technical roadmap and has a strong ability to plan and execute very large projects. Motivate the team for the goal.

 - Enjoys learning new technologies and has demonstrated innovation through past work.

 - Thrive in ambiguity and can solve business problems through technology.

 - Ownership: Demonstrates strong ownership and accountability for the success of the project and the team.

 - Collaboration: Demonstrates strong communication and collaboration skills. Able to partner with cross-functional teams and engineering teams across time zones.

 - Experience building or operating developer tooling (CI/CD, infrastructure workflows, internal platforms) with a focus on reliability, observability, and developer trust.

 - Comfortable with creating with AI agents and hardening them: defining guardrails, adding evaluation/testing, and iterating based on real workflow feedback.

 - Comfortable with creating with agentic workflows: pros-cons of code based orchestration; cost analysis; scalability issues; very long running workflows; verification/ralph loops.

 - Systems-level debugging and performance thinking; you can identify bottlenecks, choose pragmatic fixes, and avoid accidental complexity.

 - Ability to multiply the team: clear written communication, high-quality reviews, and coaching/mentoring that helps others ship faster and better.

jobs.title: Enterprise Product Manager
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



Replit is the fastest way to turn ideas into software. With Replit Agent, anyone can build and ship a real application in natural language, without setting up a single tool. We've grown explosively, from $2M to $400M+ revenue in under a year, with a global community of 60+ million users, and Replit Agent is now one of the fastest-growing products in history.



That same wave is now hitting the enterprise. Companies like Visa, Ernst & Young and Comcast are rolling Replit out to thousands of employees so finance teams, operations leads, and product managers can build without waiting on an engineering backlog. When a company puts Replit in the hands of thousands of employees, they're trusting us with their data and their workflows. That trust has to be earned: SSO and SCIM that just work, governance their security team will sign off on, and real control over where their apps run and how their data is handled. Getting this right is what turns a pilot into a company-wide standard, and it's one of the biggest levers on Replit's next phase of growth.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a Staff Product Manager to own Replit's enterprise product end to end. We've built one of the best coding agents in the world. The work now is making it just as powerful inside a big company, where putting it in front of every non-technical employee unlocks enormous leverage. That means extending what Agent can do in an enterprise context and building the platform that lets large organizations adopt it safely and at scale.



This is a role with unusual leverage. We're still early in our enterprise journey but the traction is remarkable, which means most of the platform is still to be built and you'll have an outsized hand in shaping it. You'll decide what we build next, why, and in what order, then drive it to ship with engineering, design, and a sales team that's closing deals every day.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Own the enterprise roadmap end to end. Set the strategy and priorities for everything that makes large companies successful on Replit, from getting through procurement to driving daily usage and expansion across the account.

 - Make Replit Agent the best in the world at solving business problems for non-technical users. Turn our coding agent into the fastest path from idea to solving a real problem through software, with the connectors, skills, and workflows enterprise teams need to do mission-critical work.

 - Build the enterprise platform. Own the capabilities serious buyers depend on: identity and access (SSO, SCIM), admin and governance, data privacy and compliance, and flexible deployment options like single-tenant and Cloud-Prem.

 - Drive land-and-expand. Build the product-led motion that grows a handful of builders into a company-wide rollout, helping teams get more value from Agent, connectors, and reusable workflows along the way.

 - Partner cross-functionally. Work hand in hand with engineering, design, sales, and security, turning what you learn from won and lost deals into product that ships.

 - Be the voice of the enterprise customer. Spend real time with customers, on calls, in security reviews, and on-site, and carry those needs back into a company that grew up serving individuals and prosumers.
   
   


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 6+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 focused on enterprise products.

 - Fluency with IT and admin buyer personas and what they need to adopt and roll out software at scale.

 - Excellent communication and cross-functional skills, with a track record of moving work forward across engineering, design, sales, and security.

 - Strong technical judgment. You can understand deep technical concepts and go deep with engineers on security and infrastructure topics.
   
   


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience selling into regulated industries and familiarity with frameworks like SOC 2 and HIPAA.

 - Experience at a scale-up that grew its enterprise motion from infancy to scale.
